abstract.text: We argue that health programs are administered in settings that often violate the frequently stated assumption of constant returns to scale in the provision of health services. Three types of returns to scale are identified from the general economic literature: returns to scale with respect to population, effectiveness, and quality. We show that decision rules based on incremental cost-effectiveness ratios or cost-benefit tests are not optimal if returns to scale are not constant. We derive the optimal decision rules under variable returns to scale using optimization techniques, and employ several examples to illustrate the concepts and methods.

10.1002/hec.793.abstractZh: 我们认为，健康项目的实施往往违反了一个被广泛认可的假设，即提供健康服务时规模报酬是恒定的。从一般经济文献中识别出三种规模报酬：与人口、效果和质量相关的规模报酬。我们指出，如果规模报酬不是恒定的，那么基于增量成本效益比率或成本效益测试的决策规则并非最优。我们使用优化技术推导出了在可变规模报酬下的最优决策规则，并通过几个例子来阐释这些概念和方法。

abstract.text: The health risk of smoking is valued using the contingent valuation method, applied to a Swedish sample of smokers. The respondents were asked to put a value on newly developed cigarettes with no associated health risks. The average additional willingness to pay for the new cigarettes is estimated to be between 10 and 41 SEK per pack, where the variation is due to statistical method, discounting, and whether the open-ended or closed-ended question format is used. Using medical data on life shortening effects of smoking, the results indicate rather low values put on a lost life-year, compared to most existing estimates based on other methods. This may indicate that smokers do underestimate the health risk of smoking. There is also initial optimism-bias regarding people's own ability to quit smoking at will. However, there are remaining methodological questions and we found little or no sensitivity to scope.

10.1002/hec.794.abstractZh: 本研究采用条件估值法来评估吸烟的健康风险，研究对象为瑞典的吸烟者。受访者被要求为新型无健康风险的香烟进行估值。估计新型香烟的额外支付意愿平均为每包10至41瑞典克朗，这种差异源于统计方法、折现因素以及采用开放式还是封闭式问题的形式。根据关于吸烟导致寿命缩短的医学数据，结果表明，与大多数基于其他方法的估计相比，人们对失去一年寿命的价值评估相对较低。这可能表明，吸烟者低估了吸烟的健康风险。此外，关于人们自行戒烟的能力，也存在初步的乐观偏差。不过，该研究仍存在方法学上的问题，且对研究范围的敏感性较低或几乎没有。

abstract.text: Standard gamble (SG) is commonly used to elicit preferences in order to assess health related quality of life. There has been little qualitative research exploring how respondents answer such questions. An SG study was designed to elicit values for the health states associated with anti-hypertensive medication, stroke and cardiovascular disease. This paper describes a qualitative study that was carried out alongside the SG exercise in order to document the thought processes respondents bring to bear in formulating their responses. Data were generated using 'think aloud' techniques and semi-structured interviews. Values were generally well-constructed: responses were thoroughly considered, and respondents made complex trade-offs and arrived at a point of indifference. However, some respondents incorporated inappropriate information into their choices, redefining the hypothetical 'Option B' resulting in problems interpreting the probabilistic information. Consideration of non-health factors was commonplace, in particular the impact of choices on others. We discuss these findings in terms of the use of qualitative methods in health economics and the wider discourse surrounding the theoretical underpinnings of health state valuation.

10.1002/hec.795.abstractZh: 标准赌博法（SG）通常用于引出偏好，以评估与健康相关的生活质量。关于受访者如何回答此类问题的定性研究相对较少。本研究旨在引出与抗高血压药物、中风和心血管疾病相关的健康状态的价值观。本文描述了一项与标准赌博法研究同时进行的定性研究，旨在记录受访者在形成回答时所使用的思维过程。数据通过“思维外显”技术和半结构化访谈获得。受访者给出的价值观通常结构良好：他们充分考虑了各种因素，并做出了复杂的权衡，最终达到了无差别的状态。然而，一些受访者在选择中加入了不适当的信息，导致假设的“选项B”被重新定义，从而影响了概率信息的解释。非健康因素也被广泛考虑，尤其是选择对他人的影响。我们将从定性方法在健康经济学中的应用以及围绕健康状态估值理论基础的更广泛讨论的角度来探讨这些发现。

abstract.text: This research examines the responsiveness of the demand for marijuana to changes in its money price and criminal status using data on individuals from the Australian National Drug Strategy's Household Surveys (NDSHS). The results suggest that both the prevalence of marijuana use and the conditional demand for marijuana in the general population are responsive to changes in its money price. Significant differences are found in the effect of price on participation in marijuana use across age-groups, with participation by youth more price sensitive than participation by older age-groups. Similarly, the effect of the legal status of marijuana use on the participation decision is found to differ across age-groups and gender. Specifically, decriminalisation is associated with an increases in the prevalence of use by males over the age of 25. There is no evidence that decriminalisation significantly increases participation in marijuana use by either young males or females, or that decriminalisation increases the frequency of use among marijuana users.

10.1002/hec.796.abstractZh: 本研究利用澳大利亚国家药物战略的家庭调查数据，探讨了大麻需求对其货币价格及犯罪状况变化的反应。研究结果表明，大麻使用的普遍程度以及普通人群对大麻的条件需求都对其货币价格的变化有反应。不同年龄组在价格对大麻使用参与度的影响上存在显著差异，青少年对价格的敏感度高于老年人群体。同样，大麻使用的法律状况对参与决策的影响也因年龄和性别而异。具体而言，合法化与25岁以上男性使用大麻的普遍程度增加有关。但没有证据表明合法化显著增加了年轻男性或女性的大麻使用率，也没有证据表明合法化增加了大麻使用者的使用频率。

abstract.text: This paper explores and critically discusses some of the methodological limitations of using the number-needed-to-treat (NNT) in economic evaluation. We argue that NNT may be a straightforward measure of benefit when the effect of an intervention is immediate, but that serious problems arise when the effect is delay rather than avoidance of an adverse event. In this case, NNT is not a robust or accurate measure of effect, but will vary considerably and inconsistently over time. This weakness will naturally spill over onto any CEA based on NNT. A literature review demonstrated that CEAs based on NNT were all published within the last five years, and that all studies suffered from important limitations. A major weakness of using NNT is the imposed restrictions on the outcome measure, which can only be strictly uni-dimensional and non-generic. Using NNT in economic evaluations is obtained at a cost in terms of both methodological shortcomings, and a reduced ability for such evaluations to serve as a useful tool in decision making processes. The use of NNT in economic evaluations might be better avoided. To every complicated question, there is a simple, straightforward, easy--and probably wrong answer (Occam's Sledgehammer).

10.1002/hec.797.abstractZh: 本文探讨并批判性地分析了在经济学评估中使用“所需治疗次数”（NNT）的方法论局限性。我们认为，当干预措施的效果是立竿见影时，NNT可能是一个直接衡量效益的指标，但当效果需要延迟而非避免不良事件时，就会出现严重的问题。在这种情况下，NNT并不是一个稳健或准确的衡量效果的工具，其数值会随时间发生显著且不一致的变化。这种弱点自然会影响到所有基于NNT的经济评估方法。文献回顾表明，所有基于NNT的经济评估方法都是在过去五年内发表的，而且所有研究都存在重要的局限性。使用NNT的一个主要缺点是它对结果衡量方式的限制，这种衡量方式只能是严格的一维的且不具备普遍性。在经济学评估中使用NNT会带来方法论上的缺陷，同时也会降低这些评估作为决策工具的有效性。因此，最好避免在经济评估中使用NNT。对于每一个复杂的问题，总有一个简单、直接且容易理解的答案——尽管这个答案可能是错误的（奥卡姆剃刀原理）。

abstract.text: This paper uses a full-information maximum likelihood estimation procedure, the Discrete Factor Method, to estimate the relationship between birthweight and prenatal care. This technique controls for the potential biases surrounding both the sample selection of the pregnancy-resolution decision and the endogeneity of prenatal care. In addition, we use the actual number of prenatal care visits; other studies have normally measured prenatal care as the month care is initiated. We estimate a birthweight production function using 1993 data from the US state of Texas. The results underscore the importance of correcting for estimation problems. Specifically, a model that does not control for sample selection and endogeneity overestimates the benefit of an additional visit for women who have relatively few visits. This overestimation may indicate 'positive fetal selection,' i.e., women who did not abort may have healthier babies. Also, a model that does not control for self-selection and endogenity predicts that past 17 visits, an additional visit leads to lower birthweight, while a model that corrects for these estimation problems predicts a positive effect for additional visits. This result shows the effect of mothers with less healthy fetuses making more prenatal care visits, known as 'adverse selection' in prenatal care.

10.1002/hec.801.abstractZh: 本文采用全信息最大似然估计方法，即离散因子法，来估计出生体重与产前护理之间的关系。该技术能够控制影响妊娠终止决策的样本选择以及产前护理的内生性所带来的潜在偏差。此外，我们使用了实际产前护理次数作为衡量指标；其他研究通常将产前护理定义为护理开始的时间点。我们基于1993年美国德克萨斯州的数据，估计了出生体重的生产函数。研究结果强调了纠正估计问题的重要性。具体而言，一个未控制样本选择和内生性的模型会高估那些接受较少次产前护理的女性的额外护理所带来的益处。这种高估可能表明存在“积极胎儿选择”现象，即那些没有堕胎的女性可能生出自愈力更强的婴儿。同时，一个未控制自我选择和内生性的模型预测，在接受了17次产前护理之后，额外的护理会导致出生体重下降，而一个纠正了这些估计问题的模型则预测额外护理会带来积极效果。这一结果表明，那些胎儿健康状况较差的母亲进行更多次产前护理的行为，实际上是一种“逆向选择”现象，即在产前护理中，健康状况较差的母亲反而能够带来更多的护理机会。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to study excess capacity in National Health System (NHS) hospitals, which have the characteristics of a bureaucracy, within a theoretically consistent framework. In this sense, we develop and estimate an empirical model which has not previously been applied to this problem. This model, based on an input distance function, is attractive for at least two reasons. Unlike the production function, the input distance function is valid for multiproduct technologies such as that of hospitals, and in contrast to the cost function it permits testing of the cost minimisation hypothesis and therefore allows expense preference behaviour in the context of NHS hospitals. We present an application to the Spanish public hospital sector and observe persistent allocative inefficiency in variable inputs and overcapitalisation in these hospitals. Hence, our results suggest that this sector is not in long-run equilibrium and that adjustments in variable inputs and capital equipment investments are necessary to control hospital cost.

10.1002/hec.803.abstractZh: 本文旨在在一个理论上一致的框架内，研究具有官僚特征的国家卫生系统医院中的过剩产能问题。为此，我们开发并估计了一个此前未应用于该问题的实证模型。该模型基于输入距离函数，至少有两个优点：与生产函数不同，输入距离函数适用于多产品技术，如医院行业；与成本函数相比，它允许检验成本最小化假设，因此能够反映国家卫生系统医院中的费用偏好行为。我们将其应用于西班牙公立医院部门，发现这些医院在可变投入方面存在持续的配置效率低下问题，并且在资本投入方面存在过度投资的情况。因此，我们的研究结果表明，该部门并未处于长期均衡状态，需要对可变投入和资本设备投资进行调整，以控制医院成本。

abstract.text: Decision analytical models are widely used in economic evaluation of health care interventions with the objective of generating valuable information to assist health policy decision-makers to allocate scarce health care resources efficiently. The whole decision modelling process can be summarised in four stages: (i) a systematic review of the relevant data (including meta-analyses), (ii) estimation of all inputs into the model (including effectiveness, transition probabilities and costs), (iii) sensitivity analysis for data and model specifications, and (iv) evaluation of the model. The aim of this paper is to demonstrate how the individual components of decision modelling, outlined above, may be addressed simultaneously in one coherent Bayesian model (sometimes known as a comprehensive decision analytical model) and evaluated using Markov Chain Monte Carlo simulation implemented in the specialist software WinBUGS. To illustrate the method described, it is applied to two illustrative examples: (1) The prophylactic use of neurominidase inhibitors for the prevention of influenza. (2) The use of taxanes for the second-line treatment of advanced breast cancer. The advantages of integrating the four stages outlined into one comprehensive decision analytical model, compared to the conventional 'two-stage' approach, are discussed.

10.1002/hec.804.abstractZh: 决策分析模型在医疗干预的经济评估中得到了广泛应用，其目的在于生成有价值的信息，以帮助卫生政策决策者有效分配有限的医疗资源。整个决策建模过程可以概括为四个阶段：(i) 对相关数据进行系统性的回顾（包括元分析），(ii) 估算模型中所有输入参数（包括效果、转移概率和成本），(iii) 对数据和模型规格进行敏感性分析，以及(iv) 对模型进行评估。本文旨在说明，上述决策建模的各个组成部分如何可以在一个连贯的贝叶斯模型中同时得到处理，并通过专用软件WinBUGS实现的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗模拟来进行评估。为了说明所描述的方法，本文以两个示例为例进行说明：(1) 使用神经苷酶抑制剂预防流感的预防性应用。(2) 使用紫杉烷类药物作为晚期乳腺癌的二线治疗。文章还讨论了将这四个阶段整合到一个全面的决策分析模型中，与传统的“两阶段”方法相比所具有的优势。

abstract.text: Background The person trade-off (PTO) is a technique for eliciting preferences for resource allocation across patient groups. In principle PTO responses should satisfy a requirement of multiplicative transitivity, i.e. that if people consider treatment of 1 in state A to be equivalent to treating 10 in state B, and 1 in state B to be equivalent to 10 in state C, then they should find 1 in state A equivalent to 100 in state C. Earlier studies addressing labelled diseases (specific diagnoses), have shown multiplicative intransitivity of the PTO responses. Our purpose was to test multiplicative transitivity in the case of health states described with the EuroQol instrument only and to find a possible framing effect such as the number of persons in the reference intervention. Methods Forty-four master degree students were asked to fill in a questionnaire addressing four chronic health states. Their task consisted in (1). ranking the states by severity, (2). valuing each of them by the means of the time trade-off, and (3). doing the PTO for all the 10 possible pairwise combinations of the four chronic states plus a fatal one. In a subsequent questionnaire the number of persons in the reference intervention in the PTO was increased from 10 to 100. Multiplicative transitivity was studied in subjects who demonstrated a willingness to trade off and consistency in ranking individual values. Results None of the 39 subjects included satisfied a minimum multiplicative transitivity requirement in PTO responses. Internal consistency was not improved when the PTO involved health states close to each other in terms of severity, nor when the prevention of death was not the reference intervention. For the 22 subjects having answered both types of questionnaire, increasing the number of persons in the reference intervention did not improve multiplicative transitivity. Conclusions The PTO holds promise as a useful method for determining social preferences for priority setting, inasmuch as it captures distributive concerns that individual utility techniques such as the time trade-off do not address. But the lack of multiplicative transitivity in PTO responses is unsatisfactory, and ways to reduce this problem need to be explored.

10.1002/hec.808.abstractZh:
背景  
个人权衡（PTO）是一种用于引出对不同患者群体资源分配偏好的技术。原则上，PTO的回应应满足乘法传递性要求，即如果人们认为在状态A治疗1个患者等同于在状态B治疗10个患者，而在状态B治疗1个患者等同于在状态C治疗10个患者，那么他们应该认为在状态A治疗1个患者等同于在状态C治疗100个患者。早期针对特定疾病的研究表明，PTO的回应存在乘法非传递性。我们的目的是仅在用EuroQol工具描述的健康状态情况下测试乘法传递性，并寻找可能的框架效应，例如参考干预中的患者数量。  

方法  
44名硕士生被要求填写一份问卷，涉及四种慢性健康状态。他们的任务包括：(1)按严重程度对状态进行排序；(2)通过时间权衡来评估每个状态的价值；(3)对四种慢性状态以及一种致命情况的10种所有可能的组合进行PTO分析。在后续的问卷中，将参考干预中的患者数量从10增加到100。在表现出愿意进行权衡且个体价值排序一致性的受试者中，研究了乘法传递性。  

结果  
在39名受试者中，没有一名满足PTO回应中乘法传递性的最低要求。当PTO涉及在严重程度上相近的健康状态时，内部一致性并未得到改善；当预防死亡不是参考干预时，内部一致性同样没有改善。对于回答两种类型问卷的22名受试者来说，增加参考干预中的人数并没有改善乘法传递性。结论：PTO作为一种确定社会偏好以进行优先排序的有效方法具有潜力，因为它能够捕捉到个体效用技术（如时间权衡法）未能解决的分配问题。然而，PTO响应中缺乏乘法传递性这一情况令人不满意，需要探索减少这一问题的方法。

abstract.text: The payment scale format has been widely used in willingness-to-pay studies in health care. Concerns have been expressed that the format is, in theory, prone to range bias, although this proposition has not been tested directly. We report the findings of a contingent valuation questionnaire study of colorectal cancer screening, wherein different subjects were provided with payment scales of two different lengths. Whilst the long-scale instrument included scale values up to pound 1000, the short-scale version extended only to pound 100. After controlling for inter-sample differences in, for example, income, education and health behaviour, it emerged that the long-scale instrument produced a mean willingness to pay more than 30% higher than that resulting from the short-scale version. We believe our findings to be strongly supportive of the likelihood of range bias in payment-scale instruments, with important consequences for the estimation of both average valuation and consumer surplus.

10.1002/hec.809.abstractZh: 在医疗保健的支付意愿研究中，支付金额格式已被广泛使用。尽管这一假设尚未经过直接验证，但人们一直担心该格式在理论上可能存在范围偏差。我们报告了一项关于结直肠癌筛查的支付意愿评估研究的结果，其中不同受试者分别使用了两种不同长度的支付金额量表。长量表的最高金额达到1000英镑，而短量表则仅限100英镑。在控制了样本间在收入、教育水平和健康行为等方面的差异后，我们发现长量表得出的平均支付意愿比短量表高出30%以上。我们认为，我们的研究结果强烈支持了支付金额工具可能存在范围偏差的可能性，这对平均支付意愿和消费者剩余的计算具有重要影响。

abstract.text: While insomnia can be a symptom of numerous mental and physical illnesses, it is frequently diagnosed as a sleep disorder in its own right, caused mainly by stressful life events or by non-synchronization of individuals' biological sleep-wake cycle with the one they choose to practice. Because of irregular work schedules, late-night entertainment, or rapid crossing of several time zones, individuals might retire to bed earlier or later than their biological bedtime, experiencing difficulties in falling asleep. The present paper develops a simple economic model of the bedtime decision, viewing the individual as a rational decision-maker who determines her insomnia level through consciously weighing the cost and benefit of deviating from her biological bedtime. The model is then used to examine the individual's response to stress, yielding a prediction which is consistent with observed behavior, although not with sleep therapists' recommendations. Finally, the model is applied to the case of transmeridian flights, explaining jet lag as a rational adjustment to a misalignment between the individual's slow-to-adapt internal clock and her external environment.

10.1002/hec.810.abstractZh: 虽然失眠可能是许多精神和身体疾病的症状，但它经常被诊断为一种独立的睡眠障碍，主要由压力大的生活事件或个体生物钟与所选睡眠周期的不同步导致。由于不规律的工作安排、深夜娱乐活动或跨越多个时区，人们可能会比生物钟设定的睡眠时间更早或更晚上床，从而难以入睡。本文提出了一个简单的经济模型来描述关于就寝时间的决策过程，将个体视为一个理性决策者，他通过有意识地权衡偏离生物钟设定的睡眠时间的成本和收益来决定自己的失眠程度。该模型被用来分析个体对压力的反应，得出的预测结果与观察到的行为一致，尽管与睡眠治疗师的建议有所不同。最后，该模型被应用于跨时区飞行的案例，解释了时差现象是个体缓慢适应的内部生物钟与外部环境不匹配的一种理性调整方式。

abstract.text: Panel datasets provide a rich source of information for health economists, offering the scope to control for individual heterogeneity and to model the dynamics of individual behaviour. However the qualitative or categorical measures of outcome often used in health economics create special problems for estimating econometric models. Allowing a flexible specification of the autocorrelation induced by individual heterogeneity leads to models involving higher order integrals that cannot be handled by conventional numerical methods. The dramatic growth in computing power over recent years has been accompanied by the development of simulation-based estimators that solve this problem. This review uses binary choice models to show what can be done with conventional methods and how the range of models can be expanded by using simulation methods. Practical applications of the methods are illustrated using data on health from the British Household Panel Survey (BHPS).

10.1002/hec.811.abstractZh: 面板数据集为健康经济学家提供了丰富的信息来源，使得他们能够控制个体异质性，并建模个体行为的动态变化。然而，健康经济学中常用的定性或分类性结果度量方法在估计计量经济模型时常常带来特殊问题。允许对由个体异质性引起的自相关进行灵活处理，会导致需要使用高阶积分的模型，而这些模型无法用传统的数值方法处理。近年来，计算能力的显著增长伴随着基于模拟的估计器的发展，这些估计器解决了这一问题。本综述使用二元选择模型来展示传统方法可以做什么，以及通过使用模拟方法如何扩展模型范围。文中以英国家庭面板调查中的健康数据为例，说明了这些方法的实际应用。

abstract.text: We present a model of the labor market effects of health impairments. In particular, we describe several economic models in which health affects worker productivity and the demand for and supply of market labor services. These models provide a framework for estimating the social cost of prevalent health impairments - a necessary step in conducting cost-benefit analyses and in determining the cost-effectiveness of potential health interventions from a broader social perspective. Our approach suggests that several measures used in the literature provide an incomplete and systematically biased assessment of the economic impact of health impairment or of the treatment of illness and impairment. The problem arises because of the reliance on an approximation at the firm level and from the bias from the neglect of the effect of impairment in shifting the labor market equilibrium. If the illness is prevalent, the effects on labor market equilibrium wage rates could be substantial. In addition, many analyses also ignore the effects of illness on producers' surplus.

10.1002/hec.812.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于健康障碍对劳动力市场影响的模型。具体来说，我们描述了几种经济模型，这些模型表明健康状况会影响工人的生产力以及市场劳动力服务的需求与供应。这些模型为估算普遍存在的健康障碍的社会成本提供了框架——这是进行成本效益分析以及从更广泛的社会角度评估潜在健康干预措施的成本效益的必要步骤。我们的研究表明，文献中使用的许多衡量指标无法全面且准确地评估健康障碍或疾病治疗的经济影响。问题的根源在于，这些衡量指标依赖于企业层面的近似计算，并且忽视了健康障碍对劳动力市场均衡的影响。如果疾病普遍存在，其对劳动力市场均衡工资率的影响可能是显著的。此外，许多分析还忽略了疾病对生产者剩余的影响。

abstract.text: This paper utilizes maximum likelihood methods to simulate a Hirschman-Herfindahl index (HHI) for markets in which complete market share information is unavailable or delayed. Many jurisdictions either may be unable to administratively collect data or experience delays in collection that make data regarding turbulent markets of limited use. With the development of this method, regulatory authorities monitoring health-care competition or health-care firms can now use market surveys--in which reliable recall is often limited to the largest three or four firms--to produce an on-the-spot measure of market concentration.

10.1002/hec.814.abstractZh: 本文采用最大似然方法，模拟了在缺乏完整市场份额信息或信息延迟的市场中赫希曼-赫芬达尔指数（HHI）的测算。许多司法管辖区可能无法有效收集数据，或者数据收集存在延迟，这使得关于动荡市场的数据难以使用。通过这种方法的发展，监管当局在监测医疗保健竞争或医疗保健企业时，可以使用市场调查——通常可靠的调查范围仅限于最大的三到四家企业——来实时衡量市场集中度。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of an intervention to provide easier access to pharmacists for patients with minor ailments. The intervention allowed pharmacists to prescribe and dispense medicines currently limited to general practitioners (GPs) without patients losing their right to free prescriptions. We show that the total number of GP consultations was unaffected by the intervention but that the proportion which were for minor ailments decreased. We also use estimate multinomial models of patient choices between GP and pharmacies and find that the main determinant is the type of minor ailment. Distance appears to have no effect on patient choice.

10.1002/hec.815.abstractZh: 我们研究了为轻度疾病患者提供更便捷的药师服务干预措施的效果。该干预措施允许药师开具和分发目前仅限于全科医生处理的药品，同时患者无需失去免费处方的权利。我们发现，全科医生就诊的总数量并未受到该干预措施的影响，但用于处理轻度疾病的就诊比例有所下降。我们还使用多项多项式模型来研究患者选择全科医生还是药店的情况，结果发现主要决定因素是疾病的类型。距离似乎对患者的选择没有影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use data from the Health Survey of England to show that problem drinking is negatively and significantly associated with the probability of being in work, once the endogenous relationship between these outcomes is accounted for. Being a problem drinker leads to a substantial reduction in the probability of working by between 7 and 31%, the former figure being roughly equivalent to the positive effect of having a degree relative to no qualifications in our data. This finding is robust to a variety of identifying restrictions and definitions of problem drinking. Moreover, we find that problem drinking defined by the observed psychological and physical symptoms of alcohol is an important predictor of employment, and allows for the fact that individuals differ in their tolerance or susceptibility to alcohol. Our results suggest that there may be important labour market benefits from public health policies aimed at the prevention and treatment of problem drinking.

10.1002/hec.816.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用了英格兰健康调查的数据，发现一旦考虑到这些结果之间的内生关系后，问题饮酒与就业概率之间存在显著的负相关关系。问题饮酒者的工作概率会显著减少7%到31%，其中前者的值大致相当于我们数据中拥有学位与没有学位相比所产生的正面影响。这一发现不受多种识别限制和问题饮酒定义的影响。此外，我们发现，以酒精引起的心理和生理症状来定义的问题饮酒，是就业的重要预测因素，同时也考虑到个体在酒精耐受性或易感性方面的差异。我们的研究结果表明，针对问题饮酒的预防和治疗方法可能具有重要的劳动力市场效益。

abstract.text: A managed-care company must decide on allocating resources of many services to many groups of enrollees. The profit-maximizing allocation rule is characterized. For each group, the marginal utilities across all services are equalized. The equilibrium has an enrollee group shadow price interpretation. The equilibrium spending allocation can be implemented by letting utilitarian physicians decide on service spending on an enrollee group subject to a budget for the group.

10.1002/hec.817.abstractZh: 一家管理式护理公司必须决定如何将多种服务的资源分配给不同的患者群体。文中描述了利润最大化的资源分配规则：对于每一个群体，所有服务的边际效用都是相等的。这种均衡状态具有“患者群体影子价格”的含义。通过让功利主义医生根据群体的预算来决定对某一患者群体的服务支出，可以实现这种均衡的支出分配。

abstract.text: This paper presents a comparison of willingness to pay (WTP) estimates generated from a dichotomous choice (DC) contingent valuation experiment and a choice experiment (CE). The study was conducted with subjects undergoing assisted reproductive techniques in the Grampian area of Scotland. Subjects first completed a DC WTP questionnaire. They were sent a CE questionnaire two months later. Welfare estimates for the DC WTP study and CE were not significantly different. Important research questions are raised concerning the validity of the various approaches to estimating WTP.

10.1002/hec.818.abstractZh: 本文对比了通过二分选择条件价值评估实验和选择实验得出的支付意愿估计结果。研究对象为在苏格兰格拉普尼亚地区接受辅助生殖技术的受试者。受试者首先完成了一份二分选择支付意愿问卷，两个月后收到了一份选择实验问卷。二分选择支付意愿研究与选择实验的福利估计结果并无显著差异。关于估算支付意愿的不同方法的有效性，本文提出了重要的研究问题。

abstract.text: The implementation of colorectal cancer mass screening is a high public health priority in France, as in most other industrialised countries. Despite evidences that screening using guaiac fecal occult blood test may reduce colorectal cancer mortality, no European country has organised widespread mass screening with this test. The low sensitivity of this test constitutes its main limitation. Immunological tests, which provide higher sensitivity than the guaiac test, may constitute a satisfactory alternative. This study was carried out to compare the costs and the effectiveness of 20 years of biennial colorectal cancer (CRC) screening with an automated reading immunological test (Magstream) with those obtained with a guaiac stool test (Haemoccult). The model used to estimate the costs and effectiveness of successive biennial CRC screening campaigns was a transitional probabilistic model. The parameters used in this model concerning costs and CRC epidemiological data were calculated from results obtained in the screening program run in Calvados or from published results of foreign studies because of the lack of French studies. The use of Magstream for 20 years of biennial screening costs 59 euros more than Haemoccult per target individual, and should lead to a mean increase in individual life expectancy of 0.0198 years (i.e. about one week), which corresponds to an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio of 2980 euros per years of life saved. Our results suggest that using an immunological test could increase the effectiveness of CRC screening at a reasonable cost for society.

10.1002/hec.819.abstractZh: 在法国，像大多数其他工业化国家一样，实施结直肠癌大规模筛查是公共卫生领域的优先事项。尽管有证据表明使用愈创木酚粪便隐血试验进行筛查可能降低结直肠癌死亡率，但没有任何欧洲国家采用这种筛查方法开展大规模筛查。这种测试的低灵敏度是其主要局限性。免疫学测试的灵敏度高于愈创木酚测试，可能是一种可行的替代方案。本研究旨在比较使用自动化免疫学测试（Magstream）进行20年每两年一次的结直肠癌筛查与使用愈创木酚粪便测试（Haemoccult）的成本和效果。用于估算连续每两年一次结直肠癌筛查活动的成本和效果模型是一种过渡性概率模型。该模型中关于成本和结直肠癌流行病学数据的参数是根据卡尔瓦多斯地区的筛查项目结果或国外研究的结果计算得出的，因为缺乏法国的相关研究数据。使用Magstream进行20年每两年一次的筛查，每目标个体需要多花费59欧元，但平均个体预期寿命将增加0.0198年（约一周），这意味着每节省一年的寿命，成本效益比为2980欧元。我们的研究结果表明，使用免疫学测试可以在合理的成本范围内提高结直肠癌筛查的效果。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to estimate the demand for tar and nicotine in cigarettes as a function of cigarette prices in a cohort of cigarette 11,966 smokers followed for 5 years. Data for the analysis come from a longitudinal telephone survey of 11,966 smokers who were interviewed in 1988 and 1993 as part of the Community Intervention Trial for Smoking Cessation (COMMIT). Separate models are estimated for three age groups to account for differences in levels of addiction and brand loyalty across age. We found that smokers respond to higher cigarette prices by reducing the number of cigarettes smoked per day but also by switching to cigarettes that are higher in tar and nicotine per cigarette.

10.1002/hec.820.abstractZh: 本文的目的是通过追踪一组11,966名吸烟者5年的数据，来估算香烟中焦油与尼古丁的需求量，以及这些需求与香烟价格之间的关系。分析数据来自一项纵向电话调查，该调查在1988年和1993年对11,966名吸烟者进行了采访，这项调查是“社区戒烟干预试验”（COMMIT）的一部分。为了考虑不同年龄段的成瘾程度和品牌忠诚度差异，我们为三个年龄组分别建立了模型。研究发现，吸烟者面对较高的香烟价格时，会减少每天吸烟的支数，同时也会选择焦油与尼古丁含量更高的香烟。

abstract.text: Discrete choice experiments have the advantage that they can study preferences in health care where revealed preference data is not readily available. However, as a substitute for actual observed market led data, the experimental set-up for hypothetical situations must mimic the circumstances under which actual choices are made. One situation that a consumer/patient might face is an opt-out option. They might not choose to accept any of the positive actions available and as such will be a non-demander of the health care on offer. This paper explores issues raised in the modelling of such data within an experiment looking at women's preferences for cervical screening services.

10.1002/hec.821.abstractZh: 离散选择实验的优势在于能够研究在难以获得显性偏好数据的情况下对医疗保健的偏好选择。然而，作为实际市场数据替代方案，实验设置必须模拟实际做出选择的情境。消费者/患者可能面临的一种情况是选择退出选项。他们可能不选择接受任何提供的积极措施，因此不会要求所提供的医疗保健服务。本文探讨了在实验中对女性对宫颈筛查服务的偏好进行建模时所涉及的问题。

abstract.text: This paper outlines a framework for comparing empirically overall health inequality and socioeconomic health inequality. The framework, which is developed for both individual-level data and grouped data, is illustrated using data on malnutrition amongst Vietnamese children and on health utility amongst Canadian adults. In both cases, the degree of socioeconomic inequality is estimated at around 25% of overall inequality.

10.1002/hec.822.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于从实证角度比较整体健康不平等与社会经济健康不平等。该框架适用于个体层面数据及分组数据，并以越南儿童营养不良数据以及加拿大成年人健康效用数据为例进行说明。在这两个案例中，社会经济不平等的程度估计约为整体不平等的25%。

abstract.text: We study the cost structure and efficiency of Dutch general hospitals over the period 1985-1995. Several studies on the efficiency of hospitals now exist. Most of them start from the assumption that hospital management attempts to minimize cost. We went beyond this assumption by trying to collect empirical evidence on management behaviour with respect to patient selection. We did so by estimating both the direct cost function and the indirect cost function as proposed by Färe and Primont and compared the results. We found that acknowledging the possibility of output reallocation increases the validity of optimizing models in the hospital sector but a complete indirect optimizing model ignores that some output categories are less flexible especially in the short run. Endogenous shifts in the allocation of patients appear to be realized through time by increased specialization of hospitals. We suggest that a mixed direct-indirect cost model is probably preferable.

10.1002/hec.824.abstractZh: 我们研究了1985至1995年间荷兰综合医院的成本结构与效率。目前已有多项关于医院效率的研究。大多数研究都假设医院管理层试图将成本降至最低。我们超越了这一假设，试图收集有关管理层在患者选择方面的行为的实证证据。我们通过估算Färe和Primont提出的直接成本函数与间接成本函数，并比较两者的结果来实现这一目标。我们发现，承认产出重新分配的可能性可以提高医院部门优化模型的准确性，但完整的间接优化模型忽略了某些产出类别在短期内缺乏灵活性这一事实。患者分配的变动似乎是通过医院的专业化分工随时间实现的。我们认为，混合的直接-间接成本模型可能更为合适。

abstract.text: We describe a method for estimating the cost-effectiveness of a new treatment compared to a standard, using data from a comparative clinical trial. We quantify the clinical effectiveness as a binary variable indicating success or failure. The underlying statistical model assumes that costs are uncensored and follow separate gamma distributions in each of the groups defined by the four possible combinations of treatment arm and effectiveness outcome. The method is subjectivist, in that it represents prior uncertainty about model parameters with a probability distribution, which we update via Bayes's theorem to produce a posterior distribution. We approximate the posterior by importance sampling, a straightforward simulation method. We illustrate the method with an analysis of cost (derived from resource usage data) and effectiveness (measured by one-year survival) in a clinical trial in heart disease. The example demonstrates that the method is practical and provides for a flexible data analysis.

10.1002/hec.825.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种方法，用于根据比较性临床试验的数据，估算一种新治疗方法与标准治疗之间的成本效益。我们将临床效果量化为一个二元变量，表示成功或失败。所采用的统计模型假设成本未被限制，并且每个治疗组的成本遵循独立的伽马分布，这些组由治疗组和效果结果四种可能的组合构成。该方法采用主观性假设，即用概率分布来表示对模型参数的先验不确定性，并通过贝叶斯定理更新这些概率分布以得到后验分布。我们通过重要性抽样来近似后验分布，这是一种直接的模拟方法。我们通过分析一项心脏病临床试验中的成本（基于资源使用数据）和效果（以一年生存率衡量）来说明该方法的应用。该示例表明，该方法具有实用性，并且能够灵活地进行数据分析。

abstract.text: Zweifel and colleagues have previously proposed that proximity to death is a more important influence on health-care costs than age, suggesting that demographic change per se will not have a large impact on future aggregate health expenditure. However, issues of econometric methodology have led to challenges of the robustness of these findings. This paper revisits the analysis. Using a longitudinal hospital data set from Oxfordshire, England, the two-step Heckman model from the Zweifel study is first replicated, to find that neither age nor proximity to death have a significant effect on hospital costs. Econometric problems with the model are demonstrated, and instead a two-part model shows both age and proximity to death to have significant effects on quarterly hospital costs. Cost predictions, calculated with bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals, further demonstrate that while age may significantly affect quarterly costs, these cost changes are small compared to the tripling of quarterly costs that occurs with approaching death in the last year of life. The analyses show the importance of model selection to properly assess the determinants of health-care expenditures.

10.1002/hec.826.abstractZh: Zweifel及其同事之前提出，与死亡的距离对医疗成本的影响比年龄更为重要，这表明人口结构变化本身对未来的总体医疗支出不会产生太大影响。然而，计量经济学方法方面的问题使得这些发现的稳健性受到了质疑。本文重新审视了这一分析。利用来自英格兰牛津郡的纵向医院数据集，重新应用了Zweifel研究的两步Heckman模型，结果发现年龄和与死亡的距离对医院成本都没有显著影响。该模型存在的计量经济学问题得到了证实，而一个包含两部分模型的实验表明，年龄和与死亡的距离都对季度医院成本有显著影响。通过自助法计算出的95%置信区间进一步表明，虽然年龄可能对季度成本产生显著影响，但这些变化与在生命最后一年临近死亡时季度成本增加三倍的情况相比微不足道。这些分析表明，正确评估医疗支出决定因素时，模型选择的重要性不言而喻。

abstract.text: Using econometric evidence, this article confirms that distribution of medicines online is split into two market segments of very diverse quality, and identifies the factors that drive quality and quality assurance in this activity. Unlike fraudulent, 'rogue,' websites, which offer scant guarantees and usually sell just a few medicines without prescription, online pharmacies offering insurance coverage and linked to conventional pharmacies typically sell a whole range of drugs, require third-party medical prescriptions and provide abundant information to patients. It is shown that, where online pharmacies are allowed to act legally, market forces enhance quality, as private insurers require professional standards, and specialized third parties make a business of certifying them. Furthermore, older online pharmacies and those running conventional operations offer higher quality, probably because of reputational investments. Overall, this evidence supports licensing online pharmacies, especially considering that prohibiting them is ineffective against fraudulent sites.

10.1002/hec.827.abstractZh: 本文通过计量经济学证据证实，在线药品分销市场分为两个质量差异巨大的细分市场，并揭示了推动该领域质量与质量保证的因素。与提供极少保障且通常只销售少数无需处方的药品的欺诈性网站不同，提供保险服务并与传统药店合作的在线药店通常销售多种药品，要求第三方医疗处方，并为患者提供丰富的信息。研究表明，在允许在线药店合法经营的情况下，市场力量会提升质量，因为私人保险公司要求专业标准，而专业的第三方机构则负责对其质量进行认证。此外，经营时间较长的在线药店以及采用传统运营模式的药店往往能提供更高的质量，这可能是由于它们进行了良好的声誉建设。总体而言，这些证据支持对在线药店进行许可制度，尤其是考虑到禁止这些药店对打击欺诈性网站并无效果。

abstract.text: Nursing homes vary widely between facilities with very few beds and facilities with several hundred beds. Previous studies, which estimate nursing home scale and scope economies, do not account for this heterogeneity and implicitly assume that all nursing homes face the same cost structure. To account for heterogeneity, this paper uses quantile regression to estimate cost functions for skilled and intermediate care nursing homes. The results show that the parameters of nursing home cost functions vary significantly by output mix and across the cost distribution. Estimates show that product-specific scale economies systematically increase across the cost distribution for both skilled and intermediate care facilities, with diseconomies of scale in the lower deciles and no significant scale economies in the higher deciles. As for ray scale economies, estimates show economies of scale in the lower deciles and diseconomies of scale or no significant scale economies at higher deciles. The estimates also show that scope economies exist in the lower cost deciles and that no scope economies exist in the higher cost deciles. Additionally, the degree of scope economies monotonically decreases across the deciles.

10.1002/hec.828.abstractZh: 不同养老院在床位数量上存在很大差异，有的养老院床位很少，而有的则拥有数百张床位。以往的研究在估算养老院的规模和经济效率时，并未考虑这种异质性，并隐含地假设所有养老院都面临相同的成本结构。为了考虑这种异质性，本文采用分位数回归方法来估算专业护理和中级护理养老院的成本函数。研究结果表明，养老院成本函数的参数随着产出组合的不同以及成本分布的不同而显著变化。估计结果显示，对于专业护理和中级护理设施而言，特定产品的规模经济在成本分布的不同层级都有体现，而在较低的分位数区间则存在规模不经济，而在较高分位数区间则没有显著的规模经济。至于射线规模经济，估计结果显示在较低分位数区间存在规模经济，而在较高分位数区间则存在规模不经济或没有显著的规模经济。此外，估计还显示，在较低成本的分位数区间存在范围经济，而在较高成本的分位数区间则不存在范围经济。另外，范围经济的程度随着分位数的变化而单调递减。

abstract.text: Government projections of future health care expenditures--a great concern given the aging baby-boom generation--are based on econometric regressions that control explicitly for age but do not control for end-of-life expenditures. Because expenditures increase dramatically on average at the end of life, predictions of future cost distributions based on regressions that omit time to death as an explanatory variable will be biased upward (or, more explicitly, the coefficients on age will be biased upward) if technology or other social factors continue to prolong life. Although health care expenditure predictions for a current sample will not be biased, predictions for future cohorts with greater longevity will be biased upwards, and the magnitude of the bias will increase as the expected longevity increases. We explore the empirical implications of incorporating time to death in longitudinal models of health expenditures for the purpose of predicting future expenditures. Predictions from a simple model that excludes time to death and uses current life tables are 9% higher than from an expanded model controlling for time to death. The bias increases to 15% when using projected life tables for 2020. The predicted differences between the models are sufficient to justify reassessment of the value of inclusion of time to death in models for predicting health care expenditures.

10.1002/hec.831.abstractZh: 政府对未来医疗保健支出的预测，鉴于老龄化的一代人群，是一个值得关注的问题。这些预测基于计量经济学回归分析，虽然明确考虑了年龄因素，但并未考虑临终时的支出情况。由于临终时的支出平均会显著增加，因此如果技术或其他社会因素继续延长寿命，基于忽略死亡时间的回归分析所做出的未来成本预测将会出现偏差（或者更明确地说，年龄系数将会出现偏差）。尽管对当前样本进行医疗保健支出预测时不会出现偏差，但对于寿命较长的未来人群，预测结果将会出现偏差，且随着预期寿命的增加，这种偏差的幅度也会增大。我们探讨了在纵向健康支出模型中纳入死亡时间因素对预测未来支出的实际意义。一个简单模型，仅使用当前生命表进行预测，其结果比包含死亡时间因素的扩展模型高出9%。当使用2020年的预测生命表时，这种偏差增加到15%。模型之间的预测差异足以证明在预测医疗保健支出时重新评估纳入死亡时间因素的价值是合理的。

abstract.text: This paper sheds light into the investigation of differential patterns of utilisation of physician services by populations subgroups that is emerging in a number of studies. Using Spanish data from the National Health Survey of 1997 we try to explain the distinct role of the type of insurance on the choice between specialists and GPs and its intertwining with the choice between private and public providers. We estimate a two-stages probit to conclude that differences in insurance access is the main determinant of both, the choice of sector and the kind of physician contacted, giving rise to very different patterns of consumption of GP and specialist visits. People with only public insurance go 2.8 times to the GP per one time that they visit a specialist; individuals with duplicate coverage have a ratio of GP/specialist visits equal to 1.4 (the combination being public GP and private specialist) and people with only private insurance access actually have an 'inverted' pattern of visits: they contact specialists more often than GPs. Age, sex and health and public supply characteristics also have a distinct and interesting impact on these choices. Finally, equity concerns based on the implied assumption that specialists care is superior to general practitioner care are discussed.

10.1002/hec.832.abstractZh: 本文探讨了多项研究中出现的关于不同人群对医生服务利用差异模式的研究现象。我们利用1997年西班牙国家健康调查的数据，试图解释保险类型对选择专科医生与全科医生的影响，以及这种选择如何与选择私人或公共医疗服务提供者相关联。通过两阶段Probit模型分析，我们发现保险获取方式的差异是选择医疗服务提供者和就诊医生类型的主要决定因素，这导致了全科医生和专科医生就诊模式的显著差异。仅拥有公共保险的人就诊全科医生的频率是就诊专科医生的2.8倍；拥有双重保险覆盖的人，全科医生与专科医生的就诊比例约为1.4（即公共全科医生与私人专科医生的组合），而仅拥有私人保险的人则呈现出“反向”的就诊模式，他们更频繁地选择专科医生。年龄、性别、健康状况以及公共医疗服务供给特征也对这些选择产生了显著且有趣的影响。最后，本文还讨论了基于“专科医生护理优于全科医生护理”这一隐含假设的公平问题。

abstract.text: An important focus in empirical econometric studies of health care concerns estimation of the relationship with health. This paper describes a non-parametric technique, the grade of membership (GoM) procedure, which is used to construct summary indicators of health. Health status is also assessed using three alternative measures commonly employed in the literature: an index of problems of activities of daily living (ADL), an index of health conditions and overall self-rated health. Using data from a sample of frail older people, the relationship between costs and different measures of health are estimated using ordinary least squares (OLS) and instrumental variables (IV) methods. The results show that health influences costs more strongly than other variables, an effect which persists after controlling for potential endogeneity. It is shown that health can be usefully classified using GoM techniques. An alternative measure, based on an index of ADL, also performs well. Measures based on overall self-assessed health and the number of health conditions present were less satisfactory. Although health indicators derived from GoM techniques may be more theoretically attractive, in terms of capturing more fully the multidimensional nature of health, simpler alternatives such as those based on ADL indices may offer practical computational advantages.

10.1002/hec.833.abstractZh: 在关于医疗保健问题的实证计量经济学研究中，一个重要的焦点是估计健康状况与成本之间的关系。本文介绍了一种非参数技术——会员等级（GoM）程序，该技术用于构建健康状况的总结指标。健康状态还使用文献中常用的三种替代指标进行评估：日常生活活动问题指数、健康状况指数以及整体自我评估健康指数。通过对一组虚弱的老年人样本的数据进行分析，使用普通最小二乘法和工具变量方法估计了成本与不同健康指标之间的关系。结果表明，健康对成本的影响比其他变量更为显著，即使在控制了潜在的内生性之后，这一效应仍然存在。研究表明，可以使用GoM技术对健康状况进行有用的分类。基于日常生活活动指数指标的替代指标也表现良好。而基于整体自我评估健康指数以及存在健康状况数量的指标则不太令人满意。尽管从GoM技术得出的健康指标在理论上可能更具吸引力，但在全面捕捉健康的多维度特性方面，基于日常生活活动指数指标的简单替代方法可能具有更实际的计算优势。

abstract.text: Existing techniques for eliciting health-state valuations incorporate both strength of preferences for health states and other values such as risk aversion or time preference. This paper presents a new methodological approach that allows estimation of a set of core underlying health-state values based on responses elicited through multiple measurement techniques. A study was undertaken in which respondents completed the visual analogue (VAS) scale, time trade-off (TTO), standard gamble (SG) and person trade-off (PTO) for a range of states. By specifying flexible parametric functions to explain responses on each measurement technique, we estimated both the underlying strength of preference values for the health states in the study and the values for a set of auxiliary parameters characterising risk attitudes, discount rates, distributional concerns and scale distortion effects in the group of respondents. This study demonstrates that it is possible to understand responses on these four different measurement techniques based on a consistent set of core values. The approach presented here can provide insights into different sources of observed variation in VAS, TTO, SG and PTO responses and facilitate appropriate adjustment of valuations elicited through different methods for use in summary health measures and economic analyses.

10.1002/hec.834.abstractZh: 现有的健康状态评估技术结合了人们对健康状态的偏好强度以及其他价值，如风险厌恶或时间偏好。本文提出了一种新的方法论方法，该方法能够通过多种测量技术获得的回应来估计一组核心的健康状态价值。研究过程中，受访者完成了视觉模拟量表、时间权衡量表、标准赌博量表和人物权衡量表，用于评估一系列健康状态。通过指定灵活的参数函数来解释每种测量技术的回应，我们估计了研究中健康状态的基本偏好强度，以及一组辅助参数的价值，这些参数表征了受访者的风险态度、折现率、分布关注点和规模扭曲效应。本研究表明，基于一组一致的核心价值，可以理解这四种不同测量技术的回应。这里提出的方法可以为理解视觉模拟量表、时间权衡量表、标准赌博量表和人物权衡量表回应中观察到的差异提供见解，并有助于调整通过不同方法获得的评估结果，以用于总结性健康指标和经济分析。

abstract.text: For cost-benefit analysis, health technologies with multiple effects should be valued in a single scenario by a holistic willingness-to-pay (WTP) measure. Recent studies instead used decomposed scenarios in which respondents report their WTP for each individual effect. Evidence can be found that the sum of such decomposed WTPs overestimates the holistic WTP, i.e. the holistic WTP is sub-additive. This sum of decomposed WTPs can lead to wrong conclusions on the efficiency of health technologies. This is also relevant in decision making about new technologies that are valued separately in different surveys. To date, no utility-theoretical and empirically validated aggregation function for decomposed WTPs exists. Within an expected utility model, this paper identifies as a reason for sub-additivity--beside risk aversion with respect to wealth--a negative influence of better health on the marginal utility of wealth, i.e. marginal utility of wealth is smaller in better health states. Assuming mutual utility independence of health and wealth, a theoretically founded aggregation function covering these two impacts is derived. In a contingent valuation study, 92 patients with diabetes were asked to state their WTP for reductions of the risk of several diabetic complications in decomposed as well as in holistic scenarios. The patients had preferences with a significant negative influence of health on the marginal utility of wealth. Sub-additivity occurred and theoretically founded aggregation could considerably lower the degree of overestimation. These results suggest that the theoretically founded aggregation function might reduce problems of sub-additivity that can be economically relevant. Further empirical testing of the approach is indicated.

10.1002/hec.835.abstractZh: 在成本效益分析中，具有多重效应的健康技术应通过整体支付意愿指标在单一情景下进行评估。然而，最近的研究采用了分解情景的方法，即受访者分别报告对每个单独效应的支付意愿。研究发现，这种分解后的支付意愿总和会高估整体支付意愿，即整体支付意愿具有次加性特征。这种分解后的支付意愿总和可能导致对健康技术效率的错误判断。这一点在关于新技术的决策中同样重要，因为不同调查中对新技术的评估往往是分开进行的。目前，尚无基于效用理论且经过实证验证的分解支付意愿的聚合函数。在期望效用模型下，本文指出次加性的一个原因——除了对财富的风险厌恶之外——还包括健康状况改善对财富边际效用的负面影响，即在健康状况改善的情况下，财富的边际效用会降低。假设健康与财富之间的效用相互独立，本文推导出一个理论上的聚合函数，能够涵盖这两种影响。在一项条件估值研究中，92名糖尿病患者被要求对减少几种糖尿病并发症风险的情况进行支付意愿评估，无论是分解情景还是整体情景下。结果发现，患者的偏好显示出健康状况改善对财富边际效用的显著负面影响。次加性现象确实存在，而理论上的聚合函数能够显著减少这种高估现象。这些结果表明，理论上的聚合函数可能有助于解决具有经济意义的次加性问题。进一步对该方法的实证测试是必要的。

abstract.text: The current interest in undertaking cost-effectiveness analyses alongside clinical trials has lead to the increasing availability of patient-level data on both the costs and effectiveness of intervention. In a recent paper, we show how cost-effectiveness analysis can be undertaken in a regression framework. In the current paper we develop a direct regression approach to cost-effectiveness analysis by proposing the use of a system of seemingly unrelated regression equations to provide a more general method for prognostic factor adjustment with emphasis on sub-group analysis. This more general method can be used in either an incremental cost-effectiveness or an incremental net-benefit approach, and does not require that the set of independent variables for costs and effectiveness be the same. Furthermore, the method can exhibit efficiency gains over unrelated ordinary least squares regression.

10.1002/hec.843.abstractZh: 当前，人们对进行成本效益分析与临床试验相结合的重视程度日益增加，这使得关于干预措施的成本与效果的患者级数据越来越容易获取。在最近的一篇论文中，我们展示了如何在回归框架内进行成本效益分析。在本文中，我们提出了一种直接的回归方法来进行成本效益分析，通过采用一组看似不相关的回归方程，提供了一种更通用的预后因素调整方法，并强调了对子组分析的重视。这种更通用的方法既适用于增量成本效益分析，也适用于增量净效益分析，并且不需要成本和效果的相关变量集合完全相同。此外，该方法比不相关的普通最小二乘回归方法更能展现效率提升。

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom says that because the cost of health care for the aged is more than that of the young at any time, there is a positive relationship between the aging or higher life expectancy of the population and aggregate health care spending. It is difficult, however, to find evidence to support this argument. We present a simple framework that shows how aging of the population may not necessarily increase the total cost of medical care over time or be observed across nations. This follows because numerous other factors that change with aging affect cost of care in ways that are not age-neutral. Such factors include age-specific shifts in morbidity and mortality, growth in income and insurance coverage, rising levels of education and changing technology. Consequently, the relative medical costs of the aged may indeed increase, at least for demographic reasons. Simultaneously, however, the costs of the young may decrease for the same reasons. The Israeli experience, used as a basis for a cursory empirical discussion of the issues, supports the line of reasoning presented in the paper.

10.1002/hec.844.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，由于老年人的医疗保健成本始终高于年轻人，因此人口老龄化或预期寿命延长与总体医疗保健支出之间存在正相关关系。然而，很难找到支持这一观点的证据。我们提出了一个简单的框架，说明人口老龄化并不一定会随着时间的推移增加医疗成本，且在不同国家之间也可能不会表现出这种趋势。这是因为许多与年龄相关的因素会影响医疗成本，而这些因素并非与年龄无关。这些因素包括特定年龄段的发病率和死亡率变化、收入与保险覆盖率的增长、教育水平的提高以及技术的变革。因此，老年人的相对医疗成本确实可能会上升，至少是由于人口统计原因。同时，年轻人的医疗成本也可能因相同原因而下降。以以色列的经验作为对这些问题进行初步实证讨论的基础，支持了本文提出的推理。

abstract.text: The use of stated preference analyses to evaluate choice of health care products has been growing in recent years. This paper shows how revealed preference data can be enriched with stated preference data and highlights the relative advantages of revealed and stated preference data. The techniques were applied to a study of determinants of physicians' prescriptions of alcoholism medications. Analyses were conducted on the relationship between physicians' perceptions of existing alcoholism medication attributes and their prescribing rates of those medications. Analyses were also conducted on physicians' decisions to prescribe hypothetical alcoholism medications with varying attributes such as efficacy, side effects, compliance, mode of action, and price. Finally, analyses were conducted on the combined stated and revealed preference data. Joint estimation suggests that parameters from the revealed and stated preference data are equal, up to scale. Joint analyses highlight how stated preference data can be used to estimate parameters for attributes that are not observed in the marketplace, that do not vary in the marketplace, or that are highly collinear with other attributes in actual markets.

10.1002/hec.845.abstractZh: 近年来，利用陈述偏好分析来评估医疗保健产品的选择变得越来越普遍。本文展示了如何将揭示偏好数据与陈述偏好数据相结合，并强调了这两种数据各自的优势。这些技术被应用于一项关于医生处方酒精类药物决定因素的研究中。研究分析了医生对现有酒精类药物属性的认知与其处方率之间的关系。此外，还分析了医生在处方具有不同属性（如疗效、副作用、依从性、作用机制以及价格）的假设性酒精类药物时的决策。最后，对陈述偏好数据和揭示偏好数据进行了联合分析。联合估计表明，来自揭示偏好数据和陈述偏好数据的参数在规模上是一致的。联合分析突显了如何利用陈述偏好数据来估计那些在市场中未被观察到、在市场上不发生变化，或者与实际市场中的其他属性高度相关的属性的参数。

abstract.text: Health surveys often include a general question on self-assessed health (SAH), usually measured on an ordinal scale with three to five response categories, from 'very poor' or 'poor' to 'very good' or 'excellent'. This paper assesses the scaling of responses on the SAH question. It compares alternative procedures designed to impose cardinality on the ordinal responses. These include OLS, ordered probit and interval regression approaches. The cardinal measures of health are used to compute and decompose concentration indices for income-related inequality in health. Results are provided using Finnish data on 15D and the SAH questions. Further evidence emerges for the internal validity of a method used in a pioneering study by van Doorslaer and Jones which was based on Canadian data on the McMaster Health Utility Index Mark III (HUI) and SAH. The study validates the conclusions drawn by van Doorslaer and Jones. It confirms that the interval regression approach is superior to OLS and ordered probit regression in assessing health inequality. However, regarding the choice of scaling instrument, it is concluded that the scaling of SAH categories and, consequently, the measured degree of inequality, are sensitive to characteristics of the chosen scaling instrument.

10.1002/hec.846.abstractZh: 健康调查通常会包含一个关于自我评估健康状况的问卷，该问卷通常采用序数尺度进行评分，评分范围从“非常差”或“差”到“非常好”或“优秀”。本文评估了在SAH问题上回答的序数尺度表示方式。文中比较了几种旨在为序数回答赋予基数属性的方法，包括OLS模型、有序probit模型和区间回归方法。通过健康相关的基数度量指标，可以计算并分解与收入相关的健康不平等程度。研究使用了芬兰的15D数据和SAH问卷数据作为样本。进一步的研究表明，van Doorslaer和Jones在一项基于加拿大McMaster健康效用指数Mark III（HUI）和SAH数据的开创性研究中采用的方法具有内部有效性。该研究验证了van Doorslaer和Jones得出的结论，并证实区间回归方法在评估健康不平等方面优于OLS模型和有序probit回归方法。不过，关于评分工具的选择，研究指出SAH类别的划分方式以及由此得出的不平等程度，会受到所选评分工具特性的影响。

abstract.text: This article examines the existence of price discrimination for obstetric services in two private hospitals in Bangladesh, and considers the welfare consequences of such discrimination, i.e. whether or not price discrimination benefited the poorer users. Data on 1212 normal and caesarean section patients discharged from the two hospitals were obtained. Obstetric services were chosen because they are relatively standardised and the patient population is relatively homogeneous, so minimising the scope and scale of product differentiation due to procedure and case-mix differences. The differences between the hospital list price for delivery and actual prices paid by patients were calculated to determine the average rate of discount. The welfare consequences of price discrimination were assessed by testing the differences in mean prices paid by patients from three income groups: low, middle and high. The results suggest that two different forms of price discrimination for obstetric services occurred in both these hospitals. First, there was price discrimination according to income, with the poorer users benefiting from a higher discount rate than richer ones; and second, there was price discrimination according to social status, with three high status occupational groups (doctors, senior government officials, and large businessmen) having the highest probability of receiving some level of discount.

10.1002/hec.848.abstractZh: 本文研究了孟加拉国两家私立医院中产科服务的价格歧视现象，并探讨了此类歧视的福利影响，即价格歧视是否使贫困用户受益。研究收集了来自这两家医院共计1212名正常分娩和剖宫产患者的数据。选择产科服务作为研究对象，是因为其服务相对标准化，患者群体也相对同质，因此由于手术方式和病例差异导致的产品差异化范围和规模较小。通过计算医院规定的分娩价格与患者实际支付价格之间的差异，确定了平均折扣率。通过测试三个收入群体（低、中、高收入群体）患者的平均支付价格差异，评估了价格歧视的福利影响。研究结果表明，这两家医院都存在两种形式的产科服务价格歧视。首先，存在基于收入的歧视，贫困用户获得的折扣率高于富裕用户；其次，存在基于社会地位的歧视，三个高社会地位的职业群体（医生、高级政府官员和大型企业主）最有可能获得某种程度的折扣。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to determine the price sensitivity of smokers in their consumption of cigarettes, using evidence from a major increase in California cigarette prices due to Proposition 10 and the Tobacco Settlement. The study sample consists of individual survey data from Behavioral Risk Factor Survey (BRFS) and price data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics between 1996 and 1999. A zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB) regression model was applied for the statistical analysis. The statistical model showed that price did not have an effect on reducing the estimated prevalence of smoking. However, it indicated that among smokers the price elasticity was at the level of -0.46 and statistically significant. Since smoking prevalence is significantly lower than it was a decade ago, price increases are becoming less effective as an inducement for hard-core smokers to quit, although they may respond by decreasing consumption. For those who only smoke occasionally (many of them being young adults) price increases alone may not be an effective inducement to quit smoking. Additional underlying behavioral factors need to be identified so that more effective anti-smoking strategies can be developed.

10.1002/hec.849.abstractZh: 本文的目的是通过加州因《10号提案》和烟草和解协议而导致香烟价格大幅上涨的实例，来探讨吸烟者对香烟价格变化的敏感度。研究样本包括1996至1999年间从行为风险因素调查中获取的个人调查数据，以及来自劳工统计局的物价数据。采用零膨胀负二项回归模型进行统计分析。统计结果显示，价格对降低吸烟率的估计影响并不显著。然而，研究发现，在吸烟者中，价格弹性达到了-0.46，且具有统计学意义。由于吸烟率比十年前显著下降，价格上涨作为促使顽固吸烟者戒烟的诱因效果已减弱，尽管他们可能会通过减少消费来应对。对于偶尔吸烟的人群（其中许多是年轻人），仅靠价格上涨可能不足以促使他们戒烟。因此，需要识别其他潜在的行为因素，以便制定更有效的戒烟策略。

abstract.text: Survivor costs are those costs associated with a treatment because it extends the patient's life. A controversy exists regarding whether survivor consumption costs should be included in cost-utility analyses. The present paper uses this controversy to motivate a general reexamination of what costs to include in cost-utility analyses. Rather than the ad hoc inclusion rules currently used--a causal relationship between the intervention and the costs, and a proscription on double counting--this paper suggests three inclusion principles based on standard welfare economics. Thus, costs should be (1) included if they represent resources that directly produce the utility that is being measured in the denominator of the cost-utility ratio, (2) excluded if they represent resources that produce utility that is not being measured in the denominator, even though the costs are causally associated with the intervention, and (3) included if they represent resources consumed that are causally related to the intervention, but that have no counterveiling utility gains. These principles suggest important changes in how we account for recuperation time and unrelated medical care. They also suggest that survival consumption costs and earnings be excluded from existing cost-utility analyses.

10.1002/hec.850.abstractZh: 生存成本是指与某种治疗相关的成本，因为这些治疗能够延长患者的生命。关于是否应将生存消费成本纳入成本效用分析中存在争议。本文利用这一争议来促使人们重新审视在成本效用分析中应包括哪些成本。与目前使用的临时规定不同——即要求干预措施与成本之间存在因果关系，并且禁止重复计算——本文提出了基于标准福利经济学的三个纳入原则。因此，成本应被纳入分析，前提是这些成本代表了直接产生效用资源，而这种效用正是成本效用比率的分母所衡量的；成本不应被纳入分析，前提是这些成本代表了产生效用但并未被作为分母的资源，即使这些成本与干预措施存在因果关系；成本应被纳入分析，前提是这些成本代表了与干预措施存在因果关系的消耗资源，但这些资源并没有带来抵消效用的收益。这些原则表明，我们在计算恢复时间和无关医疗护理费用时，需要做出重要的调整。同时，这些原则也建议将生存消费成本和收益排除在现有的成本效用分析之外。

abstract.text: Antibiotic resistance tends to increase when a patent on an antibiotic expires. Since other companies can now sell the antibiotic, more of the antibiotic is produced and prices fall. Because the benefits of reducing current production go to other firms, pharmaceutical companies will have little concern about future resistance. This 'open-access' problem causes excessive antibiotic use and resistance problems in the future. Extending patents is one solution. However, a pharmaceutical company that has patent protection on a drug that is cross-resistant may have little concern about future resistance. This is because when people use completely different antibiotics which cause bacteria to become resistant to the original antibiotic, then the benefits of reducing current production go to other companies. A single buyer such as national health insurance or private health insurance may also have an incentive to reduce antibiotic resistance since they bear the future cost of future resistance. However, insurance coverage reduces the price that patients pay at the margin and thus the patients are likely to use more antibiotics. National health insurance policies may even set the price of antibiotics so low that resistance problems are created even when the patent is in effect.

10.1002/hec.851.abstractZh: 抗生素专利到期时，抗生素耐药性往往会增加。由于其他公司现在也可以销售该抗生素，因此抗生素的产量会增加，价格也会下降。由于减少当前生产的利益归属于其他公司，制药公司对于未来的耐药性问题并不会太担心。这种“开放获取”问题会导致未来抗生素的过度使用和耐药性问题。延长专利保护期限是一种解决方案。然而，对于具有交叉耐药性的药物，拥有专利保护的制药公司可能并不太担心未来的耐药性问题。这是因为当人们使用完全不同的抗生素时，细菌会对原始抗生素产生耐药性，从而减少当前生产的利益则归属于其他公司。像国家健康保险或私人健康保险这样的单一购买者也可能有动机减少抗生素耐药性问题，因为他们要承担未来耐药性问题的成本。然而，保险覆盖会降低患者支付的边际价格，因此患者可能会使用更多的抗生素。国家健康保险政策甚至可能将抗生素的价格定得过低，即使专利仍然有效，也会引发耐药性问题。

abstract.text: Health economists often use log models (based on OLS or generalized linear models) to deal with skewed outcomes such as those found in health expenditures and inpatient length of stay. Some recent studies have employed Cox proportional hazard regression as a less parametric alternative to OLS and GLM models, even when there was no need to correct for censoring. This study examines how well the alternative estimators behave econometrically in terms of bias when the data are skewed to the right. Specifically we provide evidence on the performance of the Cox model under a variety of data generating mechanisms and compare it to the estimators studied recently in Manning and Mullahy (2001). No single alternative is best under all of the conditions examined here. However, the gamma regression model with a log link seems to be more robust to alternative data generating mechanisms than either OLS on ln(y) or Cox proportional hazards regression. We find that the proportional hazard assumption is an essential requirement to obtain consistent estimate of the E(y|x) using the Cox model.

10.1002/hec.852.abstractZh: 健康经济学家经常使用对数模型（基于OLS或广义线性模型）来处理如健康支出和住院时长这类偏态数据。一些近期的研究采用了Cox比例风险回归作为OLS和GLM模型的非参数替代方法，即使不需要对删失进行校正。本研究考察了在数据向右偏态的情况下，这些替代估计量在经济学上的表现，特别是其偏差情况。具体来说，我们提供了关于Cox模型在各种数据生成机制下的性能证据，并将其与Manning和Mullahy（2001年）研究的估计量进行了比较。在这里考察的所有条件下，没有一种替代方法在所有情况下都是最优的。然而，带有对数链接的伽马回归模型似乎比基于ln(y)的OLS或Cox比例风险回归更能适应不同的数据生成机制。我们发现，使用Cox模型获得一致的E(y|x)估计值，比例风险假设是一个基本要求。

abstract.text: Purpose This paper investigates the impact of quality-of-life adjustment on cost-effectiveness analyses, by comparing ratios from published studies that have reported both incremental costs per (unadjusted) life-year and per quality-adjusted life-year for the same intervention. Methods A systematic literature search identified 228 original cost-utility analyses published prior to 1998. Sixty-three of these analyses (173 ratio pairs) reported both cost/LY and cost/QALY ratios for the same intervention, from which we calculated medians and means, the difference between ratios (cost/LY minus cost/QALY) and between reciprocals of the ratios, and cost/LY as a percentage of the corresponding cost/QALY ratio. We also compared the ratios using rank-order correlation, and assessed the frequency with which quality-adjustment resulted in a ratio crossing the widely used cost-effectiveness thresholds of 20, 000 US dollars, 50,000 US dollars, and 100,000 US dollars/QALY or LY. Results The mean ratios were 69,100 US dollars/LY and 103,100 US dollars/QALY, with corresponding medians of 24,600 US dollars/LY and 20,400 US dollars/QALY. The mean difference between ratios was approximately -34,300 US dollars (median difference: 1300 US dollars), with 60% of ratio pairs differing by 10,000 US dollars/year or less. Mean difference between reciprocals was 59 (QA)LYs per million dollars (median: 2.1). The Spearman rank-order correlation between ratio types was 0.86 (p<0.001). Quality-adjustment led to a ratio moving either above or below 50,000 US dollars/LY (or QALY) in 8% of ratio pairs, and across 100,000 US dollars in 6% of cases. Conclusions In a sizable fraction of cost-utility analyses, quality adjusting did not substantially alter the estimated cost-effectiveness of an intervention, suggesting that sensitivity analyses using ad hoc adjustments or 'off-the-shelf' utility weights may be sufficient for many analyses. The collection of preference weight data should be subjected to the same scrutiny as other data inputs to cost-effectiveness analyses, and should only be under-taken if the value of this information is likely to be greater than the cost of obtaining it.

10.1002/hec.853.abstractZh: 目的：本文通过对比已发表的研究结果，探讨生活质量调整对成本效益分析的影响。这些研究同时报告了同一干预措施的每（未调整）生命年和每质量调整生命年的增量成本。方法：系统文献检索发现，1998年之前发表了228项原始成本效用分析。其中63项分析（173对比率）同时报告了成本/生命年和成本/质量调整生命年的比率，我们据此计算了中位数和平均值，以及比率之间的差异（成本/生命年减去成本/质量调整生命年）和比率的倒数之间的差异，还将成本/生命年作为相应成本/质量调整生命年比率的百分比。我们还使用等级相关比较了这些比率，并评估了质量调整导致比率超过常用的成本效益阈值的情况频率，这些阈值分别为20,000美元、50,000美元和100,000美元/质量调整生命年或生命年。结果：平均比率分别为69,100美元/生命年和103,100美元/质量调整生命年，相应中位数分别为24,600美元/生命年和20,400美元/质量调整生命年。比率之间的平均差异约为-34,300美元（中位数差异为1,300美元），60%的比率对的差异在10,000美元/年或以下。比率的倒数之间的平均差异为59质量调整生命年每百万美元（中位数：2.1）。比率类型之间的Spearman等级相关为0.86（p<0.001）。质量调整导致8%的比率对的比率超过50,000美元/生命年（或质量调整生命年），6%的比率对的比率超过100,000美元。结论：在相当一部分成本-效用分析中，质量调整并未显著改变干预措施的估计成本效益，这表明对于许多分析而言，使用特定调整或“现成”的效用权重进行敏感性分析可能就足够了。偏好权重数据的收集应像其他成本效益分析中的数据输入一样受到严格的审查，并且只有在获取这些信息的成本小于其潜在价值的情况下才应进行收集。

abstract.text: The Brenner hypothesis is essentially that economic cycles, characterized by unemployment and fluctuations in per capita income can have profound negative implications for population health. A number of subsequent studies have identified shortcomings in Brenner's model and have reported results that for the most part contradict his results. This paper argues that the failure to account for the time-series properties (i.e. the potential for unit root behaviour) of macro level data is a key omission in Brenner's and other subsequent studies. To address this omission an error correction model specification was applied to American data for the period 1948-1996. The findings suggest that economic cycles do have a permanent effect on population health. Paradoxically, they also suggest that economic growth and increases in unemployment reduce aggregate mortality risk. A need for measures of economic change that are perhaps more sensitive to the effects of economic cycles on groups that may be at greater risk of unemployment was identified.

10.1002/hec.854.abstractZh: 布伦纳假说认为，以失业和人均收入波动为特征的经济周期，会对人口健康产生严重的负面影响。后续的多项研究指出布伦纳模型存在缺陷，并且其研究结果大多与布伦纳的结论相矛盾。本文认为，未能考虑宏观数据的时间序列特性（即单位根行为的潜在可能性）是布伦纳及其他后续研究中的一个关键遗漏。为弥补这一不足，本文采用误差修正模型对1948至1996年的美国数据进行了分析。研究结果表明，经济周期确实会对人口健康产生长期影响。矛盾的是，研究还发现经济增长和失业率上升会降低总体死亡风险。因此，需要开发更能反映经济周期对高风险群体影响的衡量指标。

abstract.text: This paper derives a necessary and sufficient condition under which increased health care productivity must lead to decreased (increased) demand for health care as long as the demand for health care is inelastic (elastic). It is shown that this condition identifies a class of health production functions, which may provide useful guidance to empirical studies that depend wholly or partly on the correct specification of a health production function. As an illustration, it is demonstrated that this class of production functions may be useful for empirical studies that test the hypothesis that schooling, increasing the efficiency of health production, leads to a larger health output from a given set of health inputs. The paper also offers broader classes of production functions that would enable one to test this relationship between the demand elasticity and the effect of health care productivity on health care demand.

10.1002/hec.855.abstractZh: 本文推导出一个必要且充分的条件：只要对医疗保健的需求是非弹性的，提高医疗保健的生产效率必然会导致对医疗保健需求的减少（或增加）。该条件所确定的一类健康生产函数可以为那些完全或部分依赖于正确设定健康生产函数的实证研究提供有用的指导。作为示例，本文表明这类生产函数对于检验“教育水平的提高能够提升健康生产效率，从而从给定的健康投入中获得更大的健康产出”这一假设具有实际意义。此外，本文还提出了其他类型的生活生产函数，这些函数有助于检验需求弹性与医疗保健生产效率对医疗保健需求影响之间的关系。

abstract.text: In many cases, physicians prescribe antibiotics without knowing whether an individual patient is infected with a susceptible or resistant pathogen. As the proportion of resistant organisms in a community increases, physicians substitute away from older-inexpensive drugs to newer, more expensive agents as first line therapy. This paper explores the implications of resistance-induced antibiotic substitution for epidemiological models to predict future resistance levels, efforts to measure the health care costs associated with resistance, and policies to improve physicians' antibiotic prescribing decisions. The extent of resistance-induced substitution in outpatient settings is documented using a data set consisting of observations on initial physician office visits for otitis media in the US controlling for new product introductions and price increases, per prescription antibiotic spending increased by 22% between 1980 and 1996, corresponding to a steep increase in resistance levels over the same period.

10.1002/hec.856.abstractZh: 在许多情况下，医生在不知道患者是否感染了易感或耐药病原体的情况下就开具抗生素。随着社区中耐药生物体的比例增加，医生会放弃使用价格较低的旧药，转而使用更新、更昂贵的药物作为一线治疗选择。本文探讨了耐药性导致的抗生素替代对流行病学模型的影响，这些模型用于预测未来的耐药水平，评估与耐药性相关的医疗成本，以及改善医生抗生素处方决策的政策。通过一组数据记录了门诊环境中因耐药性导致的药物替代情况，这些数据包括美国儿童中耳炎患者初次就诊时的观察记录，同时考虑了新产品的引入和价格上涨等因素。1980年至1996年间，每次抗生素处方支出增加了22%，这对应于同一时期耐药水平的急剧上升。

abstract.text: Objectives To determine whether the binary with follow-up (BWFU) or open-ended (OPED) contingent valuation question format would yield better valid estimates of altruistic willingness to pay (WTP) and examine the feasibility of using intra-community altruistic contributions to procure insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) for the poor in Nigeria. Methods Structured questionnaires were used to elicit stated altruistic WTP from a random sub-sample of respondents that had either the OPED or BWFU used to elicit WTP in Southeast Nigeria. One month after the survey the respondents were asked to redeem their WTP pledges. Construct validity was determined using econometric analyses, while phi correlation coefficient was used to determine criterion validity. Findings More than 57% of the respondents were hypothetically willing to pay for altruism in both BWFU and OPED groups. Altruistic WTP was positively related to respondents' WTP for own nets (p<0.01) and nets for other household members (p<0.05) in both groups. A total of 27.0% and 33.1% of the respondents with positive hypothetical WTP in the BWFU and OPED actually contributed. Phi correlation coefficient was 0.23 (95%CI 0.20-0.29) in BWFU and 0.49 (95%CI 0.44-0.54) in OPED. The money realised was used to buy some ITNs, which were presented to poor people selected by community leaders. Conclusion The OPED elicited better valid estimates of altruistic WTP than BWFU. The potential for more capable people to contribute for the poor in ITNs programmes actually exist and malaria control programmes should explore altruistic contributions as a means to increase net coverage.

10.1002/hec.857.abstractZh:
目的：探讨使用二元后续式（BWFU）或开放式（OPED）的自愿支付评估问题格式，是否能获得更可靠的利他性支付意愿估计值，并研究在尼日利亚为贫困人口提供杀虫剂处理蚊帐时，利用社区内部成员的利他性贡献的可行性。  

方法：采用结构化问卷，从东南尼日利亚随机选取的受访者中，分别使用OPED和BWFU来收集他们的利他性支付意愿。调查一个月后，要求受访者兑现其支付承诺。通过计量经济分析确定结构效度，同时使用phi相关系数来评估标准效度。  

研究结果：超过57%的受访者在BWFU和OPED两种情况下，都愿意为利他行为支付费用。在两组中，利他性支付意愿与受访者为自己购买蚊帐的支付意愿呈正相关（p<0.01），与为其他家庭成员购买蚊帐的支付意愿也呈正相关（p<0.05）。在BWFU组中，有27.0%的受访者实际提供了贡献；在OPED组中，有33.1%的受访者实际提供了贡献。BWFU的phi相关系数为0.23（95%置信区间0.20-0.29），OPED的phi相关系数为0.49（95%置信区间0.44-0.54）。实际获得的资金被用于购买蚊帐，并赠送给社区领导人选定的贫困人群。  

结论：OPED方式比BWFU方式更能获得可靠的利他性支付意愿估计值。实际上，更有能力的人愿意为贫困人口的蚊帐项目做出贡献，疟疾控制项目应探索利用利他性贡献来增加蚊帐覆盖率的途径。

abstract.text: As more research is undertaken on the elderly, accurately assessing changes in their quality of life becomes increasingly important. Generic instruments are the most popular method to assess quality of life, and one of the most widely used is the EQ-5D. However, the range of dimensions, sensitivity of scales and completion rates have been raised as concerns when using this measure with the elderly. The AQoL is a newer instrument which offers greater richness in dimensions of health covered, and potentially offers greater sensitivity to changes in quality of life. This paper presents the results of a 'head-to-head' comparison of the EQ-5D and AQoL in terms of practicality, construct validity, agreement (of absolute scores and their change over time) and sensitivity to change, as part of a randomised controlled trial in the elderly. Poor agreement was found between both the absolute scores from each instrument and change in scores over time. Although the AQoL appeared to have more favourable construct validity, the EQ-5D was easier to administer, had a higher completion rate, and appeared more sensitive to change. We conclude that the AQoL is probably less well suited to measuring health status in a very elderly population than the EQ-5D.

10.1002/hec.858.abstractZh: 随着对老年人研究的不断深入，准确评估他们生活质量的改变变得越来越重要。通用工具是评估生活质量最常用的方法之一，其中EQ-5D是最广泛使用的工具之一。然而，在使用该工具评估老年人生活质量时，其维度范围、量表敏感性和完成率等问题受到了关注。AQoL是一种较新的工具，它在涵盖的健康维度方面具有更大的丰富性，并且可能对生活质量变化的敏感度更高。本文展示了在一项针对老年人的随机对照试验中，EQ-5D和AQoL在实用性、结构效度、一致性（绝对分数及其随时间的变化）以及对变化敏感性的“头对头”比较结果。研究发现，两种工具的绝对分数以及随时间变化的分数一致性较差。尽管AQoL在结构效度方面似乎更为优越，但EQ-5D更容易实施，完成率更高，并且对变化的敏感度也更高。我们得出结论，与EQ-5D相比，AQoL可能不太适合用于非常高龄人群的健康状况评估。

abstract.text: Previous research has shown that the recent tightening of college alcohol policies has been effective at reducing college students' drinking. Over the period in which these stricter alcohol policies have been put in place, marijuana use among college students has increased. This raises the question of whether current policies aimed at reducing alcohol consumption are inadvertently encouraging marijuana use. This paper begins to address this question by investigating the relationship between the demands for alcohol and marijuana for college students using data from the 1993, 1997 and 1999 waves of the Harvard School of Public Health's College Alcohol Study (CAS). We find that alcohol and marijuana are economic complements and that policies that increase the full price of alcohol decrease participation in marijuana use.

10.1002/hec.859.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，最近对大学酒精政策的收紧有效地减少了大学生的饮酒行为。在这些更严格的酒精政策实施期间，大学生的大麻使用量有所增加。这引发了这样一个问题：当前旨在减少酒精消费的政策是否无意中促进了大麻的使用？本文通过研究1993年、1997年和1999年哈佛公共卫生学院大学酒精研究的数据，来探讨大学生对酒精和大麻的需求之间的关系。我们发现，酒精和大麻在经济上是互补的，而提高酒精价格的政策会减少大学生的大麻使用行为。

abstract.text: We examine access to general practitioners and specialists who work in the public and private sectors in Italy using a seemingly unrelated system of probits. We use a latent class formulation that provides a rich and flexible functional form and can accommodate non-normality of response probabilities. The empirical analysis shows that patient behavior can be clustered in two latent classes. We find that income strongly influences the mix of services. Richer individuals are less likely to seek care from GP's and more likely to seek care from specialists, and especially private specialists. Health status and societal vulnerability are the most important indicators of class membership.

10.1002/hec.860.abstractZh: 我们研究了在意大利，公共和私营部门工作的全科医生和专科医生的可及性，使用的是一个看似不相关的概率系统。我们采用了潜在类别模型，该模型提供了丰富且灵活的功能形式，能够适应响应概率的非正态性。实证分析表明，患者行为可以分为两个潜在类别。我们发现，收入对服务组合有显著影响。较富裕的个体不太可能寻求全科医生的服务，而更可能寻求专科医生，尤其是私人专科医生的服务。健康状况和社会脆弱性是判断所属类别的最重要指标。

abstract.text: In many health decision making situations there is a requirement that the effectiveness of interventions, usually their 'clinical' effectiveness, be established, as well as their cost-effectiveness. Often indeed this is effectively a prior requirement for their cost-effectiveness being investigated. If, however, one accepts the ethical argument for using a threshold incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) for interventions that are more effective but more costly (i.e. fall in the NE quadrant of the cost-effectiveness plane), one should apply the same decision rule in the SW quadrant, where the intervention is less effective but less costly. This implication is present in most standard treatments of cost-effectiveness analysis, including recent stochastic versions, and had gone relatively unquestioned within the discipline until the recent suggestion that the ICER threshold might be 'kinked'. A kinked threshold would, O'Brien et al. argue, better reflect the asymmetrical individual preferences found in empirical studies of consumer's willingness to pay and willingness to accept and justify different decision rules in the NE and SW quadrants. We reject the validity of such asymmetric preferences in the context of public health care decisions and consider and counter the two main 'ethical' objections that probably underlie the asymmetry in this case--the objection to 'taking away' and the objection to being required to undergo treatment that is less effective than no treatment at all.

10.1002/hec.861.abstractZh: 在许多健康决策情境中，需要确定干预措施的有效性，即其“临床”有效性，以及其成本效益。实际上，这通常也是成本效益研究的先决条件。然而，如果接受基于伦理的论点，即对于那些更有效但成本更高的干预措施（即位于成本效益平面的NE象限），应使用阈值增量成本效益比（ICER），那么对于位于SW象限的干预措施，即使其效果较差但成本较低，也应采用相同的决策规则。这一结论存在于大多数标准的成本效益分析方法中，包括最近的随机版本分析，并且在该学科中一直相对未被质疑，直到最近有人提出ICER阈值可能“弯曲”的观点。O'Brien等人认为，弯曲的阈值能更好地反映在消费者支付意愿和接受不同决策规则的实证研究中发现的不对称个体偏好，NE象限和SW象限需要不同的决策规则。我们否定了在公共健康决策背景下这种不对称偏好的有效性，并考虑并反驳了可能存在于这种情况下的两个主要“伦理”反对意见——反对“剥夺”权利和反对接受效果不如不治疗的干预措施。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the effect of being insured under the voluntary component of Vietnamese Health Insurance, on patterns of treatment seeking behaviour. A multinomial logit model is estimated using household survey data from three provinces in Vietnam. Decisions regarding both the type of provider sought and type of care received are analysed. Insurance status is treated as both exogenous and endogenous to account for potential selection bias. The results indicate that, overall, insured patients are more likely to use outpatient facilities, and public providers, an effect that is particularly strong at lower income levels.

10.1002/hec.862.abstractZh: 本文分析了在越南健康保险的自愿保险成分下，参保对就医行为模式的影响。研究采用了来自越南三个省份的家庭调查数据，并运用多项逻辑模型进行了估计。研究分析了患者选择医疗服务提供者和接受医疗服务类型的情况。考虑到潜在的选择偏差，将保险状态视为既为外生变量又为内生变量。研究结果表明，总体而言，参保患者更有可能使用门诊设施，尤其是低收入群体，这一效应尤为明显。

abstract.text: We consider the impact of introducing intermediate stages, chained together, into the standard gamble (SG) and time trade-off (TTO) methods. Less is known about the impact of intermediate stages, chained together, in the TTO method. We broadly replicate the patterns of responses observed in other SG studies which have been accounted for by loss aversion. We find that the TTO responses do not replicate the patterns found in the SG responses. The results support the notion that additional issues arise in the TTO method that counteract loss aversion.

10.1002/hec.863.abstractZh: 我们研究了在标准赌博（SG）和时间权衡（TTO）方法中引入一系列中间阶段的影响。关于TTO方法中这些中间阶段的影响，目前了解较少。我们大致复制了其他SG研究中观察到的反应模式，这些模式已被归因于损失厌恶效应。我们发现，TTO中的反应并不复制SG中的反应模式。这些结果支持了这样一个观点：在TTO方法中，会出现一些额外的因素，这些因素可以抵消损失厌恶效应所带来的影响。

abstract.text: The decisions made by the National Institute for Clinical Excellence (NICE) give rise to two questions: how is cost-effectiveness evidence used to make judgements about the 'value for money' of health technologies? And how are factors other than cost-effectiveness taken into account? The aim of this paper is to explore NICE's cost-effectiveness threshold(s) and the tradeoffs between cost effectiveness and other factors apparent in its decisions. Binary choice analysis is used to reveal the preferences of NICE and to consider the consistency of its decisions. For each decision to accept or reject a technology, explanatory variables include: the cost per life year or per QALY gained; uncertainty regarding cost effectiveness; the net cost to the NHS; the burden of disease; the availability (or not) of alternative treatments; and specific factors indicated by NICE. Results support the broad notion of a threshold, where the probability of rejection increases as the cost per QALY increases. Cost effectiveness, together with uncertainty and the burden of disease, explain NICE decisions better than cost effectiveness alone. The results suggest a threshold somewhat higher than NICEs stated 'range of acceptable cost effectiveness' of pound 20,000-30,000 British pounds per QALY--although the exact meaning of a 'range' in this context remains unclear.

10.1002/hec.864.abstractZh: 国家临床卓越研究所（NICE）所做的决策引发了两个问题：如何运用成本效益证据来评估健康技术的“性价比”？除了成本效益之外，还有哪些因素被考虑在内？本文旨在探讨NICE的成本效益阈值，以及在其决策中成本效益与其他因素之间的权衡。通过二元选择分析，可以揭示NICE的偏好，并考虑其决策的一致性。对于每一个决定，无论是接受还是拒绝某项技术，相关的解释变量包括：每生命年或每QALY获得的成本；成本效益的不确定性；国民医疗服务体系（NHS）的净成本；疾病负担；替代疗法的可用性；以及NICE指出的具体因素。研究结果支持存在一个阈值的概念，即随着每QALY成本的增加，拒绝该技术的可能性也会增加。成本效益、不确定性以及疾病负担，比单独的成本效益更能解释NICE的决策。研究结果表明，该阈值略高于NICE所提出的“可接受成本效益范围”，即每QALY 20,000至30,000英镑——尽管在这种情况下“范围”的确切含义仍不清楚。

abstract.text: Previous studies demonstrated that the willingness to pay (WTP) for reducing the risk of a targeted disease increases with the severity of a comorbidity condition. They evaluated the WTPs at positions where otherwise identical individuals who have unequal comorbidity conditions all have the same consumption of wealth and the same probability of getting a targeted disease. This paper endogenizes the individual effort to reduce the risk of the targeted disease. It finds that individuals with more severe comorbidity will spend more on reducing the risk of the targeted disease and, therefore, have a lower probability of getting the targeted disease and a lower net consumption of wealth at equilibrium. Nonetheless, we find that the previous conclusion concerning the relationship between the WTP for the targeted risk reduction and the comorbidity is robust.

10.1002/hec.865.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，对于降低特定疾病风险的支付意愿会随着合并症的严重程度而增加。这些研究评估了在条件相同但合并症程度不同的个体中，这些个体在财富消费和患特定疾病的概率上是否存在差异。本文进一步探讨了个体为降低特定疾病风险所付出的努力。研究发现，合并症较为严重的个体在降低特定疾病风险方面的支出更多，因此在均衡状态下，他们患特定疾病的概率更低，财富净消费也更低。尽管如此，我们发现关于特定疾病风险降低的支付意愿与合并症之间关系的先前结论仍然具有稳健性。
