abstract.text: As the number of preference-based instruments grows, it becomes increasingly important to compare different preference-based measures of health in order to inform an important debate on the choice of instrument. This paper presents a comparison of two of them, the EQ-5D and the SF-6D (recently developed from the SF-36) across seven patient/population groups (chronic obstructive airways disease, osteoarthritis, irritable bowel syndrome, lower back pain, leg ulcers, post menopausal women and elderly). The mean SF-6D index value was found to exceed the EQ-5D by 0.045 and the intraclass correlation coefficient between them was 0.51. Whilst this convergence lends some support for the validity of these measures, the modest difference at the aggregate level masks more significant differences in agreement across the patient groups and over severity of illness, with the SF-6D having a smaller range and lower variance in values. There is evidence for floor effects in the SF-6D and ceiling effects in the EQ-5D. These discrepancies arise from differences in their health state classifications and the methods used to value them. Further research is required to fully understand the respective roles of the descriptive systems and the valuation methods and to examine the implications for estimates of the impact of health care interventions.

10.1002/hec.866.abstractZh: 随着基于偏好的评估工具数量的增加，比较不同基于偏好的健康指标变得越来越重要，这有助于为工具选择的相关讨论提供信息。本文对两种此类工具——EQ-5D和SF-6D（后者是从SF-36衍生而来）在七个患者/人群组中的表现进行了对比，这些人群包括慢性阻塞性气道疾病、骨关节炎、肠易激综合症、下背痛、腿部溃疡、绝经后妇女和老年人。研究发现，SF-6D的平均指数值比EQ-5D高出0.045，两者之间的类内相关系数达到0.51。虽然这种趋同现象为这些评估工具的有效性提供了一些支持，但总体上的微小差异掩盖了不同患者群体之间以及不同疾病严重程度下的更大差异。SF-6D的数值范围更小，方差也更低。有证据表明SF-6D存在底限效应，而EQ-5D则存在顶限效应。这些差异源于它们对健康状态的分类方式以及评估方法的不同。需要进一步的研究来全面理解这两种描述性系统和评估方法的各自作用，并探讨其对医疗干预效果评估的影响。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a new method to calculate the extent to which individuals are willing to trade money for improvements in their health status. An individual welfare function of income (WFI) is applied to calculate the equivalent income variation of health impairments. We believe that this approach avoids various drawbacks of alternative willingness-to-pay methods. The WFI is used to calculate the equivalent variation of cardiovascular diseases. It is found that for a 25 year old male the equivalent variation of a heart disease ranges from 114,000 euro to 380,000 euro depending on the welfare level. This is about 10,000 euro - 30,000 euro for an additional life year. The equivalent variation declines with age and is about the same for men and women. The estimates further vary by discount rate chosen. The estimates of the equivalent variation are generally higher than the money spent on most heart-related medical interventions per QALY. The cost-benefit analysis shows that for most interventions the value of the health benefits exceeds the costs. Heart transplants seem to be too costly and only beneficial if patients are young.

10.1002/hec.867.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种计算个体愿意为改善健康状况而支付金钱程度的新方法。通过应用个体福利函数来计算健康障碍的等价收入变化。我们认为，这种方法避免了其他支付意愿计算方法的各种缺陷。该福利函数被用来计算心血管疾病的等价变化。研究发现，对于一个25岁的男性来说，心脏病的等价变化范围从114,000欧元到380,000欧元，这取决于其福利水平。这相当于每多活一年需要支付10,000到30,000欧元。等价变化随年龄增长而下降，且男性和女性的变化幅度大致相同。估计值还会因所选的折现率而有所不同。通常，等价变化的估计值高于每QALY在心脏相关医疗干预上花费的金钱。成本效益分析表明，对于大多数干预措施，健康效益的价值超过了成本。心脏移植似乎成本过高，只有在患者年轻的情况下才具有益处。

abstract.text: The German health care reform of 1997 provides a natural experiment for evaluating the price sensitivity of demand for physicians' services. As a part of the reform, co-payments for prescription drugs were increased step up to 200%. However, certain groups of people were exempted from the increase, providing a natural control group against which the changed demand for physicians' services of the treated, those subject to increased co-payments, can be assessed. The differences-in-differences estimates indicate that increased co-payments reduced the number of doctor visits by about 10% on an average.

10.1002/hec.868.abstractZh: 1997年的德国医疗改革提供了一个自然实验，用于评估对医生服务的需求价格敏感性。作为改革的一部分，处方药的自付金额提高了约200%。然而，某些人群被免除这一增加，从而形成了一个自然对照组，可以以此来评估接受增加自付金额的受治疗人群对医生服务的需求变化。差异-差异估计表明，自付金额的增加平均使就诊次数减少了约10%。

abstract.text: Discrete choice experiments (DCEs) are being used increasingly in health economics to elicit preferences for products and programs. The results of such experiments have been used to calculate measures of welfare or more specifically, respondents' 'willingness to pay' (WTP) for products and programs and their 'marginal willingness to pay' (MWTP) for the attributes that make up such products and programs. In this note we show that the methods currently used to derive measures of welfare from DCEs in the health economics literature are not consistent with random utility theory (RUT), or with microeconomic welfare theory more generally. The inconsistency with welfare theory is an important limitation on the use of such WTP estimates in cost-benefit analyses. We describe an alternative method of deriving measures of welfare (compensating variation) from DCEs that is consistent with RUT and is derived using welfare theory. We demonstrate its use in an empirical application to derive the WTP for asthma medication and compare it to the results elicited from the method currently used in the health economics literature.

10.1002/hec.870.abstractZh: 离散选择实验在健康经济学中越来越被使用，用于引出消费者对产品和项目的偏好。这些实验的结果被用来计算福利指标，或者更具体地说，是受访者对产品和项目的“支付意愿”（WTP）以及构成这些产品和项目的属性的“边际支付意愿”（MWTP）。在这篇论文中，我们指出，目前在健康经济学文献中用于从离散选择实验中得出福利指标的方法与随机效用理论（RUT）或更广泛的微观经济福利理论并不一致。这种与福利理论的不一致性是使用这些支付意愿估计值在成本效益分析中的重要限制。我们描述了一种替代的方法，该方法可以从离散选择实验中得出福利指标（补偿变量），并且与随机效用理论一致，同时基于福利理论进行推导。我们通过一个实证应用来演示这种方法的运用，以得出哮喘药物的支付意愿，并将其与目前健康经济学文献中使用的方法得出的结果进行比较。

abstract.text: Waiting time generally acts as a rationing mechanism in the public health care system. In theory, patients who have a higher valuation of time are more likely to seek alternative care (i.e. doctor shopping) if there is a parallel private sector than those who have weaker time preference. However, the existing settings of many health care systems do not allow patients to reveal their preference of such. The data presented in this study suggest a positive association between patients' expressed value of time and doctor shopping behaviour in Hong Kong. Patients who were assigned longer waiting times relative to their expected horizon were more likely to seek private alternative care.

10.1002/hec.871.abstractZh: 等待时间通常在公共医疗保健系统中起到配给机制的作用。理论上，如果私人部门存在并行选择，那么对时间价值较高的患者更有可能寻求其他医疗服务（即“医生转介”），而那些时间价值较低的患者则不会如此。然而，许多医疗保健系统的现有设置并不允许患者表达这种偏好。本研究的数据表明，香港患者中，表达出的时间价值与寻求其他医疗服务的行为之间存在正相关关系。与预期等待时间相比，那些等待时间较长的患者更有可能寻求私人替代医疗服务。

abstract.text: When answering TTO questions respondents sometimes have to imagine being in a certain health state during their remaining lifespan, often based on objective life tables. Respondents however may have subjective expectations about length and quality of life that differ from the objective ones. If respondents do not fully abstract from own expectations, TTO scores may be biased. In this note, we indicate how subjective expectations could influence TTO scores and present some empirical findings suggesting that they do. Our results indicate that subjective expectations may serve as unobserved reference points and as such influence TTO responses.

10.1002/hec.873.abstractZh: 在回答TTO问题时，受访者有时需要想象自己在剩余寿命期间所处的某种健康状态，这通常基于客观的生命表数据。然而，受访者可能对寿命的长度和生活质量有主观的期望，这些期望与客观数据有所不同。如果受访者不能完全摆脱自己的期望，那么TTO评分可能会受到偏见的影响。在这篇笔记中，我们探讨了主观期望如何影响TTO评分，并提出了一些实证研究结果，表明这种影响确实存在。我们的研究结果表明，主观期望可能作为未观察到的参考点，从而影响TTO的评估。

abstract.text: The EQ-5D general population valuation set (or 'tariff') is increasingly being used in the evaluation of health care interventions and has been recommended by the National Institute for Clinical Excellence (NICE) for use in cost-utility analyses of health technologies. To be of use to decision-makers, the health gain implied by changes in health state values must reflect individual preferences. At the simplest level, if State A has a higher mean value than State B, then the majority of people should consider a move from B to A to be a good thing. In this paper, we examine the extent to which this is true by re-analysing data from the general population study used to derive the EQ-5D tariff. We show that, on average, the difference in value between two states has to be as large as 0.20 (on a scale where one represents full and zero represents death) for 70% of respondents to agree with the sign of that difference (never mind its size). Results such as these have important implications for the use of the EQ-5D tariff that has been generated from these data.

10.1002/hec.875.abstractZh: EQ-5D普通人群价值体系（或“价格表”）在评估医疗干预措施时越来越被使用，并且已被英国国家临床卓越研究所推荐用于医疗技术的成本-效用分析。为了对决策者有用，健康状况变化所暗示的健康收益必须反映个体偏好。最简单地说，如果状态A的平均价值高于状态B，那么大多数人应该认为从B转移到A是件好事。在本文中，我们通过重新分析用于推导EQ-5D价格表的数据，来检验这一点在多大程度上成立。结果显示，平均而言，两个状态之间的价值差异必须达到0.20（以完全为1，死亡为0的尺度），才能使70%的受访者同意该差异的符号（而不考虑其大小）。这样的结果对于使用从这些数据生成的EQ-5D价格表具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In France, public health insurance is universal but incomplete, with private payments accounting for roughly 25% of all spending. As a result, most people have supplemental private health insurance. We investigate the effects of such insurance on the utilization of physician services using data from the 1998 Enquête sur la santé et la protection sociale, a nationally representative survey of the non-institutionalized French population. Our results indicate that insurance has a strong and significant effect on the utilization of physician services. Individuals with supplemental coverage have substantially more physician visits than those without. While French patients have greater freedom than patients in other countries to choose to see a specialist rather than a general practitioner, we find no evidence that supplemental insurance affects this decision.

10.1002/hec.879.abstractZh: 在法国，公共健康保险是全民性的，但还不够完善，私人支付占所有支出的大约25%。因此，大多数人都有补充性的私人健康保险。我们利用1998年关于法国非机构化人口的健康与社会保障调查数据，研究了这种保险对医生服务利用的影响。研究结果表明，保险对医生服务的利用有显著且强烈的影响。拥有补充保险的人比没有保险的人就诊次数要多得多。虽然法国患者在选择看专科医生而非全科医生方面比其他国家的患者有更大的自由度，但我们没有发现补充保险会影响这一决策。

abstract.text: Recent studies such as the Commission on Macroeconomics and Health have highlighted the need for expanding the coverage of services for HIV/AIDS, malaria, tuberculosis, immunisations and other diseases. In order for policy makers to plan for these changes, they need to analyse the change in costs when interventions are 'scaled-up' to cover greater percentages of the population. Previous studies suggest that applying current unit costs to an entire population can misconstrue the true costs of an intervention. This study presents the methodology used in WHO-CHOICE's generalised cost effectiveness analysis, which includes non-linear cost functions for health centres, transportation and supervision costs, as well as the presence of fixed costs of establishing a health infrastructure. Results show changing marginal costs as predicted by economic theory.

10.1002/hec.880.abstractZh: 近期的研究，如宏观经济与健康委员会的研究，强调了扩大针对艾滋病、疟疾、结核病、免疫接种及其他疾病的服务覆盖范围的必要性。为了使政策制定者能够规划这些变化，他们需要分析当干预措施扩大到覆盖更大比例的人口时，成本的变化情况。先前的研究表明，将当前的单位成本应用于整个群体可能会扭曲干预措施的真实成本。本研究介绍了世界卫生组织-CHOICE通用成本效益分析所采用的方法，该方法包括针对卫生中心、运输和监管成本的非线性成本函数，以及建立卫生基础设施的固定成本。研究结果表明，边际成本如经济理论所预测的那样发生了变化。

abstract.text: We use National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) data to examine the effects of obesity on wages by gender. Sample means indicate that both men and women experience a persistent obesity wage penalty over the first two decades of their careers. We then control for a standard set of socioeconomic and familial variables but find that standard covariates do not explain why obese workers experience persistent wage penalties. This suggests that other variables -- including job discrimination, health-related factors and/or obese workers' behavior patterns -- may be the channels through which obesity adversely affects wages. The study closes with a discussion of the public policy implications suggested by these findings.

10.1002/hec.881.abstractZh: 我们使用《全国青年纵向调查》的数据来研究肥胖对工资的影响，重点关注性别差异。样本均值显示，无论男性还是女性，在其职业生涯的前二十年里都面临着持续的肥胖导致的工资损失。我们控制了一系列社会经济和家庭变量，但发现这些标准变量无法解释为何肥胖工人会持续遭受工资损失。这表明，其他变量——包括职业歧视、健康相关因素以及肥胖工人的行为模式——可能是肥胖对工资产生负面影响的渠道。研究最后讨论了这些发现所暗示的公共政策含义。

abstract.text: Using a national data set, this paper looks at the efficiency of physician practices, focusing on scopes of service by comparing single specialty groups and multispecialty groups. An analysis of efficiency using DEA indicates that there are scope inefficiencies from combining different types of providers into a single practice. Most of the inefficiency is due to technical rather than allocative reasons. In addition, we find that larger practices are able to capture efficiencies of scope, but incur inefficiencies of scale.

10.1002/hec.882.abstractZh: 本文利用全国数据集，研究了医生执业的效率，重点通过比较单一专业组和多专业组的服务范围来进行分析。通过DEA方法对效率进行分析后发现，将不同类型的医疗服务提供者合并到一个执业中会导致服务范围方面的效率低下。这种效率低下主要是由于技术原因而非分配原因造成的。此外，我们发现规模较大的执业能够提升服务范围的效率，但也会带来规模方面的效率低下。

abstract.text: The principal aim of this paper is to estimate a stochastic frontier cost function and an inefficiency effects model in the analysis of the primary health-care services purchased by the public authority and supplied by 180 providers in 1996 in Catalonia. The evidence from our sample does not support the premise that contracting out has helped improve purchasing cost efficiency in primary care. Inefficient purchasing cost was observed in the component of this purchasing cost explicitly included in the contract between purchaser and provider. There were no observable incentives for the contracted-out primary health-care teams to minimise prescription costs, which were not explicitly included in the contracting system.

10.1002/hec.883.abstractZh: 本文的主要目标是估计一个随机前沿成本函数以及一个效率低下效应模型，以分析1996年加泰罗尼亚地区公共机构从180家医疗服务提供者处购买的基本医疗服务的情况。我们的样本数据并不支持外包服务有助于提升基本医疗服务采购成本效率的观点。在合同中明确包含的采购成本组成部分中，观察到了低效的采购成本。而外包的基本医疗服务团队并没有明显的动机去最小化处方成本，因为这些成本并未被明确包含在外包体系中。

abstract.text: This paper aims to add a more intuitive understanding to the concept of a concentration index for measuring relative inequality with an application of health-related measures by income. A new redistribution interpretation and an existing redistribution interpretation of the Gini are presented and applied to the concentration index. Both indicate the share of the total amount of any variable that needs redistributing in a particular way from rich to poor (or vice versa) to achieve a concentration index equal to zero. The characteristics of these redistribution schemes are compared. The paper also draws attention to the relationship between a concentration index, a correlation coefficient with relative income rank and a coefficient of variation of the variable of interest. These relationships are illustrated using data on inequality in dental care utilisation in European countries taken from the European Community Household Panel survey.

10.1002/hec.884.abstractZh: 本文旨在通过对健康相关指标的应用，使对用于衡量相对不平等的集中度指数的理解更加直观。文中提出了一种新的再分配解释方式，并将现有的基尼再分配解释应用于集中度指数。这两种解释都指出，为了实现集中度指数等于零，需要以特定方式将某一变量总量的部分从富人重新分配给穷人（或反之）。同时，还比较了这些再分配方案的特点。本文还强调了集中度指数、与相对收入等级相关的相关系数以及所关注变量的变异系数之间的关系。这些关系是通过使用来自欧洲共同体家庭面板调查的数据，关于欧洲国家口腔护理利用不平等情况的数据来加以说明的。

abstract.text: We develop a principal-agent model to analyze how the behavior of a physician in the public sector is affected by his activities in the private sector. We show that the physician will have incentives to over-provide medical services when he uses his public activity as a way of increasing his prestige as a private doctor. The health authority only benefits from the physician's dual practice when it is interested in ensuring a very accurate treatment for the patient. Our analysis provides a theoretical framework in which some actual policies implemented to regulate physicians' dual practice can be addressed. In particular, we focus on the possibility that the health authority offers exclusive contracts to physicians and on the implications of limiting physicians' private earnings.

10.1002/hec.890.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个主体-代理模型，来分析公共部门中的医生行为如何受到其在私营部门活动的影晌。我们发现，当医生将公共活动作为提升其私人医生声望的手段时，会有动机过度提供医疗服务。只有当卫生当局希望确保患者得到非常精确的治疗时，才会从医生的双重执业中获益。我们的分析提供了一个理论框架，可以用来探讨一些实际用于规范医生双重执业的政策。特别是，我们关注了卫生当局向医生提供独家合同的可能性，以及限制医生私人收入所带来的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, I explore how children's health influences the wages and work hours of their mother. Some children have illnesses that require expensive medicine or treatment, but demand little parental time. Others require extraordinary amounts of time; and still others require care at unpredictable times of the day. I construct a theoretical model of mother's labor supply that explicitly incorporates the financial and time costs associated with the presence of unhealthy children. The model predicts that children with time-intensive illnesses and those with unpredictable illnesses negatively influence mother's labor supply, whereas children with illnesses with a strong financial component have a positive effect on mother's labor supply. In order to empirically test this, I organize a focus group of doctors to categorize illnesses and disabilities by the type of resources they require. Using the 1997 PSID Child Development Supplement, I estimate the effects of these requirements on mother's decision to work and work hours. After controlling for the financial burden of the illness, single mothers work fewer hours if their child has a time-intensive illness and married mothers are less likely to work and work fewer hours if their child has a severe condition with an unpredictable time component. These findings are consistent with the theoretical model and highlight the need to decompose the effects of child health on mother's work status. Model specifications that aggregate across illnesses are incapable of disentangling these effects and may therefore underestimate the welfare costs of having a sick child in the family.

10.1002/hec.891.abstractZh: 在本文中，我探讨了儿童的健康状况如何影响母亲的工资和工作时间。有些儿童患有需要昂贵药物或治疗的疾病，但这些疾病对父母的时间需求较低。另一些儿童则需要大量的时间照料；还有一些儿童需要在不确定的时间进行护理。我构建了一个关于母亲劳动力供给的理论模型，该模型明确考虑了与不健康儿童存在相关的财务和时间成本。该模型预测，需要大量时间照料的疾病以及具有不确定时间因素的疾病的儿童，会对母亲劳动力供给产生负面影响，而那些具有强烈财务负担的疾病则会对母亲劳动力供给产生积极影响。为了实证验证这一点，我组织了一组医生进行焦点小组讨论，根据疾病所需的资源类型对疾病和残疾进行分类。利用1997年PSID儿童发展补充数据，我估计了这些需求对母亲工作决策和工作时间的影响。在控制了疾病的财务负担后，如果儿童患有需要大量时间照料的疾病，单身母亲的工作时间会减少；如果儿童患有严重且具有不确定时间因素的疾病，已婚母亲的工作时间也会减少。这些发现与理论模型一致，并强调了需要分解儿童健康对母亲工作状况的影响。那些将各种疾病合并在一起的模型规格无法分离出这些影响，因此可能会低估了家庭中有一个患病儿童所带来的福利成本。

abstract.text: Health policy reforms in a number of countries seek to improve provider quality by sharpening the incentives they face, for example by exposing them to greater competition. For this to succeed, patients must be responsive to quality in their choice of provider. This paper uses data from Cyprus to estimate the effect of quality on patients' choice between public and private outpatient care. It improves on the existing literature by using a more comprehensive set of quality attributes which allows the dimensions of quality that have the largest effect on patient choice of provider to be identified. We also introduce an innovative way of measuring patients' perceptions of quality in a household survey. We find that patients' choice of provider is sensitive to quality, and that interpersonal quality is more important than either technical quality or system-related factors.

10.1002/hec.898.abstractZh: 许多国家的健康政策改革旨在通过增强提供者的激励措施来提高提供者的质量，例如使其面临更大的竞争。为了取得成功，患者必须能够根据质量来选择提供者。本文利用塞浦路斯的数据来估计质量对患者选择公共和私人门诊服务的影响。通过采用更全面的品质属性集合，本文改进了现有文献，从而能够识别出对选择提供者影响最大的品质维度。我们还采用了一种创新的方法，在家庭调查中测量患者对质量的感知。我们发现，患者选择提供者对质量非常敏感，而人际质量比技术质量或系统相关因素更为重要。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the issue of whether to include maintenance costs in an economic evaluation in mental health. The source of these maintenance costs may be public or private transfers. The issue is discussed in terms of a formal cost-benefit criterion. It is shown that, when transfers have productivity effects, income distribution is important, and one recognizes that public transfers have tax implications, transfers can have real resource effects and cannot be ignored. The criterion is then applied to an evaluation of three case management programs in California that sought to reduce the intensive hospitalization of the severely mentally ill.

10.1002/hec.899.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了在心理健康领域的经济评估中是否应包含维护成本的问题。这些维护成本的来源可能是公共资金或私人转移支付。本文从形式上的成本效益标准出发来讨论这一问题。研究表明，当转移支付具有生产效应时，收入分配非常重要，并且必须认识到公共转移支付具有税收影响，因此转移支付能够产生实际的资源效应，不能忽视这一点。随后，本文将这一标准应用于对加利福尼亚州三个旨在减少严重精神疾病患者住院时间的案例管理项目的评估。

abstract.text: In a large number of situations, activities in health care have to be measured in terms of outcome and cost. However, the cases where outcome is fully captured by a single measure are rather few, so that one uses some index for outcome, computed by weighing together several outcome measures using subjective and somewhat arbitrary weights. In the paper we propose an approach to cost-effectiveness analysis where such artificial aggregation is avoided. This is achieved by assigning to each activity the weights which are the most favourable in a comparison with the other options available, so that activities which have a poor score in this method are guaranteed to be inferior. The method corresponds to applying Data envelopment analysis, known from the theory of productivity, to the context of health economic evaluations. The method is applied to an analysis of the cost-effectiveness of alternative health plans using data from the Medical Outcome Study (JAMA 1996; 276: 1039-1047), where outcome is measured as improvement in mental and physical health.

10.1002/hec.900.abstractZh: 在许多情况下，医疗保健领域的活动必须以结果和成本来衡量。然而，能够完全通过单一指标来反映结果的情况相对较少，因此人们通常会使用一些指标来综合多个结果指标，这些指标的计算依赖于主观且相对任意的权重分配。本文提出了一种避免这种人为聚合的成本效益分析方法。该方法通过为每项活动分配最有利的权重来实现，这样，在该方法中得分较低的活动将被视为劣于其他选项。该方法相当于将生产理论中的数据包络分析应用于健康经济评估领域。该方法被用于分析不同健康计划的成本效益，所使用的数据来自医学结果研究（JAMA 1996; 276: 1039-1047），其中结果以心理和身体健康状况的改善来衡量。

abstract.text: Economic evaluations alongside randomised controlled trials (RCTs) are increasingly being designed to prospectively collect patient-specific resource use and preference-based health status (utility) data. This paper examines the ways in which preference-based health status (utility) data are used to generate quality adjusted life years (QALYs). A literature review was carried out which identified 23 published cost utility analyses suitable for inclusion. The methodology employed to calculate QALYs was not always consistent, as well as being poorly reported. The use of different methodologies in the calculation of QALYs may influence the magnitude and direction of results of evaluations. Analysts need to be consistent and fully transparent in the methodology chosen to calculate QALYs.

10.1002/hec.901.abstractZh: 经济评估与随机对照试验（RCTs）相结合，越来越多地被用于前瞻性收集患者特定的资源使用情况和基于偏好的健康状况（效用）数据。本文探讨了如何利用基于偏好的健康状况（效用）数据来生成质量调整生命年（QALYs）的方法。通过文献回顾，确定了23项适合纳入分析的已发表的成本效用分析。计算QALYs所采用的方法并不总是一致，且报告也较为混乱。在计算QALYs时采用不同的方法可能会影响评估结果的幅度和方向。分析人员在选择计算QALYs的方法时需要保持一致性和完全透明性。

abstract.text: Cost-effectiveness acceptability curves (CEACs) have been widely adopted as a method to quantify and graphically represent uncertainty in economic evaluation studies of health-care technologies. However, there remain some common fallacies regarding the nature and shape of CEACs that largely result from the 'textbook' illustration of the CEAC. This 'textbook' CEAC shows a smooth curve starting at probability 0, with an asymptote to 1 for higher money values of the health outcome (lambda). But this familiar 'ogive' shape which makes the 'textbook' CEAC look like a cumulative distribution function is just one special case of the CEAC. The reality is that the CEAC can take many shapes and turns because it is a graphic transformation from the cost-effectiveness plane, where the joint density of incremental costs and effects may 'straddle' quadrants with attendant discontinuities and asymptotes. In fact CEACs: (i) do not have to cut the y-axis at 0; (ii) do not have to asymptote to 1; (iii) are not always monotonically increasing in lambda; and (iv) do not represent cumulative distribution functions (cdfs). Within this paper we present a 'gallery' of CEACs in order to identify the fallacies and illustrate the facts surrounding the CEAC. The aim of the paper is to serve as a reference tool to accompany the increased use of CEACs within major medical journals.

10.1002/hec.903.abstractZh: 成本效益可接受性曲线已被广泛采用，作为量化并图形化表示医疗保健技术经济评估研究中不确定性的方法。然而，关于成本效益可接受性曲线的本质和形状，仍然存在一些常见的误解，这些误解主要源于对成本效益可接受性曲线的“教科书式”描述。这种“教科书式”的成本效益可接受性曲线表现为一条从概率0开始的平滑曲线，随着健康结果的货币价值增加，曲线趋近于1（λ）。但这种熟悉的“曲线形状”实际上只是成本效益可接受性曲线的一种特殊情况。现实情况是，成本效益可接受性曲线可以呈现多种形状和转折，因为它是从成本效益平面进行图形转换的结果，在该平面上，增量成本与效果的结合密度可能“跨越”不同的象限，并伴随不连续性和渐近线。事实上，成本效益可接受性曲线：(i) 不必在0处与y轴相交；(ii) 不必趋近于1；(iii) 在λ方向上并不总是单调递增；(iv) 并不表示累积分布函数。在本文中，我们展示了多种成本效益可接受性曲线的示例，以揭示其中的误解并说明相关事实。本文旨在作为参考工具，帮助在主要医学期刊中更广泛地使用成本效益可接受性曲线。

abstract.text: This paper presents a method to compare indices of inequality in health that are based on short-run and long-run measures of health and income. For pure health inequality (as measured by the Gini coefficient) and income-related health inequality (as measured by the concentration index), we show how measures derived from longitudinal data can be related to cross section Gini and concentration indices that have been typically reported in the literature to date, along with measures of health mobility inspired by the literature on income mobility. We also show how these measures of mobility can be usefully decomposed into the contributions of different factors. We apply these methods to investigate the degree of income-related mobility in the GHQ measure of psychological well-being in the first nine waves of the British Household Panel Survey (BHPS). This reveals that dynamics increase the absolute value of the concentration index of GHQ on income by 15%, or 1.7% per year on average, for men, and 5%, or 0.6% per year, for women.

10.1002/hec.904.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种比较健康不平等指数的方法，这些指数基于短期和长期的健康及收入指标。对于纯粹的健康不平等（以基尼系数衡量）以及与收入相关的健康不平等（以集中指数衡量），我们展示了如何从纵向数据中得出的指标与文献中通常报告的横截面基尼系数和集中指数进行关联，同时借鉴了关于收入流动性的研究来探讨健康流动性的衡量方法。我们还展示了如何将这些流动性指标分解为不同因素的贡献。我们将这些方法应用于研究英国家庭面板调查前九波数据中，关于与收入相关的心理福祉的GHQ指标的流动性程度。研究结果显示，动态因素使GHQ的集中指数相对于收入的绝对值增加了15%，男性平均每年增加1.7%，女性平均每年增加5%，即0.6%。

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence on the sources of differences in the degree of income-related inequalities in self-assessed health in 13 European Union member states. It goes beyond earlier work by measuring health using an interval regression approach to compute concentration indices and by decomposing inequality into its determining factors. New and more comparable data were used, taken from the 1996 wave of the European Community Household Panel. Significant inequalities in health (utility) favouring the higher income groups emerge in all countries, but are particularly high in Portugal and - to a lesser extent - in the UK and in Denmark. By contrast, relatively low health inequality is observed in the Netherlands and Germany, and also in Italy, Belgium, Spain Austria and Ireland. There is a positive correlation with income inequality per se but the relationship is weaker than in previous research. Health inequality is not merely a reflection of income inequality. A decomposition analysis shows that the (partial) income elasticities of the explanatory variables are generally more important than their unequal distribution by income in explaining the cross-country differences in income-related health inequality. Especially the relative health and income position of non-working Europeans like the retired and disabled explains a great deal of 'excess inequality'. We also find a substantial contribution of regional health disparities to socio-economic inequalities, primarily in the Southern European countries.

10.1002/hec.918.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于13个欧盟成员国在收入相关健康不平等程度差异来源的新证据。通过采用区间回归方法计算健康指数，并将不平等分解为其决定因素，本文超越了以往的研究。使用了来自1996年欧洲共同体家庭面板的新且更具可比性的数据。在所有国家中，都出现了有利于高收入群体的健康不平等现象，但在葡萄牙尤为明显，英国和丹麦则相对较低。相比之下，荷兰、德国以及意大利、比利时、西班牙、奥地利和爱尔兰的健康不平等程度较低。收入不平等本身与健康不平等之间存在正相关关系，但这种关系比以往研究中的关系更为微弱。健康不平等并不仅仅是收入不平等的反映。分解分析表明，解释变量的（部分）收入弹性在解释各国之间收入相关健康不平等的差异方面更为重要，其重要性通常大于按收入分布的不平等。尤其是像退休人员和残疾人这样的非劳动型欧洲人的相对健康与收入状况，在很大程度上解释了“超额不平等”现象。我们还发现，地区性健康差异对社会经济不平等有着显著的影响，尤其是在南欧国家。

abstract.text: This paper presents new international comparative evidence on the factors driving inequalities in the use of GP and specialist services in 12 EU member states. The data are taken from the 1996 wave of the European Community Household Panel (ECHP). We examine two types of utilisation (the probability of a visit and the conditional number of positive visits) for two types of medical care: general practitioner and medical specialist visits using probit, truncated Negbin and generalised Negbin models. We find little or no evidence of income-related inequity in the probability of a GP visit in these countries. Conditional upon at least one visit, there is even evidence of a somewhat pro-poor distribution. By contrast, substantial pro-rich inequity emerges in virtually every country with respect to the probability of contacting a medical specialist. Despite their lower needs for such care, wealthier and higher educated individuals appear to be much more likely to see a specialist than the less well-off. This phenomenon is universal in Europe, but stronger in countries where either private insurance cover or private practice options are offered to purchase quicker and/or preferential access. Pro-rich inequity in subsequent visits adds to this access inequity but appears more related to regional disparities in utilisation than to other factors. Despite decades of universal and fairly comprehensive coverage in European countries, utilisation patterns suggest that rich and poor are not treated equally.

10.1002/hec.919.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于12个欧盟成员国中全科医生和专科医生服务使用不平等因素的新国际比较证据。数据来源于1996年的欧洲社区家庭面板调查。我们采用了概率模型、截断负bin模型和广义负bin模型，研究了两种类型的医疗服务——全科医生和专科医生服务——的使用情况，包括就诊概率和条件下的阳性就诊次数。研究发现，在这些国家中，与收入相关的全科医生就诊概率不平等现象几乎不存在。然而，在至少一次就诊的条件下，专科医生就诊概率却呈现出某种有利于穷人的分布。相比之下，几乎每个国家都存在严重的有利于富人的专科医生就诊概率不平等现象。尽管富裕和受教育程度较高的个体似乎比贫困者更有可能获得专科医疗服务，但这种现象在欧洲是普遍存在的，而在那些提供私人保险覆盖或私人执业选择以便更快获得或优先获取服务的国家，这种不平等现象更为明显。后续就诊中的富人优势不平等现象进一步加剧了这种获取服务的不平等，但这种现象似乎更多地与地区使用差异有关，而非其他因素。尽管欧洲国家几十年来实现了普遍且相当全面的医疗服务覆盖，但使用模式表明，富人和穷人并未得到平等对待。

abstract.text: We estimate the determinants of utilisation of physician and hospital services in Belgium using a one- and two-part panel count data model, and a one- and two-part pooled count data model. We conclude that the two-part panel count data model is most appropriate as it controls for unobserved heterogeneity and allows for a two-part decision-making process. The estimates of the determinants of utilisation of health care are then used to calculate indices of horizontal inequity. We find that inequity for general practitioner and hospital services is stable across time and in favour of low-income individuals, in the sense that, overall, they consume more than one would expect on the basis of their need, albeit the indices for hospital care are not significant. Horizontal equity applies to specialist care in all years, but from 1999 onwards, some evidence (although not statistically significant) of pro-rich inequity is found.

10.1002/hec.920.abstractZh: 我们使用单部分与双部分面板计数数据模型，以及单部分与双部分合并计数数据模型，来估计比利时医生与医院服务利用度的决定因素。研究结果表明，双部分面板计数数据模型最为适用，因为它能够控制未观测到的异质性，并允许采用双部分决策过程。通过对医疗服务利用度决定因素的估计，我们进一步计算了横向不平等指数。研究发现，全科医生与医院服务的不平等现象随时间保持稳定，且倾向于低收入人群，即总体而言，他们的消费量超出了基于需求所预期的水平，不过医院护理方面的不平等指数并不显著。在专科护理方面，横向公平在所有年份都得到体现，但从1999年开始，虽然统计上不显著，但存在一些有利于富人的不平等现象的证据。

abstract.text: This paper considers the effect of work choices on mental health and looks at whether this differs across occupations. This requires a model that can deal with the endogeneity in the relationship between health, occupation and work choices. We specify such a model and estimate it on a unique UK panel survey. The survey, called the National Child development Survey (NCDS), follows a cohort since their birth in 1958 until age 42. The analyses show us that early childhood health and ability have long lasting consequences for the mental health at the later ages. Females have lower levels of mental health. Mental health deteriorates with age for males and females, but the rate of deterioration is substantially lower for females. We also find that the rate of depreciation is lower when individuals work. For females we find large effects of occupation, for males we do not find this. Employment status is important for males, but not for females. For both genders we find very large effects of the onset of a long-standing illness. The probability of experiencing such an event depends on employment status, occupation and life style variables.

10.1002/hec.929.abstractZh: 本文探讨了工作选择对心理健康的影响，并研究了这种影响在不同职业之间是否存在差异。为此，我们需要一个能够处理健康、职业与工作选择之间关系的内生性的模型。我们构建了一个这样的模型，并在一项独特的英国面板调查中对其进行了估计。这项调查被称为“国家儿童发展调查”（NCDS），从1958年出生开始跟踪一个群体直到42岁。分析结果显示，儿童时期的健康状况和能力对后期心理健康有着长期的影响。女性的心理健康水平较低。男性和女性的心理健康状况都会随着年龄的增长而恶化，但女性的恶化速度明显较慢。我们还发现，个体工作时的心理健康恶化速度较低。对于女性来说，职业因素对其心理健康有显著影响，而男性则没有这种影响。就业状况对男性来说很重要，但对女性来说则不然。对于两性而言，长期疾病的发病都有很大的影响。经历此类事件的概率取决于就业状况、职业和生活方式等因素。

abstract.text: In the last few years, the price of cigarettes has increased considerably in the USA. In addition, a number of states have also imposed smoking bans. These increases in the cost and barriers to smoking have created a natural experiment to study relationships between smoking and drinking behaviors. In this study, we employ data from the first six waves of the Health and Retirement Survey (HRS) to analyze the effects of smoking bans and cigarette prices on alcohol consumption. We also test if past cigarette and alcohol consumption affect current alcohol consumption as predicted by co-addiction models. We estimate dynamic panel models using GMM estimators. Our approach allows us to obtain consistent estimates irrespective of the number of time periods. The three main findings of this study are: (1) there is positive reinforcement effect of past cigarette consumption on current alcohol consumption, (2) smoking bans reduce alcohol consumption and (3) there is a positive effect of cigarette prices on alcohol consumption.

10.1002/hec.930.abstractZh: 在过去的几年里，美国的香烟价格大幅上涨。此外，许多州也实施了禁烟令。这些价格上涨和吸烟障碍的增加为研究吸烟与饮酒行为之间的关系提供了天然的实验条件。在这项研究中，我们利用了《健康与退休调查》的前六波数据来分析禁烟令和香烟价格对酒精消费的影响。我们还测试了过去的香烟和酒精消费是否会影响当前的酒精消费，正如共瘾模型所预测的那样。我们使用GMM估计器估计动态面板模型。我们的方法能够无论时间周期的数量如何，都能获得一致的估计结果。本研究的主要发现包括：(1)过去的香烟消费对当前的酒精消费有正向促进作用；(2)禁烟令减少了酒精消费；(3)香烟价格对酒精消费有正向影响。

abstract.text: Studies of the impact of tobacco prices on decisions to initiate and quit smoking have, to date, largely been restricted to developed countries. Such analyses, when set in developing countries, are complicated by the availability of a wide range of tobacco products that are nicotine substitutes for cigarettes. This study, which uses data from two rounds of the Vietnam Living Standards Survey in 1992-1993 and 1997-1998, finds evidence of substitution among tobacco products in response to changes in relative prices and points to the need for comprehensive tobacco-control strategies that are not restricted to cigarettes alone. We find that higher cigarette prices may not necessarily encourage quitting and may only divert cigarette smokers to rustic tobacco, which is potentially as harmful to human health as cigarettes.

10.1002/hec.932.abstractZh: 迄今为止，关于烟草价格对戒烟决策影响的研究主要局限于发达国家。在发展中国家进行此类分析时，由于存在多种可替代香烟的烟草产品，情况变得更加复杂。本研究基于1992-1993年和1997-1998年两次越南生活水平调查的数据，发现烟草产品之间存在替代现象，这反映了相对价格的变化。研究指出，需要制定全面的烟草控制策略，而不仅仅是针对香烟本身。我们发现，较高的香烟价格未必能促使人们戒烟，反而可能会将吸烟者引向劣质烟草，而这类烟草对人类健康的危害可能与香烟相当。

abstract.text: Recent waves of major longitudinal surveys in the US and other countries include retrospective questions about the timing of smoking initiation and cessation, creating a potentially important but under-utilized source of information on smoking behavior over the life course. In this paper, we explore the extent of, consequences of, and possible solutions to misclassification errors in models of smoking participation that use data generated from retrospective reports. In our empirical work, we exploit the fact that the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 provides both contemporaneous and retrospective information about smoking status in certain years. We compare the results from four sets of models of smoking participation. The first set of results are from baseline probit models of smoking participation from contemporaneously reported information. The second set of results are from models that are identical except that the dependent variable is based on retrospective information. The last two sets of results are from models that take a parametric approach to account for a simple form of misclassification error. Our preliminary results suggest that accounting for misclassification error is important. However, the adjusted maximum likelihood estimation approach to account for misclassification does not always perform as expected.

10.1002/hec.934.abstractZh: 美国及其他国家最近的一系列重大纵向调查包含了关于吸烟开始和停止时间的回顾性问题，这为研究生命过程中吸烟行为提供了潜在的重要但未被充分利用的信息来源。在本文中，我们探讨了在使用基于回顾性报告的数据构建吸烟参与模型时，分类错误的影响范围、后果以及可能的解决方案。在我们的实证研究中，我们利用了1979年青年纵向调查所提供的关于特定年份吸烟状况的同步和回顾性信息。我们比较了四组吸烟参与模型的结果。第一组结果来自基于同步报告信息的基线Probit模型；第二组结果来自模型相同，但因变量基于回顾性信息；最后两组结果来自采用参数化方法处理简单形式分类错误的模型。我们的初步结果表明，考虑分类错误是重要的。然而，用于处理分类错误的调整最大似然估计方法并不总是如预期那样有效。

abstract.text: Hospital heterogeneity is a major issue in defining a reimbursement system. If hospitals are heterogeneous, it is difficult to distinguish which part of the differences in costs is due to cost containment efforts and which part cannot be reduced, because it is due to other unobserved sources of hospital heterogeneity. In this paper, we apply an econometric approach to analyse hospital cost variability. We use a nested three-dimensional database (stays-hospitals-years) in order to explore the sources of variation in hospital costs, taking into account unobservable components of hospital cost heterogeneity. The three-dimensional structure of our data makes it possible to identify transitory and permanent components of hospital cost heterogeneity. Econometric estimates are performed on a sample of 7314 stays for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) observed in 36 French public hospitals over the period 1994-1997. Transitory unobservable hospital heterogeneity is far from negligible: its estimated standard error is about 50% of the standard error we estimate for cost variability due to permanent unobservable heterogeneity between hospitals.

10.1002/hec.935.abstractZh: 医院异质性是定义报销制度时面临的一个重要问题。如果医院之间存在异质性，就很难区分成本差异中的哪些部分是由于成本控制措施导致的，哪些部分则无法减少，因为这些差异是由其他未观察到的医院异质性来源造成的。在本文中，我们采用计量经济学方法来分析医院成本的变异性。我们使用一个嵌套的三维数据库（住院-医院-年份），以探索医院成本变异的来源，同时考虑医院成本异质性的不可观测成分。我们数据的三维结构使得能够识别医院成本异质性的临时性和永久性成分。我们对1994年至1997年间在36家法国公立医院中观察到的7314例急性心肌梗死患者的数据进行了计量经济学分析。临时性的、不可观测的医院异质性远非可以忽略：其估计的标准误差约为我们因医院间永久性不可观测异质性导致的成本变异的标准误差的50%。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with the problem of estimating the demand for health care with panel data. A random effects model is specified within a semiparametric Bayesian approach using a Dirichlet process prior. This results in a very flexible distribution for both the random effects and the count variable. In particular, the model can be seen as a mixture distribution with a random number of components, and is therefore a natural extension of prevailing latent class models. A full Bayesian analysis using Markov chain Monte Carlo simulation methods is proposed. The methodology is illustrated with an application using data from Germany.

10.1002/hec.936.abstractZh: 本文探讨了利用面板数据估计医疗保健需求的问题。在半参数贝叶斯框架下，采用狄利克雷过程先验条件，构建了一个随机效应模型。这一模型使得随机效应和计数变量都具有非常灵活的分布形式。具体而言，该模型可以被视为一个包含多个随机成分的混合分布，因此是对现有潜在类别模型的自然扩展。文中提出了一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛模拟方法的完整贝叶斯分析框架。最后，通过德国数据实例说明了该方法的应用效果。

abstract.text: Under the UK fundholding scheme, general practices could elect to hold a budget to meet the costs of some types of elective surgery (chargeable admissions) for their patients. It was alleged that patients of fundholding practices had shorter waits for elective surgery than the patients of non-fundholders. Comparison of waiting times between fundholding and non-fundholding practices are potentially confounded by selection bias as fundholding was voluntary. We estimate the effect of a practice's fundholding status on the waiting times of its patients using both cross-sectional methods (OLS, propensity score, instrumental variables, Heckman selection correction and Heckman heterogenous effects estimators) and difference in differences methodologies to correct for selection bias. The estimated effect of fundholding status was to significantly reduce the waiting times for chargeable admissions of the patients of fundholders by 4.1-6.6% (or 4-7 days) with the instrumental variables and Heckman selection correction estimators yielding the highest estimates. We also find that patients of fundholding practices had shorter waits (by 3.7% or 2 days) for non-chargeable elective admissions, suggesting that fundholders were able to obtain shorter waits for all types of elective admissions.

10.1002/hec.937.abstractZh: 在英国基金持有计划下，普通医疗机构可以选择设立预算来支付某些类型选择性手术的费用（包括收费手术）。据称，基金持有医疗机构的患者在等待选择性手术的时间比非基金持有医疗机构的患者要短。然而，基金持有与非基金持有医疗机构之间的等待时间比较可能会受到选择偏差的影响，因为基金持有是自愿选择的。我们使用横截面方法（OLS、倾向得分、工具变量、Heckman选择校正和Heckman异质性效应估计器）以及差异差异方法来纠正选择偏差，以评估医疗机构的基金持有状态对其患者等待时间的影响。估计结果显示，基金持有状态显著减少了基金持有患者收费手术等待时间4.1-6.6%（或4-7天），其中工具变量和Heckman选择校正估计器的估计结果最为准确。我们还发现，基金持有医疗机构的患者在非收费选择性手术的等待时间也较短，缩短了3.7%或2天，这表明基金持有者能够在所有类型的选择性手术中获得更短的等待时间。

abstract.text: The most commonly used approaches to parametric (stochastic frontier) analysis of efficiency in panel data, notably the fixed and random effects models, fail to distinguish between cross individual heterogeneity and inefficiency. This blending of effects is particularly problematic in the World Health Organization's (WHO) panel data set on health care delivery, which is a 191 country, 5-year panel. The wide variation in cultural and economic characteristics of the worldwide sample produces a large amount of unmeasured heterogeneity in the data. This study examines several alternative approaches to stochastic frontier analysis with panel data, and applies some of them to the WHO data. A more general, flexible model and several measured indicators of cross country heterogeneity are added to the analysis done by previous researchers. Results suggest that there is considerable heterogeneity that has masqueraded as inefficiency in other studies using the same data.

10.1002/hec.938.abstractZh: 在面板数据中，最常用的参数（随机前沿）效率分析方法，尤其是固定效应模型和随机效应模型，无法区分个体间的异质性和效率低下现象。这种效应的混合在世界卫生组织（WHO）关于医疗保健交付的面板数据集中尤为明显，该数据集涵盖了191个国家和地区，时间跨度为5年。全球样本在文化和经济特征上的巨大差异导致数据中存在大量未测量的异质性。本研究探讨了几种用于面板数据的随机前沿分析方法，并将其中一些方法应用于WHO的数据。研究在之前研究者分析的基础上，增加了一个更通用、更灵活的模型，以及几个用于衡量国家间异质性的指标。结果表明，在使用相同数据的研究中，存在相当大的异质性，这些异质性被误认为是效率低下。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with quantifying the level of mental health mobility in the British Household Panel Survey (BHPS). We investigate whether the extent of intertemporal fluctuations in mental health is different across categories of socio-economic group such as income quintiles, educational attainment and social class. Our measure of mental health is the 12-item version of the General Health Questionnaire (GHQ) that serves as a self-administered screening test aimed at detecting psychiatric disorders. Using 11 waves of the BHPS and a variety of methods we show there is much mobility in mental health from one wave to the next. Further the extent of mobility varies across socio-economic categories with greatest persistence observed in more disadvantaged groups. In general, these groups suffer poorer mental health and experience more periods of ill-health. Our results have implications for the design of appropriate prevention policies targeting mental illness within different risk groups, and also for the measurement of long-term inequalities in mental health across socioeconomic groups.

10.1002/hec.939.abstractZh: 本文旨在量化英国家庭面板调查（BHPS）中心理健康状况的变动程度。我们研究了心理健康状况在跨时间尺度上的波动是否在不同社会经济群体之间存在差异，例如收入五分位数、教育程度和社会阶层。我们使用的心理健康测量工具是12项通用健康问卷（GHQ）的版本，该问卷是一种自我评估的筛查工具，用于检测精神疾病。通过11次BHPS数据收集以及多种分析方法，我们发现心理健康状况在不同数据收集周期之间存在较大变动。此外，这种变动程度在不同社会经济群体间也存在差异，处于更弱势地位的群体表现出更明显的心理健康持续性问题。总体而言，这些群体面临更严重的心理健康问题，并且经历更多的健康不良时期。我们的研究结果对于设计针对不同风险群体精神疾病的预防政策具有重要意义，同时也为衡量不同社会经济群体间长期心理健康不平等问题提供了依据。

abstract.text: We ask whether increasing HMO penetration causes hospitals to cut back on charity care using California hospital discharge data for 1988-1996. There is little evidence at the hospital level that private hospitals respond to HMOs by turning away uninsured and/or Medicaid patients. In the for-profit sector hospitals actually reduce the share of privately insured patients and increase the shares of Medicare patients and Medicaid births. Apparently, HMO penetration reduces the price paid by privately insured patients, making them relatively less attractive to for-profit hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2001.11.001.abstractZh: 我们探讨了HMO普及率的提高是否会导致医院减少慈善护理服务，本研究使用了1988至1996年加利福尼亚州的医院出院数据作为分析依据。几乎没有证据表明，私立医院会因为HMO的存在而拒绝接待无保险患者或接受医疗补助的患者。在营利性医院领域，私立保险患者的比例实际上有所减少，而接受医疗保险和医疗补助服务的患者的比例则有所上升。显然，HMO的普及率降低了私立保险患者的支付成本，使得他们对于营利性医院来说相对缺乏吸引力。

abstract.text: In the assessment of cost-effectiveness of alternative medical technologies, it is necessary to estimate the mean total cost per patient over the relevant patient population. Where information about costs comes from a clinical trial with censored data, care is needed to estimate mean total costs. We examine the theoretical connections between the two most widely used of a growing range of nonparametric estimators of costs under censoring. By clarifying the relationships between these simple methods we hope to make them more accessible and to facilitate the take-up of more sophisticated techniques. Recommendations are offered regarding the most appropriate of the available methods, but also on the potential for greater efficiency through parametric modelling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.06.006.abstractZh: 在评估替代医疗技术的成本效益时，需要估算相关患者群体中的平均总成本。当成本信息来自带有删失数据的临床试验时，需要特别注意估算平均总成本。我们研究了在删失条件下，两种最广泛使用的非参数成本估计方法之间的理论联系。通过阐明这些简单方法之间的关系，我们希望使它们更加易于理解，并促进更复杂技术的应用。我们提出了关于哪种方法最适用的建议，同时也探讨了通过参数建模提高效率的可能性。

abstract.text: A number of non-parametric estimators have been proposed to calculate average medical care costs in the presence of censoring. This paper assesses their performance both in terms of bias and efficiency under extreme conditions using a medical dataset which exhibits heavy censoring. The estimators are further investigated using artificially generated data. Their variances are derived from analytic formulae based on the estimators' asymptotic properties and these are compared to empirically derived bootstrap estimates. The analysis revealed various performance patterns ranging from generally stable estimators under all conditions considered to estimators which become increasingly unstable with increasing levels of censoring. The bootstrap estimates of variance were consistent with the analytically derived asymptotic variance estimates. Of the two estimators that performed best, one imposes restrictions on the censoring distribution while the other is not restricted by the censoring pattern and on this basis the second may be preferred.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.07.002.abstractZh: 已经提出了许多非参数估计量，用于计算在存在截尾现象时的平均医疗成本。本文评估了这些估计量在极端条件下的表现，包括偏差和效率，所使用的数据集具有严重的截尾现象。进一步使用人工生成的数据对估计量进行了研究。这些估计量的方差是根据估计量的渐近性质通过分析公式推导出来的，并将这些结果与通过经验方法得到的自助法估计值进行了比较。分析结果显示，不同估计量的表现模式各不相同，有些估计量在所有条件下都相对稳定，而有些估计量随着截尾水平的增加而变得越来越不稳定。自助法得到的方差估计值与分析得到的渐近方差估计值一致。在表现最好的两个估计量中，其中一个对截尾分布有所限制，而另一个则不受截尾模式的影响，因此第二个估计量可能更受青睐。

abstract.text: A ubiquitous form of government intervention in insurance markets is to provide compulsory, but partial, public insurance coverage and to allow voluntary purchases of supplementary private insurance. This paper investigates the effects of such programs on insurance coverage for the risks not covered by the public program, using the example of the US Medicare program. I find that Medicare does not have substantial effects-in either direction-on coverage in residual private insurance markets. In particular, there is no evidence that Medicare is associated with reductions in private insurance coverage for prescription drug expenditures, an expenditure risk not covered by Medicare. Medicare is, however, associated with a shift in the source of prescription drug coverage, from employer-provided coverage to Medicare HMOs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.07.003.abstractZh: 在保险市场中，一种普遍存在的政府干预形式是提供强制性但有限的公共保险覆盖，同时允许个人自愿购买补充性私人保险。本文以美国医疗保险计划为例，研究此类政策对公共保险计划未覆盖风险保险覆盖的影响。研究发现，医疗保险计划对剩余私人保险市场的保险覆盖并没有显著的影响，无论是正面还是负面。具体而言，没有证据表明医疗保险计划导致了私人保险中处方药支出保险覆盖的减少，而处方药支出风险并不在医疗保险计划的覆盖范围内。不过，医疗保险计划确实导致了处方药保险覆盖来源的变化，即从雇主提供的保险转向医疗保险管理组织提供的保险。

abstract.text: Accidents are the leading cause of death and injury among children in the United States, far surpassing diseases as a health threat. We examine the effects of child care regulation on rates of accidental injury using both micro data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, and Vital Statistics mortality records. Estimates from both data sources suggest that requiring day care center directors to have more education reduces the incidence of unintentional injuries. An auxiliary analysis of the choice of child care mode confirms that these regulations are binding and that higher educational requirements tend to crowd some children out of care, as do regulations requiring frequent inspections of child care facilities and lower pupil-teacher ratios. Thus, regulation creates winners and losers: Some children benefit from safer environments, while those who are squeezed out of the regulated sector are placed at higher risk of injury.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.07.004.abstractZh: 在美国，事故是儿童死亡和受伤的主要原因，其危害远超过疾病。我们通过《全国青年纵向调查》的微观数据以及生命统计死亡记录，研究了儿童保育法规对意外伤害发生率的影响。两种数据来源得出的估计结果表明，要求日托中心负责人具备更高的教育水平可以降低非故意伤害的发生率。对选择儿童保育模式进行的辅助分析进一步证实，这些法规是强制性的，较高的教育要求往往会使一些儿童无法获得保育服务，同样，对儿童保育设施进行频繁检查以及降低师生比例的规定也会使某些儿童失去保育机会。因此，法规的实施会产生不同的影响：一些儿童会受益于更安全的环境，而那些被排除在受监管领域之外的儿童则面临更高的受伤风险。

abstract.text: Postpartum hospital length of stay fell rapidly during the 1980s and 1990s, perhaps due to increased managed care penetration. In response, 32 states enacted early postpartum discharge laws between 1995 and 1997, and a federal law took effect in 1998. We analyze how these laws changed length of stay and hospital charges, using a national discharge database. Difference-in-differences models show that the laws increased both length of stay and hospital charges, but the magnitude of this effect is much smaller than has been estimated in previously reported case studies. Furthermore, we find that effects vary by law details, that ERISA diluted the law effects, and that law effects partially spilled over to unregulated Medicaid births.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.07.005.abstractZh: 在20世纪80年代和90年代，产后住院时间迅速缩短，这可能是由于管理式医疗的普及程度增加所致。作为回应，32个州在1995年至1997年间制定了产后早期出院法律，而一项联邦法律则在1998年生效。我们利用全国出院数据库分析这些法律如何改变了住院时间和医院费用。差异差异模型显示，这些法律增加了住院时间和医院费用，但这一影响的幅度远小于之前报道的案例研究所估计的。此外，我们发现这些影响因法律细节而异，ERISA法案稀释了法律的影响，而且法律的影响部分也扩展到了未受监管的医疗补助生育服务中。

abstract.text: Existing models of hospital financing advocate mixed schemes which include both lump-sum and cost-based payments. The doctor is generally the unique decision maker, which is unrealistic in a hospital setting where both managers and doctors are involved. This paper develops a model in which managers and doctors are responsible for different decisions within the hospital. In this model, public authorities who provide the financing, hospital managers who allocate resources within the hospital, and doctors who assign patients to either a low-tech or a high-tech therapy have information of increasing quality on the casemix of patients. The public authorities sign with hospital managers contracts specifying some lump-sum financing and some size of a high-tech equipment. In turn, managers, who know the broad mix of patients in the hospital, sign with hospital doctors contracts that specify the non-medical resources allocated to this facility as well as some remuneration. Doctors, who know each patient's illness severity, select the patients to be treated by the high-tech facility, and receive from public authorities some fee-for-service payment that is differentiated according to the low- or high-tech treatment used for curing their patients. What emerges is a two-stage agency problem in which contracts are designed to elicit information in the most efficient way.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.001.abstractZh: 现有的医院融资模式提倡混合式支付方案，包括固定金额支付和基于成本支付的两种方式。在医院环境中，通常由医生做出决策，但这种方式并不现实，因为医院的管理者和医生都需要参与决策。本文提出了一个模型，在该模型中，管理者和医生分别负责医院内的不同决策。公共机构负责提供融资，医院管理者负责分配资源，而医生则负责将患者分配到低技术或高技术治疗设施中。公共机构与医院管理者签订合同，规定一定的固定金额融资以及高技术设备的配置规模。管理者则根据医院内患者的综合情况，与医院医生签订合同，明确分配给该设施的非医疗资源以及相应的报酬。医生则根据每位患者的病情严重程度，选择由高技术设施进行治疗的患者，并从公共机构获得按治疗技术差异定价的服务费用。由此形成的是一个两阶段的代理问题，合同的设计旨在以最有效的方式获取信息。

abstract.text: This paper introduces the rank-dependent quality-adjusted life-years (QALY) model, a new method to aggregate QALYs in economic evaluations of health care. The rank-dependent QALY model permits the formalization of influential concepts of equity in the allocation of health care, such as the fair innings approach, and it includes as special cases many of the social welfare functions that have been proposed in the literature. An important advantage of the rank-dependent QALY model is that it offers a straightforward procedure to estimate equity weights for QALYs. We characterize the rank-dependent QALY model and argue that its central condition has normative appeal.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.002.abstractZh: 本文介绍了基于排名的质量调整生命年（QALY）模型，这是一种在医疗健康经济学评估中汇总QALY的新方法。基于排名的QALY模型能够形式化地体现医疗分配中的公平概念，例如“公平分配法”，并且包含了文献中提出的许多社会福利函数作为特例。基于排名的QALY模型的一个重要优势在于，它提供了一种直接的方法来估算QALY的公平权重。我们对基于排名的QALY模型进行了描述，并认为其核心条件具有规范性的吸引力。

abstract.text: The social welfare function (SWF) has been used within the economics literature, to study trade-offs between equality and efficiency. These SWFs are characterised by properties determined by traditional welfare economics. One of these properties, the monotonicity principle is explored in this paper. In the context of health there may be occasions when the monotonicity principle is violated as there may be circumstances where distributional issues dominate efficiency concerns. When this is the case, conventional SWFs are not flexible enough to represent such social preferences. Therefore, we propose a SWF with an alternative specification, which is general enough to accommodate preferences that are not necessarily monotonic. A survey of the Spanish general public was undertaken to estimate preferences regarding equality in health, relative to efficiency in health. The results (with 973 usable responses) give strong support to the existence of public preferences which violate the monotonicity principle, and thus to the usefulness of the alternative specification proposed here.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.003.abstractZh: 在社会福利函数这一理论在经济学文献中被用于研究平等与效率之间的权衡。这些社会福利函数具有由传统福利经济学所确定的特性。本文探讨了其中一个特性——单调性原则。在健康领域的背景下，有时会出现违反单调性原则的情况，因为在某些情况下，分配问题可能比效率问题更为重要。在这种情况下，传统的社会福利函数不足以反映这样的社会偏好。因此，我们提出了一种具有替代性规范的社会福利函数，这种函数足够通用，能够适应不一定具有单调性的偏好。我们对西班牙公众进行了调查，以评估他们对健康平等的偏好相对于健康效率的偏好。调查结果（共有973份有效回应）强烈支持存在违反单调性原则的公共偏好，从而证明了这里提出的替代性规范的有效性。

abstract.text: Recent studies indicate that approaching death, rather than age, may be the main demographic driver of health care costs. Using a 29-year longitudinal English dataset, this paper uses more robust methods to examine the effects of age and proximity to death on hospital costs. A random effects panel data two-part model shows that approaching death affects costs up to 15 years prior to death. The large tenfold increase in costs from 5 years prior to death to the last year of life overshadows the 30% increase in costs from age 65 to 85. Hence, expenditure projections must consider remaining life expectancy in the populations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.004.abstractZh: 最近的研究表明，与年龄相比，临近死亡可能是医疗费用的主要人口驱动因素。本文利用一个为期29年的英国纵向数据集，采用更为稳健的方法来研究年龄和临近死亡对医院费用的影响。随机效应面板数据双部分模型显示，临近死亡对费用的影响可追溯到死亡前15年。从死亡前5年到生命最后一年，费用增加了十倍，这一增长超过了65岁至85岁期间费用增加30%的情况。因此，支出预测必须考虑人群剩余的生命预期。

abstract.text: This paper provides the first comprehensive analysis of the effects of "Zero Tolerance" (ZT) Drunk Driving Laws--which set very low legal blood alcohol limits for individuals under age 21--on self-reported alcohol use and drunk driving using data from the 1984 to 2001 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS). I estimate two-way fixed effects models of alcohol-related behaviors of 18-20-year-olds that can condition on unobserved differences across states that may be correlated with determinants of drinking and drunk driving, and I use 22-24-year-olds as a control group. Results indicate that the laws reduced heavy episodic drinking (five or more drinks at one sitting) among underage males by 13%. This result is supported by models that use variation in treatment intensity induced by differences in body weight. I find mixed evidence of ZT effects for females, and no robust effects on drinking participation or drunk driving for either sex.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.005.abstractZh: 本文首次全面分析了“零容忍”酒驾法律对18至20岁人群自我报告的酒精使用行为和酒驾行为的影响。该法律对21岁以下人群设定了非常低的法定血液酒精含量限制。研究采用了1984年至2001年的行为风险因素监测系统的数据。通过构建双向固定效应模型，本文考虑了各州之间可能存在的差异，这些差异可能与饮酒和酒驾的决定因素相关。同时，以22至24岁的人群作为对照组。研究结果表明，该法律使未成年男性单次饮酒量超过五杯的行为减少了13%。这一结果得到了基于体重差异导致的治疗强度变化的模型支持。对于女性而言，关于“零容忍”法律的影响，研究结果并不一致；对于男女两性的饮酒参与率和酒驾行为，也没有明显的显著影响。

abstract.text: To assess the consequences of advance medical directives--which explicitly specify a patient's preferences for one or more specific types of medical treatment in the event of a loss of competence--we analyze the medical care of elderly Medicare beneficiaries who died between 1985 and 1995. We compare the care of patients from states that adopted laws enhancing incentives for compliance with advance directives and laws requiring the appointment of a health care surrogate in the absence of an advance directive to the care of patients from states that did not. We report three key findings. First, laws enhancing incentives for compliance significantly reduce the probability of dying in an acute care hospital. Second, laws requiring the appointment of a surrogate significantly increase the probability of receiving acute care in the last month of life, but decrease the probability of receiving nonacute care. Third, neither type of law leads to any savings in medical expenditures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.006.abstractZh: 为了评估预先医疗指示的后果——这些指示明确规定了患者在丧失行为能力时对于某一或多种特定类型医疗治疗的偏好——我们分析了1985年至1995年间去世的老年医疗保险受益人的医疗护理情况。我们比较了那些通过法律增强遵守预先指示激励措施以及要求在没有预先指示的情况下指定医疗代理人州的患者的护理情况，与那些没有这些法律的州的患者的护理情况。我们得出了三个关键发现：首先，增强遵守激励措施的法律显著降低了在急性护理医院死亡的几率；其次，要求指定代理人的法律显著增加了在生命最后一个月接受急性护理的概率，但降低了接受非急性护理的概率；第三，这两种法律都没有带来医疗支出的节省。

abstract.text: This paper studies the stability of health care expenditure functions in a sample of OECD countries. We adopt the cointegration approach and the results show that there is a long-term relationship between total health care expenditure (HCE) and gross domestic product (GDP). However, the existence of cointegration is only shown when we admit the presence of some changes in the elasticities of the model. Our results also provide evidence against the existence of a unique relationship between health and GDP for the sample. Thus, we can conclude that the differences in health systems may cause differences in the aggregate functions. Additionally, we examine aggregate health functions for government (GHCE) and private expenditures (PHCE), again finding evidence of different patterns of behaviour. Finally, we open a discussion on the character of health as a necessary or luxury good. In this context, we find differences between the government and the private function. In order to illustrate these findings, we propose a theoretical model as an example of the influence of political decisions on income elasticity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.08.007.abstractZh: 本文研究了OECD国家样本中医疗保健支出函数的稳定性。我们采用了协整分析方法，结果表明总医疗保健支出与国内生产总值之间存在长期关系。然而，只有在承认模型中的弹性存在某些变化的情况下，才能显示出协整的存在。我们的研究结果还提供了证据，表明样本中的健康与GDP之间并非存在唯一的关系。因此，我们可以得出结论，不同健康体系可能导致总体支出的差异。此外，我们还研究了政府支出和私人支出在总体健康功能中的作用，发现其行为模式存在差异。最后，我们讨论了健康作为必需品或奢侈品的特性。在这一背景下，我们发现政府与私人支出功能之间存在差异。为了说明这些发现，我们提出了一个理论模型，作为政治决策对收入弹性影响的一个例子。

abstract.text: The primary objective of this paper is to examine the relationship between the status of women in the household, the use of health care (demand for prenatal care and hospital delivery) and child mortality in India. Parents care about the health of their children but cannot directly affect child health by their actions. Instead they can, through their actions, control the use of health inputs. I jointly estimate the decision to use prenatal care, the decision to deliver the baby in hospital and child mortality. The estimation methodology allows us to account for unobserved heterogeneity and self-selection in the use of health inputs. The estimation results show that: (1) a woman's education has a stronger effect on health care usage relative to that of her husband; (2) a woman's control over household resources (ability to keep money aside) has a significant effect on health care usage; (3) both prenatal care and hospital delivery significantly reduces the hazard of child mortality; and (4) not accounting for unobserved heterogeneity and self-selection in the use of health inputs results in under-estimation of the effect of health inputs on child mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.002.abstractZh: 本文的主要目标是探讨印度家庭中女性地位、医疗保健的使用（对产前护理和医院分娩的需求）与儿童死亡率之间的关系。父母关心孩子的健康，但无法直接通过自己的行为影响孩子的健康。相反，他们可以通过自己的行为来控制医疗保健资源的投入。我联合估计了使用产前护理、在医院分娩以及儿童死亡率的决策。估计方法使我们能够考虑未观察到的异质性和在医疗保健资源使用中的自我选择现象。估计结果显示：(1) 女性教育对医疗保健使用的影響比男性教育更为显著；(2) 女性对家庭资源的控制能力（能够保留资金）对医疗保健使用有显著影响；(3) 产前护理和医院分娩都能显著降低儿童死亡的风险；(4) 如果不考虑未观察到的异质性和在医疗保健资源使用中的自我选择现象，就会低估医疗保健资源对儿童死亡率的影响。

abstract.text: This paper compares willingness to pay (WTP) estimates generated from the dichotomous choice (DC) and payment card (PC) approaches. In a split-sample WTP experiment concerned with allocating scarce health care resources across three health care interventions, the DC approach is shown consistently to generate larger welfare estimates than the PC. Observed difference between PC and DC experiments cannot be explained by the inclusion of non-demanders or methods of statistical analysis but may be partly explained by "yea-saying". No evidence of range bias or mid-point bias was found with PC responses. Data were also collected on respondents' ordinal rankings of the three interventions and person-trade-offs (PTOs). Neither of these approaches converged with WTP. Future work must address the decision heuristics individuals employ when responding to valuation experiments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.003.abstractZh: 本文比较了基于二分选择法和支付卡法得出的支付意愿估计值。在一个用于分配稀缺医疗资源的分割样本支付意愿实验中，二分选择法始终能得出比支付卡法更大的福利估计值。支付卡法与二分选择法之间的差异无法用非需求者或统计分析方法来解释，但可能部分是由于“肯定回答”行为造成的。在支付卡法中，并未发现范围偏差或中点偏差现象。同时，还收集了受访者对三种医疗干预措施的排序数据以及个人权衡数据。这两种方法均与支付意愿估计值没有收敛。未来的研究需要探讨个体在参与估值实验时所使用的决策启发式方法。

abstract.text: We examine cigarette demand in China and Russia using longitudinal micro-level household and community surveys. Previous developing-country price elasticity estimates of around -0.75 have been larger than United States estimates of about -0.4, but the former have relied primarily on aggregate data. In contrast, our micro-level price elasticity estimates in China and Russia range from 0 to -0.15. Thus, raising prices in poorer countries may not reduce smoking to the degree previously suggested.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.004.abstractZh: 我们利用纵向微观层面的家庭与社区调查数据，对中国和俄罗斯的香烟需求进行了研究。以往对发展中国家价格弹性的估计约为-0.75，高于美国的估计值约-0.4，但前者的研究主要依赖于总体数据。相比之下，我们在中国和俄罗斯获得的微观层面价格弹性估计值介于0到-0.15之间。因此，在较贫穷的国家提高价格可能不会像之前认为的那样显著地减少吸烟行为。

abstract.text: Variability in demand for hospital services may have important effects on hospital costs, but this has been difficult to examine because data on within-year variations in hospital use have not been available for large samples of hospitals. We measure daily occupancy in California hospitals and examine variation in hospital utilization at the daily level. We find substantial day-to-day variation in hospital utilization, and noticeable differences between hospitals in the amount of day-to-day variation in utilization. We examine the impact of variation on hospital costs, showing that increases in variance are associated with increases in hospital expenditures, but that the effects are qualitatively modest.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.005.abstractZh: 医院服务需求的变化可能对医院成本产生重要影响，但由于缺乏大量医院在年度内使用情况的统计数据，这一现象难以研究。我们测量了加州医院的日住院率，并分析了医院使用情况的日变化。我们发现医院使用情况存在显著的日变化，且不同医院在日变化幅度上的差异也较为明显。我们进一步研究了这种变化对医院成本的影响，发现需求变化的增加与医院支出的增加相关，但这种影响在性质上较为温和。

abstract.text: Utilities elicited under the "probability equivalence" version of the standard gamble procedure systematically exaggerate the utility increments of expensive health interventions that bring the recipient towards full health. Switching to the alternative "certainty equivalence" version would introduce the reverse bias. The biases arise from anticipated pre- and post-decision risk effects that expected utility theory omits. To include these risk effects, partition the future by changes in knowledge into: (1) pre-choice periods; (2) the pre-outcome future before the chosen act's outcome becomes known; and (3) the more distant post-outcome future, when that outcome will have become known.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.006.abstractZh: 在标准的赌博程序“概率等价”版本下，获得的效用会系统性地夸大那些能够提升个体健康水平的昂贵健康干预措施的效用增量。而切换到另一种“确定性等价”版本则会引入相反的偏差。这些偏差源于预期效用理论所忽略的决策前和决策后的风险效应。为了包含这些风险效应，可以将未来划分为：(1)决策前的时期；(2)在所选行动的结果尚未知晓之前的未来结果时期；以及(3)更远的未来结果时期，届时该结果将会被知晓。

abstract.text: Many hospitals in the 1990s many hospitals were accused of "upcoding" patient diagnostic related groups (DRGs) to increase Medicare reimbursements. We find that between 1989 and 1996, the percentage point share of the most generous DRG for pneumonia and respiratory infections rose by 10 points among not-for-profit hospitals, 23 points among for-profit hospitals, and 37 points in hospitals converting to for-profit status. Not-for-profit upcoding was also higher in markets with a larger for-profit hospital share. Upcoding appears to reflect both risk-taking by administrators and a closer alignment between the goals of the administration and the behavior of the clinical staff.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.007.abstractZh: 在1990年代，许多医院被指控通过“过度编码”患者诊断相关分组（DRGs）来增加医疗保险的报销金额。我们发现，在1989年至1996年间，非营利性医院中肺炎和呼吸道感染疾病最慷慨的DRG编码比例上升了10个百分点，营利性医院上升了23个百分点，而转为营利性地位的医院则上升了37个百分点。在营利性医院比例较高的市场中，非营利性医院的过度编码现象更为严重。过度编码似乎反映了管理层的风险承担，以及管理层目标与临床工作人员行为之间的更紧密契合。

abstract.text: Our estimation strategy uses sequences of conditional probability functions, similar to those used in discrete time hazard rate analyses, to construct a discrete approximation to the density function of an outcome of interest conditional on exogenous explanatory variables. Once the conditional density function has been constructed, we can examine expectations of arbitrary functions of the outcome of interest and evaluate how these expectations vary with observed exogenous covariates. We demonstrate the features and precision of the conditional density estimation method (and compare it to other commonly used methods) through Monte Carlo experiments and an application to health expenditures using the RAND Health Insurance Experiment data. Overall, we find that the approximate conditional density estimator provides accurate and precise estimates of derivatives of expected outcomes for a wide range of types of explanatory variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.008.abstractZh: 我们的估计策略采用条件概率函数序列，类似于离散时间风险率分析中所使用的技术，来构建在给定外生解释变量条件下的目标结果密度函数的离散近似。一旦条件密度函数被构建出来，我们就可以检验目标结果任意函数的期望值，并评估这些期望值如何随着观察到的外生协变量而变化。我们通过蒙特卡洛实验以及利用RAND健康保险实验数据对医疗支出进行的应用，展示了条件密度估计方法的特点和精度，并将其与其他常用方法进行了比较。总体而言，我们发现这种近似条件密度估计方法能够为各种类型的外生解释变量提供准确且精确的期望结果导数估计。

abstract.text: The relationship between substance use and adolescent sexual activity is an important one, and extensive literature has shown that substance use is positively associated with adolescent sexual behaviors. While this is true, causality from substance use to risky sexual behaviors is difficult to establish, as it is likely that an adolescent's sexual behavior and substance use depend on a set of personal and social behaviors, many of which are unmeasured. Researchers must thus devise a credible empirical strategy in order to overcome this omitted variable bias. Using the first waves of the National Longitudinal Survey of Adolescent Health and the 1997 National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, we call into question recent methods used to determine causality. Despite attempts to determine the causal relationship between substance use and sexual behavior, the nature of the relationship remains unknown.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.009.abstractZh: 物质使用与青少年性活动之间的关系非常重要，大量文献表明，物质使用与青少年性行为之间存在正相关关系。然而，从物质使用到危险性行为的因果关系难以确立，因为青少年的性行为与物质使用可能受到一系列个人和社会行为的共同影响，而这些行为中的许多并未被量化。因此，研究人员必须设计一种可靠的实证策略来克服这种遗漏变量偏差。通过利用《全国青少年健康纵向调查》的第一批数据以及1997年的《全国青年纵向调查》，我们对用于确定因果关系的现有方法提出了质疑。尽管人们试图确定物质使用与性行为之间的因果关系，但这种关系的性质仍然未知。

abstract.text: We seek to understand the relationship between employer decisions regarding which health plans firms choose to offer to their employees and the performance of those plans. We measure performance using data from the Health Plan Employer Data Information Set (HEDIS) and the Consumer Assessment of Health Plan Survey (CAHPS). We use a unique data set that lists the Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs) available to, and offered by, large employers across markets in the year 2000, and examine the relationship between plan offerings, performance measures and other plan characteristics. We estimate two sets of specifications that differ in whether they model plan choice as a function of absolute plan performance or plan performance relative to competitors. We find that employers are more likely to offer plans with strong absolute and relative HEDIS and CAHPS performance measures. Our results are consistent with the view that large employers are responsive to the interests of their employees.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.09.010.abstractZh: 我们旨在了解雇主在选择向员工提供何种健康计划时所作的决策与该计划绩效之间的关系。我们通过“健康计划雇主数据信息集”（HEDIS）和“消费者健康计划评估调查”（CAHPS）的数据来衡量绩效。我们使用一个独特的数据集，该数据集列出了2000年各大雇主在市场中可提供的健康维护组织（HMOs），并研究计划提供情况、绩效指标以及其他计划特征之间的关系。我们估计了两组模型，这两组模型在模型构建上有所不同，一组将计划选择视为基于绝对绩效的模型，另一组则基于相对于竞争对手的绩效来构建模型。研究发现，雇主更倾向于提供在HEDIS和CAHPS绩效指标方面表现优异的计划。我们的研究结果与“大型雇主会考虑员工利益”的观点一致。

abstract.text: The literature on physician-induced demand (PID) suffers from an inability to distinguish between the effect of better access and the effect of patient shortage. Data from the Norwegian capitation trial in general practice give us an opportunity to make this distinction and hence, study whether service provision by physicians is partly income-motivated. In the capitation trial, each general practitioner (GP) has a personal list of patients. The payment system is a mix of a capitation fee and a fee for service. The data set has information on patient shortage, i.e. a positive difference between a GP's preferred and actual list size, at the individual practice level. From a model of a GP's optimal choice we derive the GP's optimal practice profile contingent on whether the GP experiences a shortage of patients or not. To what extent GPs, who experience a shortage, will undertake measures to attract patients or embark on a service-intensive practice style depends on the costs of the various measures relative to their expected benefit. The model classifies GPs into five types. In the empirical analysis a panel of GPs is followed for 5 years. Hence, transitory effects should have been exhausted. We show that GPs who experience a shortage of patients have a higher income per listed person than their unrationed colleagues.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.10.001.abstractZh: 关于医生诱导需求的研究存在无法区分更好的就医渠道效应与患者短缺效应的问题。挪威全科医生按人头付费试验的数据为我们提供了区分这两种效应的机会，从而可以研究医生的服务提供是否部分是由收入驱动的。在该试验中，每位全科医生都有一份个人患者名单。支付系统包括按人头付费和按服务收费两种形式。数据集中包含了患者短缺的信息，即全科医生期望的患者名单与实际名单之间的正差异，这一差异存在于个体诊所层面。通过全科医生最优选择的模型，我们可以推导出全科医生在面临患者短缺与否时的最优执业模式。在面临患者短缺的情况下，全科医生是否会采取措施吸引患者或采取服务密集型执业方式，取决于各种措施的成本与其预期收益之间的关系。该模型将全科医生分为五类。在实证分析中，我们跟踪了一组全科医生5年的数据，因此，暂时性效应应该已经消失。我们发现，面临患者短缺的全科医生，其每位患者对应的收入高于那些没有面临患者短缺的同行。

abstract.text: This paper examines the factors that may be responsible for the 50% increase in the number of obese adults in the US since the late 1970s. We employ the 1984-1999 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System, augmented with state level measures pertaining to the per capita number of fast-food and full-service restaurants, the prices of a meal in each type of restaurant, food consumed at home, cigarettes, and alcohol, and clean indoor air laws. Our main results are that these variables have the expected effects on obesity and explain a substantial amount of its trend.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.10.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了自20世纪70年代末以来，美国肥胖成年人数量增加50%的可能原因。我们采用了1984-1999年的行为风险因素监测系统，并补充了各州层面的数据，包括快餐店和全服务餐厅的人均数量、各类餐厅的餐费、家庭消费的食物、香烟和酒精饮料，以及清洁室内空气法律。我们的主要结论是，这些变量对肥胖问题产生了预期的影响，并解释了肥胖趋势的很大一部分。

abstract.text: This study uses recent theoretical work about group decision-making to assess the quality of decision-making by expert consensus panels. We specifically examine (1) when individual members of panels will divulge their private judgments about the decision to the panel, and (2) when the group judgment is superior to the judgment of individual panelists and will lead to better treatment for patients. We conclude that to maximize the chance of an accurate decision, panels should be made as large as possible, adopt the smallest supermajority rule, and attract members with the highest individual competencies. Furthermore, interdependence among panelists and the goal of reaching consensus can reduce the efficacy of these panels.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.10.004.abstractZh: 本研究借鉴了关于群体决策的最新理论成果，以评估专家共识小组的决策质量。我们具体研究了以下两个问题：（1）小组中的个别成员何时会向小组透露他们对决策的私人判断；（2）当小组的共识判断优于个别成员的判断时，是否能带来更好的患者治疗结果。我们的结论是，为了最大化做出准确决策的机会，小组应尽可能扩大规模，采用最小的超多数规则，并吸引具有最高个人能力的成员加入。此外，小组成员之间的相互依赖以及达成共识的目标可能会降低这些小组的决策效率。

abstract.text: Many methods for modeling skewed health care cost and use data have been suggested in the literature. This paper compares the performance of eight alternative estimators, including OLS and GLM estimators and one- and two-part models, in predicting Medicare costs. It finds that four of the alternatives produce very similar results in practice. It then suggests an efficient method for researchers to use when selecting estimators of health care costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.10.005.abstractZh: 在文献中提出了许多用于建模倾斜的医疗保健成本和使用数据的方法。本文比较了八种替代估计器的性能，包括OLS和GLM估计器以及单部分模型与双部分模型，以预测Medicare成本。研究发现，其中四种替代方法在实践中的结果非常相似。因此，本文为研究人员在选择医疗保健成本估计器时提供了一种高效的方法。

abstract.text: Many questions in health policy require an understanding of the distribution of health status across a given population and how it changes as a result of policy interventions. Since objective data on individual health status are often unavailable or incomplete, especially for populations with very low mortality, increasing use has been made of self-reported health status (SRHS) data, which record people's own perceptions of their health status. SRHS has been shown to be a strong predictor of objective health outcomes and indications, including mortality. Nevertheless, the qualitative or categorical nature of SRHS data prevents the straightforward use of traditional tools of distributional analysis, such as the Lorenz curve, in evaluating inequality. This paper presents a methodology for evaluating inequality when the data are qualitative rather than quantitative in nature. A partial inequality ordering is defined to indicate when a distribution is more "spread out" than another; a second partial ordering (first order dominance) is used to indicate when the overall health level rises. Both are applicable to qualitative data, such as SRHS, in that results do not depend on the numerical scaling assigned to the categories. The approach is illustrated using SRHS data from the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) State Data Files for 1994, focusing on the distribution of SRHS within states.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.10.006.abstractZh: 在健康政策中，许多问题需要了解特定人群中健康状况的分布情况，以及这些分布如何因政策干预而发生变化。由于关于个人健康状况的客观数据往往无法获得或不完整，尤其是对于死亡率非常低的人群来说，人们越来越多地使用自我报告的健康状况数据。自我报告数据能够很好地预测客观健康结果和指标，包括死亡率。然而，自我报告数据的定性或分类性质使得传统的分布分析工具，如洛伦兹曲线，无法直接用于评估不平等现象。本文提出了一种在数据为定性而非定量时评估不平等的方法。定义了部分不平等排序，以表明一种分布是否比另一种分布更为“分散”；第二种部分排序（一阶优势）则用于指示整体健康水平何时上升。这两种方法都适用于定性数据，如自我报告数据，因为结果并不依赖于分配给各个类别的数值尺度。该方法以1994年全国健康访谈调查州数据文件中的自我报告数据为例进行说明，重点分析了各州内部自我报告数据的分布情况。

abstract.text: This paper presents an economic model to explain the behavior of life expectancy of both sexes. It explicitly examines the relationship between the gender gap in life expectancy and the gender gap in pay. It shows that as the latter narrows over the course of economic development, the former may initially expand but will eventually shrink. Simulation results from our model accord with the behavior of life expectancy for both sexes since the 1940s in the United States.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.11.001.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个经济模型，用于解释男女预期寿命的行为差异。该模型明确探讨了预期寿命性别差距与薪酬性别差距之间的关系。研究表明，随着经济发展，薪酬性别差距缩小时，预期寿命性别差距可能会先扩大，但最终会缩小。我们模型的模拟结果与自20世纪40年代以来美国男女预期寿命的行为相符。

abstract.text: This paper uses the British Household Panel Survey for the years 1996-2000 to investigate the relationship between saving and private medical insurance in the UK. Because the National Health Service (NHS) gives comprehensive health coverage and is generally free at source, one would not expect private medical insurance to crowd-out saving. However, the NHS being characterised by long waiting lists and generally poor quality, many people prefer to use private health services. In such circumstances, those individuals who are not covered by private medical insurance, and who are therefore more exposed to facing unexpected out-of-pocket private health care expenditures or income losses while waiting for public treatment might save more for precautionary reasons than those who are covered. According to our findings, which are based on a wide range of econometric specifications, there is a positive association between insurance coverage and saving, suggesting that private medical insurance does not generally crowd-out private saving. However, we found some evidence of crowding-out in those areas where the quality of medical facilities is perceived as poor, and in rural areas, characterised by fewer NHS providers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.11.002.abstractZh: 本文利用1996至2000年的英国家庭面板调查数据，研究英国储蓄与私人医疗保险之间的关系。由于国家医疗服务体系（NHS）提供全面的医疗覆盖且通常免费，人们不会预期私人医疗保险会挤占储蓄。然而，由于NHS的等待时间较长且服务质量普遍较差，许多人更倾向于使用私人医疗服务。在这种情况下，那些没有私人医疗保险的人，在等待公共治疗期间面临意外私人医疗支出或收入损失的风险更大，因此出于预防考虑，他们可能会比有保险的人节省更多的资金。根据我们的研究结果，基于多种计量经济学模型，保险覆盖与储蓄之间存在正相关关系，这表明私人医疗保险通常不会挤占私人储蓄。不过，我们在那些认为医疗设施质量较差的地区，以及以NHS提供者较少为特征的农村地区，发现了一些保险挤占储蓄的证据。

abstract.text: Many countries, including Australia, regulate the price consumers pay for pharmaceuticals. In this paper, the Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) is modelled as a multi-stage game played between the regulator and pharmaceutical firms. Conditions are derived under which vertically differentiated firms are regulated and a number of issues are discussed. These include efficiency, regulated firm profitability, leakage, and price discrimination. An extension examines the introduction of new drugs and concludes that if all the benefits of a new drug are to be realised, then existing agreements and transfers (per-unit subsidies) need to be renegotiated.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.11.003.abstractZh: 许多国家，包括澳大利亚，都对消费者购买药品的价格进行监管。本文将澳大利亚的药品福利计划建模为监管机构和制药公司之间进行的多阶段博弈。文章探讨了在何种条件下对垂直分化的企业进行监管，并讨论了多个问题，包括效率、受监管企业的盈利能力、监管漏洞以及价格歧视等。文章还探讨了新药的引入问题，并得出结论：如果要实现新药的全部效益，就需要重新协商现有的协议和补贴政策。

abstract.text: Previous empirical tests of quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs), the most widely used outcome measure in economic evaluations of health care, generally yielded negative results. These tests were, however, for the most part based on expected utility, which is now widely acknowledged to be descriptively inaccurate.
