The observed violations might, therefore, have been caused by violations of expected utility. We performed a new test of QALYs, which is valid under expected utility and under the two most influential non-expected utility theories, rank-dependent utility and prospect theory, and found considerable support for the QALY model. Our findings suggest that QALYs may be valid if nonexpected utility formulas are used to compute health state utilities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.11.004.abstractZh: 先前对质量调整生命年（QALYs）的实证测试，作为医疗健康评估中最常用的结果指标，通常得出了负面结果。然而，这些测试大多基于期望效用模型，而人们现在普遍认为期望效用模型在描述上并不准确。因此，观察到的偏差可能源于期望效用的违反。我们进行了一种新的QALYs测试，该测试在期望效用模型以及两种最具影响力的非期望效用理论——等级依赖效用和前景理论下都是有效的，并且得到了对QALY模型的显著支持。我们的研究结果表明，如果使用非期望效用公式来计算健康状态效用，那么QALYs可能是有效的。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of maternal employment during a child's first 3 years and during adolescence on his or her decisions to engage in a range of risky behaviors: smoking cigarettes, drinking alcohol, using marijuana and other drugs, engaging in sex and committing crimes. Using data from the NLSY79 and its young adult supplement, we do not find strong evidence that mother's employment--whether early in the child's life or during adolescence--affects the likelihood of participation in risky behaviors. We note as a caveat, however, that insufficient statistical precision makes it difficult, at times, to distinguish some potentially important effects from effects that are essentially equal to zero.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.11.005.abstractZh: 本文探讨了母亲在儿童三岁前及青春期期间就业对其参与一系列风险行为的影响，这些行为包括吸烟、饮酒、使用大麻和其他药物、性行为和犯罪活动。通过NLSY79及其青少年补充数据，我们发现母亲在儿童早期或青春期就业并不会显著影响儿童参与风险行为的可能性。不过，我们也需要指出，由于统计精度不足，有时很难区分一些可能重要的效应与实际上为零的效应。

abstract.text: This paper examines the influence of body weight, body image, and cigarette prices in determining adolescent smoking initiation. Adolescents who desire to lose weight may initiate smoking as a method of appetite control. Such behavior may undermine the goals of tobacco control policies that seek to prevent smoking initiation. Using a nationally representative panel of adolescents, we show that smoking initiation is more likely among females who are overweight, who report trying to lose weight, or who describe themselves as overweight. In contrast, neither objective nor subjective measures of weight predict smoking initiation by males. Higher cigarette prices decrease the probability of smoking initiation among males but have no impact on female smoking initiation. These gender-specific differences may help explain the mixed and inconclusive evidence of the impact of price on smoking initiation found in previous literature.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.12.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了体重、身体形象和香烟价格对青少年吸烟行为的影响。希望减肥的青少年可能会将吸烟作为控制食欲的方式。这种行为可能会破坏旨在预防青少年吸烟的烟草控制政策的目标。通过对全国代表性的青少年样本进行研究，我们发现，超重、表示想要减肥或自认为超重的女性更有可能开始吸烟。相比之下，无论是客观还是主观的体重指标都无法预测男性是否开始吸烟。较高的香烟价格会降低男性开始吸烟的概率，但对女性吸烟行为的影响则不明显。这些性别差异可能有助于解释以往文献中关于价格对吸烟行为影响的研究结果既复杂又缺乏结论性证据。

abstract.text: This article introduces a model in which individuals incur adjustment costs associated with adaptations made following changes in their health. With adjustment costs, patients' preferences for health states depend on their initial health in such a way that improvements have lower values than corresponding deteriorations. Improvement and deterioration must therefore be treated asymmetrically in CEA. The inclusion of adjustment costs also has other consequences. It produces a more stringent CEA criterion, and may affect the relative rankings of interventions. In addition, when health is multi-dimensional, and adjustment costs are incorporated, we show that a consensus on even ordinal rankings of health states becomes impossible.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.12.004.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一个模型，其中个体在健康状况发生变化后需要承担调整成本。由于存在调整成本，患者对健康状态的偏好取决于其初始健康状况，因此改善带来的价值低于相应的恶化。因此，在CEA中必须不对称地对待改善和恶化。引入调整成本还会产生其他后果：它使得CEA的标准更加严格，并可能影响干预措施的相对排序。此外，当健康是多维的，并且调整成本被纳入考虑时，我们发现即使是对健康状态的序数排序，也无法达成共识。

abstract.text: This paper studies the wage effects of the use of alcohol and tobacco. The analysis based on a recent survey in The Netherlands shows that for males the use of tobacco has a negative wage effect of about 10% while the use of alcohol has a positive wage effect of about the same size. The wages of females are not affected by smoking and drinking.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.12.005.abstractZh: 本文研究了使用酒精和烟草对工资的影响。基于荷兰的一项最新调查分析表明，对于男性来说，使用烟草会对工资产生约10%的负面影响，而使用酒精则会产生大致相同的正工资效应。女性的工资则不受吸烟和饮酒的影响。

abstract.text: Obesity is an epidemic health problem in many developed countries, and it is an emerging public health concern in developing, transitional, and newly developed countries. The purpose of this research is to investigate the relationship between individuals' knowledge concerning the health risks of obesity and their tendency to be obese (as measured by the "body mass index"). Instead of assuming that obesity is a pure physiological problem as in previous studies, we allow an individual's cost/benefit evaluation to play a role. Based on survey data from Taiwan, we investigate the relationship with the quantile regression technique. The results suggest that such a relationship does exist and it is different for males and females.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.12.006.abstractZh: 肥胖在许多发达国家是一种严重的健康问题，在发展中国家、转型国家以及新兴国家则成为日益严重的公共卫生问题。本研究的目的是探讨个人对肥胖健康风险的认知与其肥胖倾向之间的关系（以“体质指数”来衡量）。与以往研究将肥胖视为纯粹的生理问题的假设不同，我们考虑了个人的成本效益评估因素。基于台湾的调查数据，我们使用分位数回归技术来研究这一关系。研究结果表明，这种关系确实存在，并且男女之间存在差异。

abstract.text: One important motive for deregulating social health insurance is to encourage product innovation. For the first time, the cost savings achieved by non-US managed care plans that are attributable to product innovation are estimated, using a novel approach. Panel data from a major Swiss health insurer permits to infer health status, which can be used to predict health care expenditure. The econometric evidence suggests that the managed care plans benefit from risk selection effects. In the case of the health maintenance organization (HMO) plan, however, the pure innovation effect may account for as much as two-thirds of the cost advantage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.12.007.abstractZh: 放开社会医疗保险管制的一个重要动机是鼓励产品创新。本研究首次采用新颖的方法，估算了非美国管理式护理计划因产品创新而节省的成本。来自一家主要瑞士健康保险公司的面板数据表明，可以推断出健康状况，从而预测医疗支出。计量经济学证据表明，管理式护理计划受益于风险选择效应。然而，在健康维护组织（HMO）计划的情况下，纯粹的创新效应可能占成本优势的三分之二。

abstract.text: Using data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, we examine the relationship between nutritional status, poverty, and food insecurity for household members of various ages. Our most striking result is that, while poverty is predictive of poor nutrition among preschool children, food insecurity does not provide any additional predictive power for this age group. Among school age children, neither poverty nor food insecurity is associated with nutritional outcomes, while among adults and the elderly, both food insecurity and poverty are predictive. These results suggest that researchers should be cautious about assuming connections between food insecurity and nutritional outcomes, particularly among children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.12.008.abstractZh: 利用全国健康与营养调查的数据，我们研究了不同年龄段家庭成员的营养状况、贫困状况以及食物不安全状况之间的关系。最引人注目的发现是，虽然贫困可以预测学龄前儿童的营养状况不佳，但食物不安全对这一年龄组并没有额外的预测作用。在学龄儿童中，贫困和食物不安全都与营养状况无关；而在成年人和老年人中，食物不安全与贫困都具备预测作用。这些结果表明，研究人员在假设食物不安全与营养状况之间存在关联时应当谨慎，尤其是在儿童群体中。

abstract.text: There is some concern that ordered responses on health questions may differ across populations or even across subgroups of a population. This reporting heterogeneity may invalidate group comparisons and measures of health inequality. This paper proposes a test for differential reporting in ordered response models which enables to distinguish between cut-point shift and index shift. The method is illustrated using Canadian National Population Health Survey data. The McMaster Health Utility Index Mark 3 (HUI3) is used as a more objective health measure than the simple five-point scale of self-assessed health. We find clear evidence of index shifting and cut-point shifting for age and gender, but not for income, education or language.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.01.002.abstractZh: 存在一些担忧，即不同人群或同一人群的不同子群体在健康问题的回答顺序上可能存在差异。这种回答的异质性可能会使得群体比较和健康不平等的衡量失去意义。本文提出了一种用于有序回答模型中的差异报告检验方法，该方法能够区分点值偏移和指数偏移。该方法以加拿大全国人口健康调查数据为例进行了说明。McMaster健康效用指数Mark 3被用作比简单的五点自评健康量表更客观的健康衡量指标。我们发现，年龄和性别方面的指数偏移和点值偏移现象较为明显，而收入、教育或语言方面则没有这种现象。

abstract.text: Concerns about frequent and harmful medical errors have led policy makers to advocate the creation of a system for medical error reporting. Health providers, fearing that reported information about errors would be used against them under the current medical malpractice system, have been reluctant to participate in such reporting systems. We propose a re-design of the malpractice system -- one in which penalties are a function of the health provider's reporting efforts -- to overcome this incentive problem. We also consider some alternatives to this mechanism that address two important ways in which reporting effort may not be observable: hospitals may have interests distinct from individual physicians and may not be able to observe their reporting efforts, and a regulatory agency or a court may not be able to adequately observe reporting efforts by a provider.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.01.003.abstractZh: 关于频繁且有害的医疗错误的担忧促使政策制定者倡导建立医疗错误报告系统。由于担心在当前医疗事故体系中，关于错误的报告信息会被用于针对医疗提供者，医疗机构一直不愿参与此类报告系统。我们提出对医疗事故体系进行重新设计——在这种体系中，处罚取决于医疗提供者的报告努力程度——以克服这一激励问题。我们还考虑了该机制的一些替代方案，这些方案能够解决报告努力可能难以被观察的两个重要问题：医院可能拥有与个别医生不同的利益，可能无法观察到他们的报告努力；而监管机构或法院也可能无法充分监督医疗提供者的报告行为。

abstract.text: The role of lifestyle in mediating the relationship between socio-economic characteristics and health has been discussed extensively in the epidemiological and economic literatures. Previous analyses have not considered a formal framework incorporating unobservable heterogeneity. In this paper, we develop a simple economic model in which health is determined (partially) by lifestyle, which depends on preferences, budget and time constraints and unobservable characteristics. We estimate a recursive empirical specification consisting of a health production function and reduced forms for the lifestyle equations using Maximum Simulated Likelihood (MSL) for a multivariate probit (MVP) model with discrete indicators of lifestyle choices and self-assessed health (SAH) on British panel data from the 1984 and 1991 Health and Lifestyle Survey (HALS). We find that sleeping well, exercising, and not smoking in 1984 have dramatic positive effects on the probability of reporting excellent or good SAH in 1991, and that these effects are much larger having accounted for endogeneity. The failure of epidemiological analyses to account for unobserved heterogeneity can explain their low estimates of the relevance of lifestyle in the socio-economic status-health relationship. Indicators for prudent alcohol consumption and eating breakfast in 1984 are not found to be statistically significant determinants of SAH in 1991.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.02.001.abstractZh: 在流行病学和经济文献中，生活方式在调节社会经济特征与健康之间的关系方面的作用已得到广泛讨论。以往的分析并未考虑包含不可观测异质性的正式框架。在本文中，我们开发了一个简单的经济模型，其中健康状况部分由生活方式决定，而生活方式又取决于偏好、预算和时间限制以及不可观测特征。我们使用最大模拟似然法，对英国1984年和1991年健康与生活方式调查中的多变量probit模型进行了递归实证分析，该模型包含生活方式选择和自我评估健康状况的离散指标。研究发现，1984年良好的睡眠、锻炼和戒烟对1991年报告优秀或良好健康状况的概率有显著积极影响，且这些影响在考虑内生性后更为显著。流行病学分析未能考虑到不可观测的异质性，这解释了它们对生活方式与社会经济地位-健康关系相关性的估计较低的原因。1984年谨慎饮酒和早餐进食等指标并未被发现是1991年健康状况的显著决定因素。

abstract.text: This survey has demonstrated that the Danish public is concerned with distributional aspects of health gains. They have a strong inclination to give priority to those in a more severe health state provided their expected benefits are large enough to bring them to the health level where their rival patients are without treatment. Results also indicated that the equity argument may not apply with equal force on all health dimensions. Respondents did to some extent trade-off equity for greater health gains. A nouvelle finding is that the valuations of health increments per se seem to be affected by whether questions are framed as individual or social choices. If social decision making is the issue, health gains which involve relieving patients of extreme problems are valued more highly than relief of minor ailments. These discrepancies between individual and social valuations suggest that the use of QALY values elicited from an individual's perspective may not be valid in social decision making.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.02.002.abstractZh: 这项调查表明，丹麦公众非常关注健康收益的分布问题。他们倾向于优先考虑那些健康状况较为严重的患者，前提是预期收益足够大，能够让他们达到与未接受治疗的患者相同的健康水平。研究结果还表明，公平原则在评估所有健康维度时可能并不同样有效。受访者在一定程度上为了获得更大的健康收益而牺牲了公平原则。另一个新的发现是，对健康增量的评估似乎会受到问题是以个人还是社会选择的形式提出的影响。如果涉及社会决策，那么能够缓解患者极端问题的健康收益会比缓解轻微疾病更为受重视。这些个体与社会评估之间的差异表明，从个人视角出发使用QALY值进行社会决策可能是不有效的。

abstract.text: We show the estimable rational addiction model tends to yield spurious evidence in favor of the rational addiction hypothesis when aggregate data are used. Direct application of the canonical model yields results seemingly indicative that non-addictive commodities such as milk, eggs, and oranges are rationally addictive. Monte Carlo simulation demonstrates that such results are likely to obtain whenever the commodity under scrutiny exhibits high serial correlation, or when even a small amount of the variation in prices is endogenous, or when overidentified instrumental variables estimators are used, or when commonly imposed restrictions are employed. We conclude that time-series data will often be insufficient to differentiate rational addiction from serial correlation in the consumption series.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.02.003.abstractZh: 我们指出，当使用汇总数据时，可估计的理性成瘾模型往往会得出支持理性成瘾假说的虚假证据。直接应用该经典模型得出的结果似乎表明，像牛奶、鸡蛋和橙子这样的非成瘾商品具有理性成瘾性。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，只要被审查的商品表现出高序列相关性，或者价格变化的微小部分是非内生性的，或者使用了过度识别的工具变量估计器，或者采用了常见的限制条件，就很可能得到这样的结果。我们得出结论，时间序列数据往往不足以区分理性成瘾与消费序列中的序列相关性。

abstract.text: This paper implements a new method for calculating the extent of selection in the aged Medicare HMO market. Selection is measured as the difference in average costs between new Medicare HMO enrollees and Medicare fee-for-service stayers with data from 1990 to 1994. Results suggest Medicare HMO enrollees were 1030 US dollars cheaper in their first year of enrollment. The effect is found entirely in Part A (hospital) expenditures, confirming selection is based on inpatient rather than outpatient or preventive care. These results are consistent with previous work.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.02.004.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种计算老年Medicare HMO市场选择程度的新方法。选择程度通过1990至1994年的数据，以新加入Medicare HMO的参保人员与继续享受Medicare常规医疗服务服务的参保人员之间的平均成本差异来衡量。研究结果表明，加入Medicare HMO的参保人员在第一年的支出比未加入者便宜1030美元。这一效果主要体现在Part A（医院服务）的支出上，这证实了选择行为是基于住院服务，而非门诊或预防保健服务。这些结果与之前的研究结果一致。

abstract.text: This is a study of the influence of socioeconomic factors on the state of health of older Canadians. Three years of panel data from the Survey of Labour and Income Dynamics are used to model the transition probabilities between good and poor health. Care is taken to avoid the problem of endogeneity of income in modelling its effects, and to adjust reported income to free it from its strong association with age at the time of the survey. Of particular note are the significant effects found for income, in spite of universal public health care coverage. Significant effects are found also for age, education, and other variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.03.001.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了社会经济因素对加拿大老年人健康状况的影响。研究使用了《劳动与收入动态调查》三年期面板数据，来模拟健康状态之间的转换概率。在建模过程中，特别注意避免收入的内生性问题，并对报告的收入进行了调整，以去除其与调查时年龄的强烈关联。值得注意的是，尽管有全民公共医疗保健制度，收入仍对健康状况有显著影响。年龄、教育程度以及其他变量也显示出显著的影响。

abstract.text: It is believed that the length of a person's life depends on a mixture of economic and social factors. Yet the relative importance of these is still debated. We provide recent British evidence that marriage has a strong positive effect on longevity. Economics matters less. After controlling for health at the start of the 1990s, we cannot find reliable evidence that income affects the probability of death in the subsequent decade. Although marriage keeps people alive, it does not appear to work through a reduction of stress levels. Greater levels of psychological distress (as measured by General Health Questionnaire (GHQ) stress scores) cannot explain why unmarried people die younger. For women, however, we do find that mental strain itself is dangerous. High GHQ stress scores help to predict the probability of an early death.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.03.002.abstractZh: 人们认为，一个人的寿命取决于经济和社会因素的相互作用。然而，这些因素的相对重要性仍然存在争议。我们获得了英国最新的研究证据，表明婚姻对延长寿命有显著的积极影响。经济因素的重要性则相对较低。在控制了1990年代初的健康状况后，我们无法找到可靠的证据表明收入会影响随后十年内的死亡概率。虽然婚姻确实能延长人们的寿命，但它似乎并没有通过降低压力水平来实现这一效果。较高的心理压力水平（通过一般健康问卷的压力评分来衡量）无法解释为什么未婚人士的寿命较短。不过，对于女性来说，我们发现精神压力本身是具有危害性的。较高的一般健康问卷压力评分有助于预测早逝的概率。

abstract.text: This paper considers three types of provider-client interactions that influence quantity of health care use: rationing, effort, and persuasion. By rationing, we refer to a quantity limit set by a provider; effort, the productive inputs supplied by a provider to increase a client's demand; persuasion, the unproductive inputs used by a provider to induce a client's demand. We construct a theoretical model incorporating all three mechanisms as special cases. When the general model is specialized into one of three mechanisms, a set of empirical implications emerges. We test for the presence of each mechanism using data of patients receiving outpatient treatment for alcohol abuse in the Maine Addiction Treatment System. We find evidence for rationing and persuasion, but not effort.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.03.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了三种影响医疗服务使用量的提供者-客户互动方式：配给、努力和说服。所谓配给，指的是由提供者设定的数量限制；努力，指的是提供者为增加客户需求而提供的生产性投入；说服，指的是提供者用于诱导客户需求的非生产性投入。我们构建了一个理论模型，将这三种机制作为特殊情况纳入其中。当将一般模型专门化为这三种机制之一时，便会出现一系列实证结论。我们利用缅因州成瘾治疗系统中接受酒精滥用门诊治疗的患者数据，来检验每种机制的存在情况。研究发现，配给和说服机制的存在得到了支持，而努力机制则未被证实。

abstract.text: We consider policy issues regarding parallel imports (PIs) of brand-name pharmaceuticals in the European Union, where such trade is permitted. We develop a simple model in which an original manufacturer competes in its home market with PI firms. The model suggests that for small trade costs the original manufacturer will accommodate the import decisions of parallel traders and that the price in the home market falls as the volume of parallel imports rises. Using data from Sweden we find that the prices of drugs subject to competition from parallel imports fell relative to other drugs over the period 1994-1999. Econometric analysis finds that parallel imports significantly reduced manufacturing prices, by 12-19%. There is evidence that this effect increases with multiple PI entrants.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.03.005.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在欧盟允许品牌药品平行进口的情况下相关的政策问题。我们建立了一个简单模型，其中原制造商在其国内市场与平行进口商竞争。该模型表明，在较小的交易成本下，原制造商会接受平行进口商的进口决策，而随着平行进口量的增加，国内市场价格会下降。利用瑞典的数据发现，在1994年至1999年期间，受到平行进口竞争影响的药品价格相对于其他药品有所下降。计量分析发现，平行进口显著降低了制造成本，降幅为12%至19%。有证据表明，随着平行进口商数量的增加，这种效应会进一步加剧。

abstract.text: This paper presents the first national estimates of the effects of the SCHIP expansions on insurance coverage. Using CPS data on insurance coverage during the years 1996-2000, we estimate instrumental variables regressions of insurance coverage. Our regression results imply that 9% of children meeting income eligibility standards for SCHIP gained public insurance. While low, our estimates indicate that states were more successful in enrolling children in SCHIP than they were with prior Medicaid expansions that were focused on children just above the poverty line. Crowd-out of private health insurance was estimated to be nearly 50%, which is in line with estimates for the Medicaid expansions of the early 1990s. In addition, state anti-crowd-out provisions in the form of waiting periods were found to significantly affect both take-up and crowd-out.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.03.006.abstractZh: 本文首次提出了关于SCHIP扩展对保险覆盖影响的全国估计结果。利用1996至2000年的保险覆盖CPS数据，我们对保险覆盖进行了工具变量回归分析。我们的回归结果显示，符合SCHIP收入资格标准的儿童中有9%获得了公共保险。虽然这一比例较低，但我们的估计表明，各州在让儿童加入SCHIP方面比之前专注于贫困线以上儿童的Medicaid扩展更为成功。私人健康保险的替代率估计接近50%，这与20世纪90年代初Medicaid扩展的估计结果一致。此外，各州通过等待期等反替代措施，对保险覆盖的接受率和替代率产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: The Food and Drug Administration has accelerated the approval of therapeutically novel drugs so that patients have faster access to innovative drug therapies. Little research, however, has examined the variation in risks among therapeutically novel and less novel drugs. Do drugs that represent greater novelty also entail greater risks for patients? This paper uses post-marketing drug safety surveillance data from the FDA to examine the adverse drug reactions (ADRs) associated with novel and less novel drugs. Negative binomial regressions are used to examine the impact of a drug's FDA novelty rating on its ADR count controlling for differences in drug utilization, the conditions being treated, disease characteristics, patient characteristics, drug review times, and year-specific effects. Results show that drugs deemed novel by the FDA are associated with a greater number of serious drug reactions, including those that result in hospitalization and death, than less novel drugs. These results suggest that novel drugs pose greater risk of serious ADRs for patients relative to less novel drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.03.007.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局加快了治疗性新药的审批速度，以便患者能够更快地获得创新药物疗法。然而，关于治疗性新药与较老药在风险方面的差异，相关研究却很少。那么，更具创新性的药物是否也会给患者带来更大的风险呢？本文利用美国食品药品监督管理局的上市后药物安全监测数据，研究了与新药及较老药相关的不良药物反应。通过负二项回归分析，本文探讨了药物的FDA创新等级对其不良药物反应数量的影响，同时控制了药物使用情况、治疗条件、疾病特征、患者特征、药物审查时间以及年度效应等因素。研究结果表明，被FDA认定为创新性的药物，其严重的药物反应数量比较老的药物更多，其中包括导致住院和死亡的情况。这些结果表明，与较老药物相比，创新药物给患者带来的严重不良药物反应风险更高。

abstract.text: Informal care by adult children is a common form of long-term care for older adults and can reduce medical expenditures if it substitutes for formal care. We address how informal care by all children affects formal care, which is critically important given demographic trends and the many policies proposed to promote informal care. We examine the 1998 Health and Retirement Survey (HRS) and 1995 Asset and Health Dynamics Among the Oldest-Old Panel Survey (AHEAD) using two-part utilization models. Instrumental variables (IV) estimation controls for the simultaneity of informal and formal care. Informal care reduces home health care use and delays nursing home entry.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.04.008.abstractZh: 成年子女提供的非正式照顾是老年人长期照顾的常见形式，如果替代正式照顾，可以降低医疗支出。我们探讨了所有儿童提供的非正式照顾如何影响正式照顾，鉴于人口趋势以及为促进非正式照顾而提出的众多政策，这一点至关重要。我们使用两部分利用模型，分析了1998年健康与退休调查（HRS）和1995年老年人资产与健康动态调查（AHEAD）的数据。工具变量估计控制了非正式照顾和正式照顾的同时发生情况。非正式照顾减少了家庭医疗服务的使用，并推迟了进入养老院的时间。

abstract.text: User fees have been promoted as a potential complementary funding mechanism for health care in developing countries. In this paper, we appraise the use of contingent valuation (CV) as a tool to help develop user fees schemes that could be used to assist in allocating, and partially fund, health care. A random sample of 499 patients seeking care in primary health care centers, in Palestine, were asked to reveal their willingness to pay values for specified improvements in the quality of delivered medical care. Empirical analysis suggests that, in this context, CV can lead to internally consistent results and useful policy implications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.05.001.abstractZh: 用户付费被提倡作为发展中国家医疗保健的潜在补充资金机制。在本文中，我们评估了条件价值评估作为一种工具，用于制定能够协助分配和部分资助医疗保健的用户付费方案。在巴勒斯坦的初级医疗保健中心，我们随机选取了499名寻求治疗的病人，要求他们表明愿意为改善医疗服务质量而支付的费用。实证分析表明，在这种情况下，条件价值评估可以得出一致的结果，并有助于制定有效的政策。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of air pollution on child hospitalizations for asthma using naturally occurring seasonal variations in pollution within zip codes. Of the pollutants considered, carbon monoxide (CO) has a significant effect on asthma for children ages 1-18: if 1998 pollution levels were at their 1992 levels, there would be a 5-14% increase in asthma admissions. Also, households respond to information about pollution with avoidance behavior, suggesting it is important to account for these endogenous responses when measuring the effect of pollution on health. Finally, the effect of pollution is greater for children of lower socio-economic status (SES), indicating that pollution is one potential mechanism by which SES affects health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2004.05.002.abstractZh: 本文利用邮政编码区域内自然存在的季节性污染变化，估算了空气污染对儿童哮喘住院的影响。在考虑的污染物中，一氧化碳对1-18岁儿童哮喘有显著影响：如果1998年的污染水平与1992年相同，哮喘住院人数将增加5-14%。此外，家庭会对污染信息作出回避行为反应，这表明在衡量污染对健康的影响时，需要考虑这些内生性反应。最后，污染对低社会经济地位（SES）的儿童的影响更大，这表明污染是SES影响健康的潜在机制之一。

abstract.text: We argue that a sharp distinction must be made between the empirical problem of finding the best equation for explaining medical expenditures and the normative question of deriving capitations which give health plans the appropriate incentives. We propose a procedure, taken from the social choice literature, to go from the estimated equations to the capitations. If the estimated equations are not additively separable in legitimate and illegitimate risk-adjusters, it is impossible to remove all incentives for risk selection while respecting at the same time a straightforward requirement of horizontal equity. This has immediate implications for the choice of the functional form. Moreover, in so far as the conventional risk adjustment literature only includes so-called "legitimate" risk-adjusters in the estimations, its results may suffer from omitted variables-bias. We illustrate our general methodological points with empirical results, obtained from a cross-section of 321,111 Belgian patients.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00040-7.abstractZh: 我们认为，在寻找解释医疗支出的最佳方程的实证问题与为健康计划提供适当激励的规范性问题之间，必须做出明确的区分。我们提出了一种从估计方程推导出激励方案的流程，该流程借鉴了社会选择领域的理论。如果估计方程在合法与非法的风险调整因子中不可加性，那么在不违反水平公平原则的情况下，就无法消除所有风险选择的激励。这对函数形式的选择具有直接的影响。此外，由于传统的风险调整文献仅包含所谓的“合法”风险调整因子，其结果可能会受到遗漏变量偏差的影响。我们通过来自321,111名比利时患者的横截面数据，用实证结果来说明我们的总体方法论观点。

abstract.text: This paper reviews the concept of optimal quality in medical care from an economic viewpoint. It also provides some data on recent trends in competition in the health care sector. Economically optimal quality reflects a tradeoff of marginal benefits against (minimized) marginal cost. Actual quality may be suboptimal either because of technical inefficiency in the production of quality or because consumers fail to make proper choices. In concept, competition, if supplemented by adequate information, can help. Overall competition in the hospital industry has declined modestly in recent years, but competition in markets for more generously reimbursed specific services, such as coronary artery bypass grafting, has increased.

10.1023/b:ihfe.0000032419.89581.04.abstractZh: 本文从经济学的角度探讨了医疗护理中最佳质量的概念。同时，文章还提供了一些关于医疗保健行业竞争趋势的数据。经济上的最佳质量反映了边际收益与边际成本之间的权衡。实际质量可能低于最佳水平，这可能是由于生产质量的技术效率不足，或者因为消费者未能做出正确的选择。从概念上讲，如果辅以足够的信息，竞争可以帮助改善这一状况。近年来，医院行业的整体竞争程度有所下降，但针对更昂贵服务（如冠状动脉搭桥手术）的市场竞争则有所增强。

abstract.text: In 1987 the federal government permitted states to raise the speed limit on their rural interstate roads, but not on their urban interstate roads, from 55 mph to 65 mph. Since the states that adopted the higher speed limit must have valued the travel hours they saved more than the fatalities incurred, this institutional change provides an opportunity to estimate an upper bound on the public’s willingness to trade off wealth for a change in the probability of death. Our estimates indicate that the adoption of the 65‐mph limit increased speeds by approximately 4 percent, or 2.5 mph, and fatality rates by roughly 35 percent. Together, the estimates suggest that about 125,000 hours were saved per lost life. When the time saved is valued at the average hourly wage, the estimates imply that adopting states were willing to accept risks that resulted in a savings of $1.54 million (1997 dollars) per fatality, with a sampling error roughly one‐third this value. We set out a simple model of states' decisions to adopt the 65‐mph limit that turns on whether their savings exceed their value of a statistical life. The empirical implementation of this model supports the claim that $1.54 million is an upper bound, but it provides imprecise estimates of the value of a statistical life.

10.1086/379932.abstractZh: 1987年，联邦政府允许各州将其农村州际道路的限速从55英里每小时提高到65英里每小时，但城市州际道路的限速并未调整。由于采用更高限速的州显然更看重节省的出行时间，而非由此带来的死亡风险，这一制度变化为估算公众愿意为降低死亡概率而牺牲财富的程度提供了依据。我们的估算显示，采用65英里每小时的限速使车速提高了约4%，即2.5英里每小时，同时死亡率下降了约35%。综合这些估算结果，每减少一例死亡事故可节省约125,000小时的出行时间。当这些节省的时间按平均时薪计算时，估算表明采用该限速的州愿意接受每死亡一人导致154万美元损失的风险，其抽样误差约为该数值的三分之一。我们建立了一个简单的模型，用于分析各州是否愿意采用65英里每小时的限速，该模型基于其节省的时间是否超过“统计生命价值”来做出决策。该模型的实证验证支持“154万美元是这一上限”的观点，但对其“统计生命价值”的估算并不精确。

abstract.text: U.S. corporations do not issue and repurchase debt and equity to counteract the mechanistic effects of stock returns on their debt-equity ratios. Thus over one- to five-year horizons, stock returns can explain about 40 percent of debt ratio dynamics. Although corporate net issuing activity is lively and although it can explain 60 percent of debt ratio dynamics (long-term debt issuing activity being most capital structurerelevant), corporate issuing motives remain largely a mystery. When stock returns are accounted for, many other proxies used in the literature play a much lesser role in explaining capital structure.

10.1086/379933.abstractZh: 美国企业并不发行和回购债务及股权，以此来抵消股票回报对其债务-股权比率的机械性影响。因此，在1至5年的时间范围内，股票回报可以解释约40%的债务比率变化。尽管企业净发行活动十分活跃，并且可以解释60%的债务比率变化（其中长期债务发行活动对资本结构的影响最为显著），但企业发行动机仍然很大程度上是个谜。当考虑股票回报因素时，文献中使用的许多其他替代指标在解释资本结构方面的作用要小得多。

abstract.text: We propose a general equilibrium model with multiple securities in which investors' risk preferences and expectations of dividend growth are time-varying. While time-varying risk preferences induce the standard positive relation between the dividend yield and expected returns, time-varying expected dividend growth induces a negative relation between them. These offsetting effects reduce the ability of the dividend yield to forecast returns and eliminate its ability to forecast dividend growth, as observed in the data. The model links the predictability of returns to that of dividend growth, suggesting specific changes to standard linear predictive regressions for both. The model's predictions are confirmed empirically.

10.1086/379934.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个包含多种证券的一般均衡模型，其中投资者的风险偏好和股息增长预期是随时间变化的。时间变化的风险偏好会导致股息收益率与预期回报之间存在正向关系，而时间变化的预期股息增长则会导致两者之间存在负向关系。这些相互抵消的效应降低了股息收益率预测回报的能力，并消除了其预测股息增长的能力，这一点在数据中得到了验证。该模型将回报的可预测性与股息增长的可预测性联系起来，为两者提出了具体的线性预测回归模型调整建议。该模型的预测结果得到了实证数据的支持。

abstract.text: I study the interaction between imperfect labor contracts and international trade in a setting in which workers have private information about their own abilities. When an individual's contribution to firm output can be measured accurately in some activities but not in others, the most able workers select occupations in which their pay most closely reflects their own performance. In a world economy with two otherwise similar countries that have different distributions of talent, the country with the more heterogeneous labor force exports the good that is produced by the most talented individuals. In this country, trade exacerbates the "polarization" of the labor force and often worsens the distribution of income.

10.1086/379935.abstractZh: 我研究了不完善的劳动合同与国际贸易之间的相互作用，研究背景是工人拥有关于自身能力的私人信息。当个体对企业产出的贡献在某些活动中可以准确衡量，而在其他活动中则无法衡量时，最优秀的工人会选择那些薪酬最能反映其表现的职业。在一个由两个其他方面相似但人才分布不同的国家组成的世界经济体系中，人才分布更为异质的国家会出口由最优秀的人才所生产的产品。在这个国家，贸易加剧了劳动力的“两极分化”，并常常恶化了收入分配状况。

abstract.text: We use a unique data set of annuities in the United Kingdom to test for adverse selection. We find systematic relationships between ex post mortality and annuity characteristics, such as the timing of payments and the possibility of payments to the annuitant's estate. These patterns are consistent with the presence of asymmetric information. However, we find no evidence of substantive mortality differences by annuity size. These results suggest that the absence of selection on one contract dimension does not preclude its presence on others. This highlights the importance of considering detailed features of insurance contracts when testing theoretical models of asymmetric information.

10.1086/379936.abstractZh: 我们使用英国年金市场的独特数据集来检验逆向选择现象。我们发现，事后死亡率与年金特征之间存在系统性关系，例如支付时间以及是否向年金受益人的遗产支付等问题。这些模式与信息不对称的存在相一致。然而，我们没有发现因年金规模不同而导致的死亡率差异。这些结果表明，某一合同维度上不存在逆向选择现象，并不意味着其他维度上也不会存在逆向选择现象。这强调了在检验信息不对称理论模型时，考虑保险合同详细特征的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper measures the importance of borrowing constraints on education decisions. Empirical identification of borrowing constraints is secured by the economic prediction that opportunity costs and direct costs of schooling affect borrowing-constrained and unconstrained persons differently. Direct costs need to be financed during school and impose a larger burden on credit-constrained students. By contrast, gross forgone earnings do not have to be financed. We explore the implications of this idea using four methodologies: schooling attainment models, instrumental variable wage regressions, and two structural economic models that integrate both schooling choices and schooling returns into a unified framework. None of the methods produces evidence that borrowing constraints generate inefficiencies in the market for schooling in the current policy environment. We conclude that, on the margin, additional policies aimed at improving credit access will have little impact on schooling attainment.

10.1086/379937.abstractZh: 本文研究了借贷限制对教育决策的影响。通过经济预测，我们确认了借贷限制与无借贷限制人群在机会成本及直接教育成本方面的差异。直接教育成本需要在学校期间融资，这对有借贷限制的学生来说负担更为沉重。相比之下，被放弃的总收入无需融资。我们采用四种方法探讨了这一观点的含义：教育成就模型、工具变量工资回归分析，以及两个将教育选择与教育回报整合到统一框架中的结构经济学模型。这些方法均未发现借贷限制会在当前政策环境下导致教育市场的效率低下。我们得出结论，从整体来看，旨在改善信贷获取渠道的额外政策对教育成就的影响甚微。

abstract.text: Les auteurs montrent que tenir compte des conséquences du travail des enfants à la fois sur le bien-être de l'enfance et sur l'investissement en capital humain, au lieu de se concentrer exclusivement sur la dimension de capital humain, apporte de nouveaux résultats sur l'analyse économique du travail des enfants. En particulier, de nouvelles sources d'inefficacité apparaissent lorsqu'on suppose que le travail induit une désutilité. Dans un tel cas, les décisions des ménages à propos du travail des enfants peuvent en effet être inefficaces même si les membres du ménage sont altruistes, si les transferts nets ne sont pas descendants et s'il n'y a pas d'imperfection de marché. Aussi, la présence de désutilité pour le travail des enfants conduit à un équilibre où les conditions pour qu'une réduction exogène du travail des enfants soient Pareto améliorantes ont moins de chance d'être remplies. L'article souligne donc le fait que l'analyse économique ne devrait pas oublier un des aspects le plus important du travail des enfants, c'est-à-dire le fait que cela ne les rend pas heureux.

10.1086/379938.abstractZh: 作者指出，考虑儿童劳动对儿童福祉以及人力资本投资的影响，而不仅仅是关注人力资本维度，可以为儿童劳动的经济分析带来新的结果。特别是，当假设劳动会导致效用减少时，会出现新的无效性来源。在这种情况下，即使家庭成员具有利他主义倾向、净转移不是向下转移且没有市场缺陷，家庭在儿童劳动方面的决策仍然可能无效。此外，儿童劳动带来的效用减少会导致一种均衡状态，在这种状态下，外部减少儿童劳动的条件更难以得到满足。因此，文章强调，经济分析不应忽视儿童劳动最重要的一个方面，即劳动并不能让儿童变得更幸福。

abstract.text: In this paper, we consider how rich sources of information on consumer choice can help to identify demand parameters in a widely used class of differentiated products demand models. Most important, we show how to use “second‐choice” data on automotive purchases to obtain good estimates of substitution patterns in the automobile industry. We use our estimates to make out‐of‐sample predictions about important recent changes in industry structure.

10.1086/379939.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了丰富的消费者选择信息如何帮助识别一类常用差异化产品需求模型中的需求参数。最重要的是，我们展示了如何利用关于汽车购买的“第二选择”数据来准确估计汽车行业的替代模式。我们利用这些估计结果，对行业结构的重要近期变化进行了样本外预测。

abstract.text: Existing work suggests that black‐white gaps in potential wages are much larger among men than women and further that black‐white differences in patterns of female labor supply are unimportant. However, panel data on wages and income sources demonstrate that the modal young black woman who does not engage in market work is a single mother receiving government aid whereas her white counterpart is a married mother receiving support from a working spouse. The median black‐white gap in log potential wages among young adult women in 1990 was likely at least 60 percent larger than the gap implied by reported earnings and hours worked in the Current Populations Surveys.

10.1086/379940.abstractZh: 现有研究指出，男性与女性的潜在工资差距在黑人与白人之间更为显著，且女性劳动力供给模式上的种族差异并不重要。然而，关于工资和收入来源的面板数据表明，不从事市场工作的年轻黑人女性通常是单亲母亲，并依赖政府援助；而白人女性则通常是已婚母亲，从配偶那里获得经济支持。1990年，年轻成年女性中黑人与白人的潜在工资差距可能至少比《当前人口调查》中报告的收入和工作时间数据所暗示的差距大60%。

abstract.text: We present a model of delegation with self‐interested and privately informed experts. A team of experts with extreme but opposite biases is acceptable to a wide range of decision makers with diverse preferences, but the value of expertise from such a team is low. A decision maker wants to appoint experts who are less partisan than he is in order to facilitate information pooling by the expert team. Selective delegation, either by controlling the decision‐making process or by conditioning the delegation decision on his own information, is an effective way for the decision maker to safeguard own interests while making use of expert information.

10.1086/379941.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个包含自私且信息私有的专家委托模型。一个具有极端但相反偏见的专家团队，虽然可以被各种偏好不同的决策者所接受，但其提供的专业知识价值较低。决策者希望任命比自己更不偏袒的专家，以便通过专家团队实现信息共享。通过控制决策过程或根据自身的信息来做出委托决策，是决策者在利用专家信息的同时保护自身利益的有效方式。

abstract.text: This paper is a theoretical study of rural‐urban migration—urbanization—as it has occurred in many low‐income economies in the postwar period. This process is viewed as a transfer of labor from a traditional, land‐intensive technology to a human capital–intensive technology with an unending potential for growth. The model emphasizes the role of cities as places in which new immigrants can accumulate the skills required by modern production technologies.

10.1086/379942.abstractZh: 本文对战后许多低收入经济体中发生的农村向城市迁移——即城市化过程进行了理论研究。这一过程被视为劳动力从传统的、依赖土地的工艺向依赖人力资源的工艺转移，具有无限的增长潜力。该模型强调了城市作为新移民积累现代生产技术所需技能的场所的作用。

abstract.text: Some have observed that individuals perform worse after being promoted. The Peter principle, which states that people are promoted to their level of incompetence, suggests that something is fundamentally misaligned in the promotion process. This view is unnecessary and inconsistent with the data. Below, it is argued that ability appears lower after promotion purely as a statistical matter. Being promoted is evidence that a standard has been met. Regression to the mean implies that future ability will be lower, on average. Firms optimally account for the regression bias in making promotion decisions, but the effect is never eliminated. Rather than evidence of a mistake, the Peter principle is a necessary consequence of any promotion rule. Furthermore, firms that take it into account appropriately adopt an optimal strategy. Usually, firms inflate the promotion criterion to offset the Peter principle effect, and the more important the transitory component is relative to total variation in ability, the larger the amount that the standard is inflated. The same logic applies to other situations. For example, it explains why movie sequels are worse than the original film on which they are based and why second visits to restaurants are less rewarding than the first.

10.1086/379943.abstractZh: 有人观察到，员工在获得晋升后表现会下降。彼得原则指出，人们会被晋升到与其能力不相称的职位，这表明晋升过程中存在根本性的问题。这种观点并不必要，且与数据不符。本文认为，晋升后员工的能力确实会下降，这纯粹是统计上的现象。获得晋升意味着达到了某个标准。回归均值表明，未来的能力平均会更低。企业会在做出晋升决策时考虑这种回归偏差，但这种影响始终存在。彼得原则并非错误的证据，而是任何晋升规则的必然结果。此外，适当考虑这一因素的企业会采取最优策略。通常，企业会提高晋升标准以抵消彼得原则的影响，而晋升标准的提高幅度与能力变化的相对重要性成正比。同样的逻辑也适用于其他情况。例如，这解释了为什么电影续集往往不如原片，以及为什么第二次光顾餐厅不如第一次那么令人满意。

abstract.text: We exploit Japan's sudden and complete opening up to international trade in the 1860s to test the empirical validity of one of the oldest and most fundamental propositions in economics: the theory of comparative advantage. Historical evidence supports the assertion that the characteristics of the Japanese economy at the time were compatible with the key assumptions of the neoclassical trade model. Using detailed product-specific data on autarky prices and trade flows, we find that the autarky price value of Japan's trade is negative for each year of the period 186875. This confirms the prediction of the theory.

10.1086/379944.abstractZh: 我们利用日本在19世纪60年代突然且完全开放国际贸易的契机，来检验经济学中最古老且最基本的命题之一——比较优势理论的实证有效性。历史证据支持这样的观点：当时日本经济的特征与新古典贸易模型的关键假设是相一致的。通过详细的产品特定数据，我们发现在1868年至1875年期间，日本的贸易中自给价格始终为负。这一结果证实了该理论的预测。

abstract.text: This paper provides one of the few successful demonstrations of the efficiency of certain types of restrictions in the context of a joint venture. The joint venture we examine is the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 1980s, which was then composed of 21 separately owned teams. (It now has 30 teams.) The restriction we analyze is the NHL rule on franchise relocation. Before one can fully understand the effect of the restriction, one must understand the theory of how sports leagues operate and whether sports leagues have any market power that can be enhanced by such a restriction. After providing such a theory, we empirically test the effect of the NHL restriction on franchise relocation. Aside from data availability, the advantage of our time period is that television was then an unimportant source of revenue for the NHL. Thus we are able to isolate a particular externality arising from how the NHL finances teams.

10.1086/379945.abstractZh: 本文提供了少数成功证明某些类型限制措施在合资企业背景下有效性的案例之一。我们研究的合资企业是1980年代的美国国家冰球联盟（NHL），当时由21支独立运营的球队组成（现在已有30支球队）。我们分析的限制措施是NHL关于球队搬迁的规定。要完全理解这一限制措施的影响，必须了解体育联盟运作的理论，以及体育联盟是否拥有可以通过此类限制措施增强的市场力量。在阐述了相关理论之后，我们实证分析了NHL限制措施对球队搬迁的影响。除了数据可得性之外，我们选择这一研究时点的另一个优势是，当时电视并非NHL的重要收入来源。因此，我们能够单独分析NHL在球队融资方面产生的特定外部性。

abstract.text: This paper develops a dynamic supply and demand model of occupational choice and applies it to the engineering profession. The model is largely successful in understanding data in the U.S. engineering labor market. The engineering market responds strongly to economic forces. The demand for engineers responds to the price of engineering services and demand shifters. More important, supply and enrollment decisions are remarkably sensitive to career prospects in engineering. Also a rational model, in which students use some forward‐looking elements to forecast future demand for engineers, fits the data reasonably well. These findings suggest that subsidies to build technical talent ahead of demand are misplaced unless public policy makers have better information on future market conditions than the market participants do.

10.1086/379946.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个动态供需模型，用于分析职业选择问题，并将其应用于工程行业。该模型在理解美国工程劳动力市场的数据方面取得了显著成效。工程市场对经济因素的反应非常强烈，对工程师的需求受到工程服务价格及需求变动因素的影响。更重要的是，供应和招生决策对工程行业的职业前景非常敏感。此外，一个理性的模型也很好地符合了数据特征，该模型中学生利用一些前瞻性因素来预测未来对工程师的需求。这些发现表明，除非公共政策制定者比市场参与者拥有更可靠的市场信息，否则在需求尚未出现之前就进行技术人才培养的投资是适得其反的。

abstract.text: This paper considers the identification and estimation of hedonic models. We establish that in an additive version of the hedonic model, technology and preferences are generically nonparametrically identified from data on demand and supply in a single hedonic market. The empirical literature that claims that hedonic models estimated on data from a single market are fundamentally underidentified is based on arbitrary linearizations that do not use all the information in the model. The exact economic model that justifies linear approximations is unappealing. Nonlinearities are generic features of equilibrium in hedonic models and a fundamental and economically motivated source of identification.

10.1086/379947.abstractZh: 本文探讨了享乐模型的可识别性与估计方法。我们证明了在享乐模型的加法版本中，技术和偏好可以从单一享乐市场中的供需数据中非参数地识别出来。那些认为基于单一市场数据估计的享乐模型存在根本识别不足问题的实证文献，其基础是采用不利用模型中所有信息的任意线性化方法。而用于证明线性近似的精确经济模型则并不令人满意。非线性性是享乐模型中均衡的普遍特征，也是一种基于经济动机的识别来源。

abstract.text: We analyze entry, pricing, and product design in a model with differentiated products. Market equilibrium can be “separating,” with multiple sellers and a sorting of heterogeneous consumers across goods, or “exclusionary,” with one seller serving all customer types. Entry into an initially monopolized market can occur because of cost reductions or product improvements, but entry need not lower the incumbent’s price, improve efficiency, or raise consumer welfare. Postentry design incentives favor a softening of price competition and stronger market segmentation, whereas exclusionary design changes typically raise consumer welfare. Potential, as distinct from actual, entry always benefits consumers.

10.1086/380084.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有差异化产品的模型中分析了市场进入、定价和产品设计。市场均衡可以是“分离型”的，即存在多个卖家，消费者在商品选择上呈现异质性；也可以是“排他型”的，即只有一个卖家服务于所有类型的消费者。市场进入最初可能是垄断状态，但这种情况可以通过成本降低或产品改进来实现。然而，市场进入并不一定会降低现有企业的价格、提高效率或提升消费者福利。市场进入后的产品设计激励措施倾向于促进价格竞争的缓和和市场的进一步细分，而排他性产品设计则通常能提升消费者福利。潜在的市场进入，与实际的市场进入一样，总是能带来消费者的利益。

abstract.text: As firms switch from defined‐benefit plans to defined‐contribution plans, employees bear more responsibility for making decisions about how much to save. The employees who fail to join the plan or who participate at a very low level appear to be saving at less than the predicted life cycle savings rates. Behavioral explanations for this behavior stress bounded rationality and self‐control and suggest that at least some of the low‐saving households are making a mistake and would welcome aid in making decisions about their saving. In this paper, we propose such a prescriptive savings program, called Save More Tomorrow™ (hereafter, the SMarT program). The essence of the program is straightforward: people commit in advance to allocating a portion of their future salary increases toward retirement savings. We report evidence on the first three implementations of the SMarT program. Our key findings, from the first implementation, which has been in place for four annual raises, are as follows: (1) a high proportion (78 percent) of those offered the plan joined, (2) the vast majority of those enrolled in the SMarT plan (80 percent) remained in it through the fourth pay raise, and (3) the average saving rates for SMarT program participants increased from 3.5 percent to 13.6 percent over the course of 40 months. The results suggest that behavioral economics can be used to design effective prescriptive programs for important economic decisions.

10.1086/380085.abstractZh: 随着企业从固定福利计划转向固定贡献计划，员工在储蓄决策上承担更多的责任。那些未能加入计划或参与程度非常低的员工，其储蓄率似乎低于预期的生命周期储蓄率。行为经济学解释认为，这些低储蓄行为源于有限理性与自我控制问题，并表明至少有一些低储蓄的家庭在做出错误决策，他们可能会欢迎在储蓄决策上得到帮助。在本文中，我们提出了这样一个指导性储蓄计划，称为“明日更多储蓄计划”（以下简称SMART计划）。该计划的本质很简单：人们提前承诺将未来工资增长的一部分用于退休储蓄。我们报告了SMART计划首次实施时的数据。从首次实施的情况来看，该计划已经持续了四年的工资增长，主要发现如下：(1) 提供该计划的人中有很高比例（78%）加入了计划；(2) 绝大多数参与SMART计划的人（80%）在第四次工资增长后仍继续参与计划；(3) 在40个月的时间里，SMART计划参与者的平均储蓄率从3.5%上升到了13.6%。这些结果表明，行为经济学可以用来设计有效的指导性计划，以协助人们做出重要的经济决策。

abstract.text: Evolution of technology causes human capital to become obsolete. We study this phenomenon in an overlapping generations setting, assuming it is hard to predict how technology will evolve, and that older workers find updating uneconomic. Among our results is the proposition that (under certain conditions) a more rapid pace of technological advance is especially unfavorable to the old in the sense that the implied within-industry division of output or income between young and old becomes much more skewed, i.e., a smaller number of young earn comparatively more. We apply our results to architecture, an occupation in which the has-beens phenomenon has had a particularly acute impact.

10.1086/380948.abstractZh: 技术的演变导致人力资本变得过时。我们在代际重叠的情境下研究了这一现象，假设很难预测技术的演变方向，且年长工人认为更新技术并不经济。我们的研究结果表明，在某些条件下，更快的技术进步对老年人尤其不利，因为这意味着行业内年轻人与老年人之间的产出或收入分配变得更加不均衡，即相对较少的年轻人能够赚取更多的收入。我们将研究结果应用于建筑行业，该行业中的“守旧者”现象尤为明显。

abstract.text: We investigate whether political jurisdictions form in response to the trade-off between economies of scale and the costs of a heterogeneous population. We consider heterogeneity in income, race, ethnicity, and religion, and we test the model using American school districts, school attendance areas, municipalities, and special districts. We find strong evidence of a trade-off between economies of scale and racial heterogeneity; we also find evidence of a trade-off between economies of scale and income heterogeneity. Conversely, we find little evidence that ethnic or religious heterogeneity shapes jurisdictions. To clarify the direction of causality between heterogeneity and jurisdictions, we exploit shocks to racial heterogeneity generated by the two world wars.

10.1086/381474.abstractZh: 我们研究政治辖区是否是在规模经济与异质人口成本之间的权衡中形成的。我们考虑了收入、种族、民族和宗教方面的异质性，并使用美国学区、学区区域、市镇和特别区来测试该模型。我们发现，规模经济与种族异质性之间存在明显的权衡；同时，我们也发现规模经济与收入异质性之间也存在权衡。相反，我们发现几乎没有证据表明民族或宗教异质性会影响辖区的形成。为了明确异质性与辖区之间的因果关系方向，我们利用两次世界大战引发的种族异质性冲击来进行研究。

abstract.text: The question of whether higherlifetime income households save a larger fraction of their income was the subject of much debate in the 1950s and 1960s, and while not resolved, it remains central to the evaluation of tax and macroeconomic policies. We resolve this long-standing question using new empirical methods applied to the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, the Survey of Consumer Finances, and the Consumer Expenditure Survey. We find a strong positive relationship between saving rates and lifetime income and a weaker but still positive relationship between the marginal propensity to save and lifetime income. There is little support for theories that seek to explain these positive correlations by relying solely on time preference rates, nonhomothetic preferences, or variations in Social Security benefits. There is more support for models emphasizing uncertainty with respect to income and health expenses, bequest motives, and asset-based means testing or behavioral factors causing minimal saving rates among low-income households.

10.1086/381475.abstractZh: 在20世纪50年代和60年代，关于高收入家庭是否会储蓄更多收入的问题引发了大量争论。尽管这一争论尚未得到解决，但它仍然是评估税收和宏观经济政策的核心问题。我们运用新的实证方法，结合收入动态面板研究、消费者金融调查以及消费者支出调查的数据，解决了这一长期存在的疑问。研究发现，储蓄率与终身收入之间存在强烈的正相关关系，而边际储蓄倾向与终身收入之间的关系则较为微弱，但仍为正相关。那些试图仅通过时间偏好率、非同质偏好或社会保障福利变化来解释这些正相关的理论，几乎没有得到支持。相反，那些强调收入与健康支出不确定性、遗产动机以及基于资产的手段测试或导致低收入家庭储蓄率极低的行为因素的理论，则得到了更多的支持。

abstract.text: Tax evasion, by its very nature, is difficult to observe. We quantify the effects of tax rates on tax evasion by examining the relationship in China between the tariff schedule and the "evasion gap," which we define as the difference between Hong Kong's reported exports to China at the product level and China's reported imports from Hong Kong. Our results imply that a one-percentage-point increase in the tax rate is associated with a 3 percent increase in evasion. Furthermore, the evasion gap is negatively correlated with tax rates on closely related products, suggesting that evasion takes place partly through misclassification of imports from higher-taxed categories to lower-taxed ones, in addition to underreporting the value of imports.

10.1086/381476.abstractZh: 逃税本质上难以被观察到。我们通过研究中国关税表与“逃税差距”之间的关系来量化税率对逃税行为的影响。我们将“逃税差距”定义为香港向中国出口的产品数量与中国从香港进口的产品数量之间的差距。我们的研究结果表明，税率每提高一个百分点，逃税行为就会增加3%。此外，逃税差距与相关产品的税率呈负相关，这表明逃税行为部分是通过将高税率类别的进口商品错误分类到低税率类别中实现的，同时也包括了对进口商品价值的低估。

abstract.text: When markets are incomplete, individuals may choose to marry to diversify their labor income risk. Love, however, can complicate the picture. If love is fleeting or the resolution of agents' income uncertainty occurs predominantly later in life, then marriages with good economic matches last longer. In contrast, if love is persistent and the resolution of uncertainty to agents' income occurs early, then marriages with good economic matches are more likely to be caught short with too little love to save a marriage. Consequently, once married, the partners will be more likely to divorce. Evidence is provided to distinguish between these alternative scenarios.

10.1086/381477.abstractZh: 当市场不完善时，个体可能会选择结婚以分散劳动收入的风险。然而，爱情可能会使情况变得复杂。如果爱情是短暂的，或者个体收入不确定性的解决主要发生在晚年，那么经济条件匹配的婚姻可能会持续更长时间。相反，如果爱情是持久的，且收入不确定性的解决发生在早期，那么经济条件匹配的婚姻则更有可能因缺乏爱情而难以维持。因此，一旦结婚，双方离婚的可能性就会增加。本文提供了证据来区分这两种不同的情景。

abstract.text: The propensity to become a business owner is a nonlinear function of wealth. The relationship between wealth and entry into entrepreneurship is essentially flat over the majority of the wealth distribution. It is only at the top of the wealth distributionafter the ninety-fifth percentilethat a positive relationship can be found. Segmenting businesses into industries with high and lowstarting capital requirements, we find no evidence that wealth matters more for businesses requiring higher initial capital. When using inheritances as an instrument for wealth, we find that both past and future inheritances predict current business entry, showing that inheritances capture more than simply liquidity. We further exploit the regional variation in house prices and find that households that lived in regions in which housing prices appreciated strongly were no more likely to start a business than households in other regions.

10.1086/381478.abstractZh: 成为企业主的倾向是财富的非线性函数。在财富分布的绝大部分范围内，财富与创业之间的关联基本上是线性的。只有在财富分布的第九十五百分位之后，才能发现正相关关系。将企业按启动资金需求高低划分为不同行业后，我们发现财富对于需要更高启动资金的企业来说并不更为重要。当使用遗产作为财富的指标时，我们发现过去和未来的遗产都能预测当前的创业行为，这表明遗产的作用不仅仅体现在流动性上。我们进一步研究了房价在不同地区的差异，发现居住在房价大幅上涨地区的家庭，与居住在其他地区的家庭相比，创业的可能性并没有增加。

abstract.text: This paper provides a case study of the effect of labor relations on product quality. We consider whether a long, contentious strike and the hiring of replacement workers at Bridgestone/Firestone's Decatur, Illinois, plant in the mid-1990s contributed to the production of defective tires. Using several independent data sources and looking before and after the strike and across plants, we find that labor strife at the Decatur plant closely coincided with lower product quality. Monthly data suggest that defects were particularly high around the time concessions were demanded and when large numbers of replacement workers and returning strikers worked side by side.

10.1086/381479.abstractZh: 本文以劳动关系对产品质量影响为案例研究。我们探讨了1990年代中期，布里奇斯通/费尔斯特尼公司在伊利诺伊州迪凯特工厂发生的长期且充满争议的罢工，以及替代工人的招聘，是否导致了产品缺陷的产生。通过多个独立的数据来源，并对比罢工前后以及不同工厂的情况，我们发现迪凯特工厂的劳资纠纷与产品质量下降密切相关。月度数据显示，在要求让步期间，以及大量替代工人和返回罢工的工人同时工作的时期，产品缺陷率特别高。

abstract.text: In the Anglo-American constitutional tradition, judicial checks and balances are often seen as crucial guarantees of freedom. Hayek distinguishes two ways in which the judiciary provides such checks and balances: judicial independence and constitutional review. We create a new database of constitutional rules in 71 countries that reflect these provisions. We find strong support for the proposition that both judicial independence and constitutional review are associated with greater freedom. Consistent with theory, judicial independence accounts for some of the positive effect of common-law legal origin on measures of economic freedom. The results point to significant benefits of the Anglo-American system of government for freedom.

10.1086/381480.abstractZh: 在英美宪法传统中，司法制衡通常被视为自由的重要保障。哈耶克指出了司法机构提供这种制衡的两种方式：司法独立和宪法审查。我们创建了一个包含71个国家宪法规则的数据库，这些规则反映了这些规定。我们发现，司法独立和宪法审查都与更大的自由密切相关。与理论一致，司法独立解释了普通法法律起源对经济自由度的一些积极影响。研究结果表明，英美式的政府体制对自由具有显著的好处。

abstract.text: In our 2001 article in the Journal of Political Economy, we show that any non-welfarist method of policy assessment violates the Pareto principle. In their Comment, Fleurbaey, Tungodden, and Chang question whether our result is fully general without imposing what they regard to be strong assumptions (transitivity and independence). However, as we explain in this Reply, their argument is irrelevant to the thrust of our article. Specifically, their argument concedes that if any particular society uses any non-welfarist principle, there may be a conflict with the Pareto principle. This result means that the vast multitude of principles proposed by policy-makers, philosophers, and others indeed fall within our demonstration.

10.1086/381865.abstractZh: 在2001年发表于《政治经济学杂志》的文章中，我们指出任何非福利主义的政策评估方法都会违反帕累托原则。在他们的评论中，Fleurbaey、Tungodden和Chang质疑我们的结论是否完全具有普遍性，而不需要他们认为的强假设（传递性和独立性）。然而，正如我们在本回复中所解释的，他们的论点与本文的核心内容无关。具体来说，他们的论点承认，如果任何特定社会采用非福利主义原则，可能会与帕累托原则发生冲突。这一结果意味着，政策制定者、哲学家等人提出的众多原则确实属于我们的论证范围。

abstract.text: We present a North‐South model of international trade in which differentiated products are developed in the North. Sectors are populated by final‐good producers who differ in productivity levels. On the basis of productivity and sectoral characteristics, firms decide whether to integrate into the production of intermediate inputs or outsource them. In either case they have to decide from which country to source the inputs. Final‐good producers and their suppliers must make relationship‐specific investments, both in an integrated firm and in an arm’s‐length relationship. We describe an equilibrium in which firms with different productivity levels choose different ownership structures and supplier locations. We then study the effects of within‐sectoral heterogeneity and variations in industry characteristics on the relative prevalence of these organizational forms.

10.1086/383099.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个南北贸易模型，在该模型中，北方地区会开发差异化产品。各个行业由生产力水平不同的最终产品生产者组成。基于生产力和行业特性，企业决定是参与中间投入的生产还是将其外包。无论哪种情况，企业都必须决定从哪个国家获取这些投入。最终产品生产者及其供应商必须在整合关系或独立关系中进行特定关系投资。我们描述了一个均衡状态，在这种状态下，生产力水平不同的企业会选择不同的所有权结构和供应商位置。随后，我们研究了行业内异质性以及行业特性变化对这些组织形式相对普遍性的影响。

abstract.text: We exploit the military mobilization for World War II to investigate the effects of female labor supply on the wage structure. The mobilization drew many women into the workforce permanently. But the impact was not uniform across states. In states with greater mobilization of men, women worked more after the war and in 1950, though not in 1940. These induced shifts in female labor supply lowered female and male wages and increased earnings inequality between high school– and college‐educated men. It appears that at midcentury, women were closer substitutes for high school men than for those with lower skills.

10.1086/383100.abstractZh: 我们利用第二次世界大战期间的军事动员来研究女性劳动力供应对工资结构的影响。这次动员使许多女性永久进入劳动力市场。但这一影响在不同州并不一致。在男性动员程度较高的州，女性在战后及1950年的工作时间更长，而在1940年则没有这种趋势。这种女性劳动力供应的变化降低了女性和男性的工资，并加剧了高中及以上学历的男性与女性之间的收入不平等。看来，在中期阶段，女性对于高中学历的男性来说，是比那些技能较低的男性更合适的替代选择。

abstract.text: This paper presents an empirical analysis of a choice‐theoretic model of cultural transmission. In particular, we use data from the General Social Survey to estimate the structural parameters of a model of marriage and child socialization along religious lines in the United States. The observed intermarriage and socialization rates are consistent with Protestants, Catholics, and Jews having a strong preference for children who identify with their own religious beliefs and making costly decisions to influence their children’s religious beliefs. Our estimates imply dynamics of the shares of religious traits in the population that are in sharp contrast with the predictions obtained by linear extrapolations from current intermarriage rates.

10.1086/383101.abstractZh: 本文对一种文化传递的选择理论模型进行了实证分析。具体而言，我们利用了《综合社会调查》的数据来估算美国基于宗教背景的婚姻与儿童社会化模型的结构参数。观察到的通婚率和社会化率与预期一致，即新教徒、天主教徒和犹太教徒都强烈倾向于培养认同自己宗教信仰的孩子，并且会付出代价来影响孩子的宗教信仰。我们的估算结果显示，宗教特征在人口中的占比变化与从当前通婚率进行线性外推所得到的预测结果截然不同。

abstract.text: We provide a new and more complete analysis of the origins of the Dust Bowl of the 1930s, one of the most severe environmental crises in North America in the 20th Century. Severe drought and wind erosion hit the Great Plains in 1930 and lasted through 1940. There were similar droughts in the 1950s and 1970s, but no comparable level of wind erosion. We explain why. The prevalence of small farms in the 1930s limited private solutions for controlling the downwind externalities associated with wind erosion. Drifting sand from unprotected fields damaged neighboring farms. Small farmers cultivated more of their land and were less likely to invest in erosion control than were larger farmers. Soil Conservation Districts, established by government after 1937, helped coordinate erosion control. This unitized' solution for collective action is similar to that used in other natural resource/environmental settings.

10.1086/383102.abstractZh: 我们提供了对20世纪30年代沙尘暴起源的新且更全面的分析。这是20世纪北美最严重的环境危机之一。1930年，大平原地区遭受了严重的干旱和风蚀，这种状况一直持续到1940年。在1950年代和1970年代也出现了类似的干旱，但风蚀的程度并不相同。我们解释了其中的原因。1930年代小农场的普遍存在限制了私人力量对风蚀带来的外部影响的控制。未受保护的田地中的沙土流动会损坏邻近的农场。小农户耕种的土地面积更大，因此不太可能像大农户那样投资于防蚀措施。1937年后，政府设立的土壤保护区有助于协调防蚀工作。这种以单位化方式进行的集体行动解决方案，与其他自然资源/环境管理中的做法类似。

abstract.text: In this paper we tie together the two literatures of durable goods monopoly and exhaustible resource pricing. We show that the intertemporal no‐arbitrage condition that arises if the durable good monopolist seller can commit to a price path mirrors the intertemporal no‐arbitrage condition if the monopsonist buyer of an exhaustible resource can commit to a price path. The intuition is that the durable good monopolist initially announces high future prices to get high‐valuation buyers to buy early and subsequently lowers the price to attract additional buyers. On the other hand, the monopsonist buyer of the exhaustible resource initially announces low future prices to encourage sellers to supply their units early and subsequently, as the stock of the resource declines, raises the price to call forth additional supply. As the period of commitment shrinks to zero, the durable good’s price drops to its marginal cost and the exhaustible resource’s price jumps to its choke level, all in a twinkling of the eye, as Coase hypothesized.

10.1086/383103.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们将耐用商品垄断与可耗尽资源定价这两大理论结合起来。我们发现，如果耐用商品垄断卖方能够承诺一个特定的价格路径，那么就会出现跨时段的无套利条件；同样地，如果可耗尽资源的垄断买方能够承诺一个特定的价格路径，也会出现类似的跨时段无套利条件。直观上，耐用商品垄断者最初会宣布较高的未来价格，以吸引高估值买家提前购买，随后会降低价格以吸引更多买家。另一方面，可耗尽资源垄断买方最初会宣布较低的未来价格，以促使卖方提前提供资源，随着资源总量的减少，买方会逐步提高价格以吸引更多的供应。当承诺的时间段缩短到零时，耐用商品的价格会降至其边际成本，而可耗尽资源的价格则会迅速上升到其“禁售水平”，正如科斯所假设的那样，这一切都发生在转瞬之间。

abstract.text: We present a model of the market for a used durable in which agents face fixed costs of adjustment, the magnitude of which depends on the degree of adverse selection in the secondary market. We find that, unlike typical models, the sS bands in our model contract as the variance of the shock increases. We also analyze a dynamic version of the model in which agents are allowed to make decisions that are conditional on the age of the durable. We find that, as the durable ages, the lemons problem tends to decline in importance, and the sS bands contract.

10.1086/383104.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个二手耐用品市场的模型，其中参与者面临固定的调整成本，这些成本的大小取决于二手市场的逆向选择程度。我们发现，与典型模型不同，随着冲击方差的增加，我们的模型中的sS带会收缩。我们还分析了该模型的动态版本，其中参与者可以根据耐用品的年龄来做出决策。我们发现，随着耐用品的老化，柠檬问题的重要性逐渐降低，sS带也会收缩。

abstract.text: Is individual labor income more risky in recessions? This is a difficult question to answer because existing panel data sets are so short. To address this problem, we develop a generalized method of moments estimator that conditions on the macroeconomic history that each member of the panel has experienced. Variation in the cross‐sectional variance between households with differing macroeconomic histories allows us to incorporate business cycle information dating back to 1930, even though our data do not begin until 1968. We implement this estimator using household‐level labor earnings data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics. We estimate that idiosyncratic risk is (i) highly persistent, with an annual autocorrelation coefficient of 0.95, and (ii) strongly countercyclical, with a conditional standard deviation that increases by 75 percent (from 0.12 to 0.21) as the macroeconomy moves from peak to trough.

10.1086/383105.abstractZh: 在经济衰退期间，个人劳动收入是否更具风险？这个问题很难回答，因为现有的面板数据集过于短小。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种广义矩估计方法，该方法考虑了面板中每个成员所经历的宏观经济历史。不同宏观经济历史背景下的家庭之间的截面方差差异，使我们能够纳入自1930年以来的商业周期信息，尽管我们的数据直到1968年才开始收集。我们使用《收入动态面板研究》中的家庭层面劳动收入数据来实施这一估计方法。我们的估计结果显示，个体风险具有以下特点：(i) 高度持久性，年度自相关系数为0.95；(ii) 强烈的反周期特性，当宏观经济从高峰转向低谷时，条件标准差会增加75%（从0.12增加到0.21）。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of internal commitments or “personal rules” based on self‐reputation over one’s willpower, which transforms lapses into precedents that undermine future self‐restraint. The foundation for this mechanism is the imperfect recall of past motives and feelings, leading people to draw inferences from their past actions. The degree of self‐control an individual can achieve is shown to rise with his self‐confidence and decrease with prior external constraints. On the negative side, individuals may adopt excessively rigid rules that result in compulsive behaviors such as miserliness, workaholism, or anorexia. We also study the cognitive basis of self‐regulation, showing how it is constrained by the extent to which self‐monitoring is subject to opportunistic distortions of memory or attribution, and how rules for information processing can themselves be maintained.

10.1086/421167.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于自我声誉的内部承诺或“个人规则”理论，该理论将行为失误转化为破坏未来自我约束的先例。这一机制的基础在于对过去动机和情感的不完全回忆，导致人们从过去的行动中得出推论。个体的自我控制能力与其自信心成正比，而受先前外部约束的影响则成反比。从负面角度来看，个体可能会采取过于严格的规则，从而导致诸如吝啬、工作狂或厌食症等强迫性行为。我们还研究了自我调节的认知基础，探讨了自我监控在多大程度上受到记忆或归因的投机性扭曲的影响，以及信息处理规则如何得以维持。

abstract.text: The factor proportions model of international trade is one of the most influential theories in international economics. Its central standing in this field has appropriately prompted, particularly recently, intense empirical scrutiny. A substantial and growing body of empirical work has tested the predictions of the theory on the net factor content of a country’s trade with the rest of the world, usually under the maintained assumptions of factor price equalization and identical homothetic preferences across trading countries (or under quite specific relaxations of these assumptions). In contrast, this paper uses OECD production and trade data to test the restrictions (derived by Helpman) on the factor content of trade flows that hold even under nonequalization of factor prices and in the absence of any assumptions regarding consumer preferences. In a further contrast with most of the existing literature, which has focused on the factor content of a country’s multilateral trade, our tests concern bilateral trade flows, thereby enabling the examination of trade flows between only a subset of countries for which quality data (relatively speaking) are available. We find that restrictions implied by the theory cannot be rejected for the vast majority of country pairs considered in our analysis.

10.1086/421168.abstractZh: 国际贸易的要素比例模型是国际经济学中最有影响力的理论之一。它在这一领域的核心地位，尤其近期引发了大量的实证研究。大量且不断增长的实证研究检验了该理论关于一个国家与世界其他国家贸易中要素含量的预测，这些研究通常在要素价格均等化和各贸易国家具有相同同质偏好这一假设下进行（或在这些假设的具体放宽条件下进行）。相比之下，本文利用经合组织生产和贸易数据，检验了由Helpman提出的关于贸易流中要素含量限制的规定，这些限制即使在要素价格不等且不考虑消费者偏好的情况下仍然成立。与大多数现有文献关注于一个国家多边贸易中的要素含量不同，我们的研究关注双边贸易流，从而能够考察那些拥有相对优质数据的国家之间的贸易流。我们发现，对于我们分析中的绝大多数国家组合来说，该理论所提出的限制是难以被推翻的。

abstract.text: There are two striking aspects of the recovery from the Great Depression in the United States: the recovery was very weak, and real wages in several sectors rose significantly above trend. These data contrast sharply with neoclassical theory, which predicts a strong recovery with low real wages. We evaluate the contribution to the persistence of the Depression of New Deal cartelization policies designed to limit competition and increase labor bargaining power. We develop a model of the bargaining process between labor and firms that occurred with these policies and embed that model within a multisector dynamic general equilibrium model. We find that New Deal cartelization policies are an important factor in accounting for the failure of the economy to recover back to trend.

10.1086/421169.abstractZh: 美国从大萧条中复苏有两个显著特点：复苏进程非常缓慢，且多个行业的实际工资水平显著高于趋势水平。这些数据与新古典理论预测的情况截然相反，新古典理论预计复苏会非常强劲，但实际工资水平会较低。我们评估了新政时期旨在限制竞争并增强劳动者议价能力的卡特尔化政策对大萧条持续存在的贡献。我们建立了一个模型，模拟了在这些政策下劳资双方之间的谈判过程，并将该模型纳入一个多部门动态一般均衡模型中。研究发现，新政时期的卡特尔化政策是解释经济未能恢复到趋势水平的重要因素之一。

abstract.text: We study a general equilibrium model in which entrepreneurs finance investment with optimal financial contracts. Because of enforceability problems, contracts are constrained efficient. We show that limited enforceability amplifies the impact of technological innovations on aggregate output. This implies that economies with lower enforceability of contracts are characterized by greater macroeconomic volatility. A key assumption for the amplification result is that defaulting entrepreneurs are not excluded from the market.

10.1086/421170.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个一般均衡模型，在该模型中，企业家通过最优的金融契约来融资投资。由于执行问题，这些契约的效率受到限制。我们发现，有限的执行能力会加剧技术创新对总产出的影响。这意味着，契约执行能力较低的经济体具有更高的宏观经济波动性。放大效应的一个关键假设是，违约的企业家不会被排除在市场之外。

abstract.text: A hierarchical structure is a widespread organizational form in many areas. My aim in this paper is to provide a rationale for this fact based on two premises. First, a group organizes itself so as to achieve efficient coordination. Second, efficient coordination is achieved only if subgroups as well as individuals agree to cooperate. Even in situations in which there are gains to coordination, the agreement of each possible subgroup may be impossible to reach, resulting in instabilities. I argue that a hierarchical organization avoids such instabilities by distributing in an optimal way autonomy and blocking power to a restricted set of subgroups. Comparisons with nondirected networks are drawn.

10.1086/421171.abstractZh: 层级结构在许多领域是一种普遍存在的组织形式。本文的目的是基于两个前提来解释这一现象。首先，一个群体通过自我组织来实现高效的协调。其次，只有当各个子群体以及个体都同意合作时，才能实现高效的协调。即使协调能够带来收益，每个子群体的同意也可能难以达成，从而导致不稳定性的出现。我认为，层级组织通过将自主权和决策权以最优方式分配给有限的子群体，从而避免了这种不稳定性。文中还对比了层级结构与非直接网络的结构差异。

abstract.text: Managed care organizations rely on incentives that encourage physicians to limit medical expenditures, but little is known about how physicians respond to these incentives. We address this issue by analyzing the physician incentive contracts in use at a health maintenance organization. By combining knowledge of the incentive contracts with internal company records, we examine how medical expenditures vary with the intensity of the incentive to cut costs. Our investigation leads us to a novel explanation for high‐powered group incentives: such incentives can improve efficiency in the allocation of resources when the allocation process is based on the professional judgment of multiple agents. Our empirical work indicates that medical expenditures at the HMO are 5 percent lower than they would have been in the absence of incentives.

10.1086/421172.abstractZh: 管理式护理组织依靠激励措施来促使医生减少医疗支出，但关于医生对这些激励措施的反应知之甚少。我们通过分析一家健康维护组织使用的医生激励合同来解决这个问题。通过将激励合同的信息与公司的内部记录相结合，我们研究了医疗支出随着削减成本激励强度的变化情况。我们的研究提出了一个关于高力度群体激励的新解释：当资源分配过程基于多个代理人的专业判断时，这种激励措施可以提高资源分配的效率。我们的实证研究表明，在没有激励措施的情况下，该健康维护组织的医疗支出比有激励措施时低5%。

abstract.text: Harsanyi’s utilitarianism is extended here to Savage’s framework. We formulate a Pareto condition that implies that both society’s utility function and its probability measure are linear combinations of those of the individuals. An indiscriminate Pareto condition has been shown to contradict linear aggregation of beliefs and tastes. We argue that such a condition is not compelling: Society should not necessarily endorse a unanimous choice when it is based on contradictory beliefs. Our Pareto condition is restricted to choices that involve identical beliefs only.

10.1086/421173.abstractZh: 哈萨尼的功利主义在此被扩展至萨维奇的框架。我们提出了一个帕累托条件，该条件表明社会的效用函数及其概率测度都是个体效用函数与概率测度的线性组合。无差别的帕累托条件被证明与信念和偏好的线性聚合相矛盾。我们认为，这样的条件并不具有说服力：当基于相互矛盾的信念时，社会并不必然支持一致的选择。我们的帕累托条件仅限于涉及相同信念的选择。

abstract.text: Estimating the impact of economic conditions on the likelihood of civil conflict is difficult because of endogeneity and omitted variable bias. We use rainfall variation as an instrumental variable for economic growth in 41 African countries during 1981–99. Growth is strongly negatively related to civil conflict: a negative growth shock of five percentage points increases the likelihood of conflict by one‐half the following year. We attempt to rule out other channels through which rainfall may affect conflict. Surprisingly, the impact of growth shocks on conflict is not significantly different in richer, more democratic, or more ethnically diverse countries.

10.1086/421174.abstractZh: 估算经济条件对内战可能性影响是困难的，这主要是由于内生性和遗漏变量偏差的问题。我们采用降雨量变化作为工具变量，研究了1981年至1999年间41个非洲国家的经济增长情况。经济增长与内战之间存在强烈的负相关关系：经济增长下降五个百分点，次年发生内战的可能性就会增加一半。我们试图排除其他可能影响冲突的渠道。令人惊讶的是，在较富裕、民主程度较高或种族多样性更大的国家中，经济增长冲击对内战的影响并没有显著差异。

abstract.text: When parents and children care about each other’s utility, increases in parental income need not always lead to decreases in child labor. Adults raised in poor families make altruistic transfers to their elderly parents, which the parents take as repayment for income lost when their children were young and spent some time in school instead of work. There is some sufficiently high level of parental income at which children cease to believe that parents need a transfer, whereas parents still would like repayment, so both transfers and the hours of extra education that the transfers made possible cease. Child labor rises.

10.1086/421175.abstractZh: 当父母和子女都关心彼此的效用时，父母收入的增加并不一定会导致儿童劳动力的减少。在贫困家庭中长大的成年人会向年迈的父母进行无私的转移支付，而父母则将这些转移支付视为对子女在年轻时花费时间学习而非工作的补偿。在一定的收入水平之上，子女不再认为父母需要这种转移支付，而父母仍然希望得到回报，因此转移支付以及由此带来的额外教育时间都会停止。这样一来，儿童劳动力的数量就会增加。

abstract.text: We examine the frequency of price changes for 350 categories of goods and services covering about 70 percent of consumer spending, on the basis of unpublished data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics for 1995–97. In comparison with previous studies, we find much more frequent price changes, with half of prices lasting less than 4.3 months. Even excluding temporary price cuts (sales), we find that half of prices last 5.5 months or less. We also find that the frequency of price changes differs dramatically across goods. Compared to the predictions of popular sticky‐price models, actual inflation rates are far more volatile and transient for sticky‐price goods.

10.1086/422559.abstractZh: 我们基于劳工统计局1995-97年的未发表数据，对涵盖约70%消费者支出的350种商品和服务的价格变化频率进行了研究。与以往的研究相比，我们发现价格变化的频率要高得多，有一半的价格持续时间不到4.3个月。即使排除临时性的降价活动，我们也发现有一半的价格持续时间在5.5个月或以下。我们还发现，不同商品的价格变化频率存在显著差异。与流行的粘性价格模型的预测相比，粘性价格商品的实际通胀率更加波动且短暂。

abstract.text: I show that among women likely to use welfare, movers move to higher‐benefit states. I also find that the probability likely welfare users will move at all is lower in higher‐benefit states. This effect is concentrated early in the life cycle, as theory predicts. I construct a theoretical framework to measure the impact of welfare migration on optimal state benefits. Simulation results suggest little impact in higher‐benefit states, but possibly a more substantial impact in other states. Finally, evidence suggests little reason for concern (due to welfare migration) in using cross‐state variation in welfare generosity to identify incentive effects of the welfare system on other outcome variables.

10.1086/422560.abstractZh: 我表明，在可能使用福利政策的女性中，那些选择迁移到福利水平较高的州的人，其福利水平也会相应提高。我还发现，在福利水平较高的州，可能使用福利政策的女性迁移的概率较低。正如理论预测的那样，这种效应主要集中在生命周期的早期阶段。我构建了一个理论框架，用于衡量福利迁移对最优州福利水平的影响。模拟结果显示，在福利水平较高的州，这种影响较小，但在其他州，这种影响可能更为显著。最后，有证据表明，由于福利迁移的存在，没有必要过于担心福利政策对其他结果变量的激励效应。

abstract.text: Given adverse selection, durable goods that trade less frequently depreciate more quickly. Consistent with this prediction, I find an inverse relationship between depreciation and trading volume for less reliable brands of used business aircraft. Additionally, recent theoretical analyses suggest that leasing, by increasing the average quality of used goods offered for sale, may reduce adverse selection in durable goods markets. Indeed, I find an increase in the direct relationship between depreciation and trading volume for aircraft models with relatively high lease rates. Together these findings suggest that adverse selection is a prominent feature of the market for contemporary used business aircraft and that leasing mitigates the consequences of asymmetric information about the quality of used durable goods.

10.1086/422561.abstractZh: 在逆向选择的情况下，交易频率较低的耐用商品会更快地贬值。与这一预测一致，我发现对于可靠性较低的二手商用飞机品牌，贬值与交易量之间存在反比关系。此外，最近的理论分析表明，租赁方式通过提高出售的二手商品的平均质量，可能减少耐用商品市场中的逆向选择问题。实际上，我发现对于租赁费率较高的飞机型号，贬值与交易量之间的直接关系有所增强。这些发现表明，逆向选择是当代二手商用飞机市场的一个显著特征，而租赁方式有助于缓解关于二手耐用商品质量的不对称信息所带来的影响。

abstract.text: Alchian and Allen show that a per unit transactions cost lowers the relative price of, and raises the relative demand for, high‐quality goods. We extend their theory, deriving a relationship between per unit and ad valorem trade costs and the quality composition of trade. Detailed international trade data for many importers and exporters are used to test these predictions. Within a narrowly defined commodity classification, exporters charge destination‐varying prices that covary positively with shipping costs and negatively with tariffs. These results provide a clear rejection of the iceberg assumption on transportation costs and a strong confirmation of the classical Alchian‐Allen hypothesis. We show that these results cannot be explained by monopoly pricing‐to‐market behavior.

10.1086/422562.abstractZh: Alchian和Allen指出，单位交易成本的降低会降低高质量商品的相对价格，并增加对其的相对需求。我们扩展了他们的理论，推导出单位交易成本和按价值计算的交易成本与贸易商品质量构成之间的关系。通过大量进口商和出口商的详细国际贸易数据来验证这些预测。在狭义的商品分类范围内，出口商对不同目的地的商品价格存在差异，这些价格与运输成本呈正相关，与关税呈负相关。这些结果明确否定了关于运输成本的“冰山假设”，并强烈证实了Alchian-Allen的经典假设。我们表明，这些结果无法用垄断定价行为来解释。

abstract.text: We develop a parsimonious model of innovation to confront firm‐level evidence. It captures the dynamics of individual heterogeneous firms, describes the behavior of an industry with firm entry and exit, and delivers a general equilibrium model of technological change. While unifying the theoretical analysis of firms, industries, and the aggregate economy, the model yields insights into empirical work on innovating firms. It accounts for the persistence of firms’ R&D investment, the concentration of R&D among incumbents, the link between R&D and patenting, and why R&D as a fraction of revenues is positively correlated with firm productivity but not with firm size or growth.

10.1086/422563.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个简约的创新模型，以分析企业层面的证据。该模型能够捕捉个体异质企业的动态变化，描述具有企业进入和退出行为的行业的特性，并提供一个技术变革的一般均衡模型。该模型在统一对企业、行业和整体经济的理论分析的同时，也为关于创新企业的实证研究提供了见解。它解释了企业研发投资的持续性、现有企业之间的研发集中现象、研发与专利之间的关联，以及为什么研发占收入的比例与企业的生产率呈正相关，但与企业规模或增长无关。

abstract.text: Walrasian tâtonnement has been a fundamental assumption in economics ever since Walras’ general equilibrium theory was introduced in 1874. Nearly a century after its introduction, Vernon Smith relaxed the Walrasian tâtonnement assumption by showing that neoclassical competitive market theory explains the equilibrating forces in “double‐auction” markets. I make a next step in this evolution by exploring the predictive power of neoclassical theory in decentralized naturally occurring markets. Using data gathered from two distinct markets—the sports card and collector pin markets—I find a tendency for exchange prices to approach the neoclassical competitive model prediction after a few market periods.

10.1086/422564.abstractZh: 自1874年瓦尔拉斯的一般均衡理论被提出以来，瓦尔拉斯式试错法一直是经济学中的一个基本假设。在近一个世纪后，弗农·史密斯通过证明新古典竞争市场理论能够解释“双拍卖”市场中的均衡力量，从而放宽了瓦尔拉斯式试错法的假设。我在此研究基础上进一步探索新古典理论在自然分散的市场中的预测能力。通过收集来自两个不同市场——体育卡市场和收藏品徽章市场的数据，我发现交换价格在几个市场周期后会趋向于新古典竞争模型所预测的数值。

abstract.text: We propose a dynamic equilibrium model of asset prices and trading volume when agents face fixed transactions costs. We show that even small fixed costs can give rise to large “no‐trade” regions for each agent’s optimal trading policy. The inability to trade more frequently reduces the agents’ asset demand and in equilibrium gives rise to a significant illiquidity discount in asset prices.

10.1086/422565.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态均衡模型，用于描述在交易成本固定的情况下资产价格和交易量的动态变化。研究表明，即使是很小的固定成本，也可能导致每个代理人的最优交易策略中出现大量“不交易”区域。由于无法更频繁地进行交易，代理人的资产需求降低，从而在均衡状态下导致资产价格出现显著的流动性不足现象。

abstract.text: Taller workers receive a wage premium. Net of differences in family background, the disparity is similar in magnitude to the race and gender gaps. We exploit variation in an individual’s height over time to explore how height affects wages. Controlling for teen height essentially eliminates the effect of adult height on wages for white men.
