The teen height premium is not explained by differences in resources or endowments. The teen height premium is partially mediated through participation in high school sports and clubs. We estimate the monetary benefits of a medical treatment for children that increases height.

10.1086/422566.abstractZh: 高个子工人能够获得更高的工资。在排除家庭背景差异后，这种差异的大小与种族和性别差异相当。我们利用个体身高随时间的变化来探讨身高对工资的影响。控制青少年时期的身高后，成年时期身高对白人男性工资的影响基本消失。青少年时期的身高优势并非由资源或天赋差异所解释。这一优势部分通过参与高中体育活动和俱乐部得到缓解。我们估算了提高儿童身高所带来的经济收益。

abstract.text: Despite the centrality of the median voter prediction in political economy models, overwhelming empirical evidence shows that legislators regularly take positions that diverge significantly from the preferences of the median voter in their districts. However, all these empirical studies to date lack the necessary data to directly measure the preferences of the median voter. We utilize a unique data set consisting of individual‐level voting data that allows us to construct direct measures of voter preferences. We find that legislators are most constrained by the preferences of the median voter in homogeneous districts.

10.1086/424737.abstractZh: 尽管在政治经济模型中，中位选民偏好预测具有核心地位，但大量实证研究表明，立法者通常会采取与所在选区中位选民偏好存在显著差异的立场。然而，迄今为止所有这些实证研究都缺乏直接衡量中位选民偏好的必要数据。我们利用了包含个体层面投票数据的独特数据集，从而能够直接衡量选民偏好。研究发现，在同质选区中，立法者受到中位选民偏好的约束最为明显。

abstract.text: We measure the cost of consumption fluctuations using an approach that does not require the specification of preferences and instead uses asset prices. We measure the marginal cost of consumption fluctuations, the per unit benefit of a marginal reduction in consumption fluctuations expressed as a percentage of lifetime consumption. We find that the gains from eliminating all consumption uncertainty are very large. However, for consumption fluctuations corresponding to business cycle frequencies, we estimate the marginal cost to be between 0.08 percent and 0.49 percent of lifetime consumption.

10.1086/424738.abstractZh: 我们采用一种不需要指定偏好关系的方法来衡量消费波动的成本，而是利用资产价格来进行衡量。我们测量了消费波动的边际成本，即每单位减少消费波动所带来的收益占 lifetime 消费的百分比。我们发现，消除所有消费不确定性的收益非常大。然而，对于与商业周期频率相对应的消费波动，我们估计其边际成本在 lifetime 消费的0.08%到0.49%之间。

abstract.text: We derive a parsimonious rational model of active portfolio management that reproduces many regularities widely regarded as anomalous. Fund flows rationally respond to past performance in the model even though performance is not persistent and investments with active managers do not outperform passive benchmarks on average. The lack of persistence in returns does not imply that differential ability across managers is nonexistent or unrewarded or that gathering information about performance is socially wasteful. The model can quantitatively reproduce many salient features in the data. The flow‐performance relationship is consistent with high average levels of skills and considerable heterogeneity across managers.

10.1086/424739.abstractZh: 我们推导出了一个简约的理性模型，用于描述主动投资组合管理，该模型能够再现许多被认为异常的规律性现象。在模型中，资金流动会理性地响应过去的业绩表现，尽管这种表现并不具有持续性；同时，由主动管理团队管理的投资组合平均而言并不会超过被动基准表现。回报的缺乏持续性并不意味着不同管理团队之间的能力差异不存在或未被利用，也不意味着收集关于业绩的信息是浪费社会资源的行为。该模型能够定量地再现数据中的许多显著特征。资金流动与业绩表现之间的关系，与高平均水平的技能以及管理团队之间的显著异质性相一致。

abstract.text: In welfare theory it is standard to pick the consumption stream that maximizes the welfare of the representative agent. We argue against this position, and show that a benevolent social planner will generally place a greater weight on future consumption than does the representative agent. Our analysis has immediate implications for public policy: agents discount the future too much and the government should promote future oriented policies.

10.1086/424740.abstractZh: 在福利理论中，通常选择能够最大化代表性代理人的福利的消费路径。我们反对这一立场，并表明一个仁慈的社会规划者通常会比代表性代理人更重视未来的消费。我们的分析对公共政策有直接的启示：代理人对未来的折现过多，因此政府应该推行以未来为导向的政策。

abstract.text: We examine the mapping of the distribution of ability onto earnings in a hierarchical job assignment model. Workers are assigned to a continuum of jobs in fixed proportions, ordered by sensitivity to ability. The model implies a novel marginal productivity interpretation of wages. We derive comparative statics for changes in technology and in the distribution of ability. We find conditions under which a more unequal distribution of ability maps onto a more/less unequal distribution of earnings. We also analyze an assignment model with variable proportions and find that in the Cobb‐Douglas case, a rise in the inequality of ability always narrows the range of earnings.

10.1086/424741.abstractZh: 我们研究了在分层工作分配模型中，能力分布与收入之间的映射关系。工人被分配到一系列按能力敏感度排序的固定比例的工作岗位。该模型为工资的边际生产力解释提供了一种新的视角。我们推导了技术变革和能力分布变化下的比较静态结果。我们发现，在某些条件下，更不平等的能力分布会对应更不平等的收入分布。我们还分析了一个比例可变的分配模型，发现在Cobb-Douglas模型中，能力不平等的加剧总是会缩小收入范围。

abstract.text: Despite declining group inequality and the rapid expansion of the black middle class in the United States, major urban centers with significant black populations continue to exhibit extreme racial separation. Using a theoretical framework in which individuals care about both the affluence and the racial composition of neighborhoods, we show that lower inequality is consistent with extreme and even rising levels of segregation in cities in which the minority population is large. Our results can help explain why segregation continues to characterize the urban landscape even though survey evidence suggests that individuals favor more integration than they did in the past.

10.1086/424742.abstractZh: 尽管美国的群体不平等程度有所下降，黑人中产阶级的迅速扩张，但拥有大量黑人人口的主要城市中心仍然表现出极端的种族隔离现象。我们采用了一个理论框架，该框架认为个人既关心社区的富裕程度，也关心种族构成。我们的研究表明，在少数族裔人口众多的城市中，较低的不平等程度与极端的甚至上升的种族隔离水平是一致的。我们的研究结果有助于解释为什么即使调查数据显示个人更倾向于融合，但城市景观仍然呈现出种族隔离的特征。

abstract.text: Many studies have documented large and persistent productivity differences across producers, even within narrowly defined industries. This paper both extends and departs from the past literature, which focused on technological explanations for these differences, by proposing that demand‐side features also play a role in creating the observed productivity variation. The specific mechanism investigated here is the effect of spatial substitutability in the product market. When producers are densely clustered in a market, it is easier for consumers to switch between suppliers (making the market in a certain sense more competitive). Relatively inefficient producers find it more difficult to operate profitably as a result. Increases in substitutability truncate the productivity distribution from below, resulting in higher minimum and average productivity levels as well as less productivity dispersion. The paper presents a model that makes this process explicit and empirically tests it using data from U.S. ready‐mixed concrete plants, taking advantage of geographic variation in substitutability created by the industry’s high transport costs. The results support the model’s predictions and appear robust. Markets with high demand density for ready‐mixed concrete—and thus high concrete plant densities—have higher lower‐bound and average productivity levels and exhibit less productivity dispersion among their producers.

10.1086/424743.abstractZh: 许多研究记录了生产者之间存在的巨大且持续的生产力差异，即使是在定义较为明确的行业内部也是如此。本文既扩展了过去文献的关注范围，也对其进行了拓展。过去的研究主要聚焦于技术因素对生产力差异的解释，而本文则认为需求方面的因素同样在创造观察到的生产力差异中起着作用。本文研究的特定机制是产品市场中空间替代性的影响。当生产者在一个市场中密集聚集时，消费者更容易在供应商之间切换（这使得市场在某种程度上更具竞争力）。因此，相对低效的生产者更难实现盈利经营。替代性的增加会从下方压缩生产力分布，从而导致最低和平均生产力水平提高，同时降低生产力的分散程度。本文提出了一个模型来明确这一过程，并通过美国预拌混凝土厂的数据进行了实证检验，利用该行业因运输成本较高而产生的地理替代性差异。研究结果支持模型的预测，并且显示出稳健性。对于预拌混凝土需求密度较高的市场——因此混凝土厂密度较高的市场——其最低和平均生产力水平更高，生产者之间的生产力分散程度也较低。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of community identity on investment behaviour in the knitted garment industry in the South Indian town of Tirupur. We document very large and systematic differences in both levels of capital stock and the capital intensity of production in firms owned by people from two different community groups. We argue that the differences in investment cannot be explained by productivity differences alone. We suggest that the most likely explanation is that the two communities differ in their access to capital.

10.1111/0034-6527.00274.abstractZh: 本文研究了社区身份对南印度城市蒂鲁普尔针织服装行业投资行为的影响。我们发现，由两个不同社区群体所拥有的企业，在资本存量和生产资本强度方面存在非常显著且系统的差异。我们认为，这种投资差异不能仅由生产力差异来解释。我们推测，最有可能的原因是这两个社区在获取资本方面的机会存在差异。

abstract.text: Models of labor market equilibrium that let forward-looking decisions be aimed at maximization of expected prots and labor income offer valuable insights into the effects of job security provisions, but can hardly explain why they would ever be imposed. This paper's model of dynamic labor market interactions lets labor reallocation costs be partly financed by risk-averse workers' consumption flows. In the resulting second-best equilibrium, job security provisions increase workers' welfare and need not reduce productive efficiency as long as employers' ring costs at least partly finance workers' mobility.

10.1111/0034-6527.00275.abstractZh: 一些劳动力市场均衡模型允许前瞻性决策以最大化预期收益和劳动收入为目标，这些模型为我们提供了关于就业保障条款影响的宝贵见解，但很难解释为何会实施这些条款。本文提出的动态劳动力市场互动模型表明，劳动重新分配的成本可以部分由风险厌恶工人的消费流来融资。在由此产生的次优均衡中，就业保障条款能够提升工人的福利，只要雇主的隐性成本能够部分融资工人的流动性，就不会降低生产效率。

abstract.text: Procedures are presented that allow the empiricist to estimate and test asset pricing models on limited-liability securities without the assumption that the historical payoff distribution provides a consistent estimate of the market's prior beliefs. The procedures effectively filter return data for unspecified historical biases in the market's priors. They do not involve explicit estimation of the market's priors, and hence, economize on parameters. The procedures derive from a new but simple property of Bayesian learning, namely: if the correct likelihood is used, the inverse posterior at the true parameter value forms a martingale process relative to the learner's information filtration augmented with the true parameter value. Application of this central result to tests of asset pricing models requires a deliberate selection bias. Hence, as a by-product, the article establishes that biased samples contain information with which to falsify an asset pricing model or estimate its parameters. These include samples subject to, e.g. survivorship bias or Peso problems.

10.1111/0034-6527.00276.abstractZh: 本文提出了一些方法，使得经验主义者能够在无需假设历史收益分布能够一致反映市场先验信念的情况下，对有限责任证券的资产定价模型进行估计和测试。这些方法能够有效地过滤掉市场先验中的非预期历史偏差。这些方法并不涉及对市场先验的显式估计，因此能够节省参数估计的运算。这些方法基于贝叶斯学习的一个新但简单的性质：如果使用正确的似然函数，那么真实参数值对应的后验逆分布相对于学习者的信息过滤过程，加上真实参数值后，会形成一个鞅过程。将这一核心结果应用于资产定价模型的测试时，需要刻意选择样本。因此，作为副产品，本文指出有偏的样本包含了可以用来推翻资产定价模型或估计其参数的信息。这些有偏样本包括受到生存偏差或佩索问题的影响的样本。

abstract.text: Do large investors increase the vulnerability of a country to speculative attacks in the foreign exchange markets? To address this issue, we build a model of currency crises where a single large investor and a continuum of small investors independently decide whether to attack a currency based on their private information about fundamentals. Even abstracting from signalling, the presence of the large investor does make all other traders more aggressive in their selling. Relative to the case in which there is no large investor, small investors attack the currency when fundamentals are stronger. Yet, the difference can be small, or non-existent, depending on the relative precision of private information of the small and large investors. Adding signalling makes the influence of the large trader on small traders' behaviour much stronger.

10.1111/0034-6527.00277.abstractZh: 大型投资者是否会增加一个国家在外汇市场遭受投机性攻击的脆弱性？为了探讨这个问题，我们构建了一个货币危机模型，其中单个大型投资者和一系列小型投资者各自根据他们对基本面的私人信息来决定是否攻击某种货币。即使不考虑信号传递的影响，大型投资者的存在确实会使所有其他交易者在抛售时更加激进。与没有大型投资者的情况相比，小型投资者在基本面较强时会攻击该货币。然而，这种差异可能很小，甚至不存在，这取决于小型和大型投资者私人信息的相对精确性。加入信号传递后，大型交易者对小型交易者的行为影响会显著增强。

abstract.text: We analyse an overlapping generations model of voting on “reform projects”. These resemble investments in that they first require some investment expenditure and later payoff. Since the time during which old people get the benefit is shorter, or because older people are more wealthy and hence pay more taxes, they are more conservative (against reforms) than young people. We show that if people vote on which majority should be required in future elections for a bill to become a law, the winning proposal specifies a supermajority. This result is very robust even if age related conflict is only one determinant among others for voting behaviour in the society.

10.1111/0034-6527.00278.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个关于“改革项目”投票的重叠世代模型。这些投票类似于投资，因为它们首先需要一定的投资支出，之后才会获得回报。由于老年人获得利益的时间较短，或者因为老年人更富有，因此他们缴纳的税款更多，因此他们比年轻人更保守（反对改革）。我们表明，如果人们投票决定未来选举中某项法案成为法律所需的多数票，那么获胜的提案会规定一个超级多数。即使年龄相关的冲突只是影响社会投票行为的一个因素，这一结果仍然非常稳健。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of “news” or advance information about future production on competitive storage behaviour and prices using a structural model of commodity markets. In particular, it generalizes the neoclassical storage model to incorporate information on future harvests, while allowing for seasonal production, two features important to African and other developing country grain markets. The model is first developed to suit the case of the Ethiopian grain markets, and a general model is then stated. The effects on welfare and price variability of the addition of news are discussed, as well as changes in key demand and uncertainty parameters. The model is shown to replicate some features of the data better than the model without news, particularly the high autocorrelation in price, and performs better in formal estimation. However, it appears that the incorporation of news still fails to explain the extreme seasonal price movements observed.

10.1111/0034-6527.00279.abstractZh: 本文通过商品市场的结构模型，探讨了关于未来生产的“新闻”或先行信息对竞争性储存行为及价格的影响。具体而言，本文将新古典储存模型推广，纳入了关于未来收成的信息，同时允许季节性生产，这两个特征对非洲及其他发展中国家的粮食市场尤为重要。模型首先针对埃塞俄比亚的粮食市场进行了开发，随后提出了一个通用模型。文章讨论了添加新闻对福利和价格变动性的影响，以及关键需求和不确定性参数的变化。模型在复制数据的一些特征方面表现得比没有新闻的模型更为出色，尤其是在价格的高度自相关性方面，并且在正式估计中表现更好。然而，似乎即使纳入新闻信息，仍无法解释所观察到的极端季节性价格变动。

abstract.text: Identical agents gather costly information, and then aggregate it through voting. Because information is a public good, information is underprovided relative to the social optimum. A “good” voting rule must give incentives to acquire information, as well as aggregate information efficiently. A voting rule that requires a large plurality (in the extreme, unanimity) to upset the status quo can be optimal only if the information available to each agent is sufficiently accurate. This result is independent of the preferences of voters and of the cost of information.

10.1111/0034-6527.00280.abstractZh: 相同的代理人会收集昂贵的信息，然后通过投票来整合这些信息。由于信息是公共物品，因此相对于社会最优状态而言，信息的供应是不足的。一个“好的”投票规则必须既能激励人们获取信息，又能有效整合信息。只有当每个代理人所拥有的信息足够准确时，要求多数票（在极端情况下，需要一致同意）来打破现状的投票规则才可能是最优的。这一结果与选民的偏好以及信息的成本无关。

abstract.text: Standard models of employment fluctuations cannot reconcile the unemployment rate's remarkable persistence with the high job-finding rates found in worker flows data. A matching model emphasizing high hazard rates among newly formed firm-worker matches can resolve this shortcoming. In the model, matches are experience goods; consequently, newly employed workers face higher hazard rates. Following a job loss, workers may experience several short-lived jobs before finding stable employment. At an aggregate level, an initial burst of job loss precipitates a steady flow of recurring job loss. A simulation shows that this recurring job loss can account for the fact that the unemployment rate remains elevated for as much as 4 or 5 years following an initial jump.

10.1111/0034-6527.00281.abstractZh: 标准的就业波动模型无法解释失业率持续高企的现象，以及工人流动数据中发现的较高的就业匹配率。一个强调新形成的企业-员工匹配中存在高风险率的匹配模型可以解决这一缺陷。在该模型中，匹配是一种经验性商品；因此，新就业的工人面临更高的风险率。在失业之后，工人可能会经历几次短暂的工作机会，然后才能找到稳定的工作。从总体上看，最初的失业激增会引发持续的失业循环。模拟结果显示，这种持续的失业循环可以解释为什么失业率在最初的波动之后仍然保持较高水平，甚至持续4到5年。

abstract.text: Many believe that a key innovation by the Grameen Bank is to encourage borrowers to help each other in hard times. To analyse this, we study a mechanism design problem where borrowers share information about each other, but their limited side contracting ability prevents them from writing complete insurance contracts. We derive a lending mechanism which efficiently induces mutual insurance. It is necessary for borrowers to submit reports about each other to achieve efficiency. Such cross-reporting increases the bargaining power of unsuccessful borrowers, and is robust to collusion against the bank.

10.1111/0034-6527.00282.abstractZh: 许多人认为，格拉敏银行的一项关键创新在于鼓励借款人在困难时期互相帮助。为了分析这一点，我们研究了一个机制设计问题，其中借款者之间会分享彼此的信息，但由于他们有限的契约签订能力，他们无法签订完整的保险合同。我们提出了一种有效的贷款机制，能够促使借款者互相提供保险。借款者需要互相提交报告以实现效率，这种相互报告的行为增加了失败借款者的议价能力，并且能够抵御针对银行的勾结行为。

abstract.text: Multi-store firms are common in the retailing industry. Theory suggests that cross-elasticities between stores of the same firm enhance market power. To evaluate the importance of this effect in the U.K. supermarket industry, we estimate a model of consumer choice and expenditure using three data sources: profit margins for each chain, a survey of consumer choices and a data-set of store characteristics. To permit plausible substitution patterns, the utility model interacts consumer and store characteristics. We measure market power by calculating the effect of merger and demerger on Nash equilibrium prices. Demerger reduces the prices of the largest firms by between 2 and 3.8% depending on local concentration; mergers between the largest firms lead to price increases up to 7.4%.

10.1111/0034-6527.00283.abstractZh: 多门店企业是零售业中常见的现象。理论表明，同一企业旗下不同门店之间的交叉弹性会增强其市场力量。为了评估这一效应在英国超市行业中的重要性，我们基于三个数据来源构建了一个消费者选择和支出模型：各连锁店的利润率、消费者选择调查以及门店特征数据。为了模拟合理的替代模式，效用模型同时考虑了消费者特征和门店特征。我们通过计算合并与拆分对纳什均衡价格的影响来衡量市场力量。根据当地集中度不同，拆分会使最大企业的价格下降2%至3.8%；而最大企业之间的合并则会导致价格上升高达7.4%。

abstract.text: If better informed voters receive favourable policies, then mass media will affect policy because mass media provide most of the information people use in voting. This paper models the incentives of the media to deliver news to different groups. The increasing-returns-to-scale technology and advertising financing of media firms induce them to provide more news to large groups, such as taxpayers and dispersed consumer interests, and groups that are valuable to advertisers. This news bias alters the trade-off in political competition and therefore introduces a bias in public policy. The paper also discusses the effects of broadcast media replacing newspapers as the main information source about politics. The model predicts that this change should raise spending on government programmes used by poor and rural voters.

10.1111/0034-6527.00284.abstractZh: 如果信息更充分的选民能够获得有利的政策，那么大众媒体将影响政策制定，因为大众媒体提供了人们投票时主要使用的信息。本文对媒体向不同群体传递新闻的动机进行了建模分析。随着规模效应的增加以及广告融资对媒体公司的推动，媒体更倾向于向大型群体、纳税人、分散的消费者利益群体以及广告商重视的群体传递新闻。这种新闻偏向会改变政治竞争中的权衡，从而引入公共政策上的偏差。文章还探讨了广播媒体取代报纸成为政治信息主要来源的影响。模型预测，这种变化应该会增加贫困和农村选民对政府项目的支出。

abstract.text: We develop a general model of lending in the presence of endogenous borrowing constraints. Borrowing constraints arise because borrowers face limited liability and debt repayment cannot be perfectly enforced. In the model, the dynamics of debt are closely linked with the dynamics of borrowing constraints. In fact, borrowing constraints must satisfy a dynamic consistency requirement: the value of outstanding debt restricts current access to short-term capital, but is itself determined by future access to credit. This dynamic consistency is not guaranteed in models of exogenous borrowing constraints, where the ability to raise short-term capital is limited by some prespecified function of debt. We characterize the optimal default-free contract—which minimizes borrowing constraints at all histories—and derive implications for firm growth, survival, leverage and debt maturity. The model is qualitatively consistent with stylized facts on the growth and survival of firms. Comparative statics with respect to technology and default constraints are derived.

10.1111/0034-6527.00285.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个在存在内生借款约束条件下的借贷通用模型。借款约束的出现是因为借款人面临有限的责任，且债务偿还无法得到完全执行。在模型中，债务的动态与借款约束的动态密切相关。实际上，借款约束必须满足动态一致性要求：未偿还债务的价值限制了当前对短期资本的使用，但本身又由未来获得信贷的能力决定。在外部借款约束的模型中，这种动态一致性并不保证，因为短期资本筹集的能力受到某种预设的债务函数限制。我们描述了最优无违约契约——该契约能在所有历史条件下最小化借款约束——并推导出其对企业增长、生存、杠杆率和债务到期日的影响。该模型在定性上与企业增长和生存的典型事实一致。我们还推导出了关于技术和违约约束的比较静态分析。

abstract.text: We consider an infinitely repeated Bertrand game, in which prices are publicly observed and each firm receives a privately observed, i.i.d. cost shock in each period. We focus on symmetric perfect public equilibria, wherein any “punishments” are borne equally by all firms. We identify a tradeoff that is associated with collusive pricing schemes in which the price to be charged by each firm is strictly increasing in its cost level: such “fully sorting” schemes offer efficiency benefits, as they ensure that the lowest-cost firm makes the current sale, but they also imply an informational cost (distorted pricing and/or equilibrium-path price wars), since a higher-cost firm must be deterred from mimicking a lower-cost firm by charging a lower price. A rigid-pricing scheme, where a firm's collusive price is independent of its current cost position, sacrifices efficiency benefits but also diminishes the informational cost. For a wide range of settings, the optimal symmetric collusive scheme requires (i) the absence of equilibrium-path price wars and (ii) a rigid price. If firms are sufficiently impatient, however, the rigid-pricing scheme cannot be enforced, and the collusive price of lower-cost firms may be distorted downward in order to diminish the incentive to cheat. When the model is modified to include i.i.d. public demand shocks, the downward pricing distortion that accompanies a firm's lower-cost realization may occur only when current demand is high.

10.1111/0034-6527.00286.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个无限重复的伯特兰博弈，其中价格是公开公布的，每家公司在每个时期都会面临一个私密的、独立同分布的成本冲击。我们关注的是对称完美的公共均衡，在这种均衡中，所有公司都会平等地承担“惩罚”。我们发现，与勾结定价方案相关的权衡是，每家公司收取的价格与其成本水平严格正相关：这种“完全排序”方案确实带来了效率上的好处，因为它确保了成本最低的公司进行当前的销售，但同时也带来了信息成本（扭曲的定价和/或均衡路径价格竞争），因为成本较高的公司必须通过收取较低的价格来避免模仿成本较低的公司。在刚性定价方案中，公司的勾结价格与其当前成本水平无关，这种方案虽然牺牲了效率上的好处，但降低了信息成本。对于广泛的设定情况，最优的对称勾结方案要求（i）不存在均衡路径价格竞争，以及（ii）价格具有刚性。然而，如果公司足够急躁，刚性定价方案就无法实施，成本较低的公司可能会通过降低价格来减少作弊的动机。当模型被修改为包含独立同分布的公开需求冲击时，成本较低的公司可能会出现价格下降的扭曲，但这通常只发生在当前需求较高的情况下。

abstract.text: Two players simultaneously decide whether or not to acquire new weapons in an arms race game. Each player's type determines his propensity to arm. Types are private information, and are independently drawn from a continuous distribution. With probability close to one, the best outcome for each player is for neither to acquire new weapons (although each prefers to acquire new weapons if he thinks the opponent will). There is a small probability that a player is a dominant strategy type who always prefers to acquire new weapons. We find conditions under which the unique Bayesian-Nash equilibrium involves an arms race with probability one. However, if the probability that a player is a dominant strategy type is sufficiently small, then there is an equilibrium of the cheap-talk extension of the game where the probability of an arms race is close to zero.

10.1111/0034-6527.00287.abstractZh: 在一项军备竞赛游戏中，两名玩家同时决定是否购买新武器。每个玩家的类型决定了他武装的倾向。这些类型属于私人信息，并且是从连续分布中独立抽取的。几乎可以肯定的是，对每位玩家来说，最好的结果是双方都不购买新武器（尽管如果认为对手会购买新武器，每位玩家都会更倾向于购买新武器）。有很小的概率，某个玩家属于占优策略类型，总是更倾向于购买新武器。我们发现了一些条件，在这些条件下，唯一的贝叶斯-纳什均衡涉及以概率一进行的军备竞赛。然而，如果某个玩家属于占优策略类型的比例足够小，那么就会出现一种廉价对话扩展游戏的均衡状态，在这种状态下，发生军备竞赛的概率接近于零。

abstract.text: Central to ongoing debates over the desirability of monetary unions is a supposed trade-off, outlined by Mundell (1961): a monetary union reduces transactions costs but renders stabilization policy less effective. If shocks across countries are sufficiently correlated, then, according to this argument, delegating monetary policy to a single central bank is not very costly and a monetary union is desirable. This paper explores this argument in a setting with both monetary and fiscal policies. In an economy with monetary policy alone, we confirm the presence of the trade-off and find that indeed a monetary union will not be welfare improving if the correlation of national shocks is too low. However, fiscal interventions by national governments, combined with a central bank that has the ability to commit to monetary policy, overturn these results. In equilibrium, such a monetary union will be welfare improving for any correlation of shocks.

10.1111/0034-6527.00288.abstractZh: 关于货币联盟的利弊争论中，有一个被普遍引用的权衡论点，由蒙代尔在1961年提出：货币联盟可以降低交易成本，但会使稳定政策的效果减弱。如果各国之间的冲击具有高度相关性，那么根据这一论点，将货币政策委托给单一中央银行并不会带来太大成本，货币联盟因此具有吸引力。本文在同时考虑货币政策和财政政策的情况下，对这一论点进行了探讨。在仅依赖货币政策的经济环境中，我们确认了这种权衡的存在，并发现如果国家间冲击的相关性过低，货币联盟实际上并不会提升福利。然而，如果各国政府进行财政干预，并且中央银行能够负责制定货币政策，那么这些结果就会被推翻。在均衡状态下，无论冲击的相关性如何，货币联盟都会提升福利。

abstract.text: Many strategic interactions in the real world take place among delegates empowered to act on behalf of others. Although there may be a multitude of reasons why delegation arises in reality, one intriguing possibility is that it yields a strategic advantage to the delegating party. In the case where only one party has the option to delegate, we analyse the possibility that strategic delegation arises as an equilibrium outcome under completely unobservable incentive contracts within the class of two-person extensive form games. We show that delegation may arise solely due to strategic reasons in quite general economic environments even under unobservable contracts. Furthermore, under some reasonable restrictions on out-of-equilibrium beliefs and actions of the outside party, strategic delegation is shown to be the only equilibrium outcome.

10.1111/0034-6527.00289.abstractZh: 在现实世界中，许多战略互动都是发生在被授权代表他人行事的代理人之间。尽管现实中出现委托行为可能有多种原因，但一个有趣的可能性是，委托行为可能为委托方带来战略优势。在只有一方可以选择委托的情况下，我们分析了在完全不可观测的激励契约下，战略委托作为均衡结果的可能性。我们证明，即使在不可观测的契约下，战略委托也可能仅仅由于战略原因而在一般的经济环境中出现。此外，在一些合理的限制条件下，针对外部方的非均衡信念和行为，战略委托被证明是唯一均衡结果。

abstract.text: We examine the robustness of information cascades in laboratory experiments. Apart from the situation in which each player can obtain a signal for free (as in the experiment by Anderson and Holt (1997), American Economic Review, 87 (5), 847–862), the case of costly signals is studied where players decide whether or not to obtain private information, at a small but positive cost. In the equilibrium of this game, only the first player buys a signal and makes a decision based on this information whereas all following players do not buy a signal and herd behind the first player. The experimental results show that too many signals are bought and the equilibrium prediction performs poorly. To explain these observations, the depth of the subjects' reasoning process is estimated, using a statistical error-rate model. Allowing for different error rates on different levels of reasoning, we find that the subjects' inferences become significantly more noisy on higher levels of the thought process, and that only short chains of reasoning are applied by the subjects.

10.1111/0034-6527.00290.abstractZh: 我们研究了实验室实验中信息级联的稳健性。除了每个参与者可以免费获得信号的情景（如Anderson和Holt在1997年的《美国经济评论》第87卷第5期，847-862页的实验），我们还研究了信号成本较高的情形，即参与者需要支付少量但积极的成本来决定是否获取私人信息。在这个游戏的均衡状态下，只有第一个参与者购买信号并基于这些信息做出决策，而所有后续的参与者都不购买信号，并跟随第一个参与者行动。实验结果表明，购买的信号数量过多，均衡预测效果较差。为了解释这些现象，我们使用统计错误率模型来估计参与者推理过程的深度。考虑到不同推理层次上的错误率差异，我们发现参与者在更高层次的推理过程中，推断结果变得更加混乱，而且他们只应用了较短的推理链。

abstract.text: I analyse social interactions that stem from the successive endeavours of new cohorts of heterogeneous decision makers to learn from the experiences of past cohorts. A dynamic process of information accumulation and decision making occurs as the members of each cohort observe the experiences of earlier ones, and then make choices that yield experiences observable by future cohorts. Decision makers face the selection problem as they seek to learn from observation of past actions and outcomes, while not observing the counterfactual outcomes that would have occurred had other actions been chosen. Assuming that all cohorts face the same outcome distributions, I show that social learning is a process of sequential reduction in ambiguity. The specific nature of this process, and its terminal state, depend critically on how decision makers make choices under ambiguity. I use the problem of learning about innovations to illustrate.

10.1111/0034-6527.00291.abstractZh: 我分析了由新一代异质决策者不断努力从过去群体的经验中学习而产生的社会互动。随着每个群体的成员观察前一代人的经验，并做出能够给未来群体带来可观察经验的决策，信息积累和决策过程便开始了。决策者面临着选择问题，他们试图通过观察过去的行为和结果来学习，但却无法观察到如果选择其他行为将会发生的反事实结果。假设所有群体都面临相同的结果分布，我表明社会学习是一个逐步减少模糊性的过程。这一过程的具体性质及其最终状态，在很大程度上取决于决策者在模糊性条件下如何做出选择。我以了解创新知识的问题为例进行说明。

abstract.text: We claim that the stock market encourages business creation, innovation, and growth by allowing the recycling of “informed capital”. Due to incentive and information problems, start-ups face larger costs of going public than mature firms. Sustaining a tight relationship with a monitor (bank, venture capitalist) allows them to finance their operations without going public until profitability prospects are clearer or incentive problems are less severe. However, the earlier young firms go public, the quicker monitors' informed capital is redirected towards new start-ups. Hence, when informed capital is in limited supply, factors that lower the costs for start-ups to go public encourage business creation. Technological spill-overs associated with business creation and thick market externalities in the young firms segment of the stock market provide prima facie cases for encouraging young firms to go public.

10.1111/0034-6527.00292.abstractZh: 我们认为，股市通过允许“信息丰富的资本”的循环利用，促进了商业创造、创新与增长。由于激励和信息的限制，初创企业上市的成本比成熟企业要高。与保荐机构（银行、风险投资机构）保持紧密关系，可以让它们在盈利前景明朗或激励问题减轻之前，无需上市即可融资运营。然而，初创企业上市越早，保荐机构的信息丰富资本就越可能转向新的初创企业。因此，在信息资本供应有限的情况下，降低初创企业上市成本的因素，实际上促进了商业创造。与商业创造相关的技术溢出效应，以及股市中年轻企业群体的市场外部性，都为鼓励年轻企业上市提供了初步依据。

abstract.text: Data from a field experiment are used to estimate the gain in productivity that is realized when workers are paid piece rates rather than fixed wages. The experiment was conducted within a tree-planting firm and provides daily observations on individual worker productivity under both compensation systems. Unrestricted statistical methods estimate the productivity gain to be 20%. Since planting conditions potentially affect incentives, structural econometric methods are used to generalize the experimental results to out-of-sample conditions. The structural results suggest that the average productivity gain, outside of the experimental conditions, would be at least 21.7%.

10.1111/0034-6527.00294.abstractZh: 一项实地实验的数据被用来估算当工人采用计件工资而非固定工资时，生产力所提升的幅度。该实验在一家植树公司进行，每天对两种薪酬制度下工人的生产力进行了观察。通过不受限制的统计方法估算，生产力提升幅度为20%。由于植树条件可能会影响激励因素，因此采用了结构计量经济学方法来将实验结果推广到非实验条件下的情况。结构分析结果表明，在非实验条件下，平均生产力提升幅度至少为21.7%。

abstract.text: A common assumption in equilibrium search and matching models of the labour market is that each firm posts a wage, to be paid to any worker hired. This paper considers the implications of firms posting contracts, in a random matching model with on-the-job search. More complex contracts enable firms to address both recruitment and retention problems by, for example, increasing the wage with tenure. The effect on the labour market is to reduce turnover, below the level required for efficient matching of workers to firms.

10.1111/0034-6527.00295.abstractZh: 在劳动力市场的均衡搜索与匹配模型中，一个常见的假设是，每家公司都会公布自己的工资，这些工资将支付给所雇佣的工人。本文探讨了在随机匹配模型下，公司公布合同所带来的影响，同时考虑了在职搜索的环节。更复杂的合同能够帮助企业解决招聘和留任问题，例如，通过增加与任期相关的工资来提升员工的留存率。这种机制有助于降低劳动力市场的流动率，使其低于实现工人与公司有效匹配所需的水平。

abstract.text: This paper describes a search model with a continuum of worker and job types, free entry and transferable utility. We apply a second-order Taylor expansion to characterize the equilibrium, derive the “cost of search” and show that it is decreasing in the substitutability of worker types. This cost of search is then decomposed into three components: unemployment, vacancy costs and mismatch. Our contact technology rules out congestion effects between different worker types and therefore exhibits increasing returns to scale. One third of those increasing returns in contacts are shown to be absorbed by firms and workers being more choosy. The resulting equilibrium is not efficient. Unemployment benefits can reduce the loss by serving as a search subsidy. Numerical simulations of the model show that our Taylor expansions are quite accurate.

10.1111/0034-6527.00296.abstractZh: 本文描述了一个具有连续工人和职位类型、自由进入及可转移效用的搜索模型。我们采用二阶泰勒展开来刻画均衡状态，推导出“搜索成本”，并发现该成本随着工人类型替代性的增加而减少。这一搜索成本可分解为三个组成部分：失业、职位空缺成本以及不匹配问题。我们的接触技术排除了不同工人类型之间的拥堵效应，因此表现出规模收益递增。研究发现，接触机会中三分之一的递增收益被企业和工人更挑剔的择选行为所吸收。由此产生的均衡并不高效。失业救济金可以通过提供搜索补贴来减少这种损失。模型数值模拟表明，我们的泰勒展开方法相当准确。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of money in markets in which producers have private information about the quality of the goods they supply. When the fraction of high-quality producers in the economy is given, money promotes the production of high-quality goods, which improves the quality mix and welfare unambiguously. When this fraction is endogenous, however, we find that money can decrease welfare relative to the barter equilibrium. The origin of this inefficiency is that money provides consumption insurance to low-quality producers, which can result in a higher fraction of low-quality producers in the monetary equilibrium. Finally, we find that most often agents acquire more costly information in the monetary equilibrium than in the barter equilibrium. Consequently, money is welfare-enhancing because it promotes useful production and exchange, but not because it saves information costs.

10.1111/0034-6527.00309.abstractZh: 本文研究了在生产者拥有关于所供应商品质量的私人信息的市场中，货币的作用。当经济中高质量生产者的比例已知时，货币会促进高质量商品的生产，从而明确提升质量组合和福利水平。然而，当这一比例是内生变量时，我们发现货币可能会降低福利水平，相对于物物交换的均衡状态而言。这种低效率的根源在于，货币为低质量生产者提供了消费保障，这可能导致货币均衡状态下低质量生产者所占的比例增加。最后，我们发现，在货币均衡状态下，代理人通常会获得成本更高的信息。因此，货币之所以能提升福利，是因为它促进了有用的生产和交换，而不是因为节省了信息成本。

abstract.text: We develop generalized indirect estimation procedures that handle equality and inequality constraints on the auxiliary model parameters by extracting information from the relevant multipliers, and compare their asymptotic efficiency to maximum likelihood. We also show that, regardless of the validity of the restrictions, the asymptotic efficiency of such estimators can never decrease by explicitly considering the multipliers associated with additional equality constraints. Furthermore, we discuss the variety of effects on efficiency that can result from imposing constraints on a previously unrestricted model. As an example, we consider a stochastic volatility process estimated through a garch model with Gaussian or t distributed errors.

10.1111/0034-6527.00310.abstractZh: 我们开发了广义间接估计方法，能够处理辅助模型参数上的等式和不等式约束，通过从相关乘数中提取信息来实现。我们还将这些估计方法的渐近效率与最大似然法进行了比较。我们还表明，无论约束的有效性如何，通过明确考虑与额外等式约束相关的乘数，这些估计方法的渐近效率永远不会下降。此外，我们还讨论了在先前不受限制的模型上施加约束可能带来的各种效率影响。作为一个例子，我们考虑了一个通过GARCH模型估计的随机波动率过程，该模型具有高斯或t分布误差。

abstract.text: This paper identifies a source of gradualism in bargaining and contribution games. In the bargaining games we examine, each party can opt out at any time, and the outside option outcome is assumed to depend on the offers made in the negotiation phase. Specifically, we assume that (1) making a concession in the negotiation phase increases the other party's outside option pay-off and (2) the outside option outcome induces an efficiency loss as compared with a negotiated agreement. The main finding is that the mere presence of such history-dependent outside options forces equilibrium concessions in the negotiation phase to be gradual, and the degree of gradualism is characterized. The model also applies to contribution games in which the outside option may be interpreted as the option to implement a partial project using the total contributions made so far.

10.1111/0034-6527.00311.abstractZh: 本文指出了 bargaining 和 contribution 游戏中渐进主义的一种来源。在我们研究的 bargaining 游戏中，各方都可以随时选择退出，而外部选项的结果被认为取决于谈判阶段的提议。具体来说，我们假设：（1）在谈判阶段做出让步会增加另一方外部选项的收益；（2）与协商达成的协议相比，外部选项的结果会导致效率损失。主要发现是，这种依赖历史条件的外部选项的存在，迫使谈判阶段的均衡让步是渐进的，并且渐进的程度可以被描述出来。该模型也适用于 contribution 游戏，在这些游戏中，外部选项可以被解释为使用迄今为止所做出的全部贡献来实施部分项目的选项。

abstract.text: This paper develops a growth theory that captures the replacement of physical capital accumulation by human capital accumulation as a prime engine of growth along the process of development. It argues that the positive impact of inequality on the growth process was reversed in this process. In early stages of the Industrial Revolution, when physical capital accumulation was the prime source of growth, inequality stimulated development by channelling resources towards individuals with a higher propensity to save. As human capital emerged as a growth engine, equality alleviated adverse effects of credit constraints on human capital accumulation, stimulating the growth process.

10.1111/0034-6527.00312.abstractZh: 本文发展了一种增长理论，认为在发展过程中，人力资本积累取代了物质资本积累，成为增长的主要动力。文章指出，不平等对增长过程的积极影响在这一过程中被逆转了。在工业革命初期，物质资本积累是增长的主要来源，不平等通过将资源导向那些有更高储蓄倾向的个体，促进了发展。随着人力资本成为增长的主要动力，平等缓解了信贷约束对人力资本积累的不利影响，从而刺激了增长过程。

abstract.text: We provide empirical restrictions of a model of optimal order submissions in a limit order market. A trader's optimal order submission depends on the trader's valuation for the asset and the trade-offs between order prices, execution probabilities and picking off risks. The optimal order submission strategy is a monotone function of a trader's valuation for the asset. We test the monotonicity restriction in a sample of order submissions and their realized outcomes from the Stockholm Stock Exchange. We do not reject the monotonicity restriction for buy orders or sell orders considered separately, but reject the monotonicity restriction for buy and sell orders considered jointly.

10.1111/0034-6527.00313.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个关于限价订单市场中最优订单提交模型的实证限制。交易者的最优订单提交取决于其对资产的估值，以及订单价格、执行概率和风险规避之间的权衡。最优订单提交策略是交易者资产估值的单调函数。我们在斯德哥尔摩证券交易所的一组订单提交及其实际结果中检验了这一单调性限制。对于单独考虑的买入订单和卖出订单，我们并未拒绝该单调性限制，但对于同时考虑的买入订单和卖出订单，我们却拒绝了该单调性限制。

abstract.text: This paper presents a model of dynamic competition between two firms that repeatedly engage in an innovative activity. The state of competition—measured by the difference between the number of innovations introduced by the firms—evolves stochastically according to their effort level. The structure of Markov perfect equilibria is identified. It is generally not true that competition is fiercest when firms are closest. Rather, firms invest under two distinct circumstances: while sufficiently ahead, to outstrip their rival and secure a durable leadership; while behind, to regain leadership and prevent the situation from worsening to the point where their rival outstrips them.

10.1111/0034-6527.00314.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，描述了两家企业之间动态的竞争关系，这两家企业不断进行创新活动。竞争的状态——通过企业所引入的创新数量之差来衡量——会根据它们的努力程度随机变化。马尔可夫完美均衡的结构被确定下来。通常情况下，企业之间的距离越近，竞争越激烈这一说法并不成立。相反，企业在两种不同情况下进行投资：当企业领先足够远时，为了超越竞争对手并获得持久的优势；而当企业落后时，则为了重新夺回领导地位，防止情况恶化到竞争对手超越自己的地步。

abstract.text: We examine an oligopoly model where some consumers engage in costly non-sequential search to discover prices. There are three distinct price-dispersed equilibria characterized by low, moderate and high search intensity. The effects of an increase in the number of firms on search behaviour, expected prices, price dispersion and welfare are sensitive (i) to the equilibrium consumers' search intensity, and (ii) to the status quo number of firms. For instance, when consumers search with low intensity, an increase in the number of firms reduces search, does not affect expected price, leads to greater price dispersion and reduces welfare. In contrast, when consumers search with high intensity, increased competition results in more search and lower prices when the number of competitors in the market is low to begin with, but in less search and higher prices when the number of competitors is large. Duopoly yields identical expected price and price dispersion but higher welfare than an infinite number of firms.

10.1111/0034-6527.00315.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个寡头垄断模型，其中一些消费者会进行昂贵的非顺序搜索以了解价格信息。存在三种不同的价格分散均衡状态，分别对应于低、中、高的搜索强度。企业数量增加对搜索行为、预期价格、价格分散性和福利的影响，会受到以下两个因素的影响：(i) 均衡消费者的搜索强度，以及 (ii) 现有的企业数量。例如，当消费者的搜索强度较低时，企业数量的增加会减少搜索行为，但不影响预期价格，导致价格分散性增加，同时降低福利。相反，当消费者的搜索强度较高时，市场竞争加剧会导致更多的搜索行为，但在市场中的竞争对手数量较少时，价格会下降；而当竞争对手数量较多时，搜索行为减少，价格则上升。双寡头垄断情况下，预期价格和价格分散性相同，但福利水平高于无限多企业的情形。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the link between the internal organization of the firm and the growth process. We present a Schumpeterian growth model in which monopoly firms face agency costs due to collusion between managers inside the organization. These costs affect incentives to invest and the rate of innovation in the economy. When collusion is self-enforcing, higher growth and more creative destruction shortens in turn the time horizon of colluding agents in the organization and makes internal collusion more difficult to sustain. We analyse this two-way mechanism between growth and agency problems and show how the transaction costs of side-contracting within the firm and the growth rate of the economy are simultaneously derived.

10.1111/0034-6527.00316.abstractZh: 本文分析了企业内部组织与增长过程之间的联系。我们提出了一个熊彼特式增长模型，在该模型中，垄断企业由于企业内部管理者之间的勾结而面临代理成本。这些成本影响了投资激励以及经济中的创新率。当勾结行为具有自我维持性时，更高的增长和更少的创造性破坏会缩短组织内勾结者的时间范围，使得内部勾结难以持续。我们分析了增长与代理问题之间的这种双向机制，并展示了企业内部横向契约的交易成本与经济增长率是如何同时产生的。

abstract.text: We analyse the efficiency of the labour market outcome in a competitive search equilibrium model with endogenous turnover and endogenous general human capital formation. We show that search frictions do not distort training decisions if firms and their employees are able to coordinate efficiently, for instance, by using long-term contracts. In the absence of efficient coordination devices there is too much turnover and too little investment in general training. Nonetheless, the number of training firms and the amount of training provided are constrained optimal, and training subsidies therefore reduce welfare.

10.1111/0034-6527.00317.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有内生人员流动和内生一般人力资本形成的竞争搜索均衡模型中，分析了劳动力市场结果的效率。研究表明，如果企业和员工能够高效地进行协调，例如通过长期合同，那么搜索摩擦就不会扭曲培训决策。在没有有效的协调机制的情况下，人员流动过多，一般培训的投资不足。尽管如此，培训企业的数量和提供的培训量仍然处于最优状态，因此培训补贴会降低福利水平。

abstract.text: Constrained efficient provision of an excludable public good is studied in a model where preferences are private information. The provision level is asymptotically deterministic, making it possible to approximate the optimal mechanism with a mechanism that provides a fixed quantity of the good and charges fixed user fees for access. In general, the fixed fees involve third degree price discrimination, but, if names are uninformative about preferences, the analysis provides a justification for average cost pricing.

10.1111/0034-6527.00318.abstractZh: 本文研究在偏好为私人信息的模型中，对可排除的公共物品的约束性有效供给问题。供给水平具有渐近确定性，因此可以通过提供一种固定数量的物品并收取固定的使用费用来近似最优机制。通常，这些固定费用涉及第三级价格歧视，但如果姓名与偏好无关，则分析为平均成本定价提供了依据。

abstract.text: Prepares students for graduate study in business and law as well as graduate work in economics or public policy, leading to careers in teaching and research in economics; and it serves as a direct stepping stone towards employment in business, non-profits, finance, and government organizations.

10.1111/0034-6527.00319.abstractZh: 该课程为学生攻读商业与法律领域的研究生学位以及经济学或公共政策领域的研究生学位做准备，从而能够从事经济学领域的教学与研究工作；同时，它也是进入商业、非营利组织、金融及政府机构工作的直接途径。

abstract.text: The Ramsey model of fiscal policy implies that taxes should be smooth in the sense of having small variances. In contrast, empirical labour tax processes are smooth in the sense of being random walks; they provide prima facie evidence for incomplete government insurance. This paper considers whether private government information might lie behind such incomplete insurance. It shows that optimal incentive compatible policies exhibit limited use of state contingent debt and greater persistence in taxes and debt, and it argues that they are better approximations to empirical fiscal policies than those implied by the Ramsey model. The paper also establishes that optimal incentive compatible allocations converge to allocations such that the government's incentive compatibility constraint no longer binds. Generally, these limiting allocations are ones in which the government is maximally indebted. Their credibility and the interaction of incentive compatibility and credibility is briefly discussed.

10.1111/0034-6527.00320.abstractZh: 拉姆齐的财政政策模型认为，税收应当具有平稳性，即方差较小。相比之下，实际的劳动税过程表现为随机游走，这为政府保险的不完全性提供了初步证据。本文探讨了私人政府信息是否可能掩盖这种不完全性。研究表明，最优的激励相容政策在利用国家债务方面较为有限，且税收和债务的持续性更强。这些政策比拉姆齐模型所暗示的政策更接近于实际财政政策。此外，本文还指出，最优的激励相容分配最终会收敛到一种状态，即政府的激励相容约束不再起作用。通常，这些极限分配意味着政府负债达到最大。文章还简要讨论了这些分配的可信度，以及激励相容性与可信度之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the importance of network effects in the market for Yellow Pages. I estimate three simultaneous equations: consumer demand for usage of a directory, advertiser demand for advertising and a publisher's first-order condition (derived from profit-maximizing behaviour). Estimation shows that advertisers value consumer usage and that consumers value advertising, implying a network effect. I find that internalizing network effects would significantly increase surplus. As an application, I consider whether the market benefits from monopoly (which takes advantage of network effects) or oligopoly (which reduces market power). I find that a more competitive market is preferable.

10.1111/0034-6527.00512.abstractZh: 本文估计了网络效应在黄色目录市场中的重要性。我建立了三个同时方程模型：消费者对目录使用的需求、广告商对广告的需求，以及基于利润最大化行为的出版商的一阶条件。估计结果显示，广告商重视消费者的使用行为，而消费者则重视广告，这表明存在网络效应。我发现，将网络效应内部化会显著增加市场剩余。作为应用研究，我探讨了市场是否应受益于垄断（利用网络效应）还是寡头垄断（降低市场力量）。我的结论是，更具竞争性的市场更为理想。

abstract.text: This paper uses an empirical dynamic oligopoly model of the commercial aircraft industry to analyse industry pricing, industry performance, and optimal industry policy. A novel feature of the model with respect to the previous literature is that entry, exit, prices, and quantities are endogenously determined in Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE). We find that many unusual aspects of the aircraft data, such as high concentration and persistent pricing below static marginal cost, are explained by this model. We also find that the unconstrained MPE is quite efficient from a social perspective, providing only 10% less welfare on average than a social planner would obtain. Finally, we provide simulation evidence that an anti-trust policy in the form of a concentration restriction would be welfare reducing.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00297.x.abstractZh: 本文采用实证动态寡头垄断模型来分析商业航空业的定价、行业绩效以及最优行业政策。该模型与以往文献相比的一个新颖之处在于，进入、退出、价格和数量都是在马尔可夫完美均衡中内生决定的。我们发现，飞机行业的许多不寻常现象，如高度集中以及持续低于静态边际成本的定价，都可以用该模型来解释。此外，我们进一步发现，无约束的马尔可夫完美均衡从社会角度来看相当高效，其带来的福利损失平均仅比社会规划者所能获得的福利少10%。最后，我们通过模拟实验表明，以限制集中度形式的反垄断政策实际上会降低福利水平。

abstract.text: We provide an asymptotic distribution theory for a class of generalized method of moments estimators that arise in the study of differentiated product markets when the number of observations is associated with the number of products within a given market. We allow for three sources of error: sampling error in estimating market shares, simulation error in approximating the shares predicted by the model, and the underlying model error. It is shown that the estimators are CAN provided the size of the consumer sample and the number of simulation draws grow at a large enough rate relative to the number of products. We consider the implications of the results for the Berry, Levinsohn and Pakes (1995) random coefficient logit model and the pure characteristics model analysed in Berry and Pakes (2002). The required rates differ for these two frequently used demand models. A small Monte Carlo study shows that the differences in asymptotic properties of the two models are reflected, in quite a striking way, in the models' small sample properties. Moreover the limit distributions provide a good approximation to the actual Monte Carlo distribution of the parameter estimates. The results have important implications for the computational burden of the two models.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00298.x.abstractZh: 我们为一类在差异化产品市场研究中出现的广义矩估计量提供了渐近分布理论，这些研究涉及观测数量与特定市场内产品数量之间的关系。我们考虑了三种误差来源：估计市场份额时的抽样误差、模拟估计模型预测份额时的模拟误差，以及模型本身的误差。研究表明，只要消费者样本的大小和模拟抽样的次数以足够快的速度增长，相对于产品数量而言，这些估计量能够满足CAN的要求。我们考虑了这些结果对Berry、Levinsohn和Pakes（1995）提出的随机系数Logit模型以及Berry和Pakes（2002）分析的纯特征模型的影响。这两种常用需求模型所需的增长率有所不同。一项小型蒙特卡洛研究表明，这两种模型在渐近性质上的差异在模型的小样本性质中得到了相当显著的体现。此外，极限分布能够很好地近似实际蒙特卡洛分布中的参数估计值。这些结果对这两种模型的计算负担具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper develops and implements semiparametric methods for estimating binary response (binary choice) models with continuous endogenous regressors. It extends existing results on semiparametric estimation in single-index binary response models to the case of endogenous regressors. It develops a control function approach to account for endogeneity in triangular and fully simultaneous binary response models. The proposed estimation method is applied to estimate the income effect in a labour market participation problem using a large micro data-set from the British Family Expenditure Survey. The semiparametric estimator is found to perform well, detecting a significant attenuation bias. The proposed estimator is contrasted to the corresponding probit and linear probability specifications.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00299.x.abstractZh: 本文开发并实施了用于估计具有连续内生回归变量的二元响应（二元选择）模型的半参数方法。它将现有的关于单指标二元响应模型半参数估计的结果扩展到包含内生回归变量的情形。文中提出了一种控制函数方法，以处理三角模型和完全同时二元响应模型中的内生性问题。所提出的估计方法被应用于利用英国家庭支出调查中的大型微观数据集来估计劳动力市场参与问题中的收入效应。研究发现，该半参数估计方法表现良好，能够显著减少偏差。所提出的估计方法与相应的Probit模型和线性概率模型进行了对比。

abstract.text: We study optimal enforcement in credit markets in which the only threat facing a defaulting borrower is restricted access to financial markets. We solve for the optimal level of exclusion, and link it to observed institutional arrangements. Regulation in this environment must accomplish two objectives. First, it must prevent borrowers from defaulting on one bank and transferring their resources to another bank. Second, and less obviously, it must give banks the incentive to make sizeable loans, and to honour their promises of future credit. We establish that the optimal regulation resembles observed laws governing default on debt. Moreover, if debtors have the right to a “fresh start” after bankruptcy then this must be balanced by enforceable provisions against fraudulent conveyance. Our optimal regulation is robust, in that it can be implemented in a way that does not require the regulator to have information about either the borrower or lender. Our results isolate the way in which specific institutions surrounding bankruptcy—namely rules governing asset garnishment and fraudulent conveyances—support loan markets in which borrowers have no collateral.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00300.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了信用市场中的最优监管问题，其中违约借款人面临的唯一威胁是金融市场的受限访问。我们确定了最优的排除程度，并将其与观察到的制度安排联系起来。在这种环境下，监管必须实现两个目标：首先，必须防止借款人从一家银行违约并将资源转移到另一家银行；其次，虽然不那么明显，但必须激励银行发放大额贷款，并履行未来的信用承诺。我们发现，最优的监管措施类似于观察到的关于债务违约的法律。此外，如果债务人有权在破产后获得“重新开始的机会”，那么就必须通过可执行的条款来防止欺诈性转移资产。我们的最优监管方案是稳健的，因为实施该方案不需要监管者了解借款人或贷款人的信息。我们的研究结果揭示了围绕破产的特定制度——即管理资产扣押和欺诈性转移的规则——如何支持那些没有抵押品的借款人的贷款市场。

abstract.text: In this paper we study the evolution of lifetime labour income inequality by constructing present value life cycle measures that incorporate both earnings and employment risk. We find that, even though lifetime income inequality is 40% less than earnings inequality, the total increase in lifetime income inequality over the past 20 years is the same as earnings inequality. While the total increase is the same, the pathways there differ with earnings inequality experiencing a steady increase and lifetime income inequality increasing in spurts particularly in the latter half of the 1990s. Finally, we find the changes in lifetime income inequality are primarily driven by changes in earnings mobility and changes in the earnings distribution itself, changes in employment risk and the composition of the sample, such as the shift toward attaining more education and the ageing population, do not play a large role.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00301.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过构建包含收入与就业风险在内的现值生命周期指标，研究了终身劳动收入不平等的演变。研究发现，尽管终身收入不平等程度比收入不平等低40%，但过去20年中终身收入不平等的总增长与收入不平等相同。虽然总增长幅度一致，但增长路径有所不同：收入不平等呈现稳步上升的趋势，而终身收入不平等在1990年代后半期出现了阶段性增长。最后，我们发现终身收入不平等的变化主要由收入流动性的变化以及收入分布本身的变化所驱动，而就业风险的变化以及样本构成的改变，例如向更高教育水平的转变和人口老龄化，对终身收入不平等的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: Previous work has had difficulty generating household saving behaviour that makes the distribution of wealth much more concentrated than that of labour earnings, and that makes the richest households hold onto large amounts of wealth, even during very old age. I construct a quantitative, general equilibrium, overlapping-generations model in which parents and children are linked by accidental and voluntary bequests and by earnings ability. I show that voluntary bequests can explain the emergence of large estates, while accidental bequests alone cannot, and that adding earnings persistence within families increases wealth concentration even more. I also show that the introduction of a bequest motive generates lifetime savings profiles more consistent with the data.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00302.x.abstractZh: 先前的研究在模拟家庭储蓄行为方面存在困难，这些行为使得财富分配比劳动收入的分配更加集中，并且最富裕的家庭即使在非常年老的时候也能持有大量财富。我构建了一个定量、一般均衡的重叠代际模型，在这个模型中，父母和子女通过偶然的遗赠和自愿的遗赠以及收入能力相互关联。我表明，自愿遗赠可以解释大型遗产的出现，而偶然的遗赠则无法做到这一点；此外，增加家庭内部的收入持久性还会进一步加剧财富集中现象。我还表明，引入遗赠动机可以生成更符合数据特征的终身储蓄模式。

abstract.text: When does an individual's expected wealth accumulation profile increase as earnings risk increases? This paper answers this question for multi-period models where earnings shocks are independent over time. Sufficient conditions are stated in terms of properties of a decision rule for savings and, alternatively, in terms of properties of preferences.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00303.x.abstractZh: 当收益风险增加时，个人的预期财富积累模式何时会发生变化？本文针对多期模型回答了这个问题，其中收益冲击在时间上是独立的。文章从储蓄决策规则的性质出发，提出了充分条件；另外，也从偏好性质的角度提出了充分条件。

abstract.text: This paper examines monopoly power in the market for groundwater (irrigation water extracted by private tubewells), a market characterized by barriers to entry and spatial fragmentation. In Pakistan's Punjab region, groundwater and tenancy contracts are often interlinked, with share-tenants gaining access to water through the use of their landlord's tubewell. An analysis of groundwater transactions shows that tenants of tubewell owners are charged lower prices than other customers. Tubewell owners and their tenants also use considerably more groundwater on their plots than other farmers. Using detailed price and quantity data, the efficiency and distributional implications of this monopoly power are explored.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00304.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了地下水市场中的垄断力量，该市场由私人井抽取灌溉用水构成，具有进入壁垒和空间分散的特点。在巴基斯坦的旁遮普地区，地下水供应与租赁合同常常相互关联，租户通过使用地主的井来获取水源。对地下水交易的分析表明，井主租赁户的用水价格低于其他客户。井主及其租户在各自的土地上使用的地下水量也远高于其他农民。通过详细的价格和数量数据，本文探讨了这种垄断力量的效率及分配影响。

abstract.text: We develop an auction model for the case of interdependent values and multidimensional signals in which agents' signals are correlated. We provide conditions under which a modification of the Vickrey auction which includes payments to the bidders will result in an ex post efficient outcome. Furthermore, we provide a definition of informational size such that the necessary payments to bidders will be arbitrarily small if agents are sufficiently informationally small.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00305.x.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个拍卖模型，用于 interdependent values和 multidimensional signals的情况，其中代理人的信号是相关的。我们提出了一些条件，在这些条件下，对Vickrey拍卖的修改，包括对投标者的支付，将产生事后有效的结果。此外，我们定义了一个信息规模的概念，如果代理人具有足够的信息规模，那么对投标者所需的支付将可以任意小。

abstract.text: I introduce a model of representative democracy with strategic parties, strategic candidates, strategic voters and multiple districts. If policy preferences are similar across districts and not too concentrated within districts, then the number of effective parties is larger under proportional representation (PR) than under plurality, and both electoral systems determine the median voter's preferred policy. However, for more asymmetric distributions of preferences the Duvergerian predictions can be reversed, and the policy outcome with PR is more moderate than the one with plurality. Sincere voting induces more party formation, and strategic voting can be observed more often under PR.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00306.x.abstractZh: 我提出了一个包含战略政党、战略候选人、战略选民和多个选区的代表性民主模型。如果各选区的政策偏好相似且不在同一选区内过于集中，那么在比例代表制下有效政党的数量会比多数制更多，两种选举制度都会决定中位选民偏好的政策。然而，对于偏好分布更加不对称的情况，Duverger的预测结果可能会逆转，比例代表制下的政策结果会比多数制更为温和。真诚投票会促进更多政党的形成，而在比例代表制下，战略投票现象也会更常见。

abstract.text: We analyse a bargaining game in which one party, called the buyer, has the option of choosing the sequence of negotiations with other participants, called sellers. When the sequencing of negotiations is confidential and the sellers' goods are highly complementary, efficient, non-dissipative equilibria exist in which the buyer randomizes over negotiation sequences. In these equilibria, the buyer can obtain higher pay-offs than in pure strategy equilibria or in public negotiations. The degree of sequencing uncertainty that maximizes buyer pay-offs is inversely related to the aggregate bargaining power of the sellers.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00307.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个讨价还价游戏，其中一方被称为买方，可以选择与其他参与者（即卖方）的谈判顺序。当谈判顺序具有保密性且卖方的商品高度互补时，存在一种高效、无耗散的均衡状态，买方可以在这些均衡状态下随机选择谈判顺序。在这种均衡状态下，买方获得的收益比在纯策略均衡或公开谈判中更高。最大化买方收益的谈判顺序不确定性程度与卖方的总体讨价还价能力成反比。

abstract.text: Several recent twin' currency and banking crises were preceded by lending booms during which the banking system financed rapid growth of the nontradable (N) sector by borrowing in foreign currency. They were followed by recessions during which a sharp decline in credit especially hurt the N-sector. This paper presents a model that accounts for these stylized facts. A crucial element is that we model a banking system that is simultaneously subject to two distortions typical of international credit markets: bailout guarantees and the imperfect enforceability of contracts. The interaction of these distortions produces unusually fast N-sector growth, together with a real appreciation, during the boom. However, it is also responsible for self-fulfilling twin crises, which have persistent adverse effects on N-sector output.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2004.00308.x.abstractZh: 最近发生的几次双货币和银行危机，都伴随着借贷繁荣时期，在此期间，银行系统通过借入外币为不可贸易部门提供了快速的资金支持。这些危机之后紧接着是经济衰退，其中信贷的急剧下降尤其对不可贸易部门造成了严重损害。本文提出了一个模型来解释这些典型现象。一个关键点是，我们模拟了一个同时受到国际信贷市场两种典型扭曲影响的银行系统：救助担保以及合同执行的不完善性。这些扭曲相互作用，导致在借贷繁荣期间不可贸易部门的增长异常迅速，同时货币也出现了实际升值。然而，这些扭曲也导致了自我实现的双货币危机，对不可贸易部门的产出产生了持续的负面影响。

abstract.text: Recent theoretical work has shown the importance of measuring microeconomic uncertainty for models of both general and partial equilibrium under imperfect insurance. In this paper the assumption of i.i.d. income innovations used in previous empirical studies is removed and the focus of the analysis is placed on models for the conditional variance of income shocks, which is related to the measure of risk emphasized by the theory. We first discriminate amongst various models of earnings determination that separate income shocks into idiosyncratic transitory and permanent components. We allow for education- and time-specific differences in the stochastic process for earnings and for measurement error. The conditional variance of the income shocks is modelled as a parsimonious ARCH process with both observable and unobserved heterogeneity. The empirical analysis is conducted on data drawn from the 1967–1992 Panel Study of Income Dynamics. We find strong evidence of sizeable ARCH effects as well as evidence of unobserved heterogeneity in the variances.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00476.x.abstractZh: 近期理论研究表明，在不完全保险条件下，衡量微观经济不确定性对于一般均衡和部分均衡模型的重要性。本文摒弃了以往实证研究中采用的独立同分布收入创新的假设，将分析重点放在收入冲击的条件方差上，这一指标与理论所强调的风险度量密切相关。我们首先区分了多种收入决定模型，这些模型将收入冲击分解为特有的暂时性成分和永久性成分。我们还考虑了教育与时间对收入随机过程的影响，以及测量误差的影响。收入冲击的条件方差被建模为一个简约的ARCH过程，其中包含可观测和不可观测的异质性。实证分析基于1967年至1992年的收入动态面板数据，我们发现ARCH效应显著，同时还存在不可观测方差的异质性。

abstract.text: This paper presents a solution to an important econometric problem, namely the root n consistent estimation of nonlinear models with measurement errors in the explanatory variables, when one repeated observation of each mismeasured regressor is available. While a root n consistent estimator has been derived for polynomial specifications (see Hausman, Ichimura, Newey, and Powell (1991)), such an estimator for general nonlinear specifications has so far not been available. Using the additional information provided by the repeated observation, the suggested estimator separates the measurement error from the “true” value of the regressors thanks to a useful property of the Fourier transform: The Fourier transform converts the integral equations that relate the distribution of the unobserved “true” variables to the observed variables measured with error into algebraic equations. The solution to these equations yields enough information to identify arbitrary moments of the “true,” unobserved variables. The value of these moments can then be used to construct any estimator that can be written in terms of moments, including traditional linear and nonlinear least squares estimators, or general extremum estimators. The proposed estimator is shown to admit a representation in terms of an influence function, thus establishing its root n consistency and asymptotic normality. Monte Carlo evidence and an application to Engel curve estimation illustrate the usefulness of this new approach.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00477.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种解决重要计量经济问题的方案，即如何在存在重复观测数据的情况下，对包含测量误差的非线性模型进行根n一致性估计。虽然已经为多项式模型推导出了根n一致性估计量（参见Hausman、Ichimura、Newey和Powell（1991）的研究），但对于一般非线性模型而言，此类估计量尚未得到研究。利用重复观测数据提供的额外信息，所提出的估计量能够通过将测量误差与回归量的“真实”值分离开来，这得益于傅里叶变换的一个有用性质：傅里叶变换将描述未观测到的“真实”变量分布与观测到的有误差变量之间的积分方程转换为代数方程。这些方程的解能够提供足够的信息来识别“真实”未观测变量的任意阶矩。这些矩的值随后可用于构建任何以矩表示的估计量，包括传统的线性和非线性最小二乘估计量，或一般的极值估计量。所提出的估计量被证明可以用影响函数来表示，从而确立了其根n一致性和渐近正态性。蒙特卡洛模拟结果以及其在Engel曲线估计中的应用，证明了这种新方法的实用性。

abstract.text: We analyze bidding behavior in auctions when risk-averse buyers bid for a good whose value is risky. We show that when the risk in the valuations increases, DARA bidders will reduce their bids by more than the appropriate increase in the risk premium. Ceteris paribus, buyers will be better off bidding for a more risky object in first price, second price, and English auctions with affiliated common (interdependent) values. This “precautionary bidding” effect arises because the expected marginal utility of income increases with risk, so buyers are reluctant to bid so highly. We also show that precautionary bidding behavior can make DARA bidders prefer bidding in a common values setting to bidding in a private values one when risk-neutral or CARA bidders would be indifferent. Thus the potential for a “winner's curse” can be a blessing for rational DARA bidders.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00478.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了在拍卖中风险厌恶型买家对价值具有风险性的商品进行出价的行为。研究表明，当估值中的风险增加时，DARA型买家会降低出价，降幅超过风险溢价应有的增加幅度。在其他条件不变的情况下，对于具有相互依赖价值的物品，买家在第一价格、第二价格以及英语拍卖中，选择竞标风险更高的物品会获得更好的收益。这种“预防性出价”效应源于收入的预期边际效用随风险增加而增加，因此买家不愿出过高的价格。我们还发现，预防性出价行为使得DARA型买家更倾向于在共同价值环境下出价，而不是在风险中性或CARA型买家无差别的私有价值环境下出价。因此，对于理性的DARA型买家来说，“赢家诅咒”的潜在影响可能是一种福音。

abstract.text: Preferences exhibit relative consumption effects if a person's satisfaction with their own consumption appears to depend upon how much others are consuming. This paper examines a model of an evolutionary environment in which Nature optimally builds relative consumption effects into preferences in order to compensate for incomplete environmental information.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00479.x.abstractZh: 如果一个人对自己消费行为的满意度似乎取决于其他人的消费水平，那么偏好就会表现出相对消费效应。本文探讨了一个进化环境的模型，在该模型中，自然会优化地将相对消费效应融入偏好之中，以弥补不完整的环境信息所带来的影响。

abstract.text: To study the behavior of agents who are susceptible to temptation in infinite horizon consumption problems under uncertainty, we define and characterize dynamic self-control (DSC) preferences. DSC preferences are recursive and separable. In economies with DSC agents, equilibria exist but may be inefficient; in such equilibria, steady state consumption is independent of initial endowments and increases in self-control. Increasing the preference for commitment while keeping self-control constant increases the equity premium. Removing nonbinding constraints changes equilibrium allocations and prices. Debt contracts can be sustained even if the only feasible punishment for default is the termination of the contract.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00480.x.abstractZh: 为了研究在不确定性下的无限时域消费问题中易受诱惑的代理人的行为，我们定义并描述了动态自我控制（DSC）偏好。DSC偏好具有递归性和可分离性。在具有DSC代理人的经济体系中，存在均衡，但这些均衡可能效率低下；在这种均衡中，稳态消费与初始禀赋无关，并且随着自我控制的增强而增加。在保持自我控制不变的情况下，增加对承诺的偏好会提高股权溢价。去除非强制性约束会改变均衡分配和价格。即使违约的唯一可行惩罚是合同终止，债务合同仍然可以维持。

abstract.text: Intestinal helminths—including hookworm, roundworm, whipworm, and schistosomiasis—infect more than one-quarter of the world's population. Studies in which medical treatment is randomized at the individual level potentially doubly underestimate the benefits of treatment, missing externality benefits to the comparison group from reduced disease transmission, and therefore also underestimating benefits for the treatment group. We evaluate a Kenyan project in which school-based mass treatment with deworming drugs was randomly phased into schools, rather than to individuals, allowing estimation of overall program effects. The program reduced school absenteeism in treatment schools by one-quarter, and was far cheaper than alternative ways of boosting school participation. Deworming substantially improved health and school participation among untreated children in both treatment schools and neighboring schools, and these externalities are large enough to justify fully subsidizing treatment. Yet we do not find evidence that deworming improved academic test scores.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00481.x.abstractZh: 肠道蠕虫——包括钩虫、蛔虫、鞭虫和血吸虫病——影响着全球超过四分之一的人口。在个体层面进行的治疗随机对照研究可能会双重低估治疗的好处，因为研究未能考虑到对照组因疾病传播减少而获得的外部效益，从而也低估了治疗组的好处。我们评估了一个肯尼亚项目，该项目通过在学校范围内随机分配驱虫药物，而非针对个人，从而能够估算整个项目的效果。该项目使治疗学校的缺勤率降低了四分之一，且成本远低于其他提高学校参与度的措施。驱虫治疗显著改善了未接受治疗儿童的健康状况和学校参与度，这些外部效益足以证明完全资助治疗的合理性。然而，我们没有发现驱虫治疗能提升学业成绩的证据。

abstract.text: In an effort to improve the small sample properties of generalized method of mo-ments (GMM) estimators, a number of alternative estimators have been suggested. These include empirical likelihood (EL), continuous updating, and exponential tilt-ing estimators. We show that these estimators share a common structure, being members of a class of generalized empirical likelihood (GEL) estimators. We use this structure to compare their higher order asymptotic properties. We find that GEL has no asymptotic bias due to correlation of the moment functions with their Jacobian, eliminating an important source of bias for GMM in models with endo-geneity. We also find that EL has no asymptotic bias from estimating the optimal weight matrix, eliminating a further important source of bias for GMM in panel data models. We give bias corrected GMM and GEL estimators. We also show that bias corrected EL inherits the higher order property of maximum likelihood, that it is higher order asymptotically efficient relative to the other bias corrected estimators.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00482.x.abstractZh: 为了改善广义矩估计方法的小样本特性，人们提出了多种替代估计方法。这些方法包括经验似然估计、连续更新估计以及指数倾斜估计。我们指出，这些估计方法具有共同的结构，属于广义经验似然估计类。我们利用这一结构来比较它们的高阶渐近特性。研究发现，广义经验似然估计在渐近意义上不存在由于矩函数与其雅可比矩阵相关而产生的偏差，从而消除了具有内生性模型中对广义矩估计的一个重要偏差来源。此外，经验似然估计在估计最优权重矩阵时也不存在渐近偏差，这进一步消除了面板数据模型中广义矩估计的另一个重要偏差来源。我们还提出了带有偏差校正功能的广义矩估计和广义经验似然估计方法。同时，我们发现带有偏差校正的经验似然估计继承了最大似然估计的高阶特性，并且在高阶渐近意义上比其他带有偏差校正功能的估计方法更为高效。

abstract.text: We consider bilateral matching problems where each person views those on the other side of the market as either acceptable or unacceptable: an acceptable mate is preferred to remaining single, and the latter to an unacceptable mate; all acceptable mates are welfare-wise identical. Using randomization, many efficient and fair matching methods define strategyproof revelation mechanisms. Randomly selecting a priority ordering of the participants is a simple example. Equalizing as much as possible the probability of getting an acceptable mate across all participants stands out for its normative and incentives properties: the profile of probabilities is Lorenz dominant, and the revelation mechanism is groupstrategyproof for each side of the market.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00483.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑双边匹配问题，其中每个人都将市场另一边的对象视为可接受的或不可接受的：可接受的伴侣比保持单身更受欢迎，而后者则比不可接受的伴侣更受欢迎；所有可接受的伴侣在福利方面都是相同的。通过随机化，许多高效且公平的匹配方法可以定义策略证明的揭示机制。随机选择参与者的优先级排序就是一个简单的例子。尽可能均衡地让所有参与者获得可接受的伴侣，这一做法因其规范性和激励性质而显得尤为重要：概率分布具有洛伦兹优势，且揭示机制对市场的每一方都是群体策略证明的。

abstract.text: The Amsterdam auction has been used to sell real estate in the Dutch capital for centuries. By awarding a premium to the highest losing bidder, the Amsterdam auction favors weak bidders without having the implementation difficulties of Myerson's (1981) optimal auction. In a series of experiments, we compare the standard first-price and English auctions, the optimal auction, and two variants of the Amsterdam auction. With strongly asymmetric bidders, the second-price Amsterdam auction raises substantially more revenues than standard formats and only slightly less than the optimal auction.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00484.x.abstractZh: 阿姆斯特丹拍卖方式在荷兰首都的房地产交易中已使用数百年。通过向最高出价者支付溢价，阿姆斯特丹拍卖方式能够照顾到出价较低的竞买人，而无需像迈尔森在1981年提出的最优拍卖那样面临实施上的困难。在一系列实验中，我们比较了标准的第一价格拍卖、英国式拍卖、最优拍卖以及阿姆斯特丹拍卖的两种变体。对于出价严重不对称的竞买人来说，第二价格阿姆斯特丹拍卖方式能够比标准格式带来更多的收入，且收入仅略低于最优拍卖。

abstract.text: In this paper we propose a new estimator for a model with one endogenous regressor and many instrumental variables. Our motivation comes from the recent literature on the poor properties of standard instrumental variables estimators when the instrumental variables are weakly correlated with the endogenous regressor. Our proposed estimator puts a random coefficients structure on the relation between the endogenous regressor and the instruments. The variance of the random coefficients is modelled as an unknown parameter. In addition to proposing a new estimator, our analysis yields new insights into the properties of the standard two-stage least squares (TSLS) and limited-information maximum likelihood (LIML) estimators in the case with many weak instruments. We show that in some interesting cases, TSLS and LIML can be approximated by maximizing the random effects likelihood subject to particular constraints. We show that statistics based on comparisons of the unconstrained estimates of these parameters to the implicit TSLS and LIML restrictions can be used to identify settings when standard large sample approximations to the distributions of TSLS and LIML are likely to perform poorly. We also show that with many weak instruments, LIML confidence intervals are likely to have under-coverage, even though its finite sample distribution is approximately centered at the true value of the parameter. In an application with real data and simulations around this data set, the proposed estimator performs markedly better than TSLS and LIML, both in terms of coverage rate and in terms of risk.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00485.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种针对具有一个内生回归变量和多个工具变量的模型的新估计方法。我们的动机源于近期文献中关于标准工具变量估计方法在工具变量与内生回归变量弱相关时的不良性能。我们提出的估计方法将随机系数结构应用于内生回归变量与工具变量之间的关系，随机系数的方差被建模为一个未知参数。除了提出新的估计方法外，我们的分析还揭示了在存在多个弱工具变量的情况下，标准两阶段最小二乘法和有限信息最大似然估计方法的特性。我们展示了在某些有趣的情况下，可以通过在特定约束条件下最大化随机效应似然来近似TSLS和LIML。我们进一步指出，通过比较这些参数的无约束估计值与隐含的TSLS和LIML约束值，可以识别出标准大样本近似方法在TSLS和LIML分布估计中表现不佳的情况。我们还发现，在存在多个弱工具变量的情况下，LIML的置信区间可能会出现覆盖不足的情况，尽管其有限样本分布大致集中在参数的真实值附近。在基于实际数据及模拟数据的应用中，我们提出的估计方法在覆盖率和风险方面均优于TSLS和LIML。

abstract.text: This paper examines direct broadcast satellites (DBS) as a competitor to cable. We first estimate a structural consumer level demand system for satellite, basic cable, premium cable and local antenna using micro data on almost 30000 households in 317 markets, including extensive controls for unobserved product quality and allowing the distribution of unobserved tastes to follow a fully flexible multivariate normal distribution. The estimated elasticity of expanded basic is about -15, with the demand for premium cable and DBS more elastic. The results identify strong correlations in the taste for different products not captured in conventional logit models. Estimates of the supply response of cable suggest that without DBS entry cable prices would be about 15 percent higher and cable quality would fall. We find a welfare gain of between $127 and $190 per year (aggregate $2.5 billion) for satellite buyers, and about $50 (aggregate $3 billion) for cable subscribers.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00494.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了直接广播卫星作为有线电视竞争对手的作用。我们首先利用来自317个市场的近30,000户家庭的微观数据，估计了卫星、基础有线电视、高级有线电视和本地天线在消费者层面的需求系统。在控制未观测到的产品质量因素后，未观测到的偏好分布遵循完全灵活的多元正态分布。估计结果显示，基础有线电视的弹性约为-15，而高级有线电视和直接广播卫星的弹性更高。研究结果揭示了不同产品偏好之间的强相关性，这些关系在传统逻辑斯蒂模型中并未被充分考虑。对有线电视供应反应的估计表明，如果没有直接广播卫星的进入，有线电视价格将高出约15%，同时有线电视的质量也会下降。我们估计，卫星用户每年将获得127至190美元的福利收益（总计25亿美元），而有线电视用户则能获得约50美元的福利收益（总计30亿美元）。

abstract.text: This paper considers learning rules for environments in which little prior and feedback information is available to the decision maker. Two properties of such learning rules are studied: absolute expediency and monotonicity. Both require that some aspect of the decision maker's performance improves from the current period to the next. The paper provides some necessary, and some sufficient conditions for these properties. It turns out that there is a large variety of learning rules that have the properties. However, all learning rules that have these properties are related to the replicator dynamics of evolutionary game theory. For the case in which there are only two actions, it is shown that one of the absolutely expedient learning rules dominates all others.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00495.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在决策者可获得极少先验信息和反馈信息的情况下适用的学习规则。研究了这类学习规则的两个特性：绝对效率性和单调性。这两个特性都要求决策者的表现从当前时期到下一个时期有所改善。本文提出了这些特性的必要条件和充分条件。结果表明，存在多种具有这些特性的学习规则。然而，所有具有这些特性的学习规则都与进化博弈论中的复制者动态有关。在只有两种行动的情况下，证明了其中一种绝对效率性的学习规则能够支配其他所有规则。

abstract.text: We study the long-run sustainability of reputations in games with imperfect public monitoring. It is impossible to maintain a permanent reputation for playing a strategy that does not play an equilibrium of the game without uncertainty about types. Thus, a player cannot indefinitely sustain a reputation for noncredible behavior in the presence of imperfect monitoring.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00496.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在缺乏公众监督的游戏中，声誉的长期可持续性。如果不对策略的类型进行不确定性分析，那么就无法维持一种策略的永久声誉，因为该策略并不符合游戏的均衡状态。因此，在缺乏监督的情况下，玩家无法无限期地维持一种不可信行为的声誉。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes models of securities markets with a single strategic informed trader and competitive market makers. In one version, uninformed trades arrive as a Brownian motion and market makers see only the order imbalance, as in Kyle (1985). In the other version, uninformed trades arrive as a Poisson process and market makers see individual trades. This is similar to the Glosten–Milgrom (1985) model, except that we allow the informed trader to optimize his times of trading. We show there is an equilibrium in the Glosten–Milgrom-type model in which the informed trader plays a mixed strategy (a point process with stochastic intensity). In this equilibrium, informed and uninformed trades arrive probabilistically, as Glosten and Milgrom assume. We study a sequence of such markets in which uninformed trades become smaller and arrive more frequently, approximating a Brownian motion. We show that the equilibria of the Glosten–Milgrom model converge to the equilibrium of the Kyle model.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00497.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了具有单一策略性知情交易者和竞争性做市商的市场模型。在一个版本中，无信息的交易以布朗运动的方式出现，而做市商仅能看到订单不平衡的情况，类似于Kyle（1985）的研究。在另一个版本中，无信息的交易以泊松过程的方式出现，做市商能够看到单个交易的行为。这一模型与Glosten–Milgrom（1985）的模型类似，但我们允许知情交易者优化其交易时间。我们证明了在Glosten–Milgrom型模型中存在一个均衡状态，其中知情交易者采用混合策略（即具有随机强度的点过程）。在这个均衡状态下，知情交易和无信息交易都以概率方式出现，正如Glosten和Milgrom所假设的那样。我们研究了一系列这样的市场，其中无信息交易的数量逐渐减少，出现频率增加，逐渐趋近于布朗运动。我们证明了Glosten–Milgrom模型的均衡状态会收敛到Kyle模型的均衡状态。

abstract.text: This paper investigates a generalized method of moments (GMM) approach to the estimation of autoregressive roots near unity with panel data and incidental deterministic trends. Such models arise in empirical econometric studies of firm size and in dynamic panel data modeling with weak instruments. The two moment conditions in the GMM approach are obtained by constructing bias corrections to the score functions under OLS and GLS detrending, respectively. It is shown that the moment condition under GLS detrending corresponds to taking the projected score on the Bhattacharya basis, linking the approach to recent work on projected score methods for models with infinite numbers of nuisance parameters (Waterman and Lindsay (1998)). Assuming that the localizing parameter takes a nonpositive value, we establish consistency of the GMM estimator and find its limiting distribution. A notable new finding is that the GMM estimator has convergence rate , slower than , when the true localizing parameter is zero (i.e., when there is a panel unit root) and the deterministic trends in the panel are linear. These results, which rely on boundary point asymptotics, point to the continued difficulty of distinguishing unit roots from local alternatives, even when there is an infinity of additional data.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00498.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一种广义矩估计方法，用于估计具有面板数据及偶然确定性趋势的自回归根的接近单位根的情况。这类模型在关于企业规模的实证计量经济学研究中出现，也出现在具有弱工具的动态面板数据建模中。广义矩估计方法中的两个矩条件是通过在OLS和GLS去趋势条件下对得分函数进行偏差修正而获得的。研究表明，GLS去趋势下的矩条件相当于在Bhattacharya基础上对得分进行投影，这一方法与最近关于具有无限数量干扰参数的模型的投影得分方法的研究相呼应（Waterman和Lindsay，1998年）。假设局部化参数取非正数值，我们证明了广义矩估计量的一致性，并找到了其极限分布。一个值得注意的新发现是，当真实局部化参数为零时（即存在面板单位根），且面板中的确定性趋势为线性时，广义矩估计量的收敛速率比预期的要慢。这些结果依赖于边界点渐近法，表明即使有无限多的额外数据，区分单位根与局部替代方案仍然是一个持续的挑战。

abstract.text: We study strategic voting after weakening the notion of strategy-proofness to Ordinal Bayesian Incentive Compatibility (OBIC). Under OBIC, truth-telling is required to maximize the expected utility of every voter, expected utility being computed with respect to the voter's prior beliefs and under the assumption that everybody else is also telling the truth. We show that for a special type of priors, i.e., the uniform priors, there exists a large class of social choice functions that are OBIC. However, for priors that are generic in the set of independent beliefs, a social choice function is OBIC only if it is dictatorial. This result underlines the robustness of the Gibbard–Satterthwaite Theorem.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00499.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在弱化策略-proof性概念的基础上，基于序数贝叶斯激励相容性（OBIC）的策略性投票问题。在OBIC框架下，为了实现每个选民的期望效用最大化，必须要求所有选民都如实陈述自己的观点，而期望效用是依据选民的先验信念以及假设其他所有人也如实陈述观点来计算的。我们证明了对于某种特殊的先验分布，即均匀先验，存在一大类满足OBIC条件的社会选择函数。然而，对于在独立信念集合中具有普遍性的先验分布，只有当社会选择函数是独裁性的时，它才是OBIC的。这一结果凸显了Gibbard–Satterthwaite定理的稳健性。

abstract.text: Are optimal monetary and fiscal policies time consistent in a monetary economy? Yes, but if and only if under commitment the Friedman rule of setting nominal interest rates to zero is optimal. This result is of applied interest because the Friedman rule is optimal for the standard preferences used in applied work, those consistent with the growth facts.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00500.x.abstractZh: 在货币经济中，最优的货币政策和财政政策是否具有时间一致性？是的，但前提是只有在承诺机制下，将名义利率设定为零的弗里德曼规则才是最优的。这一结果具有实际应用价值，因为对于应用研究中使用的标准偏好，即与增长事实一致的偏好，弗里德曼规则确实是最优的。

abstract.text: The local Whittle (or Gaussian semiparametric) estimator of long range dependence, proposed by Kunsch (1987) and analyzed by Robinson (1995a), has a relatively slow rate of convergence and a finite sample bias that can be large. In this paper, we generalize the local Whittle estimator to circumvent these problems. Instead of approximating the short-run component of the spectrum, phi(lambda), by a constant in a shrinking neighborhood of frequency zero, we approximate its logarithm by a polynomial. This leads to a "local polynomial Whittle" (LPW) estimator. We specify a data-dependent adaptive procedure that adjusts the degree of the polynomial to the smoothness of phi(lambda) at zero and selects the bandwidth.
