The resulting "adaptive LPW" estimator is shown to achieve the optimal rate of convergence, which depends on the smoothness of phi(lambda) at zero, up to a logarithmic factor.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00501.x.abstractZh: Kunsch在1987年提出的局部Whittle（或高斯半参数）长程依赖性估计量，随后由Robinson在1995a年进行了分析。该估计量的收敛速度相对较慢，并且存在较大的样本偏差。在本文中，我们对该局部Whittle估计量进行了推广，以克服这些问题。我们不再用频率零点附近的一个常数来近似频谱的短期成分phi(lambda)，而是用多项式来近似其对数。这就得到了“局部多项式Whittle”（LPW）估计量。我们提出了一种数据依赖的自适应调整方法，该方法会根据phi(lambda)在零点的平滑程度来调整多项式的次数，并选择适当的带宽。结果表明，这种“自适应LPW”估计量能够实现最优的收敛速度，这一速度取决于phi(lambda)在零点的平滑程度，且这一结果仅受到对数因子的影响。

abstract.text: Several experimental studies have provided evidence that suggest indifference curves have a kink around the current endowment level. These results, which clearly contradict closely held economic doctrines, have led some influential commentators to call for an entirely new economic paradigm to displace conventional neoclassical theory—e.g., prospect theory, which invokes psychological effects. This paper pits neoclassical theory against prospect theory by investigating data drawn from more than 375 subjects actively participating in a well-functioning marketplace. The pattern of results suggests that prospect theory adequately organizes behavior among inexperienced consumers, but consumers with intense market experience behave largely in accordance with neoclassical predictions. Moreover, the data are consistent with the notion that consumers learn to overcome the endowment effect in situations beyond specific problems they have previously encountered. This “transference of behavior” across domains has important implications in both a positive and normative sense.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00502.x.abstractZh: 多项实验研究提供了证据，表明无差异曲线在当前的禀赋水平附近存在拐点。这些结果显然与传统的经济理论相悖，因此一些有影响力的评论家呼吁引入全新的经济范式来取代传统的新古典理论——例如，前景理论，它考虑了心理效应。本文通过研究来自375多名积极参与活跃市场的受试者的数据，将新古典理论与前景理论进行了对比。研究结果表明，前景理论能够充分解释缺乏市场经验的消费者的行为，而具有丰富市场经验的消费者则主要遵循新古典理论的预测。此外，数据还表明，消费者能够在超出以往特定问题的情境中学会克服禀赋效应。这种“行为跨领域转移”在积极和规范性方面都具有重要的意义。

abstract.text: We study fairness in economies with one private good and one partially excludable nonrival good. A social ordering function determines for each profile of preferences an ordering of all conceivable allocations. We propose the following Free Lunch Aversion condition: if the private good contributions of two agents consuming the same quantity of the nonrival good have opposite signs, reducing that gap improves social welfare. This condition, combined with the more standard requirements of Unanimous Indifference and Responsiveness, delivers a form of welfare egalitarianism in which an agent's welfare is measured by the quantity of the nonrival good that, consumed at no cost, would leave her indifferent to the bundle she is assigned.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00503.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个包含一种私人商品和一种部分排他性、非竞争性商品的经济中的公平性问题。一个社会排序函数为每个偏好配置确定了所有可能的分配顺序。我们提出了以下“免费午餐厌恶”条件：如果两个代理消费相同数量的非竞争性商品时，他们对私人商品的贡献符号相反，那么缩小这种差异可以提高社会福利。这一条件，结合更标准的“一致无差异”和“响应性”要求，提供了一种福利平等主义形式，其中代理人的福利通过无成本消费的非竞争性商品的数量来衡量，该数量能使她对该分配到的商品组合无差别。

abstract.text: We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the quasi-maximum likelihood estimator in the linear ARCH model. Contrary to the existing literature, we allow the parameters to be in the region where no stationary version of the process exists. This implies that the estimator is always asymptotically normal.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00504.x.abstractZh: 我们证明了线性ARCH模型中拟最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。与现有文献不同，我们允许参数存在于不存在平稳版本的过程的区域中。这意味着该估计量始终具有渐近正态性。

abstract.text: A systems cointegration rank test is proposed that is applicable for vector autoregressive (VAR) processes with a structural shift at unknown time. The structural shift is modeled as a simple shift in the level of the process. It is proposed to estimate the break date first on the basis of a full unrestricted VAR model. Two alternative estimators are considered and their asymptotic properties are derived. In the next step the deterministic part of the process including the shift size is estimated and the series are adjusted by subtracting the estimated deterministic part. A Johansen type test for the cointegrating rank is applied to the adjusted series. The test statistic is shown to have a well-known asymptotic null distribution that does not depend on the break date. The performance of the procedure in small samples is investigated by simulations.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00505.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种适用于具有未知时间结构变化的向量自回归过程的系统协整秩检验。结构变化被建模为过程水平上的简单变化。首先基于完全无限制的自回归模型来估计变化发生的日期。考虑了两种替代估计方法，并推导了它们的渐近性质。接下来，估计包含变化大小的过程的确定性部分，并通过减去估计的确定性部分来调整序列。对调整后的序列应用Johansen型协整秩检验。结果表明，检验统计量具有一个众所周知的渐近零分布，该分布不依赖于变化发生的日期。通过模拟实验研究了该方法在小样本数据中的性能。

abstract.text: The asymptotic refinements attributable to the block bootstrap for time series are not as large as those of the nonparametric iid bootstrap or the parametric bootstrap. One reason is that the independence between the blocks in the block bootstrap sample does not mimic the dependence structure of the original sample. This is the join-point problem. In this paper, we propose a method of solving this problem. The idea is not to alter the block bootstrap. Instead, we alter the original sample statistics to which the block bootstrap is applied. We introduce block statistics that possess join-point features that are similar to those of the block bootstrap versions of these statistics. We refer to the application of the block bootstrap to block statistics as the block–block bootstrap. The asymptotic refinements of the block–block bootstrap are shown to be greater than those obtained with the block bootstrap and close to those obtained with the nonparametric iid bootstrap and parametric bootstrap.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00509.x.abstractZh: 块自助法对时间序列进行的渐近改进并不如非参数独立同分布自助法或参数自助法那样显著。其中一个原因是，块自助法样本中的块之间的独立性并不能完全模拟原始样本中的依赖结构。这就是所谓的“连接点问题”。在本文中，我们提出了一种解决这一问题的方法。我们的思路不是改变块自助法本身，而是改变块自助法所应用于的原始样本统计量。我们引入了具有与块自助法版本类似的连接点特征的块统计量。我们将块自助法应用于块统计量称为块-块自助法。结果表明，块-块自助法的渐近改进程度高于块自助法，并且接近于非参数独立同分布自助法和参数自助法所得到的改进程度。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of credit markets on optimal contracting, when the agent's “interim preference” over upcoming contracts is private information because personal financial decisions affect it via the wealth effect. The main result is a severe loss of incentive provision: equilibrium contracts invariably cause the agent to shirk (i.e., exert minimal effort) if the agent's private financial decision precedes moral hazard contracting. The basic intuition is that committing on another private variable, other than the effort level, exposes the parties to further exploitation of efficient risk-sharing by relaxing the incentive constraint that was binding ex ante, unless the risk-sharing was fully efficient to begin with.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00510.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了信用市场对最优契约的影响，特别是当代理人的“中期偏好”是关于即将到来的契约的私人信息时，因为个人财务决策会通过财富效应对其产生影响。主要结论是激励机制的严重丧失：如果代理人的私人财务决策先于道德风险契约做出，那么均衡契约必然导致代理人采取最低限度的努力。基本直觉是，在承诺另一个私人变量（而非努力水平）的情况下，各方将面临进一步的有效风险分担的剥削，除非风险分担本身就已经是高效的。

abstract.text: We provide evidence that long-term relationships between trading parties emergeendogenously in the absence of third party enforcement of contracts and are associated witha fundamental change in the nature of market interactions. Without third party enforcement,the vast majority of trades are initiated with private offers and the parties share the gains fromtrade equally. Low effort or bad quality is penalized by the termination of the relationship,wielding a powerful effect on contract enforcement. Successful long-term relations exhibitgenerous rent sharing and high effort (quality) from the very beginning of the relationship. Inthe absence of third-party enforcement, markets resemble a collection of bilateral tradingislands rather than a competitive market. If contracts are third party enforceable, rent sharingand long-term relations are absent and the vast majority of trades are initiated with publicoffers. Most trades take place in one-shot transactions and the contracting parties areindifferent with regard to the identity of their trading partner.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00511.x.abstractZh: 我们的研究提供了证据，表明在没有第三方合同执行的情况下，交易双方之间的长期关系会自然形成，并且这种关系与市场互动的本质有着根本性的变化。在没有第三方执行的情况下，绝大多数交易都是基于私人提议发起的，各方平等分享交易收益。低质量或低效率的交易会被终止关系所惩罚，这对合同执行产生了强大的影响。成功的长期关系从一开始就表现出慷慨的租金分享和高质量的交易。在没有第三方执行的情况下，市场更像是一系列双边交易岛屿，而不是竞争性的市场。如果合同可以由第三方执行，那么租金分享和长期关系就会消失，绝大多数交易都是基于公开提议发起的。大多数交易都是一次性完成的，交易各方对其交易伙伴的身份并不关心。

abstract.text: Different people may use different strategies, or decision rules, when solving complex decision problems. We provide a new Bayesian procedure for drawing inferences about the nature and number of decision rules present in a population, and use it to analyze the behaviors of laboratory subjects confronted with a difficult dynamic stochastic decision problem. Subjects practiced before playing for money. Based on money round decisions, our procedure classifies subjects into three types, which we label “Near Rational,”“Fatalist,” and “Confused.” There is clear evidence of continuity in subjects' behaviors between the practice and money rounds: types who performed best in practice also tended to perform best when playing for money. However, the agreement between practice and money play is far from perfect. The divergences appear to be well explained by a combination of type switching (due to learning and/or increased effort in money play) and errors in our probabilistic type assignments.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00512.x.abstractZh: 不同的人在解决复杂的决策问题时，可能会采用不同的策略或决策规则。我们提出了一种新的贝叶斯方法，用于推断人群中存在的决策规则的类型和数量，并运用该方法分析实验室受试者在面对复杂的动态随机决策问题时的行为。受试者在进行金钱游戏之前进行了练习。根据金钱游戏中的决策结果，我们的方法将受试者分为三类：接近理性型、宿命论型以及困惑型。在练习和金钱游戏之间，受试者的行为表现出明显的连续性：在练习中表现最好的受试者，在金钱游戏中的表现也往往最好。然而，练习与金钱游戏之间的表现一致性远非完美。这种差异似乎可以通过类型转换（由于学习和/或金钱游戏中的努力增加）以及概率类型分配的错误来解释。

abstract.text: We investigate two-player infinitely repeated games where the discount factor is less than but close to unity. Monitoring is private and players cannot communicate. We require no condition concerning the accuracy of players' monitoring technology. We show the folk theorem for the prisoners' dilemma with conditional independence. We also investigate more general games where players' private signals are correlated only through an unobservable macro shock. We show that efficiency is sustainable for generic private signal structures when the size of the set of private signals is sufficiently large. Finally, we show that cartel collusion is sustainable in price-setting duopoly.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00513.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了两名玩家参与的无限重复博弈，其中折扣因子小于1但接近1。监控行为是私密的，玩家之间无法沟通。我们对玩家监控技术的准确性没有要求。我们证明了在条件独立的情况下，囚徒困境的民间定理。我们还研究了更一般的博弈，其中玩家的私人信号仅通过不可观测的宏观冲击相互关联。我们表明，当私人信号集合的大小足够大时，对于一般的私人信号结构，效率是可持续的。最后，我们证明了在价格设定的双头垄断中，卡特尔勾结是可持续的。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of financial market globalization on the inequality of nations. The world economy consists of inherently identical countries, which differ only in their levels of capital stock. Each country is represented by the standard overlapping generations model, modified only to incorporate credit market imperfection. An integration of financial markets affects the set of stable steady states, as it changes the balance between the equalizing force of the diminishing returns technology and the unequalizing force of the wealth-dependent borrowing constraint. The model is tractable enough to allow for a complete characterization of the stable steady states. In the absence of the international financial market, the world economy has a unique steady state, which is symmetric and stable. In the presence of the international financial market, symmetry-breaking occurs under some conditions. That is, the symmetric steady state loses its stability and stable asymmetric steady states come to exist. In the stable asymmetric steady states, the world economy is endogenously divided into the rich and poor countries; the borrowing constraints are binding in the poor but not in the rich; the world output is smaller, the rich are richer and the poor are poorer in any of the stable asymmetric steady states than in the (unstable) symmetric steady state.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00514.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了金融市场全球化对各国不平等现象的影响。世界经济由本质上相同的国家组成，这些国家仅在资本存量方面存在差异。每个国家都通过标准重叠世代模型来表示，该模型仅通过纳入信贷市场的不完善性进行了修改。金融市场的整合会影响稳定稳态的构成，因为它改变了递减收益技术的均衡力量与财富依赖型借贷约束的不均衡力量之间的平衡。该模型足够易于处理，可以完全描述稳定稳态。在没有国际金融市场的情况下，世界经济具有一个独特的稳态，这种稳态是对称且稳定的。在存在国际金融市场的情况下，在某些条件下会发生对称性破坏。也就是说，对称稳态会失去稳定性，而稳定的非对称稳态开始存在。在稳定的非对称稳态中，世界经济会内生性地划分为富裕国家和贫穷国家；借贷约束在贫穷国家中起作用，但在富裕国家中不起作用；在任何稳定的非对称稳态中，世界产出较小，富裕国家更富裕，而贫穷国家则更贫穷，与（不稳定的）对称稳态相比。

abstract.text: This paper analyses multivariate high frequency financial data using realized covariation. We provide a new asymptotic distribution theory for standard methods such as regression, correlation analysis, and covariance. It will be based on a fixed interval of time (e.g., a day or week), allowing the number of high frequency returns during this period to go to infinity. Our analysis allows us to study how high frequency correlations, regressions, and covariances change through time. In particular we provide confidence intervals for each of these quantities.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00515.x.abstractZh: 本文利用实现协变方法分析了多变量高频金融数据。我们为回归分析、相关分析和协方差分析等标准方法提供了一种新的渐近分布理论。该理论基于固定的时间间隔（例如，一天或一周），使得该时间段内的高频回报数量可以无限增加。我们的分析使我们能够研究高频相关性、回归和协方差随时间的变化情况。特别地，我们为这些量提供了置信区间。

abstract.text: An asymmetric information model of a finite horizon “nth order” rational asset price bubble is presented, where (all agents know that)n the asset is worthless. Also, the model has only two agents, so the first order version of the bubble is simpler than other first order bubbles in the literature.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00516.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个有限时间范围内“n阶”理性资产价格泡沫的非对称信息模型，在该模型中，所有代理人都知道该资产毫无价值。此外，该模型仅包含两个代理人，因此该泡沫模型比其他文献中的一阶泡沫模型更为简单。

abstract.text: A new class of autocorrelation robust test statistics is introduced. The class of tests generalizes the Kiefer, Vogelsang, and Bunzel (2000) test in a manner analogous to Anderson and Darling's (1952) generalization of the Cramér–von Mises goodness of fit test. In a Gaussian location model, the error in rejection probability of the new tests is found to be O(T-1logT), where T denotes the sample size.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00517.x.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种新的自相关稳健检验统计量。这类检验在某种程度上推广了Kiefer、Vogelsang和Bunzel在2000年提出的检验方法，类似于Anderson和Darling在1952年对Cramér–von Mises拟合优度检验的推广。在高斯定位模型中，新检验的拒绝概率误差被证明为O(T-1logT)，其中T表示样本大小。

abstract.text: The purpose of this note is to show how semiparametric estimators with a small bias property can be constructed. The small bias property (SBP) of a semiparametric estimator is that its bias converges to zero faster than the pointwise and integrated bias of the nonparametric estimator on which it is based. We show that semiparametric estimators based on twicing kernels have the SBP. We also show that semiparametric estimators where nonparametric kernel estimation does not affect the asymptotic variance have the SBP. In addition we discuss an interpretation of series and sieve estimators as idempotent transformations of the empirical distribution that helps explain the known result that they lead to the SBP. In Monte Carlo experiments we find that estimators with the SBP have mean-square error that is smaller and less sensitive to bandwidth than those that do not have the SBP.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00518.x.abstractZh: 本文的目的是展示如何构造具有小偏差性质的半参数估计量。半参数估计量的小偏差性质是指其偏差收敛速度比基于非参数估计量的点态和积分偏差更快，趋近于零。我们证明了基于双核的半参数估计量具有小偏差性质。此外，我们还证明了那些非参数核估计不影响渐近方差的半参数估计量也具有小偏差性质。我们还讨论了将序列估计和筛选估计视为经验分布的幂等变换的解释，这有助于解释已知结果，即这些估计量会导致小偏差性质。在蒙特卡洛实验中，我们发现具有小偏差性质的估计量的均方误差更小，且对带宽的敏感性也更低。

abstract.text: We examine the problem of measuring influence based on the information contained in the data on the communications between scholarly publications, judicial decisions, patents, web pages, and other entities. The measurement of influence is useful to address several empirical questions such as reputation, prestige, aspects of the diffusion of knowledge, the markets for scientists and scientific publications, the dynamics of innovation, ranking algorithms of search engines in the World Wide Web, and others. In this paper we ask why any given methodology is reasonable and informative applying the axiomatic method. We find that a unique ranking method can be characterized by means of five axioms: Anonymity, invariance to citation intensity, weak homogeneity, weak consistency, and invariance to splitting of journals. This method is easily implementable and turns out to be different from those regularly used in social and natural sciences, arts and humanities, and computer science.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00519.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于学术出版物、司法判决、专利、网页及其他实体之间的通信数据来衡量影响力的问题。这种影响力的衡量方法对于解答多个实证问题非常有用，例如声誉、声望、知识传播的各个方面、科学家与科学出版物的市场、创新的动态、万维网中搜索引擎的排名算法等。在本文中，我们探讨了为何某种方法能够合理地提供信息，并采用了公理化的方法来研究这一问题。我们发现，一种独特的排名方法可以通过五个公理来表征：匿名性、对引用强度的不变性、弱同质性、弱一致性以及对期刊分割的不变性。这种方法易于实施，并且与社会科学、自然科学、艺术与人文科学以及计算机科学中常用的方法有所不同。

abstract.text: A complex financial system comprises both financial markets and financial intermediaries. We distinguish financial intermediaries according to whether they issue complete contingent contracts or incomplete contracts. Intermediaries such as banks that issue incomplete con-tracts, e.g., demand deposits, are subject to runs, but this does not imply a market failure. A sophisticated financial system–a system with complete markets for aggregate risk and limited market participation–is incentive-efficient, if the intermediaries issue complete con-tingent contracts, or else constrained-efficient, if they issue incomplete contracts. We argue that there may be a role for regulating liquidity provision in an economy in which markets for aggregate risks are incomplete. 1 Markets, intermediaries and crises For a long time, it has been taken as axiomatic that financial crises are best avoided. We confront this conventional wisdom by showing that, under certain conditions, a laisser-faire financial system achieves the incentive-efficient or constrained-efficient allocation.1 Further-more, constrained efficiency may require financial crises in equilibrium. The assumptions

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00525.x.abstractZh: 复杂的金融系统包括金融市场和金融中介。我们根据金融中介是否发行完整的或有合同或不完整的合同来区分它们。像银行这样发行不完整合同的中介，例如活期存款，可能会面临挤兑，但这并不意味着市场失灵。一个完善的金融系统——一个拥有完整的风险聚合市场且市场参与有限的系统——如果中介发行完整的或有合同，则具有激励效率；如果它们发行不完整的合同，则具有约束效率。我们认为，在风险聚合市场不完整的经济中，对流动性提供进行监管可能是必要的。1 市场、中介与危机长期以来，人们普遍认为避免金融危机是最理想的。我们通过论证在某些条件下，自由放任的金融系统能够实现激励效率或约束效率的分配来反驳这一传统观念。此外，约束效率可能需要在均衡状态下出现金融危机。假设条件

abstract.text: The holdup problem arises when parties negotiate to divide the surplus generated by their relationship specific investments. We study this problem in a dynamic model of bargaining and investment which, unlike the stylized static model, allows the parties to continue to invest until they agree on the terms of trade. The investment dynamics overturns the conventional wisdom dramatically. First, the holdup problem need not entail underinvestment when the parties are sufficiently patient. Second, inefficiencies can arise unambiguously in some cases, but they are not caused by the sharing of surplus per se but rather by a failure of an individual rationality constraint.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00526.x.abstractZh: 当各方就特定投资所产生的收益进行分配时，就会出现“扣留问题”。我们在一个动态的讨价还价和投资模型中研究了这个问题。与传统的静态模型不同，该模型允许各方继续投资，直到他们就交易条件达成一致。投资动态颠覆了传统观念。首先，当各方有足够的耐心时，扣留问题并不一定意味着投资不足。其次，在某些情况下，效率低下是明确存在的，但这些效率问题并非由收益分配本身引起，而是由个体理性约束的失效所导致的。

abstract.text: We establish the existence of pure strategy equilibria in monotone bidding functions in first-price auctions with asymmetric bidders, interdependent values, and affiliated one-dimensional signals. By extending a monotonicity result due to Milgrom and Weber (1982), we show that single crossing can fail only when ties occur at winning bids or when bids are individually irrational. We avoid these problems by considering limits of ever finer finite bid sets such that no two bidders have a common serious bid, and by recalling that single crossing is needed only at individually rational bids. Two examples suggest that our results cannot be extended to multidimensional signals or to second-price auctions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00527.x.abstractZh: 我们证明了在具有不对称投标者、相互依赖的价值以及关联的一维信号的首次报价拍卖中，单调投标函数存在纯策略均衡。通过扩展Milgrom和Weber在1982年提出的单调性结果，我们表明，单一交叉只有在赢得报价时出现平局或投标个别不合理时才会失败。我们通过考虑越来越细的有限投标集合的极限来避免这些问题，这样就不会有两个投标者拥有相同的有效投标。同时，我们指出，单一交叉仅在投标个别合理时才需要。两个例子表明，我们的结果无法扩展到多维信号或二次报价拍卖。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new methodology that makes use of the factor structure of large dimensional panels to understand the nature of non-stationarity in the data. We refer to it as PANIC - a 'Panel Analysis of Non-stationarity in Idiosyncratic and Common components'. PANIC consists of univariate and panel tests with a number of novel features. It can detect whether the nonstationarity is pervasive, or variable-specific, or both. It tests the components of the data instead of the observed series. Inference is therefore more accurate when the components have different orders of integration. PANIC also permits the construction of valid panel tests even when cross-section correlation invalidates pooling of statistics constructed using the observed data. The key to PANIC is consistent estimation of the components even when the regressions are individually spurious. We provide a rigorous theory for estimation and inference. In Monte Carlo simulations, the tests have very good size and power. PANIC is applied to a panel of inflation series.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00528.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的研究方法，该方法利用大型面板数据的因子结构来理解数据中非平稳性的本质。我们将其命名为PANIC——一种“关于异质性和共性成分的非平稳性的面板分析”。PANIC包括单变量检验和面板检验，并具备多项创新特性。它能够判断非平稳性是普遍存在的，还是特定于某些变量，或者两者兼有。PANIC通过检验数据的各个成分而非观测值来进行分析，因此当各成分的积分阶数不同时，推断结果更为准确。即使横截面相关性使得使用观测数据构建的统计量无法合并，PANIC仍然能够构建有效的面板检验。PANIC的关键在于即使在回归结果个别存在虚假值的情况下，也能对各个成分进行一致估计。我们为这种估计和推断方法提供了严格的理论依据。在蒙特卡洛模拟中，这些检验的显著性和功效都表现非常出色。PANIC已应用于一系列通货膨胀数据的面板分析。

abstract.text: In a one principal two-agent model with adverse selection and collusion among agents, we show that delegating to one agent the right to subcontract with the other agent always earns lower profit for the principal compared with centralized contracting. Delegation to an intermediary is also not in the principal’s interest if the agents supply substitutes. It can be beneficial if the agents produce complements and the intermediary is well informed. Earlier versions of this paper have previously been circulated under different

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00529.x.abstractZh: 在一个由一名主体和两名代理人组成的模型中，考虑到逆向选择和代理人之间的勾结问题，我们证明了将与其他代理人进行分包的权利委托给一名代理人，相较于集中式合同，主体获得的利润总是更低。如果代理人提供替代品，那么将分包权委托给中介也不符合主体的利益。但如果代理人生产互补品，且中介具有充分的信息，那么这种委托方式可能是有益的。本文的早期版本曾以不同的标题发表过。

abstract.text: An important objective of empirical research on treatment response is to provide decision makers with information useful in choosing treatments. Manski (2000, 2002, 2003) showed how identification problems generate ambiguity about the identity of optimal treatment choices. This paper studies treatment choice using sample data. I consider a planner who must choose among alternative statistical treatment rules, these being functions that map observed covariates of population members and sample data on treatment response into a treatment allocation. I study the use of risk (Wald, 1950) to evaluate the performance of alternative rules and, more particularly, the minimax-regret criterion to choose a treatment rule. These concepts may also be used to choose a sample design. Wald's development of statistical decision theory directly confronts the problem of finite-sample inference without recourse to the approximations of asymptotic theory. However, it is computationally challenging to implement. The main original work of this paper is to studyimplementation using data from a classical randomized experiment. Analysis of a simple problem of evaluation of an innovation yields a concise description of the set of undominated treatment rules and tractable computation of the minimax-regret rule. Analysis of a more complex problem of treatment choice using covariate information yields computable bounds on the maximum regret of alternative conditionalempirical success rules, and consequent sufficient sample sizes for the beneficial use of covariate information. Numerical findings indicate that prevailing practices in the use of covariate information in treatment choiceare too conservative.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00530.x.abstractZh: 关于治疗反应的经验研究的一个重要目标是为决策者提供有助于选择治疗方案的信息。Manski（2000、2002、2003）揭示了识别问题如何导致对最优治疗方案选择的模糊性。本文使用样本数据研究治疗方案的选择。我考虑了一个必须在不同统计治疗方案之间进行选择的规划者，这些方案是将人群成员的观测协变量和样本数据中的治疗反应映射成治疗分配的函数。我研究了使用风险（Wald，1950）来评估不同方案的性能，并更具体地使用了极小极大遗憾准则来选择治疗方案。这些概念也可以用于选择样本设计。Wald对统计决策理论的发展直接解决了有限样本推断的问题，而无需依赖渐近理论的近似方法。然而，这种方法的实施在计算上具有挑战性。本文的主要创新之处在于使用经典随机实验的数据来研究实施过程。对一个简单的创新评估问题的分析，得出了未被支配治疗方案集合的简洁描述，以及极小极大遗憾规则的可行计算方式。对一个更复杂的基于协变量信息的治疗选择问题的分析，得出了不同条件经验成功规则的最大遗憾的可计算界限，以及利用协变量信息进行有益分析所需的足够样本量。数值结果表明，目前在治疗选择中使用协变量的做法过于保守。

abstract.text: In an environment where trading volume affects security prices and where prices are uncertain when trades are submitted, quasi-arbitrage is the availability of a series of trades that generate infinite expected profits with an infinite Sharpe ratio. We show that when the price impact of trades is permanent and time-independent, only linear price-impact functions rule out quasi-arbitrage and thus support viable market prices. When trades have also a temporary price impact, only the permanent price impact must be linear while the temporary one can be of a more general form. We also extend the analysis to a time-dependent framework.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00531.x.abstractZh: 在交易量影响证券价格且交易提交时价格不确定的环境中，准套利是指能够产生无限预期利润且夏普比率也无限的一系列交易。我们证明，当交易的价格影响是永久性的且时间无关时，只有线性价格影响函数才能排除准套利，从而支持可行的市场价格。当交易还有临时价格影响时，只有永久价格影响必须是线性的，而临时价格影响可以采用更一般的形式。我们还将分析扩展到时间依赖的框架中。

abstract.text: An asymptotically efficient likelihood-based semiparametric estimator is derived for the censored regression (tobit) model, based on a new approach for estimating the density function of the residuals in a partially observed regression. Smoothing the self-consistency equation for the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator of the distribution of the residuals yields an integral equation, which in some cases can be solved explicitly. The resulting estimated density is smooth enough to be used in a practical implementation of the profile likelihood estimator, but is sufficiently close to the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator to allow estimation of the semiparametric efficient score. The parameter estimates obtained by solving the estimated score equations are then asymptotically efficient. A summary of analogous results for truncated regression is also given.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00532.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于似然的渐近有效半参数估计方法，用于被截尾回归（Tobit模型）。该方法基于一种新的估计残差密度函数的方法，适用于部分观测的回归数据。通过对非参数最大似然估计器的自洽方程进行平滑处理，可以得到一个积分方程，在某些情况下可以明确求解。得到的估计密度足够平滑，可以用于实际中的剖面似然估计器的应用，同时该估计值又足够接近非参数最大似然估计值，从而能够估计出半参数有效得分。通过求解这些估计得分方程得到的参数估计值具有渐近有效性。文中还总结了截断回归情况下的类似结果。

abstract.text: Fixed effects estimators of panel models can be severely biased because of the well-known incidental parameters problem. We show that this bias can be reduced by using a panel jackknife or an analytical bias correction motivated by large T. We give bias corrections for averages over the fixed effects, as well as model parameters. We find large bias reductions from using these approaches in examples. We consider asymptotics where T grows with n, as an approximation to the properties of the estimators in econometric applications. We show that if T grows at the same rate as n, the fixed effects estimator is asymptotically biased, so that asymptotic confidence intervals are incorrect, but that they are correct for the panel jackknife. We show T growing faster than n-super-1/3 suffices for correctness of the analytic correction, a property we also conjecture for the jackknife.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00533.x.abstractZh: 面板模型中的固定效应估计量可能会因众所周知的偶然参数问题而产生严重偏差。我们表明，通过使用面板杰克刀法或基于大T值的分析性偏差校正方法，可以减少这种偏差。我们为固定效应的平均值以及模型参数提供了偏差校正方法。通过实例验证，这些方法能够显著减少偏差。我们考虑了T值与n同步增长的渐近情况，以此近似描述估计量在计量经济学应用中的特性。我们指出，如果T的增长速率与n相同，固定效应估计量将具有渐近偏差，从而导致渐近置信区间不准确；而使用面板杰克刀法时，置信区间则是正确的。我们证明，T的增长速率超过n-super-1/3时，分析性校正方法才具有正确性，这一性质我们也为杰克刀法提出了类似的猜想。

abstract.text: This article discusses the history underlying the new literature, describes some of what has been learned thus far, and looks ahead towards making further progress

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00537.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了新文献背后的历史背景，描述了迄今为止所取得的一些研究成果，并展望了未来进一步进展的可能性。

abstract.text: Previous research has shown that under a suitable no-jump condition, the price of a defaultable security is equal to its risk-neutral expected discounted cash flows if a modified discount rate is introduced to account for the possibility of default. Below, we generalize this result by demonstrating that one can always value defaultable claims using expected risk-adjusted discounting provided that the expectation is taken under a slightly modified probability measure. This new probability measure puts zero probability on paths where default occurs prior to the maturity, and is thus only absolutely continuous with respect to the risk-neutral probability measure. After establishing the general result and discussing its relation with the existing literature, we investigate several examples for which the no-jump condition fails. Each example illustrates the power of our general formula by providing simple analytic solutions for the prices of defaultable securities.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00538.x.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，在合适的无跳跃条件下，如果引入修改后的折现率来考虑违约的可能性，那么违约证券的价格等于其风险中性预期折现现金流。在下文中，我们通过证明只要在略微修改的概率度量下进行计算，就可以使用预期风险调整折现法来评估违约索赔的价值，从而将这一结果推广到一般情况。这种新的概率度量在违约发生在到期之前的情况下赋予零概率，因此仅与风险中性概率度量绝对连续。在确立了这一一般结果并讨论了其与现有文献的关系之后，我们研究了几个违反无跳跃条件的例子。每个例子都展示了我们通用公式的强大功能，为违约证券的价格提供了简单的解析解。

abstract.text: This data set uses political reservations for women in India to study the impact of women's leadership on policy decisions. Using a dataset we collected on 265 village councils in West Bengal and Rajasthan, we compare the type of public goods provided in reserved and unreserved village's councils. Data sets based upon information provided by GP Pradhans, local villagers, and the 1991 Indian Census.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00539.x.abstractZh: 该数据集利用印度对女性的政治保留政策来研究女性领导力对政策决策的影响。我们基于西孟加拉邦和拉贾斯坦邦的265个村议会收集的数据，比较了保留政策和未保留政策下村议会所提供的公共产品类型。数据来源于GP普拉丹、当地村民以及1991年印度人口普查提供的信息。

abstract.text: We study inference in structural models with a jump in the conditional density, where location and size of the jump are described by regression curves. Two prominent examples are auction models, where the bid density jumps from zero to a positive value at the lowest cost, and equilibrium job-search models, where the wage density jumps from one positive level to another at the reservation wage. General inference in such models remained a long-standing, unresolved problem, primarily due to nonregularities and computational difficulties caused by discontinuous likelihood functions. This paper develops likelihood-based estimation and inference methods for these models, focusing on optimal (Bayes) and maximum likelihood procedures. We derive convergence rates and distribution theory, and develop Bayes and Wald inference. We show that Bayes estimators and confidence intervals are attractive both theoretically and computationally, and that Bayes confidence intervals, based on posterior quantiles, provide a valid large sample inference method.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00540.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在条件密度中存在跳跃的结构模型中的推断问题，其中跳跃的位置和大小由回归曲线描述。两个典型的例子是拍卖模型，其中出价密度在最低成本时从零跳跃到正值；以及均衡求职模型，其中工资密度在保留工资处从一个正值跳跃到另一个正值。这类模型中的一般推断问题一直是一个长期未解决的问题，主要是由于非规律性以及由不连续似然函数引起的计算困难。本文为这些模型开发了基于似然的估计和推断方法，重点研究了最优（贝叶斯）和最大似然方法。我们推导了收敛速率和分布理论，并开发了贝叶斯和Wald推断方法。我们表明，贝叶斯估计量和置信区间在理论和计算上都具有吸引力，而基于后验分位数的贝叶斯置信区间提供了一种有效的大样本推断方法。

abstract.text: GARCH models are commonly used as latent processes in econometrics, financial economics, and macroeconomics. Yet no exact likelihood analysis of these models has been provided so far. In this paper we outline the issues and suggest a Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm which allows the calculation of a classical estimator via the simulated EM algorithm or a Bayesian solution in O(T) computational operations, where T denotes the sample size.We assess the performance of our proposed algorithm in the context of both artificial examples and an empirical application to 26UK sectorial stock returns, and compare it to existing approximate solutions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00541.x.abstractZh: GARCH模型在计量经济学、金融经济学和宏观经济学中常被用作潜在过程。然而，迄今为止尚未有针对这些模型的精确似然分析。本文概述了相关问题，并提出了一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法，该算法能够通过模拟EM算法或贝叶斯方法，在O(T)的计算时间内计算出经典估计量，其中T表示样本大小。我们评估了所提出算法的性能，包括使用人工示例和26个英国行业股票回报数据的实证应用，并将其与现有的近似解决方案进行了比较。

abstract.text: Wavelet analysis is a new mathematical method developed as a unified field of science over the last decade or so. As a spatially adaptive analytic tool, wavelets are useful for capturing serial correlation where the spectrum has peaks or kinks, as can arise from persistent dependence, seasonality, and other kinds of periodicity. This paper proposes a new class of generally applicable wavelet-based tests for serial correlation of unknown form in the estimated residuals of a panel regression model, where error components can be one-way or two-way, individual and time effects can be fixed or random, and regressors may contain lagged dependent variables or deterministic/stochastic trending variables. Our tests are applicable to unbalanced heterogenous panel data. They have a convenient null limit N(0,1) distribution. No formulation of an alternative model is required, and our tests are consistent against serial correlation of unknown form even in the presence of substantial inhomogeneity in serial correlation across individuals. This is in contrast to existing serial correlation tests for panel models, which ignore inhomogeneity in serial correlation across individuals by assuming a common alternative, and thus have no power against the alternatives where the average of serial correlations among individuals is close to zero. We propose and justify a data-driven method to choose the smoothing parameter—the finest scale in wavelet spectral estimation, making the tests completely operational in practice. The data-driven finest scale automatically converges to zero under the null hypothesis of no serial correlation and diverges to infinity as the sample size increases under the alternative, ensuring the consistency of our tests. Simulation shows that our tests perform well in small and finite samples relative to some existing tests.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00542.x.abstractZh: 小波分析是一种新的数学方法，在过去十年左右的时间里发展成为一门统一的科学领域。作为一种空间自适应分析工具，小波分析对于捕捉具有峰点或突变点的序列相关性非常有用，这种情况可能由持续性依赖、季节性变化以及其他类型的周期性现象引起。本文提出了一种新的基于小波分析的序列相关性检验方法，适用于面板回归模型中未知形式的序列相关性检验。在面板回归模型中，误差成分可以是单向的或双向的，个体效应可以是固定的或随机的，回归变量可能包含滞后依赖变量或确定性/随机趋势变量。我们的检验方法适用于不平衡的异质面板数据，并且具有方便的零假设分布N(0,1)。无需构建替代模型，我们的检验方法即使在个体间序列相关性存在显著不均匀性的情况下，也能有效识别未知形式的序列相关性。这与现有的面板模型序列相关性检验不同，后者通过假设一个共同的替代模型来忽略个体间序列相关性的不均匀性，因此无法有效识别个体间序列相关性的平均水平接近零的情况。我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法来选择平滑参数——即小波谱估计中最细的尺度，使得检验方法在实践中的应用更加便捷。在零假设下，数据驱动的最细尺度会自动收敛到零；而在替代假设下，随着样本量的增加，该尺度会发散到无穷大，从而确保我们的检验方法的一致性。仿真结果表明，与一些现有的测试方法相比，我们的测试方法在小型和有限样本情况下表现良好。

abstract.text: An extension of Condorcet's paradox by McGarvey (1953) asserts that for every asymmetric relation R on a finite set of candidates there is a strict-preferences voter profile that has the relation R as its strict simple majority relation. We prove that McGarvey's theorem can be extended to arbitrary neutral monotone social welfare functions which can be described by a strong simple game G if the voting power of each individual, measured by the it Shapley-Shubik power index, is sufficiently small. Our proof is based on an extension to another classic result concerning the majority rule. Condorcet studied an election between two candidates in which the voters' choices are random and independent and the probability of a voter choosing the first candidate is p > 1/2. Condorcet's Jury Theorem asserts that if the number of voters tends to infinity then the probability that the first candidate will be elected tends to one. We prove that this assertion extends to a sequence of arbitrary monotone strong simple games if and only if the maximum voting power for all individuals tends to zero.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00543.x.abstractZh: McGarvey在1953年对Condorcet悖论进行了扩展，指出对于有限候选人集合上的每一个不对称关系R，都存在一个严格偏好选民配置，使得关系R成为其严格简单多数关系。我们证明了，如果每个个体通过Shapley-Shubik权力指数衡量的投票权足够小，那么McGarvey的定理可以扩展到任意的中性单调社会福利函数，这些函数可以通过强简单博弈G来描述。我们的证明基于另一个关于多数规则的经典结果的扩展。Condorcet研究了一种两位候选人之间的选举，其中选民的选择是随机且独立的，且选民选择第一位候选人的概率p大于1/2。Condorcet的陪审团定理指出，如果选民数量趋于无穷大，那么第一位候选人当选的概率趋于1。我们证明，这一结论可以扩展到任意单调强简单博弈序列，当且仅当所有个体的最大投票权趋于零时才会成立。

abstract.text: The theory of global games has shown that coordination games with multiple equilibria may have a unique equilibrium if certain parameters of the payoff function are private information instead of common knowledge. We report the results of an experiment designed to test the predictions of this theory. Comparing sessions with common and private information, we observe only small differences in behavior. For common information, subjects coordinate on threshold strategies that deviate from the global game solution towards the payoff-dominant equilibrium. For private information, thresholds are closer to the global game solution than for common information. Variations in the payoff function affect behavior as predicted by comparative statics of the global game solution. Predictability of coordination points is about the same for both information conditions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00544.x.abstractZh: 全球博弈理论表明，具有多个均衡的协调博弈，如果收益函数的某些参数属于私人信息而非共同知识，则可能存在一个唯一的均衡。我们报告了一项旨在验证这一理论预测的实验结果。通过比较具有共同信息和私人信息的会话，我们发现行为上的差异很小。对于共同信息的情况，参与者会采用偏离全球博弈解的阈值策略，以追求收益主导的均衡。而对于私人信息的情况，阈值则更接近于全球博弈解。收益函数的变化会影响行为，这与全球博弈解的比较静态分析所预测的相符。两种信息条件下，协调点的可预测性大致相同。

abstract.text: In econometrics, models stated as conditional moment restrictions are typically estimated by means of the generalized method of moments (GMM). The GMM estimation procedure can render inconsistent estimates since the number of arbitrarily chosen instruments is finite. In fact, consistency of the GMM estimators relies on additional assumptions that imply unclear restrictions on the data generating process. This article introduces a new, simple and consistent estimation procedure for these models that is directly based on the definition of the conditional moments. The main feature of our procedure is its simplicity, since its implementation does not require the selection of any user-chosen number, and statistical inference is straightforward since the proposed estimator is asymptotically normal. In addition, we suggest an asymptotically efficient estimator constructed by carrying out one Newton–Raphson step in the direction of the efficient GMM estimator.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00545.x.abstractZh: 在计量经济学中，以条件矩限制形式表述的模型通常通过广义矩方法（GMM）进行估计。然而，由于可选择的工具变量数量是有限的，GMM估计过程可能会导致估计结果不一致。实际上，GMM估计量的一致性依赖于额外的假设，而这些假设对数据生成过程提出了不明确的要求。本文提出了一种新的、简单且一致的估计方法，该方法直接基于条件矩的定义。我们的主要特点是其简单性，因为实施该方法不需要选择任何用户指定的数值，并且由于所提出的估计量具有渐近正态性，统计推断也非常直接。此外，我们还提出了一种渐近高效的估计量，该估计量是通过向高效的GMM估计量方向进行一步牛顿-拉夫森迭代运算而得到的。

abstract.text: Agents' valuations are interdependent if they depend on the signals, or types, of all agents. Under the implicit assumption that agents cannot observe their outcome-decision payoffs, previous literature has shown that with interdependent valuations and independent signals, efficient design is impossible. This paper shows that an efficient mechanism exists in an environment where first the final outcome (e.g., allocation of the goods) is determined, then the agents observe their own outcome-decision payoffs, and then final transfers are made.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00546.x.abstractZh: 如果代理人的估值依赖于所有代理人的信号或类型，那么这些估值就是相互依赖的。在假设代理人无法观察到自己的结果决策收益的隐含假设下，先前的研究表明，在估值相互依赖且信号独立的情况下，无法实现高效的设计。本文表明，在这样一种环境中存在一种高效机制：首先确定最终结果（例如，物品的分配），然后代理人观察到自己的结果决策收益，最后进行最终的转移。

abstract.text: With many semi-anonymous players, the equilibria of simultaneous-move games are extensively robust. This means that the equilibria survive even if the simultaneous-play assumption is relaxed to allow for a large variety of extensive modifications. Such modifications include sequential play with partial and differential revelation of information, commitments, multiple revisions of choices, cheap talk announcements, and more.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00549.x.abstractZh: 在有许多半匿名玩家的情形下，同时行动博弈的均衡是广泛稳健的。这意味着即使同时行动这一假设被放宽，允许进行各种广泛的修改，这些均衡仍然能够保持不变。这些修改包括顺序行动、部分或差异性的信息揭示、承诺、多次选择修正、廉价谈话公告等等。

abstract.text: This paper proposes an asymptotically efficient method for estimating models with conditional moment restrictions. Our estimator generalizes the maximum empirical likelihood estimator (MELE) of Qin and Lawless (1994). Using a kernel smoothing method, we efficiently incorporate the information implied by the conditional moment restrictions into our empirical likelihood-based procedure. This yields a one-step estimator which avoids estimating optimal instruments. Our likelihood ratio-type statistic for parametric restrictions does not require the estimation of variance, and achieves asymptotic pivotalness implicitly. The estimation and testing procedures we propose are normalization invariant. Simulation results suggest that our new estimator works remarkably well in finite samples.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00550.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种渐近高效的方法，用于估计具有条件矩限制模型的参数。我们的估计量是对Qin和Lawless（1994年）提出的最大经验似然估计量的推广。通过采用核平滑方法，我们能够有效地将条件矩限制所蕴含的信息纳入基于经验似然的估计过程中。这种方法无需估计最优工具变量，且得到的似然比统计量无需估计方差，同时实现了渐近枢轴性。我们提出的估计和检验方法具有归一性。仿真结果表明，我们的新估计量在有限样本情况下表现非常出色。

abstract.text: A speaker wishes to persuade a listener to accept a certain request. The conditions under which the request is justified, from the listener's point of view, depend on the values of two aspects. The values of the aspects are known only to the speaker and the listener can check the value of at most one. A mechanism specifies a set of messages that the speaker can send and a rule that determines the listener's response, namely, which aspect he checks and whether he accepts or rejects the speaker's request. We study mechanisms that maximize the probability that the listener accepts the request when it is justified and rejects the request when it is unjustified, given that the speaker maximizes the probability that his request is accepted. We show that a simple optimal mechanism exists and can be found by solving a linear programming problem in which the set of constraints is derived from what we call the L-principle.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00551.x.abstractZh: 一位演讲者希望说服听众接受某个请求。从听众的角度来看，该请求被接受的条件取决于两个方面的价值。这两个方面的价值只有演讲者知道，而听众最多只能验证其中一个方面的价值。一种机制规定了演讲者可以发送的一组信息，以及决定听众反应的规则，即听众会检查哪个方面，并决定是否接受演讲者的请求。我们研究了那些能在保证演讲者请求被接受概率最大化的同时，使听众在请求合理时接受、在请求不合理时拒绝的请求的机制。我们证明，存在一种简单的最优机制，可以通过解决一个线性规划问题来找到，该问题的约束条件源自我们所称的L原则。

abstract.text: We develop the measurement theory of polarization for the case in which income distributions can be described using density functions. The main theorem uniquely characterizes a class of polarization measures that fits into what we call the “identity-alienation” framework, and simultanously satisfies a set of axioms. Second, we provide sample estimators of population polarization indices that can be used to compare polarization across time or entities. Distribution-free statistical inference results are also used in order to ensure that the orderings of polarization across entities are not simply due to sampling noise. An illustration of the use of these tools using data from 21 countries shows that polarization and inequality orderings can often differ in practice.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00552.x.abstractZh: 我们发展了极化度测量理论，适用于可以用密度函数描述收入分布的情况。主定理唯一地描述了一类符合我们所称的“身份-异质”框架的极化度量，并且同时满足一系列公理。其次，我们提供了可用于比较不同时间或实体间极化度的样本估计量。我们还使用了无分布统计推断结果，以确保不同实体间的极化排序并非仅仅由于抽样噪声所致。通过21个国家的数据实例表明，实际上极化度与不平等排序往往存在差异。

abstract.text: We introduce a family of generalized-method-of-moments estimators of the parameters of a continuous-time Markov process observed at random time intervals. The results include strong consistency, asymptotic normality, and a characterization of standard errors. Sampling is at an arrival intensity that is allowed to depend on the underlying Markov process and on the parameter vector to be estimated. We focus on financial applications, including tick-based sampling, allowing for jump diffusions, regime-switching diffusions, and reflected diffusions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00553.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一类广义矩估计量，用于估计在随机时间间隔观测到的连续时间马尔可夫过程的参数。这些估计量具有强一致性、渐近正态性，并且能够给出标准误差的表征。采样过程以某种到达强度进行，该强度可以依赖于 underlying Markov process 以及待估计的参数向量。我们重点关注金融领域的应用，包括基于 tick 的采样、跳跃扩散、制度转换扩散以及反射扩散等情况。

abstract.text: In this paper we investigate methods for testing the existence of a cointegration relationship among the components of a nonstationary fractionally integrated (NFI) vector time series. Our framework generalizes previous studies restricted to unit root integrated processes and permits simultaneous analysis of spurious and cointegrated NFI vectors. We propose a modified F-statistic, based on a particular studentization, which converges weakly under both hypotheses, despite the fact that OLS estimates are only consistent under cointegration. This statistic leads to a Wald-type test of cointegration when combined with a narrow band GLS-type estimate. Our semiparametric methodology allows consistent testing of the spurious regression hypothesis against the alternative of fractional cointegration without prior knowledge on the memory of the original series, their short run properties, the cointegrating vector, or the degree of cointegration. This semiparametric aspect of the modelization does not lead to an asymptotic loss of power, permitting the Wald statistic to diverge faster under the alternative of cointegration than when testing for a hypothesized cointegration vector. In our simulations we show that the method has comparable power to customary procedures under the unit root cointegration setup, and maintains good properties in a general framework where other methods may fail. We illustrate our method testing the cointegration hypothesis of nominal GNP and simple-sum (M1, M2, M3) monetary aggregates.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00554.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了用于检验非平稳分数积分向量时间序列各成分之间是否存在协整关系的方法。我们的框架扩展了以往仅限于单位根积分过程的研究，并允许同时分析虚假回归和协整的NFI向量。我们提出了一种改进的F统计量，该统计量基于特定的学生化方法，在两种假设下都能弱收敛，尽管OLS估计仅在协整情况下才具有一致性。当将这种统计量与窄带GLS型估计结合使用时，可以构成一种Wald型协整检验。我们的半参数方法允许在不事先了解原始序列的记忆特性、短期属性、协整向量或协整程度的情况下，对虚假回归假设进行一致性检验，以及针对分数协整的替代假设进行检验。这种模型的半参数特性不会导致渐近功效的丧失，使得Wald统计量在协整替代假设下比在假设协整向量的情况下更快地发散。在我们的模拟中，我们展示了该方法在单位根协整设置下与常规方法具有相当的功效，并且在其他方法可能失效的一般框架下仍然保持良好的性能。我们通过检验名义GNP和简单总和（M1、M2、M3）货币总量的协整假设来说明我们的方法。

abstract.text: In the last decade a growing body of research has studied inference on partially identified parameters (e.g., Manski, 1990, 2003). In many cases where the parameter of interest is realvalued, the identification region is an interval whose lower and upper bounds may be estimated from sample data. Confidence intervals may be constructed to take account of the sampling variation in estimates of these bounds. Horowitz and Manski (1998, 2000) proposed and applied interval estimates that asymptotically cover the entire identification region with fixed probability. Here we introduce conceptually different interval estimates that asymptotically cover each element in the identification region with fixed probability (but not necessarily every element simultaneously). We show that these two types of interval estimate are different in practice, the latter in general being shorter. The difference in length (in excess of the length of the identification set itself) can be substantial, and in large samples is comparable to the difference of one and twosided confidence intervals. A complication arises from the fact that the simplest version of the proposed interval is discontinuous in the limit case of point identification, leading to coverage rates that are not uniform in important subsets of the parameter space. We develop a modification depending on the width of the identification region that restores uniformity. We show that under some conditions, using the estimated width of the identification region instead of the true width maintains uniformity.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00555.x.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，越来越多的研究关注于对部分识别参数的推断（例如，Manski，1990年，2003年）。在许多情况下，感兴趣的参数是实值的，识别区域是一个区间，其上下界可以从样本数据中估计得出。可以构建置信区间来考虑这些界估计的抽样变异。Horowitz和Manski（1998年，2000年）提出了并应用了区间估计方法，这些方法以固定的概率渐近覆盖整个识别区域。在这里，我们介绍了两种概念上不同的区间估计方法，这两种方法以固定的概率渐近覆盖识别区域中的每个元素（但不一定同时覆盖每个元素）。我们表明，这两种区间估计在实践中是不同的，后者通常更为简洁。长度上的差异（超过识别集本身的长度）可能是相当大的，在大样本中，这种差异与一维和二维置信区间的差异相当。一个复杂的问题是，在点识别的极限情况下，所提出的区间的最简单版本是不连续的，导致在参数空间的重要子集上的覆盖率并不均匀。我们开发了一种根据识别区域宽度进行修改的方法，以恢复均匀性。我们表明，在某些条件下，使用识别区域的估计宽度而不是真实宽度可以保持均匀性。

abstract.text: This paper extends the conditional logit approach (Rasch, Andersen, Chamberlain) used in panel data models of binary variables with correlated fixed effects and strictly exogenous regressors. In a two-period two-state model, necessary and sufficient conditions on the joint distribution function of the individual-and-period specific shocks are given such that the sum of individual binary variables across time is a sufficient statistic for the individual effect. By extending a result of Chamberlain, it is shown that root-n consistent regular estimators can be constructed in panel binary models if and only if the property of sufficiency holds. In applied work, the estimation method amounts to quasi-differencing the binary variables as if they were continuous variables and transforming a panel data model into a cross-section model. Semiparametric approaches can then be readily applied.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00556.x.abstractZh: 本文扩展了条件Logit方法（Rasch、Andersen、Chamberlain）在具有相关固定效应和严格外生回归变量的二元变量面板数据模型中的应用。在一个两期两状态模型中，给出了个体与时期特定冲击的联合分布函数的必要充分条件，使得随时间变化的个体二元变量的总和成为个体效应的充分统计量。通过扩展Chamberlain的研究成果，本文证明了在面板二元模型中，当且仅当满足充分性条件时，可以构造出根-n一致的规则估计量。在应用工作中，该估计方法相当于对二元变量进行准差分，将其视为连续变量，并将面板数据模型转化为横截面模型，从而可以轻松应用半参数方法。

abstract.text: Conditional moment restrictions can be combined through GMM estimation to construct more efficient semiparametric estimators. This paper is about attainable efficiency for such estimators. We define and use a moment tangent set, the directions of departure from the truth allowed by the moments, to characterize when the semiparametric efficiency bound can be attained. The efficiency condition is that the moment tangent set equals the model tangent set. We apply these results to transformed, censored, and truncated regression models, e.g., finding that the conditional moment restrictions from Powell's (1986) censored regression quantile estimators can be combined to approximate efficiency when the disturbance is independent of regressors.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00557.x.abstractZh: 通过GMM估计，可以将条件矩限制条件结合起来，以构建更高效的半参数估计量。本文探讨了此类估计量的可达效率问题。我们定义了一个“矩切线集”，即矩所允许偏离真实情况的方向，以此来表征何时可以达到半参数效率界限。效率条件是指矩切线集等于模型切线集。我们将这些结果应用于变换型、截尾型和截断型回归模型，发现Powell在1986年提出的截尾回归分位数估计量中的条件矩限制条件可以结合起来，从而在干扰因素与回归变量独立的情况下近似实现效率。

abstract.text: This paper investigates asymptotic properties of the maximum likelihood estimator and the quasi-maximum likelihood estimator for the spatial autoregressive model. The rates of convergence of those estimators may depend on some general features of the spatial weights matrix of the model. It is important to make the distinction with different spatial scenarios. Under the scenario that each unit will be influenced by only a few neighboring units, the estimators may have -rate of convergence and be asymptotically normal. When each unit can be influenced by many neighbors, irregularity of the information matrix may occur and various components of the estimators may have different rates of convergence.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00558.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了空间自回归模型中最大似然估计量和准最大似然估计量的渐近性质。这些估计量的收敛速率可能取决于模型空间权重矩阵的一些一般特征。区分不同的空间情景非常重要。在每种情况下，如果每个单元仅受到少数邻近单元的影响，那么估计量可能具有特定的收敛速率，并且是渐近正态的。而当每个单元可能受到许多邻居单元的影响时，信息矩阵可能会出现不规则性，估计量的各个组成部分可能具有不同的收敛速率。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To understand how proximity to safety net clinics and hospitals affects a variety of measures of access to care and service use by uninsured persons. DATA SOURCES: The 1998-1999 Community Tracking Study household survey, administered primarily by telephone survey to households in 60 randomly selected communities, linked to data on community health centers, other free clinics, and safety net hospitals. STUDY DESIGN: Instrumental variable estimation of multivariate regression models of several measures of access to care (having a usual source of care, unmet or delayed medical care needs, ambulatory service use, and overnight hospital stays) against endogenous measures of distances to the nearest community health center and safety net hospital, controlling for characteristics of uninsured persons and other area characteristics that are related to access to care. The models are estimated with data from a nationally representative sample of uninsured people. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Shorter distances to the nearest safety net providers increase access to care for uninsured persons. Failure to account for the endogeneity of distance to safety net providers on access to care generally leads to finding little or no safety net effects on access. CONCLUSIONS: Closer proximity to the safety net increases access to care for uninsured persons. However, the improvements in access to care are relatively small compared with similar measures of access to care for insured persons. Modest expansion of the safety net is unlikely to provide a full substitute for insurance coverage expansions.

10.1111/j.1475-6773.2004.00302.x.abstractZh: 目的：了解与安全网诊所和医院的接近程度如何影响无保险人群在就医服务获取方面的各种指标。数据来源：1998-1999年的社区跟踪研究家庭调查，主要通过电话调查在60个随机选取的社区中对家庭进行访问，并收集了关于社区健康中心、其他免费诊所和安全网医院的数据。研究设计：通过工具变量估计多元回归模型，研究几种就医服务获取指标（如拥有常规就医来源、未满足或延迟的医疗需求、门诊服务使用以及夜间住院情况）与距离最近的社区健康中心和安全网医院的距离之间的关系，同时控制无保险人群的特征以及其他与就医服务获取相关的地区特征。模型使用全国代表性无保险人群样本的数据进行估计。主要发现：距离最近的安全网服务提供者较近能够增加无保险人群的就医服务获取。如果未能考虑安全网服务提供者距离对就医服务获取的影响，通常会导致发现安全网对就医服务获取几乎没有或根本没有影响。结论：接近安全网能够增加无保险人群的就医服务获取。然而，与有保险人群类似的就医服务获取指标相比，无保险人群的就医服务获取改善幅度相对较小。对安全网进行适度扩展不太可能完全替代保险覆盖范围的扩大。

abstract.text: ... this paper we analyze the profit-maximizing contract design of firms if consumers have time-inconsistent preferences and are partially naive about it. We consider markets for two types of goods: goods with immediate costs and delayed benefits (investment goods) such as health club attendance, and goods with immediate benefits and delayed costs (leisure goods) such as credit card-financed consumption. We establish three features of the profit-maximizing contract design with partially naive time-inconsistent consumers. First, firms price investment goods below marginal cost. Second, firms price leisure goods above marginal cost. Third, for all types of goods firms introduce switching costs and charge back-loaded fees. The contractual design targets consumer misperception of future consumption and underestimation of the renewal probability. The predictions of the theory match the empirical contract design in the credit card, gambling, health club, life insurance, mail order, mobile phone, and vacation time-sharing industries. We also show that time inconsistency has adverse effects on consumer welfare only if consumers are naive.

10.1162/0033553041382111.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了在消费者具有时间不一致偏好且部分天真的情况下，企业如何设计能够最大化利润的契约。我们考虑了两种类型的商品市场：具有即时成本与延迟收益的商品（如健身俱乐部的会员服务），以及具有即时收益与延迟成本的商品（如信用卡融资的消费）。我们确定了在部分天真的时间不一致消费者情况下，利润最大化契约设计的三个特点。首先，企业会将投资商品的定价低于边际成本。其次，企业会将休闲商品的定价高于边际成本。第三，对于所有类型的商品，企业都会引入转换成本，并收取滞后收费。这种契约设计旨在利用消费者对未来消费的误解以及他们对续约概率的低估。理论预测与信用卡、赌博、健身俱乐部、人寿保险、邮购、移动电话和度假时间共享等行业中的实际契约设计相符。我们还表明，时间不一致性对消费者福利的负面影响仅存在于消费者部分天真的情况下。

abstract.text: According to official statistics, 20 percent of Uganda's total public expenditure was spent on education in the mid-1990s, most of it on primary education. One of the large public programs was a capitation grant to cover schools' nonwage expenditures. Using panel data from a unique survey of primary schools, we assess the extent to which the grant actually reached the intended end-user (schools). The survey data reveal that during 1991–1995, the schools, on average, received only 13 percent of the grants. Most schools received nothing. The bulk of the school grant was captured by local officials (and politicians). The data also reveal considerable variation in grants received across schools, suggesting that rather than being passive recipients of flows from the government, schools use their bargaining power to secure greater shares of funding. We find that schools in better-off communities managed to claim a higher share of their entitlements. As a result, actual education spending, in contrast to budget allocations, is regressive. Similar surveys in other African countries confirm that Uganda is not a special case.

10.1162/0033553041382120.abstractZh: 根据官方统计，在20世纪90年代中期，乌干达的公共支出中有20%用于教育，其中大部分用于小学教育。其中一个大型公共项目是发放定额补助金，以弥补学校的非工资支出。通过一项针对小学的独特调查所获取的数据，我们评估了这些补助金实际是否到达了预期的使用者——学校。调查数据显示，在1991年至1995年期间，学校平均只收到了补助金金额的13%。大多数学校根本没有收到任何补助。大部分学校补助金被当地官员（以及政客）截留。数据还显示，不同学校之间获得的补助金存在显著差异，这表明学校并非被动接受政府的资金分配，而是利用自身的议价能力争取到更多的资金份额。我们发现，来自富裕社区的学校能够争取到更高的资金份额。因此，实际的教育支出与预算分配相比呈现出递减的趋势。其他非洲国家的类似调查也证实，乌干达并非个例。

abstract.text: We find that international trade has an economically significant and statistically robust positive effect on productivity. Our trade measure is imports plus exports relative to purchasing power parity GDP (real openness), which we argue is preferable on theoretical grounds to the nominal measure conventionally used. We also find a significantly positive aggregate scale effect. Our estimates control for proxies of institutional quality as well as geography and take into account the endogeneity of trade and institutional quality. Our analysis of the channels through which trade and scale affect productivity yields that they work through total factor productivity.

10.1162/0033553041382139.abstractZh: 我们发现，国际贸易对生产率具有显著的经济意义和统计上的稳健性积极影响。我们采用的贸易衡量指标是进口与出口之和，以购买力平价GDP为基准（实际开放度），我们认为这一指标在理论上的优越性优于传统使用的名义衡量方式。我们还发现，贸易和规模因素之间存在显著的正向综合效应。我们的估计结果控制了制度质量、地理因素等代理变量，并考虑了贸易与制度质量的内生性。通过对贸易和规模如何影响生产率的分析，我们发现它们是通过全要素生产率来发挥作用的。

abstract.text: A fundamental aspect of institutional design is how much society chooses to delegate unchecked power to its leaders. If, once elected, a leader cannot be restrained, society runs the risk of a tyranny of the majority, if not the tyranny of a dictator. If a leader faces too many ex post checks and balances, legislative action is too often blocked. As our critical constitutional choice, we focus upon the size of the minority needed to block legislation, or conversely the size of the (super)majority needed to govern. We analyze both “optimal” constitutional design and “positive” aspects of this process. We derive several empirical implications which we then discuss.

10.1162/0033553041382148.abstractZh: 制度设计的一个基本方面是，社会愿意将其未受约束的权力委托给领导者多少。如果一旦当选，领导者无法受到约束，社会就有可能面临多数人的暴政，甚至独裁者的统治。如果领导者面临过多的事后制衡机制，立法行动往往会被阻碍。作为我们重要的宪法选择，我们关注需要多少少数派才能阻止立法，或者相反地，需要多少（超级）多数才能行使权力。我们分析了这种“最优”的宪法设计以及这一过程的“积极”方面。我们还得出了一些实证结论，并进行了讨论。

abstract.text: Most transplanted kidneys are from cadavers, but there are also many transplants from live donors. Recently, there have started to be kidney exchanges involving two donor-patient pairs such that each donor cannot give a kidney to the intended recipient because of immunological incompatibility, but each patient can receive a kidney from the other donor. Exchanges are also made in which a donor-patient pair makes a donation to someone waiting for a cadaver kidney, in return for the patient in the pair receiving high priority for a compatible cadaver kidney when one becomes available. There are stringent legal/ethical constraints on how exchanges can be conducted. We explore how larger scale exchanges of these kinds can be arranged efficiently and incentive compatibly, within existing constraints. The problem resembles some of the "housing" problems studied in the mechanism design literature for indivisible goods, with the novel feature that while live donor kidneys can be assigned simultaneously, cadaver kidneys cannot. In addition to studying the theoretical properties of the proposed kidney exchange, we present simulation results suggesting that the welfare gains from larger scale exchange would be substantial, both in increased number of feasible live donation transplants, and in improved match quality of transplanted kidneys.

10.1162/0033553041382157.abstractZh: 大多数移植的肾脏来自尸体捐赠者，但也有许多来自活体捐赠者的移植案例。最近，出现了一种肾脏交换方式，即两个捐赠者-患者配对，由于免疫不相容性，每个捐赠者无法将肾脏移植给预定的接收者，但每个患者都可以从另一个捐赠者那里获得肾脏。此外，还有一种交换方式，即一个捐赠者-患者配对向等待尸体肾脏的人进行捐赠，以换取在获得兼容尸体肾脏时优先获得该配对的接收者。这种交换方式受到严格的法律/伦理约束。我们探讨了如何在现有限制条件下，高效且具有激励相容性地安排更大规模的这种交换。这个问题类似于机制设计文献中研究的“住房”问题，不同之处在于活体捐赠者的肾脏可以同时进行分配，而尸体肾脏则不能。除了研究所提出的肾脏交换的理论特性外，我们还展示了模拟结果，表明更大规模的交换将带来显著的福利收益，包括增加可行的活体捐赠移植数量，以及提高移植肾脏的匹配质量。

abstract.text: Public policies designed to increase utilization of existing technologies may also affect incentives to develop new technologies. This paper investigates this phenomenon by examining policies designed to increase usage of preexisting vaccines. I find that these policies were associated with a 2.5-fold increase in clinical trials for new vaccines. For several diseases, the induced innovation is socially wasteful, though small in magnitude. In one case, however, the “dynamic” social welfare benefits from induced innovation exceed the policies' “static” benefits from increasing vaccination with existing technology. These findings underscore the importance of including technological progress in economic analysis of public policy.

10.1162/0033553041382166.abstractZh: 旨在增加现有技术利用度的公共政策，也可能影响开发新技术的激励因素。本文通过研究旨在增加现有疫苗使用的政策，来探讨这一现象。研究发现，这些政策导致新疫苗的临床试验数量增加了2.5倍。对于某些疾病而言，由此引发的创新虽然规模较小，但具有社会浪费性。然而，在一种情况下，由创新带来的“动态”社会福利效益，超过了通过现有技术增加疫苗接种所带来的“静态”效益。这些发现强调了在公共政策的经济分析中包含技术进步的重要性。

abstract.text: A new rationale is presented for why an elite may want to expand the franchise even in the absence of threats to the established order. Expanding the franchise can turn politicians away from particularistic politics based on ad personam redistribution within the elite and foster competition based on programs with diffuse benefits. If these programs are valuable, a majority of the elite votes in favor of an extension of the franchise despite the absence of a threat from the disenfranchised. We argue that the evolution of public spending and of political competition in nineteenth century Britain is consistent with our model.

10.1162/0033553041382175.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的理论依据，解释为何即使在现有秩序没有受到威胁的情况下，精英阶层仍可能希望扩大选举权。扩大选举权可以促使政客们放弃基于个人再分配的特定主义政治，转而促进基于具有广泛利益的项目的竞争。如果这些项目具有价值，即使没有来自被剥夺权利的人的威胁，大多数精英也会投票支持扩大选举权。我们认为，19世纪英国公共支出和政治竞争的发展与我们的模型是一致的。

abstract.text: We investigate the role that nonportfolio fund differentiation and information/search frictions play in creating two salient features of the mutual fund industry: the large number of funds and the sizable dispersion in fund fees. In a case study, we find that despite the financial homogeneity of S&P 500 index funds, this sector exhibits the fund proliferation and fee dispersion observed in the broader industry. We show how extra-portfolio mechanisms explain these features. These mechanisms also suggest an explanation for the puzzling late-1990s shift in sector assets to more expensive (and often newly entered) funds: an influx of high-information-cost novice investors.

10.1162/0033553041382184.abstractZh: 我们研究了非投资组合基金差异化以及信息/搜寻障碍在形成共同基金行业两个显著特征中的作用：基金数量的庞大以及基金费用分布的广泛差异。在一项案例研究中，我们发现尽管标准普尔500指数基金在财务上具有同质性，但该行业仍然表现出与整个行业相同的基金数量激增和费用分布分散的现象。我们展示了非投资组合机制如何解释这些特征。这些机制还提供了一种解释，即为什么在1990年代末，行业资产转向了更昂贵的（且通常是新进入的）基金：这是由于大量高信息成本的新手投资者的涌入。

abstract.text: In May 1991 fifteen thousand Ethiopian Jews were brought to Israel in an overnight airlift and sorted in a haphazard and essentially random fashion to absorption centers across the country. This quasi-random assignment produced a natural experiment whereby the initial schooling environment of Ethiopian children can be considered exogenous to their family background and parental decisions. We examine the extent to which the initial elementary school environment affected the high school outcomes of Ethiopian children, using administrative panel data on the educational career of each child in Israel through much of the 1990s. The results show that the early schooling environment has an important effect on high school dropout rates, repetition rates, and the passing rate on matriculation exams necessary to enter college. The results are robust to using alternative measures of the schooling environment and to the inclusion of community fixed effects, which suggests that aspects of the elementary school itself are important for high school success.

10.1162/0033553041382193.abstractZh: 1991年5月，一万五千名埃塞俄比亚犹太人通过夜间空运被带到以色列，随后以随机的方式被分配到全国各地的收容中心。这种近乎随机的分配构成了一个自然实验，使得埃塞俄比亚儿童的初始教育环境可以被视为与其家庭背景和父母决策无关的因素。我们利用关于以色列各地儿童在1990年代大部分时间内的教育生涯的行政面板数据，来研究初始小学教育环境对埃塞俄比亚儿童高中学业成绩的影响程度。研究结果表明，早期教育环境对高中辍学率、留级率以及进入大学所需的入学考试通过率有着重要影响。研究结果在采用不同的教育环境衡量指标以及纳入社区固定效应后依然保持稳定，这表明小学阶段的一些因素对高中学业成功至关重要。

abstract.text: This paper exploits product-level U. S. import data to test trade theory. Although the United States increasingly sources the same products from both high- and low-wage countries, unit values within products vary systematically with exporter relative factor endowments and exporter production techniques. These facts reject factor-proportions specialization across products but are consistent with such specialization within products. The data are inconsistent with new trade theory models predicting an inverse relationship between price and producer productivity. The existence of within-product specialization is an important consideration for understanding the impact of globalization on firms and workers, the evolution of total factor productivity, and the likelihood of long-run income convergence.

10.1162/0033553041382201.abstractZh: 本文利用美国产品层面的进口数据来检验贸易理论。尽管美国越来越多地从高工资国家和低工资国家采购相同的产品，但产品内部的单位价值却随着出口商的相对要素禀赋和出口商的生产技术而系统性地变化。这些事实否定了产品间要素比例专业化的情况，但与产品内部的专业化是一致的。这些数据与新的贸易理论模型预测的价格与生产者生产率之间的反比关系不符。产品内部专业化的存在对于理解全球化对企业和工人影响、全要素生产率的演变以及长期收入收敛的可能性具有重要意义。

abstract.text: I estimate adjustment costs for labor and capital from the Euler equations for factor demand. For both factors, I find relatively strong evidence against substantial adjustment costs. My estimates use annual data from two-digit industries. My results support the view that rents arising from adjustment costs are relatively small and are not an important part of the explanation of the large movements of the values of corporations in relation to the reproduction costs of their capital. I investigate the potential effects of three types of specification error: (1) aggregation over time, (2) aggregation over firms with heterogeneous demand shocks, and (3) estimation of a convex adjustment-cost technology in the presence of nonconvex discrete adjustment costs. I find that the likely biases from these specification errors are relatively small.

10.1162/0033553041502135.abstractZh: 我利用欧拉方程对劳动力和资本的调整成本进行了估算。对于这两种要素，我发现反对存在较大调整成本的证据相对较强。我的估算使用了两位数 industries的年度数据。我的研究结果支持这样一种观点：由于调整成本而产生的租金相对较小，并不是解释企业价值与其资本再生产成本之间巨大变动的重要因素。我研究了三种类型的规定性误差的潜在影响：(1) 时间上的聚合；(2) 面对异质需求冲击时的企业聚合；(3) 在非凸离散调整成本存在的情况下对凸调整成本技术的估算。我发现这些规定性误差带来的偏差相对较小。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of (potential) market size on entry of new drugs and pharmaceutical innovation. Focusing on exogenous changes driven by U. S. demographic trends, we find a large effect of potential market size on the entry of nongeneric drugs and new molecular entities. These effects are generally robust to controlling for a variety of supply-side factors and changes in the technology of pharmaceutical research.

10.1162/0033553041502144.abstractZh: 本文研究了（潜在）市场规模对新药物和药品创新进入市场的影响。重点关注由美国人口趋势驱动的外生变化，我们发现潜在市场规模对非专利药物和新型分子实体的进入有显著影响。这些影响在控制多种供应侧因素以及药品研究技术变化的情况下仍然保持稳健。

abstract.text: There are two fundamentally different views of the role of elections in policy formation. In one view, voters can affect candidates' policy choices: competition for votes induces politicians to move toward the center. In this view, elections have the effect of bringing about some degree of policy compromise. In the alternative view, voters merely elect policies: politicians cannot make credible promises to moderate their policies, and elections are merely a means to decide which one of two opposing policy views will be implemented. We assess which of these contrasting perspectives is more empirically relevant for the U. S. House. Focusing on elections decided by a narrow margin allows us to generate quasi-experimental estimates of the impact of a “randomized” change in electoral strength on subsequent representatives' roll-call voting records. We find that voters merely elect policies: the degree of electoral strength has no effect on a legislator's voting behavior. For example, a large exogenous increase in electoral strength for the Democratic party in a district does not result in shifting both parties' nominees to the left. Politicians' inability to credibly commit to a compromise appears to dominate any competition-induced convergence in policy.

10.1162/0033553041502153.abstractZh: 关于选举在政策形成中的作用，存在两种根本不同的观点。一种观点认为，选民可以影响候选人的政策选择：竞选中的竞争促使政客们倾向于采取中间立场。在这种观点下，选举在一定程度上能够促成政策上的妥协。另一种观点则认为，选民只是选举政策本身：政客无法做出可信的承诺来缓和他们的政策立场，而选举只是决定两种对立政策观点中哪一个会被实施的手段。我们评估了这两种观点中哪一种在美国众议院的实际情况中更为合理。通过关注以微弱差距决定的选举，我们可以进行准实验性的分析，以了解“随机化”改变选举力量对后续代表投票行为的影响。研究发现，选民只是选举政策本身：选举力量的大小对立法者的投票行为没有影响。例如，在一个选区，民主党获得的选举力量大幅增加，并不会导致两个政党的提名者都向左转。政客无法做出可信的妥协承诺，这似乎主导了任何由竞争引发的政策趋同。

abstract.text: We study the effects of differences in local financial development within an integrated financial market. We construct a new indicator of financial development by estimating a regional effect on the probability that, ceteris paribus, a household is shut off from the credit market. By using this indicator, we find that financial development enhances the probability an individual starts his own business, favors entry of new firms, increases competition, and promotes growth. As predicted by theory, these effects are weaker for larger firms, which can more easily raise funds outside of the local area. These effects are present even when we instrument our indicator with the structure of the local banking markets in 1936, which, because of regulatory reasons, affected the supply of credit in the following 50 years. Overall, the results suggest local financial development is an important determinant of the economic success of an area even in an environment where there are no frictions to capital movements.

10.1162/0033553041502162.abstractZh: 我们研究了在一体化金融市场中，不同地区的金融发展差异所带来的影响。我们通过估计一个地区对家庭被排除在信贷市场之外的概率的区域效应，构建了一个新的金融发展指标。利用这一指标，我们发现金融发展能够提升个人创业的可能性，促进新企业的进入，增加竞争，并推动经济增长。正如理论预测的那样，这些效应对于规模较大的企业来说较弱，因为这些企业更容易在地区外筹集资金。即使我们在1936年的地方银行市场结构这一工具变量存在的情况下进行研究，这些效应仍然存在，因为由于监管原因，这一结构影响了随后50年的信贷供应。总体而言，结果表明，即使在没有资本流动障碍的环境中，地方金融发展也是决定一个地区经济成功的重要因素。

abstract.text: Does investor protection foster economic growth? To assess the widely held affirmative view, we introduce investor protection into a standard overlapping generations model of capital accumulation. Better investor protection implies better risk sharing. Because of entrepreneurs' risk aversion, this results in a larger demand for capital. This is the demand effect. A second effect (the supply effect) follows from general equilibrium restrictions. Better protection (i.e., higher demand) increases the interest rate and lowers the income of entrepreneurs, decreasing current savings and next period's supply of capital. The supply effect is stronger the tighter are the restrictions on capital flows. Our model thus predicts that the (positive) effect of investor protection on growth is stronger for countries with lower restrictions. Cross-country data provide support for this prediction, as does the detailed examination of the growth experiences of South Korea and India.

10.1162/0033553041502171.abstractZh: 投资者保护是否能够促进经济增长？为了验证这一普遍持有的积极观点，我们将投资者保护引入到一个标准的重叠世代资本积累模型中。更好的投资者保护意味着更好的风险分担。由于企业家具有风险厌恶倾向，这导致对资本的需求增加。这就是需求效应。第二个效应（供给效应）则源于一般均衡限制条件。更好的保护（即更高的需求）会提高利率，降低企业家的收入，从而减少当前的储蓄和下一期的资本供应。对资本流动的限制越严格，供给效应就越强。因此，我们的模型预测，对于限制较少的国家来说，投资者保护对经济增长的积极影响更为显著。跨国数据支持了这一预测，对韩国和印度经济增长经历的详细分析也证实了这一点。

abstract.text: In the 1960s Blacks and Whites chose relatively similar first names for their children. Over a short period of time in the early 1970s, that pattern changed dramatically with most Blacks (particularly those living in racially isolated neighborhoods) adopting increasingly distinctive names, but a subset of Blacks actually moving toward more assimilating names. The patterns in the data appear most consistent with a model in which the rise of the Black Power movement influenced how Blacks perceived their identities. Among Blacks born in the last two decades, names provide a strong signal of socioeconomic status, which was not previously the case. We find, however, no negative relationship between having a distinctively Black name and later life outcomes after controlling for a child's circumstances at birth.

10.1162/0033553041502180.abstractZh: 在1960年代，黑人和白人给他们的孩子选择的名字相对相似。然而，在1970年代初的短时间内，这一模式发生了显著变化：大多数黑人（尤其是那些居住在种族隔离社区的人）开始使用越来越独特的名字，但也有一部分黑人选择更加融合化的名字。数据中的这些模式似乎更符合一个模型，即黑人权力运动的兴起影响了黑人对自己身份的认知。对于过去二十年出生的黑人来说，名字能够强烈反映社会经济地位，而这一点在之前并不明显。不过，我们在控制孩子出生时的环境因素后，并未发现拥有独特黑人名字与后期生活结果之间存在负相关关系。

abstract.text: Advances in communication and transportation technologies have the potential to bring people closer together and create a “global village.” However, they also allow heterogeneous agents to segregate along special interests, which gives rise to communities fragmented by type rather than by geography. We show that lower communication costs should always decrease separation between individual agents even as group-based separation increases. Each measure of separation is pertinent for distinct types of social interaction. A group-based measure captures the diversity of group preferences that can have an impact on the provision of public goods. While an individual measure correlates with the speed of information transmission through the social network that affects, for example, learning about job opportunities and new technologies. We test the model by looking at coauthoring between academic economists before and during the rise of the Internet in the 1990s.

10.1162/0033553041502199.abstractZh: 通信和交通技术的进步有潜力将人们紧密联系起来，形成“全球村”。然而，这些技术也允许不同性质的个体根据特殊利益进行分化，从而导致社区按类型而非地理区域进行划分。我们发现，尽管基于群体的分化现象有所增加，但较低的通信成本应该始终能够减少个体之间的分离。每种分离度量方式都适用于不同类型的社会互动。基于群体的度量方式能够反映群体偏好的多样性，这可能会影响公共产品的提供。而个体层面的度量方式则与信息在社交网络中的传输速度相关，这会影响人们了解就业机会和新技术的机会。我们通过研究20世纪90年代互联网兴起之前和期间学术经济学家的合作行为，来验证这一模型。

abstract.text: Constitutional arrangements affect the decisions made by a society. We study how this effect leads to preferences of citizens over constitutions; and ultimately how this has a feedback that determines which constitutions can survive in a given society. Constitutions are stylized here, to consist of a voting rule for ordinary business and possibly a different voting rule for making changes to the constitution. We define an equilibrium notion for constitutions, called self-stability, whereby under the rules of a self-stable constitution, the society would not vote to change the constitution. We argue that only self-stable constitutions will endure. We prove that self-stable constitutions always exist, but that most constitutions (even very prominent ones) may not be self-stable for some societies. We show that constitutions where the voting rule used to amend the constitution is the same as the voting rule used for ordinary business are dangerously simplistic, and there are (many) societies for which no such constitution is self-stable. We conclude with a characterization of the set of self-stable constitutions that use majority rule for ordinary business.

10.1162/0033553041502207.abstractZh: 宪法安排会影响一个社会做出的决策。我们研究这种影响如何导致公民对宪法的偏好；最终，这种偏好如何产生反馈，决定哪些宪法能够在特定社会中存续。这里将宪法抽象化为由普通事务的投票规则组成，可能还有用于修改宪法的不同投票规则。我们定义了一个称为“自我稳定性”的宪法均衡概念，即在一个自我稳定的宪法下，社会不会投票修改宪法。我们认为只有自我稳定的宪法才能持久存在。我们证明自我稳定的宪法总是存在的，但大多数宪法（即使是非常重要的宪法）在某些社会中可能不具备自我稳定性。我们发现，那些用于修改宪法的投票规则与用于普通事务的投票规则相同的宪法过于简单化，而且有许多社会不存在这样的自我稳定宪法。最后，我们对使用多数规则处理普通事务的自我稳定宪法集合进行了描述。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between the unemployment rate at the time of a baby's conception and parental characteristics, parental behaviors, and babies' health. Babies conceived in times of high unemployment have a reduced incidence of low and very low birth weight, fewer congenital malformations, and lower postneonatal mortality. These health improvements are attributable both to selection (changes in the type of mothers who conceive during recessions) and to improvements in health behavior during recessions. Black mothers tend to be higher socioeconomic status (as measured by education and marital status) in times of high unemployment, whereas White mothers are less educated.

10.1162/0033553041502216.abstractZh: 我们研究了婴儿受孕时的失业率与父母特征、父母行为以及婴儿健康之间的关系。在高失业率时期受孕的婴儿，出生体重低和极低的情况较少，先天性畸形也较少，新生儿死亡率也较低。这些健康改善既归因于选择因素（在经济衰退期间受孕的母亲类型发生变化），也归因于经济衰退期间健康行为的改善。在高失业率时期，黑人母亲往往具有较高的社会经济地位（通过教育和婚姻状况来衡量），而白人母亲的受教育程度较低。

abstract.text: Players in a game are “in equilibrium” if they are rational, and accurately predict other players' strategies. In many experiments, however, players are not in equilibrium. An alternative is “cognitive hierarchy” (CH) theory, where each player assumes that his strategy is the most sophisticated. The CH model has inductively defined strategic categories: step 0 players randomize; and step k thinkers best-respond, assuming that other players are distributed over step 0 through step k - 1. This model fits empirical data, and explains why equilibrium theory predicts behavior well in some games and poorly in others. An average of 1.5 steps fits data from many games.

10.1162/0033553041502225.abstractZh: 如果玩家具有理性，并且能够准确预测其他玩家的策略，那么他们就处于“均衡状态”。然而，在许多实验中，玩家并不处于均衡状态。另一种理论是“认知层次”理论，该理论认为每个玩家都认为自己所采用的策略是最为复杂的。CH模型通过归纳法定义了策略类别：在第一步，玩家进行随机化；而在第k步，思考型玩家做出最佳反应，前提是其他玩家分布在第0步到第k-1步之间。该模型能够解释为什么均衡理论在某些游戏中能够很好地预测行为，而在其他游戏中则效果不佳。根据许多游戏的数据分析，平均需要1.5个步骤才能达到均衡状态。

abstract.text: Are there agglomeration economies in crime? The positive correlation between city size and crime rates is well-known. This paper establishes a positive relationship between youth cohort size and marijuana use rates. It further demonstrates a negative association between youth cohort size and marijuana prices, youth drug possession arrest rates, and both overall and youth sales arrest rates. Cohort size affects demand by lowering possession arrest probabilities, but this factor explains less than 10 percent of the relationship. The main effect shown here, accounting for at least a quarter of the relationship, is on the supply of marijuana. Larger youth cohorts yield thicker drug markets that, through lower sales arrest risk and informational economies, generate cost-savings in drug distribution.

10.1162/0033553042476125.abstractZh: 犯罪活动是否存在集聚经济效应？城市规模与犯罪率之间的正相关性是众所周知的。本文发现，青少年群体规模与大麻使用率之间存在正相关关系。此外，研究还发现，青少年群体规模与大麻价格、青少年毒品持有被捕率以及整体和青少年毒品销售被捕率之间存在负相关关系。群体规模通过降低毒品持有被捕的概率来影响需求，但这一因素仅能解释不到10%的关联关系。本文主要揭示的效应，至少占关联关系的四分之一，是对于大麻供应的影响。规模较大的青少年群体能够形成更密集的毒品市场，通过降低销售被捕风险和信息优势，从而在毒品分销过程中实现成本节约。

abstract.text: As a remedy for the notorious deficiency of pre-Civil War U. S. macroeconomic data, this study introduces an annual index of American industrial production consistently defined from 1790 until World War I. The index incorporates 43 quantity-based annual series (most entirely new) in the manufacturing and mining industries in a manner similar to the Federal Reserve Board's monthly industrial production index. The index changes our view of the growth and volatility of the U. S. economy before World War I. A direct implication of the index is that antebellum-postbellum differences in industrial volatility are statistically indistinguishable.
