Bush’s speech (March 16, 2002), the announcement by the White House on creating the Millennium Challenge Corporation (White House, 2002), as well as a Washington Post editorial (February 9, 2002), a Financial Times column by Alan Beattie (March 11, 2002), and The Economist (March 16, 2002).

10.1257/0002828041464560.abstractZh: 在一篇极具影响力的论文中，Craig Burnside和David Dollar（2000年，第847页）发现，“……援助对拥有良好财政、货币和贸易政策的发展中国家具有积极影响，但在政策不佳的情况下，援助的效果甚微。”这一发现具有重要的政策意义。Burnside和Dollar的研究结果为对外援助提供了作用方向和策略。如果援助仅在政策良好的国家中促进经济增长，这表明：（1）援助能够推动经济增长；（2）对外援助必须选择性地分配给那些采取了合理政策的国家。国际援助机构、公共政策制定者和媒体迅速认识到BD研究的重要性。本文利用更多数据重新评估了援助、政策与经济增长之间的关系。BD研究的数据截止于1993年。我们通过原始资料重建了BD数据库，因此：（1）由于自他们进行分析以来获得了新的信息，我们在BD数据集中增加了更多的国家和观测数据；（2）将数据扩展至1997年。因此，利用BD的研究方法，我们重新检验了在政策良好的情况下，援助是否会影响经济增长。鉴于我们专注于重新验证BD的研究结果，我们没有总结BD研究之前关于援助与经济增长的丰富文献。我们只是指出，此前存在一段漫长而尚无定论的文献研究，这些研究受到数据有限、关于援助如何影响经济增长的机制存在争议以及计量经济学规范上存在分歧的阻碍（参见Gustav F. Papanek, 1972; Robert Cassen, 1986; Paul Mosley等, 1987; Peter Boone, 1994, 1996; Henrik Hansen和Finn Tarp的2000年综述）。由于BD发现援助在良好的政策环境下能够促进增长，因此还有许多其他论文对他们的研究结果进行了回应，包括Paul Collier和Jan Dehn（2001年）、CarlJohan Dalgaard和Hansen（2001年）、Patrick Guillaumont和Lisa Chauvet（2001年）、Hansen和Tarp（2001年）、Robert Lensink和Howard White（2001年），以及Collier和Dollar（2002年）的论文。这些论文进行了许多有用的变体和扩展研究（其中一些已经在BD之前的相关文献中出现过），例如引入额外的控制变量、使用非线性模型等。一些论文证实了援助仅在良好的政策环境下才有效，而另一些论文则排除了援助政策与其他变量之间的交互作用。这些文献通常存在选择模型时没有理论指导的局限性，这意味着实际可行的模型可能比样本中的数据点更多。我们的论文与这些其他论文的不同之处在于，我们没有偏离BD的模型框架。因此，我们并没有测试结果对无限多变体的鲁棒性，而是保持了BD的方法论。本文通过添加BD无法获取的新数据来进行非常简单的鲁棒性检验。因此，我们扩大了样本范围，将数据延长到1993年至1997年。Easterly：纽约大学经济学系，纽约州纽约市默瑟街269号，全球发展中心，以及美国国家经济研究局（电子邮件：william.easterly@nyu.edu）；Levine：明尼苏达大学卡尔森管理学院金融系，明尼阿波利斯市第19号南大道321号，邮编55455，以及美国国家经济研究局（电子邮件：rlevine@csom.umn.edu）；Roodman：全球发展中心，华盛顿特区马萨诸塞大道NW1776号，邮编20036（电子邮件：droodman@cgdev.org）。我们感谢Craig Burnside提供数据并协助重建以往的研究结果，但不对他在这项工作中的贡献负责。同时感谢Francis Ng和Prarthna Dayal在更新Sachs-Warner开放变量方面提供的慷慨帮助，以及三位匿名审稿人、Craig Burnside和Henrik Hansen提供的有益评论。1 例如，可参考世界银行（1994年、2001年、2002年）、英国国际发展部（2000年）、乔治·W·布什总统的演讲（2002年3月16日）、白宫关于创建千年挑战公司的公告（白宫，2002年），以及《华盛顿邮报》的社论（2002年2月9日）、Alan Beattie在《金融时报》的专栏文章（2002年3月11日），以及《经济学人》杂志的报道（2002年3月16日）。

abstract.text: It is typically less profitable for an opportunistic borrower to divert inputs than to divert cash. Therefore, suppliers may lend more liberally than banks. This simple argument is at the core of our contract theoretic model of trade credit in competitive markets. The model implies that trade credit and bank credit can be either complements or substitutes. Among other things, the model explains why trade credit has short maturity, why trade credit is more prevalent in less developed credit markets, and why accounts payable of large unrated firms are more countercyclical than those of small firms.

10.1257/0002828041464579.abstractZh: 通常情况下，机会主义借款人将投入品转移出去比转移现金更不划算。因此，供应商可能会比银行更慷慨地提供贷款。这一简单论点是我们关于竞争市场中贸易信贷的契约理论模型的核心。该模型表明，贸易信贷和银行信贷可以是互补的，也可以是替代的。此外，该模型还解释了为什么贸易信贷的期限较短，为什么在欠发达的信贷市场中贸易信贷更为普遍，以及为什么大型未评级公司的应付账款比小型公司的应付账款更具逆周期特性。

abstract.text: The advantage of knowing about risks is that we can change our behavior to avoid them. Of course, it is easily observed that to avoid all risks would be impossible; it might entail no flying, no driving, no walking, eating and drinking only healthy foods, and never being touched by sunshine. Even a bath could be dangerous. I could not receive this prize if I sought to avoid all risks. There are some risks we choose to take because the benefits from taking them exceed the possible costs. Optimal behavior takes risks that are worthwhile. This is the central paradigm of finance; we must take risks to achieve rewards but not all risks are equally rewarded. Both the risks and the rewards are in the future, so it is the expectation of loss that is balanced against the expectation of reward. Thus we optimize our behavior, and in particular our portfolio, to maximize rewards and minimize risks. This simple concept has a long history in economics and in Nobel citations. Harry M. Markowitz (1952) and James Tobin (1958) associated risk with the variance in the value of a portfolio. From the avoidance of risk they derived optimizing portfolio and banking behavior. William Sharpe (1964) developed the implications when all investors follow the same objectives with the same information. This theory is called the Capital Asset Pricing Model or CAPM, and shows that there is a natural rela-

10.1257/0002828041464597.abstractZh: 了解风险的优势在于我们可以改变自己的行为来避免这些风险。当然，很容易观察到，完全避免所有风险是不可能的；这可能意味着不飞行、不驾驶、不行走、只吃健康食品，甚至不接触阳光。即使是洗澡也可能带来危险。如果我试图完全避免所有风险，我就无法获得这个奖项。有些风险是我们选择承担的，因为承担这些风险所带来的好处超过了可能付出的代价。最优的行为是承担那些值得的风险。这是金融学的核心理念；我们必须承担风险以获得回报，但并非所有风险都能得到同等回报。风险和回报都发生在未来，因此需要通过预期损失与预期回报之间的平衡来优化我们的行为，特别是我们的投资组合，以最大化回报并最小化风险。这个简单的概念在经济学中有着悠久的历史，并且多次被诺贝尔奖引用。哈里·M·马克维茨（1952年）和詹姆斯·托宾（1958年）将风险与投资组合价值的方差联系起来。他们从避免风险的理念出发，发展出了优化投资组合和银行行为的理论。威廉·夏普（1964年）研究了当所有投资者都遵循相同目标和相同信息时的影响。这一理论被称为资本资产定价模型或CAPM，它表明存在一种自然的关联。

abstract.text: Many countries strive to attract foreign direct investment (FDI) hoping that knowledge brought by multinationals will spill over to domestic industries and increase their productivity. In contrast with earlier literature that failed to find positive intraindustry spillovers from FDI, this study focuses on effects operating across industries. The analysis, based on firm-level data from Lithuania, produces evidence consistent with positive productivity spillovers from FDI taking place through contacts between foreign affiliates and their local suppliers in upstream sectors. The data indicate that spillovers are associated with projects with shared domestic and foreign ownership but not with fully owned foreign investments.

10.1257/0002828041464605.abstractZh: 许多国家努力吸引外国直接投资，期望跨国企业带来的知识能够传播到国内产业，从而提高其生产效率。与之前未能发现外国直接投资对国内产业产生积极影响的文献不同，本研究重点关注跨行业的影响。基于立陶宛的企业级数据进行分析后，发现通过外国子公司与上游行业的本地供应商之间的接触，外国直接投资确实能够带来积极的生产效率提升。数据表明，这种影响与拥有部分国内和外国股权的项目相关，而与完全由外国投资者控制的投资项目无关。

abstract.text: I assess the magnitude of human capital spillovers by estimating production functions using a unique firm-worker matched data set. Productivity of plants in cities that experience large increases in the share of college graduates rises more than the productivity of similar plants in cities that experience small increases in the share of college graduates. These productivity gains are offset by increased labor costs. Using three alternative measures of economic distance—input-output flows, technological specialization, and patent citations—I find that within a city, spillovers between industries that are economically close are larger than spillovers between industries that are economically distant.

10.1257/0002828041464623.abstractZh: 我通过利用独特的企业-员工匹配数据集来估计人力资本溢出效应的大小。在那些大学毕业生比例大幅增加的城市，工厂的生产力提升幅度大于那些大学毕业生比例略有增加的类似城市的工厂。这些生产力的提升被劳动力成本的增加所抵消。通过三种不同的经济距离衡量指标——投入产出流动、技术专业化以及专利引用——我发现，在一个城市内部，经济上接近的行业之间的溢出效应大于经济上相距较远的行业之间的溢出效应。

abstract.text: The paper builds a tractable model of patent pools, agreements among patent owners to license sets of their patents. It provides a necessary and sufficient condition for patent pools to enhance welfare and shows that requiring pool members to be able to independently license patents matters if and only if the pool is otherwise welfare reducing. The paper allows patents to differ in importance, asymmetric blocking patterns, and licensors to also be licensees. We undertake some initial exploration of the impact of pools on innovation. The analysis has broader applicability than pools, being relevant to a number of co-marketing arrangements.

10.1257/0002828041464641.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个易于分析的专利池模型，即专利所有者之间就许可其专利进行合作的形式。文章提出了专利池能够提升福利的必要充分条件，并表明：只有当专利池在其他方面会降低福利时，要求池中的成员能够独立许可专利才具有意义。此外，文章还允许专利在重要性、阻塞模式等方面存在差异，并且许可方也可以是被许可方。我们对专利池对创新的影响进行了初步探讨。该分析的应用范围不仅限于专利池，还适用于许多其他合作营销安排。

abstract.text: Governments can efficiently provide liquidity, as when the banking system is bailed out. We study a model in which not all assets can be used to purchase all other assets at every date. Agents sometimes want to sell projects. The market price of the projects sold depends on the supply of liquidity, which is determined in general equilibrium. While private liquidity provision is socially beneficial since it allows valuable reallocations, it is also socially costly since liquidity suppliers could have made more efficient investments ex ante. There is a role for the government to supply liquidity by issuing government securities.

10.1257/0002828041464650.abstractZh: 政府可以有效地提供流动性，例如当银行系统需要救助时。我们研究了一个模型，在这个模型中，并非所有资产都能在每一个时间点用来购买其他资产。代理人有时希望出售项目。出售项目的市场价格取决于流动性的供应情况，而流动性的供应通常在一般均衡状态下确定。虽然私人提供流动性对社会是有益的，因为它允许有价值的资源重新分配，但这也会带来社会成本，因为流动性提供者可以在事前做出更高效的投资。因此，政府通过发行政府证券来提供流动性是合适的。

abstract.text: The two prize winners in Economics this year would describe themselves as “Econometricians, ” so I thought that I should start by explaining that term. One can begin with the ancient subject of Mathematics which is largely concerned with the discovery of relationships between deterministic variables using a rigorous argument. (A deterministic variable is one whose value is known with certainty.) However, by the middle of the last millennium it became clear that some objects were not deterministic, they had to be described with the use of probabilities, so that Mathematics grew a substantial sub-field known as “Statistics. ” This later became involved with the analysis of data and a number of methods have been developed for data having what may be called “standard properties.” However, in some areas of application, the data that they generated were found to be not standard, and so special sub-sub-fields needed to be developed. For example, Biology produced Biometrics, Psychology gave us Psychometrics, and Economics produced Econometrics.

10.1257/0002828041464669.abstractZh: 今年在经济学领域获得两个奖项的人将自己称为“计量经济学家”，因此我认为应该先解释一下这个术语。计量经济学起源于古老的数学领域，主要致力于通过严谨的论证来发现确定性变量之间的关系。（确定性变量是指其取值可以确定的变量。）然而，到了上个千年的中期，人们意识到有些对象并非确定性变量，它们需要用概率来描述，于是数学发展出了一个重要的分支——统计学。后来，统计学又逐渐与数据分析相结合，并发展出许多适用于具有所谓“标准属性”的数据的方法。然而，在某些应用领域，生成的数据并不符合标准，因此需要发展出专门的子分支。例如，生物学发展出了生物统计学，心理学产生了心理测量学，而经济学则产生了计量经济学。

abstract.text: Saving decisions are made jointly by household members who generally earn risky incomes. Consequently, to interpret saving patterns it is crucial to analyze the relationship between intra-household risk sharing and intertemporal choices. To that end in this paper the household is characterized as a group of agents with possibly heterogeneous preferences making efficient decisions. Two results are obtained. First, it is shown that risk sharing can increase the amount saved by the household. Second, I find that an increase in risk aversion and prudence of an individual member can reduce household risk aversion and prudence. These results are consistent with the empirical evidence collected using the HRS. 1

10.1257/0002828042002516.abstractZh: 储蓄决策是由家庭成员共同做出的，这些成员通常拥有风险性收入。因此，要解释储蓄模式，分析家庭内部风险分担与跨时期选择之间的关系至关重要。为此，本文将家庭视为一个由可能具有不同偏好的代理人组成的群体，他们共同做出高效决策。本文得出了两个重要结论：首先，风险分担可以增加家庭的储蓄金额；其次，个体成员风险厌恶程度及谨慎程度的增加，会降低整个家庭的风险厌恶和谨慎程度。这些结果与使用HRS收集到的实证数据是一致的。

abstract.text: Credit market imperfections influence the labor market and aggregate economic activity. In turn, macroeconomic factors have an impact on the credit sector. To assess these effects in a tractable general-equilibrium framework, we introduce endogenous search frictions, in the spirit of Peter Diamond (1990), in both credit and labor markets. We demonstrate that credit frictions amplify macroeconomic volatility through a financial accelerator. The magnitude of this general-equilibrium accelerator is proportional to the credit gap, defined as the deviation of actual output from its perfect credit market level. We explore various extensions, notably endogenous wages.

10.1257/0002828042002525.abstractZh: 信贷市场的缺陷会影响劳动力市场以及整体经济活动。反过来，宏观经济因素也会对信贷部门产生影响。为了在一个易于处理的一般均衡框架内评估这些效应，我们引入了内生搜寻摩擦，这一思想源自Peter Diamond（1990年）的研究，并将其应用于信贷市场和劳动力市场。我们证明，信贷摩擦通过金融加速器效应放大了宏观经济波动。这种一般均衡加速器的强度与信贷缺口成正比，信贷缺口是指实际产出与其在完美信贷市场条件下的水平之间的偏差。我们还探讨了各种扩展情况，特别是内生工资的影响。

abstract.text: We study the inferences about labor adjustment costs obtained by the gap methodology of Caballero and Engel [1993] and Caballero, Engel and Haltiwanger [1997]. In that approach, the policy function of a manufacturing plant is assumed to depend on the gap between a target and the current level of employment. We Þnd that their rejection of the quadratic cost of adjustment model, based upon evidence of nonlinear hazard functions, may not be justiÞed. Instead these nonlinearities may reßect difficulties measuring the gap. Thus it appears that the gap methodology, as currently employed, may be unable to identify the costs of labor adjustment. ∗We are grateful to seminar participants at Boston University, the University of British Columbia, University of Texas at Austin and the 2000 CMSG conference at McMaster University for comments and suggestions. Discussions with John Haltiwanger and Daniel Hamermesh were much appreciated. The authors thank the NSF for Þnancial support. The views expressed herein are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily reßect the views of the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis or the Federal Reserve System.

10.1257/0002828042002534.abstractZh: 我们研究了Caballero和Engel [1993]以及Caballero、Engel和Haltiwanger [1997]提出的基于“差距方法”对劳动力调整成本的推断。在该方法中，假设制造工厂的政策函数取决于目标就业水平与当前就业水平之间的差距。我们发现，他们基于非线性风险函数的证据而拒绝二次调整成本模型的观点可能并不合理。实际上，这些非线性现象可能反映了测量差距时的困难。因此，目前采用的“差距方法”可能无法准确识别劳动力调整的成本。我们感谢波士顿大学、不列颠哥伦比亚大学、德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校以及2000年麦克马斯特大学CMSG会议的与会者提供的意见和建议。同时，我们也非常感谢John Haltiwanger和Daniel Hamermesh的讨论。作者感谢NSF提供的资金支持。本文所表达的观点仅代表作者个人意见，并不一定反映堪萨斯城联邦储备银行、明尼阿波利斯联邦储备银行或联邦储备系统的观点。

abstract.text: Do observed contracts have the properties predicted by the principal-agent model with moral hazard in contract theory? This paper tests the predictions of such an agency model in the context of sharecropping in North India. The most well-known explanation for sharecropping is based on the principal-agent model with a trade-off between risk and incentives. Even though sharecropping contracts are quite prevalent in rural areas of developing countries, there is very little evidence on factors determining the instruments used to provide incentives in such contracts. Using information in the data giving rise to exogenous variation in technology across regions, this paper tests for the effect of cultivation technology on the incentive structure of share contracts as predicted by the agency model. Existing empirical evidence on sharecropping seems to indicate that yield on sharecropped plots is lower than on owner-operated plots, i.e., there is an incentive problem or moral hazard (Radwan A. Shaban, 1987; Jean-Jacques Laffont and Mohamed S. Matoussi, 1995). There is some informal evidence that landowners use various mechanisms to improve efficiency in sharecropping by participating in cost sharing and by repeating contracts. Robert M. Townsend and Rolf A. Mueller (1994) examine the nature of these mechanisms in detail but their data do not permit econometric tests. More generally, though the principal-agent model has been widely studied there is little existing empirical evidence for it. Michael C. Jensen and Kevin J. Murphy (1990) find that executive compensation is only weakly sensitive to firm performance. In recent work Rajesh K. Aggarwal and Andrew A. Samwick (1999) find that executive’s pay-performance sensitivity is decreasing in the volatility of firm’s performance. However, their results are sensitive to the inclusion of other characteristics of the firms in the regressions. As Pierre A. Chiappori and Bernard Salanie (2003) note in a recent survey, empirical work on contract theory using nonexperimental data needs to be careful in adequately correcting for underlying heterogeneity across agents. Otherwise the parameters of interest would be hard to interpret if such heterogeneity affects contract choice. For example, Douglas W. Allen and Dean Lueck (1995) find no role for risk in the choice between share contract and fixed rent contracts but they do not take the heterogeneity across agents into account. In a recent paper addressing the issue of heterogeneity across agents, Ackerberg and Botticini (2002) find a significant role for risk in the choice between share contract and fixed rent contract. After correcting for endogenous matching between landowners and tenants, they find that wealthier tenants are more likely to be in fixed rent contracts. In this paper, we are able to address such estimation issues and check for the robustness of our results regarding the relationship between technology and the design of share contracts * Department of Economics, Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA 16801 (e-mail: pxp22@psu.edu). This paper derives from related work done earlier in my dissertation. I am grateful to two anonymous referees for very helpful suggestions. I thank James Heckman, Lars Stole, Robert Townsend, Kala Krishna, and seminar participants for useful comments. Financial support from the Andrew Mellon Foundation for both rounds of fieldwork is gratefully acknowledged. Any errors remain my own. 1 See Nirvikar Singh (1991) for a survey of various theories of sharecropping including Steven N. Cheung (1969), C. H. Hanumantha Rao (1971), Joseph E. Stiglitz (1974), David Newbery and Stiglitz (1979), Avishay Braverman and Stiglitz (1982), Mukesh Eswaran and Ashok Kotwal (1985), and Sudhir Shetty (1988). A common feature of the different theories is an emphasis on uncertainty and asymmetric information. 2 An exception is Daniel A. Ackerberg and Maristella Botticini (2002). Ackerberg and Botticini differ from our paper in that they examine the role of tenant’s risk aversion in the choice between fixed rental contract and share contract—they do not examine share contracts per se. 3 See John E. Core and Wayne Guay (2000).

10.1257/0002828042002543.abstractZh: 在合同理论中，观察到的合同是否具有道德风险下主代理人模型所预测的属性？本文在印度北部的佃农制度背景下，检验了这种代理模型的预测结果。佃农制度最著名的解释基于主代理人模型，该模型考虑了风险与激励之间的权衡。尽管佃农合同在发展中国家农村地区非常普遍，但关于决定此类合同中激励手段因素的实证证据却很少。本文利用数据中反映的地区间技术差异信息，检验了耕作技术对佃农合同激励结构的影响，正如代理模型所预测的那样。现有的关于佃农制度的实证证据表明，佃农地块的产量低于自耕农地块，即存在激励问题或道德风险（Radwan A. Shaban, 1987; Jean-Jacques Laffont和Mohamed S. Matoussi, 1995）。有一些非正式证据表明，土地所有者通过参与成本分摊和重复合同等方式来提高佃农制度的效率。Robert M. Townsend和Rolf A. Mueller（1994）详细研究了这些机制的性质，但他们的数据不允许进行计量经济学检验。总体而言，尽管主代理人模型已被广泛研究，但现有的实证证据却很少。Michael C. Jensen和Kevin J. Murphy（1990）发现，高管薪酬对公司绩效的敏感性较低。在最近的研究中，Rajesh K. Aggarwal和Andrew A. Samwick（1999）发现，高管薪酬对公司绩效波动的敏感性在降低。然而，他们的研究结果对于在回归分析中纳入企业的其他特征非常敏感。正如Pierre A. Chiappori和Bernard Salanie在2003年的一项研究指出的那样，使用非实验数据进行契约理论研究的实证工作需要谨慎地纠正各主体之间的异质性。否则，如果这种异质性影响了契约选择，那么相关参数将难以解释。例如，Douglas W. Allen和Dean Lueck在1995年的研究中发现，风险在股票契约与固定租金契约的选择中并不起作用，但他们没有考虑各主体之间的异质性。在最近一篇关于主体间异质性的论文中，Ackerberg和Botticini发现风险在股票契约与固定租金契约的选择中起着重要作用。在纠正了土地所有者与租户之间的内生匹配后，他们发现更富有的租户更有可能选择固定租金契约。在本文中，我们能够解决这些估计问题，并检验我们的研究结果在技术和股票契约设计之间的关系方面的稳健性。本文源自我博士论文中的相关研究。我感谢两位匿名审稿人提出的非常有帮助的建议。我感谢James Heckman、Lars Stole、Robert Townsend、Kala Krishna以及研讨会参与者提供的宝贵意见。感谢Andrew Mellon基金会为两次实地工作提供的资金支持。任何错误都应由我负责。1 参见Nirvikar Singh在1991年对各种租地理论的综述，其中包括Steven N. Cheung在1969年、C. H. Hanumantha Rao在1971年以及Joseph E.斯蒂格利茨（1974年）、大卫·纽伯里和斯蒂格利茨（1979年）、阿维沙伊·布拉弗曼和斯蒂格利茨（1982年）、穆克什·埃斯瓦兰和阿肖克·科特瓦尔（1985年）以及苏迪尔·谢蒂（1988年）。这些不同理论的一个共同特点是强调不确定性和信息不对称问题。一个例外是丹尼尔·A·阿克尔伯格和马里斯特拉·博蒂奇尼（2002年）。阿克尔伯格和博蒂奇尼与我们论文的不同之处在于，他们研究了租户风险厌恶在固定租金合同与共享合同选择中的作用——他们并没有专门研究共享合同本身。参见约翰·E·科尔和韦恩·盖伊（2000年）的研究。

abstract.text: The cyclical behavior of real wages has evolved from mildly countercyclical during the interwar period to modestly procyclical in the postwar era. This paper presents a general-equilibrium business-cycle model that helps explain the evolution. In the model, changes in the real wage cyclicality arise from interactions between nominal wage and price rigidities and an evolving input-output structure.

10.1257/0002828042002552.abstractZh: 实际工资的周期性变化从两次世界大战期间的相对逆周期行为，转变为战后时期的适度顺周期行为。本文提出了一个一般均衡商业周期模型，以解释这种变化。在该模型中，实际工资的周期性变化源于名义工资与价格刚性之间的相互作用，以及不断变化的投入产出结构。

abstract.text: We study race in the labor market by sending fictitious resumes to help-wanted ads in Boston and Chicago newspapers. To manipulate perceived race, resumes are randomly assigned African-American- or White-sounding names. White names receive 50 percent more callbacks for interviews. Callbacks are also more responsive to resume quality for White names than for African-American ones. The racial gap is uniform across occupation, industry, and employer size. We also find little evidence that employers are inferring social class from the names. Differential treatment by race still appears to still be prominent in the U.S. labor market.

10.1257/0002828042002561.abstractZh: 我们通过向波士顿和芝加哥报纸的招聘广告发送虚构的简历来研究劳动力市场中的种族问题。为了操控人们对种族的认知，简历上会随机使用非洲裔或白人风格的姓名。白人名字在获得面试机会方面比非洲裔名字多获得50%的反馈。对于白人名字的简历，雇主对简历质量的反应也更为积极。这种种族差异在职业、行业和雇主规模方面都是一致的。此外，我们几乎没有发现雇主会从姓名中推断社会阶层的情况。种族差异在美国劳动力市场中仍然相当明显。

abstract.text: This paper examines the robustness of explanatory variables in cross-country economic growth regressions. It introduces and employs a novel approach, Bayesian Averaging of Classical Estimates (BACE), which constructs estimates by averaging OLS coefficients across models. The weights given to individual regressions have a Bayesian justification similar to the Schwarz model selection criterion. Of 67 explanatory variables we find 18 to be significantly and robustly partially correlated with long-term growth and another three variables to be marginally related. The strongest evidence is for the relative price of investment, primary school enrollment, and the initial level of real GDP per capita.

10.1257/0002828042002570.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在跨国经济增长回归分析中解释变量的稳健性。文章引入并采用了一种新颖的方法——贝叶斯平均经典估计法（BACE），该方法通过跨模型平均OLS系数来构建估计值。各个回归的权重具有与Schwarz模型选择标准类似的贝叶斯依据。在67个解释变量中，我们发现有18个变量与长期经济增长存在显著且稳健的部分相关性，另外还有3个变量与长期经济增长有边缘性关联。最有力的证据体现在投资相对价格、小学入学率以及人均实际GDP的初始水平上。

abstract.text: В статье анализируется связь между обменным курсом и балансом активов и пассивов и влияние этой связи на макроэкономические показатели в малой открытой экономике. Из-за высокой степени долларизации обязательств, обесценение национальной валюты, с одной стороны, снижает чистую стоимость компаний (net worth), что порождает финансовую хрупкость частного сектора. Это ведет к ограничению инвестиций. С другой стороны, девальвация приводит к расширению выпуска и росту отдачи от инвестиций, что также является компонентом чистой стоимости компании. В работе показывается, что негативный внешний шок может быть усилен эффектом баланса (balance sheet effect). В результате выпуск и инвестиции снижаются. При фиксированном курсе это падение сильнее, чем при плавающем. Таким образом, гибкий курс является лучим амортизатором внешних реальных шоков, даже несмотря на значительный эффект баланса.

10.1257/0002828042002589.abstractZh: 本文分析了汇率与资产和负债平衡之间的关系，以及这种关系对小型开放经济体的宏观经济指标的影响。由于债务的高度美元化，本国货币贬值一方面降低了企业的净价值，从而加剧了私营部门的财务脆弱性。这限制了投资。另一方面，货币贬值导致产出增加和投资回报上升，这也是企业净价值的一部分。研究表明，负面的外部冲击可能会因资产负债表效应而加剧。结果，产出和投资都会下降。在固定汇率下，这种下降比浮动汇率下更为严重。因此，灵活的汇率是抵御外部实际冲击的较好缓冲手段，即便存在显著的资产负债表效应。

abstract.text: We build a simple model to capture the major virtues and drawbacks of making public officials accountable (i.e., subjecting them to reelection): On the one hand, accountability allows the public to screen and discipline their officials; on the other, it may induce those officials to pander to public opinion and put too little weight on minority welfare. We study when decision-making powers should be allocated to the public directly (direct democracy), to accountable officials (called “politicians”), or to nonaccountable officials (called “judges”).

10.1257/0002828042002606.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个简单的模型，来探讨让公共官员承担责任的优点和缺点（即让这些官员面临重新选举的约束）。一方面，责任机制使得公众能够筛选和约束官员；另一方面，它可能会促使官员迎合公众意见，而忽视少数群体的福祉。我们研究了决策权应该直接由公众掌握（直接民主）、由负责的官员（即政治家）掌握，还是由不负责的官员（即法官）掌握。

abstract.text: Robert E. Lucas, Jr. argued that the welfare gains from reducing aggregate consumption volatility are negligible. Subsequent work that revisited his calculation continued to find small welfare benefits, further reinforcing the perception that business cycles do not matter. This paper argues instead that fluctuations can affect welfare, by affecting the growth rate of consumption. I show that fluctuations can reduce growth starting from a given initial consumption, which can imply substantial welfare effects as Lucas himself observed. Empirical evidence suggests the welfare effects are likely to be substantial, about two orders of magnitude greater than Lucas' original estimates.

10.1257/0002828042002615.abstractZh: 罗伯特·E·卢卡斯认为，减少总体消费波动所带来的福利收益微乎其微。后续的研究继续发现，这种波动对福利的积极影响并不显著，这进一步强化了商业周期并不重要的观点。本文则认为，消费波动确实会影响福利，因为它们会影响消费的增长率。我证明了，从给定的初始消费水平开始，波动可以降低经济增长，正如卢卡斯本人所观察到的那样，这可能会带来显著的福利效应。实证证据表明，这种福利效应可能相当显著，比卢卡斯最初的估计高出两个数量级。

abstract.text: The Canada-U.S. Free Trade Agreement provides a unique window onto the effects of a reciprocal trade agreement on an industrialized economy (Canada). For industries that experienced the deepest Canadian tariff cuts, the contraction of low-productivity plants reduced employment by 12 percent while raising industry-level labor productivity by 15 percent. For industries that experienced the largest U.S. tariff cuts, plant-level labor productivity soared by 14 percent. These results highlight the conflict between those who bore the short-run adjustment costs (displaced workers and struggling plants) and those who are garnering the long-run gains (consumers and efficient plants).

10.1257/0002828042002633.abstractZh: 《加拿大-美国自由贸易协定》为观察互惠贸易协定对工业化经济（加拿大）的影响提供了一个独特的视角。对于那些在加拿大遭受最大幅关税削减的行业来说，低生产力工厂的缩减导致就业人数减少了12%，而工业层面的劳动生产率则提高了15%。而对于那些在美利坚合众国遭受最大幅度关税削减的行业来说，工厂层面的劳动生产率则提升了14%。这些结果凸显了短期调整成本承担者（被取代的工人和陷入困境的工厂）与长期收益获得者（消费者和高效的工厂）之间的冲突。

abstract.text: This paper shows how the demand for non-life insurance interacts with consumption and saving. The analysis is set in continuous time, using the maximum principle. When insurance is actuarially fair, the insurance and consumption decisions are separable. With loaded premiums, and alternatively without insurance, optimal consumption is dynamically related to the growth rate of the loss probability, and a growing loss probability generates precautionary saving. With loaded premiums, less than full insurance is demanded at each instant, and optimal cover varies over time, whether or not the loss probability is constant.

10.1257/0002828042002642.abstractZh: 本文探讨了非人寿保险需求如何与消费和储蓄相互作用。分析采用连续时间框架，并运用最大值原理。当保险费用符合精算公平原则时，保险决策与消费决策是可分离的。在保费负担较重的情况下，或者在没有保险的情况下，最优消费行为与损失概率的增长率动态相关，而不断增长的损失概率会促使人们进行预防性储蓄。在保费负担较重的情况下，每个时刻所需的保险覆盖程度都低于完全保险的程度，且最优保险覆盖程度会随时间变化，无论损失概率是否保持不变。

abstract.text: This paper develops a measure of U.S. monetary policy shocks for the period 1969–1996 that is relatively free of endogenous and anticipatory movements. Quantitative and narrative records are used to infer the Federal Reserve's intentions for the federal funds rate around FOMC meetings. This series is regressed on the Federal Reserve's internal forecasts to derive a measure free of systematic responses to information about future developments. Estimates using the new measure indicate that policy has large, relatively rapid, and statistically significant effects on both output and inflation. The effects are substantially stronger and quicker than those obtained using conventional indicators.

10.1257/0002828042002651.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于衡量1969年至1996年期间美国货币政策冲击的方法，该方法相对避免了内生性和预期性因素的影响。通过定量和叙述性数据，可以推断出美联储在联邦基金利率会议前后对利率的意图。该指标基于美联储内部的预测数据进行回归分析，从而得出一个不受未来发展信息系统性影响的衡量指标。使用这一新指标得出的估计结果显示，货币政策对产出和通货膨胀的影响较大、相对较快，且统计上显著。这些影响比使用传统指标得出的结果更为强烈和迅速。

abstract.text: We study transactions that require investments before trading in a competitive market, when forward contracts fixing the transaction price are absent. We show that, despite the market being perfectly competitive and subject to arbitrarily little uncertainty, the inability to jointly determine investment levels and prices may make it impossible for buyers and sellers to predict the prices at which they will trade, leading to inefficient levels of investment and trade.

10.1257/0002828042002660.abstractZh: 我们研究在竞争市场中，在远期合约无法固定交易价格的情况下，需要先进行投资才能进行的交易。我们发现，尽管市场是完全竞争的，且不确定性极小，但无法共同确定投资水平和价格，可能会导致买卖双方无法预测交易价格，从而导致投资与交易的效率低下。

abstract.text: In 1954 the United States Supreme Court ruled that separate schools for black and white children were “inherently unequal.” This paper studies whether the desegregation plans of the next 30 years benefited black and white students in desegregated school districts. Data from the 1970 and 1980 censuses suggest desegregation plans of the 1970's reduced high school dropout rates of blacks by two to three percentage points during this decade. No significant change is observed among whites. The results are robust to controls for family income, parental education, and state- and region-specific trends, as well as to tests for selective migration.

10.1257/0002828042002679.abstractZh: 1954年，美国最高法院裁定，为黑人和白人儿童设立不同学校的行为“本质上是不平等的”。本文研究未来30年的种族融合计划是否对已实现种族融合的学区内的黑人和白人学生产生了积极影响。1970年和1980年的人口普查数据显示，1970年代的种族融合计划使黑人在这一十年中高中辍学率降低了2%至3个百分点。而白人学生的辍学率则没有显著变化。研究结果在控制家庭收入、父母教育水平以及州和地区特定趋势的情况下仍然保持稳定，同时经过选择性迁移的检验后，结果依然可靠。

abstract.text: We develop a monopolistic-competition model of trade with many industries to examine how home-market effects vary with industry characteristics. Industries with high transport costs and more differentiated products tend to be more concentrated in large countries than industries with low transport costs and less differentiated products. We test this prediction using a difference-in-difference gravity specification that controls for import tariffs, importing-country remoteness, home bias in demand, and the tendency for large countries to export more of all goods. We find strong evidence of home-market effects whose intensity varies across industries in a manner consistent with theory.

10.1257/0002828042002688.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个包含多个行业的垄断竞争贸易模型，以研究本土市场效应如何随行业特征而变化。运输成本较高且产品差异较大的行业，往往比运输成本较低且产品差异较小的行业更集中在大国中。我们通过使用差异-差异引力模型来检验这一预测，该模型控制了进口关税、进口国的距离、需求本土偏好以及大国倾向于出口更多各类商品等因素。我们发现，本土市场效应的强度在不同行业中存在差异，这一结果与理论预测一致。

abstract.text: Rational agents with differing priors tend to be overoptimistic about their chances of success. In particular, an agent who tries to choose the action that is most likely to succeed, is more likely to choose an action of which he overestimated, rather than underestimated, the likelihood of success. After studying the comparative statics of this mechanism, I show that it also causes agents to attribute failure to exogenous factors but success to their own choice of action, to disproportionately believe that they will outperform others, to overestimate the precision of their estimates, and to overestimate their control over the outcome.

10.1257/0002828042002697.abstractZh: 具有不同先验假设的理性代理人往往对成功的可能性过于乐观。特别是，试图选择最有可能成功的行动的代理人，更可能会选择一种他高估了成功概率的行动，而不是低估了成功概率的行动。通过研究这一机制的比较静态特性，我发现它还会导致代理人将失败归因于外部因素，而将成功归因于自己的选择；过度相信自己能够超越他人；高估自己估计的精确度；以及高估自己对结果的控制能力。

abstract.text: If individuals care about their status, defined as their rank in the distribution of consumption of one “positional” good, then the consumer's problem is strategic as her utility depends on the consumption choices of others. In the symmetric Nash equilibrium, each individual spends an inefficiently high amount on the status good. Using techniques from auction theory, we analyze the effects of exogenous changes in the distribution of income. In a richer society, almost all individuals spend more on conspicuous consumption, and individual utility is lower at each income level. In a more equal society, the poor are worse off.

10.1257/0002828042002705.abstractZh: 如果个体关心自己的地位，即他们在某种“位置性”商品消费分配中的排名，那么消费者的行为就具有战略性，因为她的效用取决于其他人的消费选择。在对称纳什均衡中，每个个体在地位商品上的支出都过高且效率低下。利用拍卖理论中的技术，我们分析了收入分配变化的外生影响。在更富裕的社会中，几乎所有个体在炫耀性消费上的支出都更高，而个体效用在每个收入水平上都会降低。在更平等的社会中，穷人的处境会变得更糟。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a formulation of consumer sovereignty, for use in normative economics, which does not presuppose individuals' preferences to be coherent. The fundamental intuition, that opportunity and responsibility have moral value, is formalized as an “opportunity criterion” for assessing resource allocation systems. A model of an exchange economy is presented in which rational arbitrageurs compete to make profits by trading with nonrational consumers. In equilibrium, this economy satisfies the opportunity criterion. One interpretation of this result is that, in a competitive environment, the overall effects of money pumps are benign, even if individuals' preferences are unstable or incoherent.

10.1257/0002828042002714.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种消费者主权的表述方式，适用于规范经济学，该表述不预设个体的偏好是连贯的。基本的直觉是，机会与责任具有道德价值，这一直觉被形式化为一个“机会标准”，用于评估资源分配系统。文中还提出了一个交换经济模型，在该模型中，理性的套利者通过与非理性的消费者进行交易来追求利润。在均衡状态下，该经济满足机会标准。这一结果的一种解释是，在竞争环境中，货币 pumping 的总体效应是积极的，即使个体的偏好不稳定或不连贯。

abstract.text: Consumers living near the U.S.-Canada border can shift their expenditures between the two countries, so real exchange rate fluctuations can act as demand shocks to border areas' retailers. Using annual county-level data, we estimate the effects of real exchange rates on the number of establishments and their average employment in border counties for four retail industries. In three of the four industries we consider, the number of operating establishments responds either contemporaneously or with a lag of one year, so long-run changes in net entry in fact occur quickly enough to matter for short-run fluctuations.

10.1257/0002828042002723.abstractZh: 居住在美加边境附近的消费者可以在这两个国家之间转移支出，因此实际汇率的波动可能会对边境地区的零售商产生需求冲击。我们利用年度县级数据，估计实际汇率对四个零售行业在边境县内的企业数量及其平均就业人数的影响。在我们研究的四个行业中，有三个行业的经营企业数量会同时或滞后一年做出反应，因此长期性的净进入变化实际上会迅速影响到短期波动。

abstract.text: We present simple one-shot distribution experiments comparing the relative importance of efficiency concerns, maximin preferences, and inequality aversion, as well as the relative performance of the fairness theories by Gary E Bolton and Axel Ockenfels and by Ernst Fehr and Klaus M. Schmidt. While the Fehr-Schmidt theory performs better in a direct comparison, this appears to be due to being in line with maximin preferences. More importantly, we find that a combination of efficiency concerns, maximin preferences, and selfishness can rationalize most of the data while the Bolton-Ockenfels and Fehr-Schmidt theories are unable to explain important patterns.

10.1257/0002828042002741.abstractZh: 我们提出了简单的一次性分配实验，比较了效率关切、最大最小偏好以及不平等厌恶的相对重要性，以及Gary E Bolton和Axel Ockenfels以及Ernst Fehr和Klaus M. Schmidt的公平理论的相对表现。虽然Fehr-Schmidt理论在直接比较中表现更好，但这似乎是因为它与最大最小偏好一致。更重要的是，我们发现效率关切、最大最小偏好以及自私性相结合可以解释大部分数据，而Bolton-Ockenfels和Fehr-Schmidt理论无法解释重要的模式。

abstract.text: The Metropolitan Council for Educational Opportunity (Metco) is a desegregation program that sends students from Boston schools to more affluent suburbs. Metco increases the number of blacks and reduces test scores in receiving districts. School-level data for Massachusetts and micro data from a large district show no impact of Metco on the scores of white non-Metco students. But the micro estimates show some evidence of an effect on minority third graders, especially girls. Instrumental variables estimates for third graders are imprecise but generally in line with ordinary least squares estimates. Given the localized nature of these results, we conclude that peer effects from Metco are modest and short lived.

10.1257/0002828043052169.abstractZh: 教育机会都市委员会（Metco）是一个旨在消除学校间种族隔离的计划，该计划将波士顿学校的学生送往较为富裕的郊区。Metco计划增加了黑人学生的数量，但接收地区的测试成绩却有所下降。马萨诸塞州的学校层面数据以及某个大区的微观数据表明，Metco对白人非Metco学生的成绩没有产生影响。不过，微观估计结果显示，Metco对少数族裔三年级学生，尤其是女生，有一定的影响。对于三年级学生的工具变量估计结果并不精确，但总体上与普通最小二乘法估计结果一致。鉴于这些结果的局部性，我们得出结论：Metco带来的同伴效应较为微弱且持续时间较短。

abstract.text: This paper considers the problem of how to construct and reconcile price indexes across space and time. A general taxonomy of panel price index methods, containing four broad classes, is proposed, along with five criteria for discriminating between them. Methods from each of the four classes are then used to compute spatial and temporal price indexes for the 15 countries of the European Union (EU) over the period 1995–2000. Using these panel price indexes, I test whether or not price levels and relative prices converged across the EU over this period.

10.1257/0002828043052178.abstractZh: 本文探讨了如何构建并协调不同空间和时间维度下的价格指数问题。文章提出了一种通用的面板价格指数分类方法，包含四个大类，并提出了五个区分这些方法的标准。随后，作者使用这四个大类中的每一种方法，计算了1995至2000年间欧盟15个国家的空间和时间价格指数。基于这些面板价格指数，作者检验了在此期间欧盟内价格水平及相对价格是否趋于一致。

abstract.text: "People behave pro-socially in a wide variety of situations that standard economic theory is unable to explain. Social comparison is one explanation for such pro-social behavior: people contribute if others contribute or cooperate as well. This paper tests social comparison in a field experiment at the University of Zurich. Each semester every single student has to decide whether he or shenwants to contribute to two Social Funds. We provided 2500 randomly selected students with information about the average behavior of the student population. Some received the information that a high percentage of the student population contributed, while others received the information that a relatively low percentage contributed. The results show that people behave pro-socially, conditional on others. The more others cooperate, the more one is inclined to do so as well. The type of person is important. We are able to fix the types by looking at revealed past behavior. Some persons seem to care more about the pro-social behavior of others, while other types are not affected by the average behavior of the reference group."

10.1257/0002828043052187.abstractZh: 人们在各种情况下表现出亲社会行为，而标准经济理论无法对此进行解释。社会比较是解释这种亲社会行为的一种方式：如果其他人也做出贡献或合作，人们也会随之做出贡献。本文在苏黎世大学进行了一项关于社会比较的实地实验。每个学期，每位学生都必须决定是否向两个社会基金捐款。我们向2500名随机选取的学生提供了关于学生群体平均行为的信息。其中一些学生得知有较高比例的学生参与了捐款，而另一些学生则得知参与捐款的比例相对较低。实验结果表明，人们在其他人的影响下会表现出亲社会行为。其他人越合作，一个人也越倾向于合作。个人的类型也很重要。我们通过观察过去的行为来确定这些“类型”。有些人似乎更关心他人的亲社会行为，而其他“类型”则不受参考群体平均行为的影响。

abstract.text: Since the emergence of early endogenous growth models (Larry E. Jones and Rodolfo E. Manuelli, 1990; Sergio Rebelo, 1991), a large body of work has studied the growth effects of tax reform. While virtually all of this literature has confined itself to the analysis of flat-rate taxes, tax codes are generally progressive. This paper, therefore, explores the effects of progressive taxes in conventional growth models with heterogenous households. In such frameworks, the tax code helps to determine simultaneously the pre-tax income distribution and the rate of technical progress. We present three main findings. First, we show that when variations in tax codes stem from differences in progressivity, shares of tax revenue in GDP or income may constitute poor proxies for average marginal tax rates. In particular, we find that the decrease in progressivity associated with the Tax Reform Act of 1986 (TRA-86) lowered the U.S. average marginal tax rate by 0.06 to 0.37 percentage points depending on the model used. At the same time, however, the endogenous adjustment in the distribution of income produced by this progressivity change contributed to raising the tax share of income by approximately 0.8 percentage points. Because marginal tax rates are not easily observable, empirical work often has to make use of tax shares in income as an alternative. To the degree that lower marginal rates entail less tax distortion, our study suggests that relying on tax shares may cause less progressive tax codes to be incorrectly perceived as more distortional. Second, we find that the progressivity decrease implied by TRA-86 helped raise U.S. per capita GDP growth by 0.12 to 0.34 percentage points. Given the prominence of TRA-86 compared with other U.S. tax reforms over the past four decades, these growth effects, while not negligible (as in Robert E. Lucas, 1990), shed doubt on the potential for tax policy to alter significantly prospects for U.S. long-run growth. Finally, consistent with previous work, our analysis suggests that the progressivity change associated with TRA-86 had a significant effect on income inequality, resulting in a 20to 24percent increase in the Gini coefficient of income. We carry out our analysis using two prototypical endogenous growth models augmented to include a nondegenerate distribution of income. These models, one first formulated by Robert J. Barro (1990) and the other by Rebelo (1991), account for two polar extremes regarding the use of tax proceeds. On the one hand, in Rebelo’s two-sector framework, tax revenue is spent in a way that affects neither the marginal utility of private consumption nor the production possibilities of the private sector. On the other hand, in the environment envisioned by Barro (1990), all tax revenue serves to finance public services that enhance private production. Interestingly, the results we have just described emerge irrespective of the framework under consideration.

10.1257/0002828043052196.abstractZh: 自早期内生增长模型出现以来（Larry E. Jones和Rodolfo E. Manuelli，1990年；Sergio Rebelo，1991年），大量研究探讨了税收改革对经济增长的影响。尽管几乎所有这些研究都局限于对固定税率的分析，但税法通常具有累进性。因此，本文探讨了在具有异质家庭的常规增长模型中，累进税的影响。在这种框架下，税法有助于同时确定税前收入分布和技术进步的速度。我们提出了三个主要发现。首先，我们表明，当税法差异源于累进性的不同时，税收收入占GDP或收入的份额可能不能很好地反映平均边际税率。特别是，我们发现1986年税收改革法案带来的累进性降低使得美国的平均边际税率相应下降了0.06至0.37个百分点，具体取决于所使用的模型。然而，与此同时，这种累进性变化引起的收入分布的内生调整使得税收收入占收入的份额增加了约0.8个百分点。由于边际税率不易观测，实证研究通常不得不使用税收收入占收入的份额作为替代指标。研究表明，较低的边际税率意味着更少的税收扭曲，因此依赖税收收入占收入的份额可能会减少人们对累进性税制造成更大扭曲的误解。其次，我们发现1986年税收改革法案带来的累进性降低使得美国人均GDP增长率增加了0.12至0.34个百分点。鉴于1986年税收改革法案与其他美国税收改革相比的重要性，这一发现具有重要意义。在过去的四十年中，尽管这些增长效应不可忽视（如罗伯特·E·卢卡斯在1990年的研究所示），但它们却让人对税收政策能否显著改变美国长期增长前景产生怀疑。与先前的研究一致，我们的分析表明，与TRA-86政策相关的累进性变化对收入不平等产生了显著影响，导致基尼系数增加了20%到24%。我们采用两种典型的内生增长模型进行分析，并增加了非退化收入分配的考虑。这两种模型分别由罗伯特·J·巴罗在1990年提出，以及雷贝洛在1991年提出，它们分别考虑了税收使用的两种极端情况。一方面，在雷贝洛的两部门框架中，税收收入的使用不会影响私人消费的边际效用或私营部门的生产可能性。另一方面，在巴罗所设想的环境中，所有税收收入都用于资助能够提升私人生产的公共服务。有趣的是，我们刚刚描述的结果无论采用哪种框架都是相同的。

abstract.text: There is ample evidence that emotions affect performance. Positive emotions can improve performance, while negative ones can diminish it. For example, the fears induced by the possibility of failure or of negative evaluations have physiological consequences (shaking, loss of concentration) that may impair performance in sports, on stage, or at school. There is also ample evidence that individuals have distorted recollection of past events and distorted attributions of the causes of success or failure. Recollection of good events or successes is typically easier than recollection of bad ones or failures. Successes tend to be attributed to intrinsic aptitudes or effort, while failures are attributed to bad luck. In addition, these attributions are often reversed when judging the performance of others. The objective of this paper is to incorporate the phenomenon that emotions affect performance into an otherwise standard decision theoretic model and show that in a world where performance depends on emotions, biases in information processing enhance welfare.

10.1257/0002828043052204.abstractZh: 有大量证据表明情绪会影响表现。积极的情绪可以提高表现，而消极的情绪则会降低表现。例如，因失败或负面评价而产生的恐惧会导致生理上的反应（如颤抖、注意力丧失），这可能会损害在体育、舞台表演或学校中的表现。此外，也有大量证据表明人们对过去事件的记忆存在扭曲，对成功或失败原因的解释也存在偏差。对好的事件或成功的记忆通常比对不好的事件或失败的记忆更容易记住。成功往往被归因于内在的能力或努力，而失败则被归因于运气不好。另外，在评价他人表现时，这些归因往往也会发生逆转。本文的目的是将情绪影响表现这一现象纳入标准的决策理论模型中，并表明在一个表现依赖于情绪的世界里，信息处理中的偏见反而会提升福利。

abstract.text: Recent empirical evidence from the United States indicates a high degree of persistence in earnings across generations. Designing effective public policies to increase social mobility requires identifying and measuring the major sources of persistence and inequality in earnings. We provide a quantitative model of intergenerational human capital transmission that focuses on three sources: innate ability, early education, and college education. We find that approximately one-half of the intergenerational correlation in earnings is accounted for by parental investment in education, in particular early education. We show that these results have important implications for education policy.

10.1257/0002828043052213.abstractZh: 来自美国的近期实证数据表明，收入在代际间的持久性非常高。为了制定有效的公共政策以提高社会流动性，需要识别和衡量收入持久性和不平等的主要来源。我们提出了一个关于代际人力资本传递的定量模型，重点关注三个因素：先天能力、早期教育和高等教育。我们发现，大约一半的代际收入相关性可以归因于父母对教育的投资，尤其是早期教育。这些结果对教育政策具有重要的启示意义。

abstract.text: We propose a model of addiction based on three premises: (i) use among addicts is frequently a mistake; (ii) experience sensitizes an individual to environmental cues that trigger mistaken usage; (iii) addicts understand and manage their susceptibilities. We argue that these premises find support in evidence from psychology, neuroscience, and clinical practice. The model is tractable and generates a plausible mapping between behavior and the characteristics of the user, substance, and environment. It accounts for a number of important patterns associated with addiction, gives rise to a clear welfare standard, and has novel implications for policy.

10.1257/0002828043052222.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于三个前提的成瘾模型：(i) 成瘾者的使用行为往往是一种错误；(ii) 经历会使个体对触发错误使用的环境线索更加敏感；(iii) 成瘾者能够理解并管理自己的敏感性。我们认为这些前提得到了心理学、神经科学和临床实践中的证据支持。该模型易于处理，并且能够合理地描述行为与用户、物质以及环境特征之间的关系。它解释了与成瘾相关的许多重要现象，提出了明确的福利标准，并对政策提出了新的启示。

abstract.text: This paper explores a group rule–utilitarian approach to understanding voter turnout, inspired by the theoretical work of John C. Harsanyi (1980) and Timothy J. Feddersen and Alvaro Sandroni (2002). It develops a model based on this approach and studies its performance in explaining turnout in Texas liquor referenda. The results are encouraging: the comparative static predictions of the model are broadly consistent with the data, and a structurally estimated version of the model yields reasonable coefficient estimates and fits the data well. The structurally estimated model also outperforms a simple expressive voting model.

10.1257/0002828043052231.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一种基于群体规则-功利主义的方法，用于理解选民投票率问题，该方法受到了约翰·C·哈萨尼（1980年）以及蒂莫西·J·费德森和阿尔瓦罗·桑德罗尼（2002年）的理论工作的启发。文章基于这一方法构建了一个模型，并研究了该模型在解释德克萨斯州酒类公投投票率方面的表现。研究结果令人鼓舞：该模型的比较静态预测与数据结果大体一致，而结构估计版本的模型则能够得出合理的系数估计，并且与数据吻合得很好。此外，结构估计模型的表现优于一个简单的表达性投票模型。

abstract.text: This paper explains the size and value “anomalies” in stock returns using an economically motivated two-beta model. We break the beta of a stock with the market portfolio into two components, one reflecting news about the market's future cash flows and one reflecting news about the market's discount rates. Intertemporal asset pricing theory suggests that the former should have a higher price of risk; thus beta, like cholesterol, comes in “bad” and “good” varieties. Empirically, we find that value stocks and small stocks have considerably higher cash-flow betas than growth stocks and large stocks, and this can explain their higher average returns. The poor performance of the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) since 1963 is explained by the fact that growth stocks and high-past-beta stocks have predominantly good betas with low risk prices.

10.1257/0002828043052240.abstractZh: 本文利用经济理论为基础的双贝塔模型，解释了股票回报中的规模与价值“异常”现象。我们将一只股票的贝塔值与市场投资组合的贝塔值进行了分解，其中一部分反映了关于市场未来现金流的信息，另一部分则反映了关于市场折现率的信息。跨期资产定价理论表明，前者应该具有更高的风险溢价；因此，贝塔值就像胆固醇一样，存在“好”与“坏”两种类型。从经验数据来看，价值型股票和小规模股票的比现金流贝塔值明显高于成长型股票和大规模股票，这一差异可以解释它们较高的平均回报。自1963年以来，资本资产定价模型（CAPM）的表现不佳，其原因在于成长型股票和过去贝塔值较高的股票通常具有较高的贝塔值，但风险溢价却较低。

abstract.text: How do firm boundaries influence employees' acquisition of information? Using detailed project-level data and qualitative evidence, I document that pharmaceutical firms are more likely to outsource the coordination of data-intensive clinical trials, while they are more likely to assign knowledge-intensive trials to internal teams. Managers do not choose between market and hierarchy, but between the hierarchy of the firm—in which subjective performance evaluations are combined with flat explicit incentives—and the hierarchy of its subcontractor—whose virtue stems precisely from the ability to provide high-powered incentives on a narrow set of monitorable tasks.

10.1257/0002828043052259.abstractZh: 企业边界如何影响员工获取信息的途径？通过详细的项目级数据及定性证据，我发现制药公司更倾向于将数据密集型临床试验的协调工作外包，而将知识密集型试验则分配给内部团队。管理者在选择时并非在市场和层级之间做出抉择，而是在企业内部的层级结构（其中主观绩效评估与明确的激励措施相结合）与外包商内部的层级结构之间做出选择——后者之所以能成功，正是因为它能够在有限的监控任务上提供高强度的激励。

abstract.text: This paper presents a case study of a well-informed investor in the South Sea bubble. We argue that Hoare's Bank, a fledgling West End London bank, knew that a bubble was in progress and nonetheless invested in the stock: it was profitable to “ride the bubble.” Using a unique dataset on daily trades, we show that this sophisticated investor was not constrained by such institutional factors as restrictions on short sales or agency problems. Instead, this study demonstrates that predictable investor sentiment can prevent attacks on a bubble; rational investors may attack only when some coordinating event promotes joint action.

10.1257/0002828043052268.abstractZh: 本文对一位在南海泡沫中获利颇丰的投资者进行了案例研究。我们认为，霍尔银行这家位于伦敦西区的初创银行，虽然意识到泡沫正在形成，但仍然投资于该股票；参与泡沫投资是盈利的。通过一份关于日常交易数据的独特数据集，我们发现这位精明的投资者并未受到诸如卖空限制或代理问题等机构因素的约束。相反，这项研究表明，可预测的投资者情绪可以防止泡沫的破裂；理性投资者通常只有在某些协调事件促使集体行动时才会采取行动。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of scale on performance in the active money management industry. We first document that fund returns, both before and after fees and expenses, decline with lagged fund size, even after accounting for various performance benchmarks. We then explore a number of potential explanations for this relationship. This association is most pronounced among funds that have to invest in small and illiquid stocks, suggesting that these adverse scale effects are related to liquidity. Controlling for its size, a fund's return does not deteriorate with the size of the family that it belongs to, indicating that scale need not be bad for performance depending on how the fund is organized. Finally, using data on whether funds are solo-managed or team-managed and the composition of fund investments, we explore the idea that scale erodes fund performance because of the interaction of liquidity and organizational diseconomies.

10.1257/0002828043052277.abstractZh: 我们研究了规模对主动资金管理行业绩效的影响。首先，我们发现即使考虑到各种绩效基准，基金收益在扣除费用和开支后，仍会随着基金规模的扩大而下降。接着，我们探讨了这一关系的多种可能解释。这种关联在那些必须投资于小型且流动性较差股票的基金中最为明显，这表明这些不利的规模效应与流动性有关。控制基金规模后，基金的收益并不会随着所属家族规模的扩大而下降，这表明根据基金的组织方式，规模并不一定会对绩效产生负面影响。最后，通过研究基金是单独管理还是团队管理，以及基金投资的结构，我们探讨了规模侵蚀基金绩效的原因，即流动性和组织效率之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: Real incomes are routinely compared internationally using methods that “correct” for deviations from purchasing power parity. The most widely used of these is the Geary method which, though theoretically suspect, underlies the Penn World Table. This paper provides a theoretical foundation for the Geary method which I call the GAIA (“Geary-Allen International Accounts”) system. I show that the Geary method is exact when preferences are non-homothetic Leontief and, more generally, gives a (possibly poor) approximation to the GAIA benchmark. An empirical application suggests that both it and other widely used methods underestimate the degree of international inequality.

10.1257/0002828043052286.abstractZh: 实际收入在国际上通常是通过一些方法来比较的，这些方法会“修正”购买力平价方面的偏差。其中最常用的方法是Geary方法，尽管从理论上来说存在疑问，但它仍然是Penn世界表格的基础。本文为Geary方法提供了理论依据，我将其称为GAIA（“Geary-Allen国际账户”）系统。我证明了，当偏好满足Leontief非齐次条件时，Geary方法是精确的，并且更一般地，它提供了一个对GAIA基准的近似结果，尽管这个近似可能并不完美。实证应用表明，无论是Geary方法还是其他广泛使用的方法，都低估了国际不平等的程度。

abstract.text: This paper presents a model that provides an explanation, based on regime switching in the real interest rate and learning, of why tests based on stock-adjustment models, Euler equations, or decision rules—which emphasize short-run fluctuations in inventories and the interest rate—are unlikely to uncover a negative relationship between inventories and the real interest rate. The model, however, predicts that inventories will respond to long-run movements, that is, to regime shifts in the real interest rate. Tests emphasizing cointegration techniques confirm this prediction and show a significant long-run relationship between inventories and the real interest rate.

10.1257/0002828043052295.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，该模型基于实际利率的体制转换和学习过程，解释了为何基于库存调整模型、欧拉方程或决策规则的测试——这些测试强调库存和利率的短期波动——不太可能发现库存与实际利率之间的负相关关系。然而，该模型预测，库存会对长期变动作出反应，即实际利率的体制转换。强调协整技术的测试证实了这一预测，并显示出库存与实际利率之间存在显著的长期关系。

abstract.text: Two empirical regularities concerning the size distribution of cities have repeatedly been established: Zipf's law holds (the upper tail is Pareto), and city growth is proportionate. Census 2000 data are used covering the entire size distribution, not just the upper tail. The nontruncated distribution is shown to be lognormal, rather than Pareto. This provides a simple justification for the coexistence of proportionate growth and the resulting lognormal distribution. An equilibrium theory of local externalities that can explain the empirical size distribution of cities is proposed. The driving force is a random productivity process of local economies and the perfect mobility of workers.

10.1257/0002828043052303.abstractZh: 关于城市规模分布的两种经验规律已被反复证实：Zipf定律成立（上尾部符合帕累托分布），且城市增长是成比例的。研究使用了2000年人口普查数据，涵盖了整个规模分布，而不仅仅是上尾部。非截断分布被证明是对数正态分布，而非帕累托分布。这为比例增长与对数正态分布的共存提供了一个简单的解释。本文还提出了一种关于地方外部性的均衡理论，该理论可以解释城市规模分布的实证结果。其驱动力是地方经济的随机生产率过程以及工人的完美流动性。

abstract.text: We study the incentives that governments have to protect intellectual property in a trading world economy. We consider a world economy with ongoing innovation in two countries that differ in market size and in their capacity for innovation. After describing the determination of national patent policies in a noncooperative regime of patent protection, we ask, “Why is intellectual property better protected in the North than in the South?” We also study international patent agreements by deriving the properties of an efficient global regime of patent protection and asking whether harmonization of patent policies is necessary or sufficient for global efficiency.

10.1257/0002828043052312.abstractZh: 我们研究了政府在贸易世界经济中保护知识产权的动机。我们考虑了一个包含两个国家的世界经济，这两个国家在市场规模和创新能力方面存在差异。在描述了在非合作专利保护制度下国家专利政策的决定机制后，我们提出了一个问题：“为什么北方的知识产权比南方得到更好的保护？”我们还研究了国际专利协议，通过推导高效全球专利保护制度的特性，并探讨专利政策的协调是否对全球效率是必要或充分条件。

abstract.text: Economists have invested a great deal of effort in trying to understand the motivation for family transfers, yet recent empirical work testing the seemingly appealing models of altruism and exchange has led to decidedly mixed results. A major stumbling block has been the lack of adequate data. We take a fresh look at the issue using responses to an innovative survey question that directly asks mother about the planned division of their estates. We find that both altruism and exchange are frequently offered as explanations of behavior and are of nearly equal importance. Furthermore, the explanations are consistent with observable characteristics of the mother, lending support to the validity of the question. We also find that among step or adopted families, genetic ties play an important role. Because motivating factors appear to differ across families the lack of a consensus among previous researchers about motives ought not to be surprising.

10.1257/0002828043052321.abstractZh: 经济学家们投入了大量精力来研究家庭转移行为的动机，然而最近关于利他主义和交换行为的实证研究却得出了截然不同的结果。一个主要的障碍是缺乏足够的数据支持。我们通过一项创新的调查来重新审视这个问题，该调查直接询问母亲关于财产分配的计划。我们发现，利他主义和交换行为经常被用作解释家庭行为的理由，并且两者的重要性几乎相当。此外，这些解释与母亲的特征相符，进一步支持了这项调查的有效性。我们还发现，在继亲或领养家庭中，血缘关系起着重要作用。由于不同家庭之间的动机存在差异，之前的研究者们未能就动机达成一致，这并不令人意外。

abstract.text: When bidders exhibit multi-unit demands, standard auction methods generally yield inefficient outcomes. This article proposes a new ascending-bid auction for homogeneous goods, such as Treasury bills or telecommunications spectrum. The auctioneer announces a price and bidders respond with quantities. Items are awarded at the current price whenever they are “clinched,” and the price is incremented until the market clears. With private values, this (dynamic) auction yields the same outcome as the (sealed-bid) Vickrey auction, but has advantages of simplicity and privacy preservation. With interdependent values, this auction may retain efficiency, whereas the Vickrey auction suffers from a generalized Winner's Curse.

10.1257/0002828043052330.abstractZh: 当竞标者表现出多单位需求时，标准拍卖方法通常会导致低效的结果。本文提出了一种新的升价拍卖机制，适用于同类商品，例如国库券或电信频谱。拍卖师公布一个价格，竞标者则根据价格提出购买数量。物品在达到“临界数量”时以当前价格被授予，价格会逐步上升直至市场出清。在竞标者拥有私人价值的情况下，这种动态拍卖与密封投标的Vickrey拍卖结果相同，但具有简单性和隐私保护的优势。在竞标者具有相互依赖价值的情况下，这种拍卖方式可能仍然保持效率，而Vickrey拍卖则存在普遍存在的“赢家诅咒”。

abstract.text: This study clarifies the conditions under which learning in games produces convergence to Nash equilibria in practice. We experimentally investigate the role of supermodularity, which is closely related to the more familiar concept of strategic complementarities, in achieving convergence through learning. Using a game from the literature on solutions to externalities, we find that supermodular and “near-supermodular” games converge significantly better than those far below the threshold of supermodularity. From a little below the threshold to the threshold, the improvement is statistically insignificant. Increasing the parameter far beyond the threshold does not significantly improve convergence.

10.1257/0002828043052349.abstractZh: 本研究阐明了在何种条件下，游戏中的学习能够实际收敛到纳什均衡。我们通过实验研究了超模块性在促进学习收敛中的作用。超模块性与更为人熟知的策略互补性概念密切相关。利用关于外部性解决方案的文献中的游戏模型，我们发现，超模块性和“接近超模块性”的游戏比那些远未达到超模块性阈值的游戏收敛得更为显著。从略低于阈值到达到阈值的过程中，这种改进在统计上并不显著。将参数增加到远超阈值之后，并不会显著改善收敛效果。

abstract.text: This paper measures the impact of an outbreak of pediatric leukemia on local housing values. A model of location choice is used to describe conditions under which the gradient of the hedonic price function with respect to pediatric leukemia risk is equal to household marginal willingness to pay to avoid risk. This equalizing di®erential is estimated using property-level sales records from a county in Nevada where residents recently experienced a severe increase in pediatric leukemia. Housing prices are compared before and after the increase with a nearby county acting as a control group. The variation in health risk over time makes it possible to control for unobserved di®erences across locations. In addition, because many houses were sold repeatedly during the sample period it is possible to control for property-speci¯c heterogeneity. The results indicate that housing values decreased 15.6 percent during the period of maximum risk. Results are similar for di®erent measures of risk and across houses of di®erent sizes. Using lifetime estimates of risk derived from a Bayesian learning process the results imply that the statistical value of pediatric leukemia is $5.6 million. These estimates provide some of the ¯rst market-based estimates of the value of health for children.

10.1257/0002828043052358.abstractZh: 本文研究了儿童白血病爆发对当地住房价值的影响。通过选址模型来描述在儿童白血病风险下，享乐价格函数的梯度等于家庭避免风险的边际支付意愿的情况。该均衡差异是通过内华达州一个县的数据估计得出的，该县的居民最近经历了儿童白血病发病率的显著上升。文章将房价在疫情前后与邻近县进行比较，以作为对照组。由于健康风险随时间的变化，可以控制不同地点之间的未观测差异。此外，由于许多房屋在样本期间被多次出售，因此可以控制房产的特异性差异。研究结果表明，在风险最高期间，住房价值下降了15.6%。不同风险指标以及不同大小的房屋所呈现的结果相似。通过贝叶斯学习过程得出的终身风险估计表明，儿童白血病的统计价值为560万美元。这些估计提供了首批基于市场的儿童健康价值评估。

abstract.text: In human capital intensive industries where it is difficult to contract upon the training effort of skilled agents a socially suboptimal level of training may occur. We show how partnership organisations can overcome this problem by tying human and financial capital. Partnerships are opaque so that the willingness of clients to pay depends upon reputation. Partnerships are illiquid and partners must stay with the firm until clients discover their type and update the firm's reputation. This renders unskilled agents, who will aversely affect reputation, unwilling to accept partnerships. Skilled agents therefore train the next generation so as to ensure that there is an adequate market for their own shares. We comment upon the salient differences between partnerships and joint stock firms.

10.1257/0002828043052367.abstractZh: 在人力资本密集型行业中，由于难以通过培训来提升熟练人员的技能，可能会导致社会最优水平的培训不足。我们展示了如何通过结合人力和金融资本来克服这一问题。合伙企业往往缺乏透明度，因此客户是否愿意支付费用取决于声誉。合伙企业流动性较差，合作伙伴必须一直留在企业内，直到客户了解其类型并提升企业的声誉。这使得非熟练人员不愿接受合伙企业，因为他们会负面影响企业的声誉。因此，熟练人员需要培训下一代人才，以确保自己的股份有充足的市场需求。我们对合伙企业与股份制企业之间的显著差异进行了分析。

abstract.text: In this paper I suggest a unified explanation for two puzzles in the inventory literature: first, estimates of inventory speeds of adjustment in aggregate data are very small relative to the apparent rapid reaction of stocks to unanticipated variations in sales. Second, estimates of inventory speeds of adjustment in firm-level data are significantly higher than in aggregate data. The paper develops a multi-sector model where inventories are held to avoid stockouts, and price markups vary along the business cycle. The omission of countercyclical markup variations from inventory targets introduces a downward bias in estimates of adjustment speeds obtained from partial adjustment models. When the cyclicality of markups differs across sectors, this downward bias is shown to be more severe with aggregate rather than firm-level data. Similar results apply not only to inventories, but also to labor and prices. Montercarlo simulations of a calibrated version of the model suggest that these biases are quantitatively significant.

10.1257/0002828043052376.abstractZh: 在本文中，我提出了一种统一的解释，用于解决库存文献中的两个难题：首先，在总体数据中，库存调整速度的估计值非常小，这与库存对销售意外变化所表现出的快速反应形成对比。其次，在企业层面的数据中，库存调整速度的估计值明显高于总体数据。本文构建了一个多部门模型，其中库存被持有以避免缺货，且价格加成随商业周期变化。如果忽略反周期的价格加成变化对库存目标的影响，那么从部分调整模型得到的调整速度估计值会存在向下的偏差。当不同部门的加成变化存在差异时，这种向下的偏差在总体数据而非企业层面数据中更为明显。类似的结果不仅适用于库存，也适用于劳动力和价格。Montercarlo对模型校准版本的模拟表明，这些偏差在数量上具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of electoral rules and forms of government on fiscal policy outcomes in a large sample of democracies. We rely on different estimation methods to address prospective problems of statistical inference, due to nonrandom selection of these constitutional rules. The findings are consistent with our theoretical priors: presidential regimes induce smaller governments than parliamentary democracies, while majoritarian elections lead to smaller governments and smaller welfare programs than proportional elections.

10.1257/000282804322970689.abstractZh: 我们研究了选举规则和政府形式对多数民主国家财政政策结果的影响。为了应对由于宪法规则的非随机选择而导致的统计推断问题，我们采用了不同的估计方法。研究结果与我们理论预测一致：总统制政府导致的政府规模通常小于议会制政府，而多数选举方式通常会导致政府规模较小，福利项目也较少。

abstract.text: On news of a takeover, the sum of the stock market values of the firms involved often falls, and the value of the acquirer almost always does. Does this mean that takeovers do not raise the values of the firms involved? Not necessarily. We set up a model in which the equilibrium number of takeovers is constrained efficient. Yet upon news of a takeover, a target's price rises, the bidder's price falls, and most of the time the joint value of the target and acquirer also falls.

10.1257/000282804322970698.abstractZh: 在收购消息公布时，相关公司的股票市场价值通常会下降，而收购方的价值几乎总是上升。这是否意味着收购不会提升相关公司的价值呢？未必如此。我们建立了一个模型，其中收购行为的均衡数量受到效率约束。然而，在收购消息公布后，目标公司的股价会上升，收购方的股价会下降，而且大多数情况下，目标公司和收购方的联合价值也会下降。

abstract.text: What are good voting rules if voting is costly? We analyze this question for the case that an electorate chooses among two alternatives. In a symmetric private value model of voting we show that majority voting with voluntary participation Pareto-dominates majority voting with compulsory participation as well as random decision-making.

10.1257/000282804322970706.abstractZh: 如果投票成本较高，那么什么样的投票规则才是好的呢？我们分析了在选民在两个选项中做出选择的情况。在对称的私人价值投票模型中，我们证明了自愿参与的多数投票方式优于强制参与的多数投票方式，同时也优于随机决策方式。

abstract.text: This paper examines how factor proportions determine the structure of commodity trade. It integrates a many-country version of a Heckscher-Ohlin model with a continuum of goods with Paul R. Krugman's (1980) model of monopolistic competition and transport costs. The commodity structure of production and bilateral trade is fully determined. Two main predictions emerge. Countries capture larger shares of world production and trade of commodities that more intensively use their abundant factors. Countries that rapidly accumulate a factor see their production and export structures systematically shift towards industries that intensively use that factor. Both predictions receive support from detailed trade data.

10.1257/000282804322970715.abstractZh: 本文探讨了要素比例如何决定商品贸易的结构。它整合了Heckscher-Ohlin模型的多国版本、Paul R. Krugman（1980年）提出的垄断竞争模型以及运输成本因素，形成了完整的分析框架。商品生产和双边贸易的结构被完全确定。本文提出了两个主要预测：各国会更多地参与那些能够更充分利用其丰富要素的商品生产和贸易；那些迅速积累某种要素的国家，其生产和出口结构会系统性地转向那些大量使用该要素的行业。这两个预测都得到了详细贸易数据的支持。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect on international trade of multilateral trade agreements—the World Trade Organization (WTO), its predecessor the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), and the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) extended from rich countries to developing countries. I use a standard “gravity” model of bilateral merchandise trade and a large panel data set covering over 50 years and 175 countries. An extensive search reveals little evidence that countries joining or belonging to the GATT/WTO have different trade patterns from outsiders, though the GSP seems to have a strong effect.

10.1257/000282804322970724.abstractZh: 本文估计了多边贸易协定对国际贸易的影响，包括世界贸易组织（WTO）及其前身关税与贸易总协定（GATT），以及从富裕国家扩展到发展中国家的普遍优惠制（GSP）。本文采用了标准的双边商品贸易“引力模型”，并使用了涵盖50多年、175个国家的庞大面板数据集。广泛的调查显示，加入或属于GATT/WTO的国家与外来者相比，其贸易模式几乎没有差异，不过普遍优惠制似乎具有显著的影响。

abstract.text: An important challenge in the crime literature is to isolate causal effects of police on crime. Following a terrorist attack on the main Jewish center in Buenos Aires, Argentina, in July 1994, all Jewish institutions received police protection. Thus, this hideous event induced a geographical allocation of police forces that can be presumed exogenous in a crime regression. Using data on the location of car thefts before and after the attack, we find a large deterrent effect of observable police on crime. The effect is local, with no appreciable impact outside the narrow area in which the police are deployed.

10.1257/000282804322970733.abstractZh: 犯罪学领域的一个重要挑战是分离出警察对犯罪行为的因果效应。1994年7月，阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯的主要犹太中心遭受恐怖袭击后，所有犹太机构都获得了警察的保护。因此，这一可怕事件导致了警察力量的地理分配，这种分配可以被认为是犯罪回归过程中的外生因素。通过对比袭击前后汽车盗窃案件的位置数据，我们发现警察对犯罪行为的威慑作用非常显著。这种效应是局部的，在警察部署的狭窄区域内没有显著的影响。

abstract.text: Antidumping (AD) trade protection policies allow government agencies to recalculate AD duties based on foreign firms' most recent pricing behavior. We examine the resulting dynamic pricing problem of a foreign firm facing such policy. We show that the expected pattern of AD duty recalculations over time crucially depends on the foreign firm's ex ante expectations of possible outcomes of AD policy enforcement. Our empirical analysis then confirms the role of ex ante expectations in explaining observed patterns of AD recalculations. Many of our model's results are applicable to other situations where enforcement of policy is tied to the subject's behavior.

10.1257/000282804322970742.abstractZh: 反倾销贸易保护政策允许政府机构根据外国企业的最新定价行为重新计算反倾销关税。我们研究了在这种政策下外国企业面临的动态定价问题。我们发现，反倾销关税重新计算的预期模式在很大程度上取决于外国企业对反倾销政策执行可能结果的预期。我们的实证分析进一步证实了预期在解释反倾销关税重新计算模式中的作用。我们模型的许多结果适用于其他政策执行与主体行为相关的情形。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of education on participation in criminal activity using changes in state compulsory schooling laws over time to account for the endogeneity of schooling decisions. Using Census and FBI data, we find that schooling significantly reduces the probability of incarceration and arrest. NLSY data indicate that our results are caused by changes in criminal behavior and not differences in the probability of arrest or incarceration conditional on crime. We estimate that the social savings from crime reduction associated with high school graduation (for men) is about 14–26 percent of the private return.

10.1257/000282804322970751.abstractZh: 我们通过分析州强制教育法律随时间的变化，来估计教育对参与犯罪活动的影响，以解释教育决策的内生性。利用人口普查和联邦调查局的数据，我们发现教育显著降低了监禁和被捕的概率。NLSY数据显示，我们的结果是由犯罪行为的变化引起的，而不是基于犯罪行为的被捕或监禁概率的差异。我们估计，与高中毕业相关的犯罪减少所带来的社会收益（对于男性而言）约为私人收益的14%至26%。

abstract.text: This paper considers a prototypical New Keynesian model, in which the equilibrium is undetermined if monetary policy is “passive.” The likelihood-based estimation of dynamic equilibrium models is extended to allow for indeterminacies and sunspot fluctuations. We construct posterior weights for the determinacy and indeterminacy region of the parameter space and estimates for the propagation of fundamental and sunspot shocks. According to the estimated model, U.S. monetary policy post-1982 is consistent with determinacy, whereas the pre-Volcker policy is not. We find that before 1979 indeterminacy substantially altered the propagation of shocks.

10.1257/000282804322970760.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一个典型的新凯恩斯主义模型，在该模型中，如果货币政策是“被动的”，则均衡是不确定的。基于似然的动态均衡模型估计方法被扩展以考虑不确定性和太阳黑子波动的影响。我们为参数空间中的确定性和不确定性区域构建了后验权重，并估计了基本冲击和太阳黑子冲击的传播情况。根据估计模型，1982年之后的美国货币政策与确定性一致，而Volcker之前的政策则不然。我们发现，在1979年之前，不确定性显著改变了冲击的传播方式。

abstract.text: Using the December 1998 and August 2000 CPS Computer and Internet Supplements matched with subsequent CPS files, we ask which types of unemployed workers looked for work on line and whether Internet searchers became reemployed more quickly. In our data, Internet searchers have observed characteristics that are typically associated with shorter unemployment spells, and do spend less time unemployed. This unemployment differential is however eliminated and in some cases reversed when we hold observable characteristics constant. We conclude that either Internet job search is ineffective in reducing unemployment durations, or Internet job searchers are negatively selected on unobservables.

10.1257/000282804322970779.abstractZh: 我们利用1998年12月和2000年8月的CPS计算机和互联网补充数据，以及后续的CPS文件，来研究哪些类型的失业者通过互联网寻找工作，以及使用互联网搜索的失业者是否更快速地重新就业。我们的数据显示，使用互联网搜索的失业者具有一些通常与较短失业期相关的特征，并且他们失业的时间确实较短。然而，当我们保持其他可观测特征不变时，这种失业差异被消除，在某些情况下甚至逆转。我们得出结论：要么互联网求职在缩短失业持续时间方面无效，要么使用互联网求职的失业者在不可观测特征上存在负面选择效应。

abstract.text: This paper utilizes a plausibly exogenous source of variation in housing assistance generated by public housing demolitions in Chicago to examine the impact of high-rise public housing on student outcomes. I find that children in households affected by the demolitions do no better or worse than their peers on a wide variety of achievement measures. Because the majority of households that leave high-rise public housing in response to the demolitions move to neighborhoods and schools that closely resemble those they left, the zero effect of the demolitions may be interpreted as the independent impact of public housing.

10.1257/000282804322970788.abstractZh: 本文利用芝加哥公共住房拆除所引发的住房援助变化这一可能外生的变量来源，来研究高层公共住房对学生学业成绩的影响。研究发现，受拆除影响的家庭中的孩子，在多种学业表现指标上并没有比同龄人表现得更好或更差。由于大多数因拆除而离开高层公共住房的家庭，会搬入与他们原来居住的地方相似的社区和学校，因此拆除对这些孩子的影响可能被视为公共住房本身对学业成绩的影响。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes Pareto-efficient international tax regimes. Because every country faces its own national budget constraint, the Diamond-Mirrlees production-efficiency theorem, which underlies key tenets of policy advice in international taxation—the desirability of destination basis for commodity taxation, of the residence principle for capital income taxation, and of free trade—does not apply. The paper establishes conditions—relating to the availability of explicit or implicit devices for reallocating tax revenues across countries—under which production efficiency is nevertheless desirable, and characterizes the precise ways in which Pareto-efficient international taxation may require violation of established tenets.

10.1257/000282804322970797.abstractZh: 本文分析了帕累托效率高的国际税收制度。由于每个国家都面临自身的预算限制，因此Diamond-Mirrlees生产效率定理——该理论是国际税收政策建议中的关键原则的基础——并不适用于商品税收的目的地原则、资本收入税收的居住地原则以及自由贸易理念。本文探讨了在哪些条件下，尽管存在预算限制，生产效率仍然具有吸引力，并描述了帕累托效率高的国际税收制度可能要求违反既定原则的具体方式。

10.1257/000282804322970814.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，跨国销售的增长速度非常快，远远超过了制造业贸易的显著扩张。因此，贸易文献试图将进入外国市场的模式纳入“新”贸易理论中。这些文献认识到，企业可以通过多种渠道为外国买家服务：他们可以将产品出口给外国客户，通过外国子公司为这些客户提供服务，或者授权外国公司生产他们的产品。我们的研究重点在于企业选择出口还是进行“横向”外国直接投资。所谓“横向”外国直接投资，指的是对国外生产设施的投资。

abstract.text: The primary bargaining power of organized labor is its ability to withdraw labor from the rm in the form of a strike. From the workers’ perspective, a strike is intended to impose sub-stantial costs upon the rm. Over time, as these costs accumulate, the rm develops an appreci-ation of the solidarity of labor and may eventu-ally surrender to the demands of the workers.

10.1257/000282804322970841.abstractZh: 有组织劳工的主要谈判力量在于其以罢工的形式将劳动力从企业中撤出的能力。从工人的角度来看，罢工的目的是给企业带来巨大的成本。随着时间的推移，这些成本不断累积，企业会逐渐认识到工人的团结性，并最终可能屈服于工人的要求。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of parental schooling on the child¿s schooling and uses adoptees to get rid of persistency effects caused by the parents¿ genes. The results indicate that, especially for mothers, inherited abilities and assortative mating play an important role in the intergenerational transmission of schooling. In fact, for adoptees I found no treatment effect for the mother¿s schooling, conditional on her husband¿s schooling. It should be noted, however, that the WLS data on adoptees and their parents do not possess the properties of a clean and well-de¿ ned experiment, and that obtained results require a careful interpretation. There are two potential dangers to an adoption experiment. First, adoptees and adoptive parents are different from other children and their parents. This argument suggests that my maternal schooling estimates may be biased and suffer from omitted variables, but I have little indication of what these might be. The sensitivity analysis ruled out a number of plausible candidates. Second, adoptees are not always randomly assigned to their adoptive parents. This argument suggests that a portion of what is interpreted as the impact of the parent¿s schooling may in fact be genetic. With respect to paternal schooling estimates there is some merit to this view. However, with respect to the estimated maternal effect it is not. Nonrandom assignment and corresponding upward bias form no danger when interpreting the absence of maternal schooling effects. In all, these results, in combination with the parallel finndings of Behrman and Rosenzweig (2002) using twins, support the idea that the positive influence of mother¿s schooling on that of her child disappears when heritable abilities and assortative mating are taken into account.

10.1257/000282804322970850.abstractZh: 本文探讨了父母教育水平对孩子教育水平的影响，并通过收养儿童来消除由父母基因引起的持续性效应。研究结果表明，特别是对于母亲而言，遗传能力和选择性交配在代际教育传递中起着重要作用。实际上，在收养儿童的研究中，我发现母亲的受教育水平对其子女的教育水平并没有显著影响，前提是父亲的受教育水平已知。不过需要注意的是，关于收养儿童及其父母的数据并不具备一个干净且定义明确的实验数据所具有的特性，因此所得结果需要谨慎解读。收养实验存在两个潜在的风险。首先，收养儿童和养父母与其他孩子及其父母不同。这一论点表明，我对母亲教育水平的估计可能存在偏差，并受到遗漏变量的影响，但我几乎没有证据表明这些变量是什么。敏感性分析排除了一些可能的候选变量。其次，收养儿童并不总是被随机分配到他们的养父母那里。这一论点表明，被解释为父母教育水平影响的某些因素实际上可能是遗传的。对于父亲教育水平的估计，这一观点有一定的合理性。然而，对于母亲教育水平的估计则不然。当考虑到非随机分配和相应的向上偏差时，解释缺乏母亲教育水平的影响并不构成危险。总的来说，这些结果，结合Behrman和Rosenzweig（2002）使用双胞胎进行的研究结果，支持了这样一个观点：当考虑到遗传能力和选择性交配时，母亲教育对孩子教育水平的积极影响会消失。

abstract.text: Scale economy in the construction and operation of public facilities, such as landfills, calls for cooperation among communities to build a common facility (Arthur O’Sullivan, 1993). Such a facility is a mixture of a public good and a private bad and, hence, leads to strong opposition by communities to locate it in their vicinity (Bruno S. Frey et al., 1996). This is one of the most serious environmental concerns of recent years, and is known as NIMBY: “not in my backyard.” In this paper we study the hypothesis that a democratic political process creates an adequate mechanism for the resolution of the NIMBY conflict. The intuitive explanation is simple. A NIMBY conflict is likely to induce lobbying and symmetric pressures by all threatened communities in the relevant region. As is well known (Gene M. Grossman and Elhanan Helpman, 1994), when subject to symmetric pressures, politicians stick firmly to principles and function most efficiently. The existing literature on the siting of noxious facilities focuses mainly on normative issues, such as welfare-maximizing siting via decentralized community-based mechanisms (e.g., Howard Kunreuther and Paul R. Kleindorfer, 1986; Robert C. Mitchell and Richard T. Carson, 1986; and Deborah Minehart and Zvika Neeman, 2002). Evidently, however, such mechanisms have seldom been practiced (e.g., Stephen K. Swallow et al., 1992). The current study adopts a positive approach, integrating a political-economic framework with a model of a competitive real estate market. In the theoretical section, a government of a linear two-city economy determines the location of a noxious facility, which affects the equilibrium in the real estate market and induces the spatial distributions of price and population. The government is subject to political pressures by city-level lobbies of landowners (both landlords and home owners). In general, the political equilibrium and the socially optimal siting differ. However, the more equitable the distribution of landownership in the region, the smaller the difference. At the limit, when property distribution is perfectly equitable and all cities participate in the political arena, the government locates the facility at the socially optimal site. The analysis proceeds by identifying additional conditions under which the political equilibrium siting coincides with the socially optimal location and, with an empirical analysis. In the empirical section, the theoretical framework is extended to account for a multiple-city region, and is calibrated to assess the prospects of the political system for resolving the NIMBY conflict in the context of landfill-siting in Israel. It is shown that if all cities in the region form political lobbies and the politicians are not extremely corrupt, the political siting is close geographically to the socially optimal location, and the difference entails a less than 0.1 percent reduction in social welfare. Moreover, even if the formation of lobbying in the region is incomplete, as long as the weight the politicians assign to social welfare is larger than 0.7, the proximity of the politically and socially optimal locations is preserved. We interpret the above results as supportive of the hypothesis of an effective political solution to the NIMBY conflict.

10.1257/000282804322970869.abstractZh: 在公共设施的建设和运营中，如垃圾填埋场，规模经济要求社区之间合作，共同建设公共设施（Arthur O’Sullivan，1993）。这种公共设施既具有公共物品的特性，又具有私人物品的负面效应，因此会引发社区强烈的反对，不愿将其建在自家附近（Bruno S. Frey等，1996）。这是近年来最严重的环境问题之一，被称为NIMBY现象：“不要在我家后院”。本文研究了一个假设，即民主政治机制能够为解决NIMBY冲突提供有效的机制。直观的解释是，NIMBY冲突可能会引发相关区域内所有受威胁社区的游说和对称压力。正如Gene M. Grossman和Elhanan Helpman所提出的，当受到对称压力时，政治家会坚定地遵循原则，并发挥最有效的作用。关于有害设施选址的现有文献主要关注规范性问题，例如通过分散的社区机制来最大化福利的选址问题（例如，Howard Kunreuther和Paul R. Kleindorfer，1986；Robert C. Mitchell和Richard T. Carson，1986；Deborah Minehart和Zvika Neeman，2002）。然而，显然，这些机制很少被实际实施（例如，Stephen K. Swallow等，1992）。本研究采用积极的方法，将政治-经济框架与竞争性房地产市场模型相结合。在理论部分，一个线性双城市经济中的政府决定了有害设施的位置，这会影响房地产市场的均衡，并导致价格和人口的地理分布。政府受到城市层面土地所有者（包括房东和房主）政治压力的制约。总体而言，政治均衡与社会最优选址之间存在差异。然而，地区内土地所有权的分配越公平，这种差异就越小。在极端情况下，当财产分配完全公平且所有城市都参与政治活动时，政府会将设施建在社会最优位置。分析进一步探讨了政治均衡选址与社会最优位置一致的其他条件，并通过实证分析进行了验证。在实证部分，理论框架被扩展以适用于多城市地区，并用于评估以色列垃圾填埋场选址背景下政治体系解决NIMBY冲突的可能性。研究表明，如果该地区所有城市都形成政治联盟，且政客并非极度腐败，那么政治选址在地理上接近社会最优位置，这种差异导致的社会福利减少幅度小于0.1%。此外，即使地区内的游说活动尚未完全形成，只要政客对社会福利的重视程度超过0.7，政治和社会最优位置之间的接近性就能得到保持。我们将上述结果解释为支持“有效的政治解决方案能够解决NIMBY冲突”这一假设的证据。

abstract.text: Variation in use of health care is ubiquitous in the United States. It is attributable to exogenous differences in supply of medical resources; to identified and unidentified economic, social, and cultural factors; and to the idiosyncratic beliefs of physicians. It is perpetuated by the parochial character of much clinical practice. Patients in high-intensity areas do not appear to have better health outcomes: Much care is "flat of the curve." A more robust scientific foundation for clinical decisions could help to reduce variations, but major reform of health care financing is probably necessary to achieve substantial improvement in the organization and delivery of care.
