10.1377/hlthaff.var.104.abstractZh: 在美国，医疗保健的使用差异普遍存在。这种差异可归因于医疗资源供应的外部差异、已识别或未识别的经济、社会和文化因素，以及医生的独特观念。这种差异还因许多临床实践的狭隘性而得以延续。在医疗资源较为紧张的地区，患者的健康结果似乎并不更好：许多医疗服务的质量相当低下。为临床决策提供更坚实的科学基础有助于减少这些差异，但可能需要对医疗保健的融资方式进行重大改革，才能显著改善医疗保健的组织和提供方式。

abstract.text: Recent studies have revealed dramatic differences among academic medical centers (AMCs) in the quantity of care provided to their patients. The implications, however, depend upon whether the additional resources provided by some centers lead to better results. This study describes the content, quality, and outcomes of care across AMCs that differ by up to 60 percent in the overall intensity of medical services delivered to patients with serious chronic illnesses. Efforts to reduce costs will require attention to supply-sensitive services (the frequency of hospital stays, physician visits, specialist consultations, diagnostic tests, and minor procedures) and should include a focus on the longitudinal efficiency of hospitals and medical staffs.

10.1377/hlthaff.var.19.abstractZh: 最近的研究发现，不同学术医疗中心在为患者提供的护理数量上存在显著差异。然而，这些差异是否具有实际意义，取决于某些中心提供的额外资源是否确实能带来更好的治疗效果。本研究描述了那些在为患者提供医疗服务的整体强度上相差高达60%的不同学术医疗中心的护理内容、质量及治疗效果。为了降低成本，需要关注那些对供应敏感的医疗服务（如住院频率、医生就诊次数、专科咨询、诊断测试以及小型手术等），并应重视医院和医务人员的长期效率。

abstract.text: The quality of care received by Medicare beneficiaries varies across areas. We find that states with higher Medicare spending have lower-quality care. This negative relationship may be driven by the use of intensive, costly care that crowds out the use of more effective care. One mechanism for this trade-off may be the mix of the provider workforce: States with more general practitioners use more effective care and have lower spending, while those with more specialists have higher costs and lower quality. Improving the quality of beneficiaries' care could be accomplished with more effective use of existing dollars.

10.1377/hlthaff.w4.184.abstractZh: 医疗保险受益人所接受的护理质量在不同地区存在差异。我们发现，医疗保险支出较高的州，其护理质量较低。这种负相关关系可能是由于使用了更为昂贵且强度较高的护理服务，从而挤占了更有效的护理服务的使用。这种权衡的一种机制可能是医疗服务提供者的构成：拥有更多全科医生的州能够提供更有效的护理，并且支出较低；而拥有更多专科医生的州则成本较高，护理质量也较低。提高受益人护理的质量可以通过更有效地使用现有资金来实现。

abstract.text: This paper develops a life-cycle model in which workers choose both consumption levels and job fatality risks, implying that the effect of age on the value of life is ambiguous. The empirical analysis of this relationship uses novel, age-dependent fatal and nonfatal risk variables. Workers' value of statistical life exhibits an inverted U-shaped relationship over workers' life cycle based on hedonic wage model estimates, age-specific hedonic wage estimates, and a minimum distance estimator. The value of statistical life for a 60-year old ranges from $2.5 million to $3.0 million -- less than half the value for 30 to 40-year olds.

10.3386/w10199.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个生命周期模型，其中劳动者同时选择消费水平和工作死亡风险，这意味着年龄对生命价值的影响具有双重性。对这种关系的实证分析采用了新的、与年龄相关的死亡和非死亡风险变量。根据享乐工资模型估计、特定年龄的享乐工资估计以及最小距离估计方法，劳动者的统计生命价值在其生命周期内呈现倒U形关系。对于60岁的劳动者而言，其统计生命价值在250万到300万美元之间——这不到30至40岁劳动者的生命价值的一半。

abstract.text: We seek to investigate whether managed health care can affect mortality, and if so, through which mechanisms. We estimate the impact of Medicare+Choice (M+C), Medicare's managed care program, on elderly mortality, using a county-level panel from 1993 to 2000. We control for endogenous M+C penetration rates with county fixed effects and instrumental variables. We construct instruments using the identification created by the fact that M+C payment rates are based on 3 to 8 year lagged fee-for-service (FFS) costs in the county. We find that enrollment in managed care without prescription drug coverage significantly increases mortality while enrollment in managed care with drug coverage has no significant impact, both relative to FFS. The impact of managed care penetration on mortality from heart disease appears to follow a similar pattern. The estimates suggest that a 10-percentage point increase in M+C non-drug coverage would cause 51,000 additional deaths among the aged population in 2000.

10.3386/w10204.abstractZh: 我们旨在研究管理式医疗保健是否会影响死亡率，如果会，是通过哪些机制。我们利用1993至2000年的县级面板数据，估算了Medicare+Choice（M+C）这一管理式医疗保健计划对老年人死亡率的影响。我们通过县级固定效应和工具变量来控制M+C渗透率内生变化的影响。我们基于M+C的支付率与县级内3至8年滞后期的传统付费服务（FFS）成本之间的关系，构建工具变量。研究发现，在没有处方药覆盖的管理式医疗保健中，参保人数增加会显著导致死亡率上升，而在有药物覆盖的管理式医疗保健中，参保人数增加则没有显著影响。管理式医疗保健的普及对心脏病死亡率的影响似乎也遵循类似的模式。估计结果显示，如果M+C的非药物覆盖范围增加10个百分点，将导致2000年老年人口额外增加51,000例死亡。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to investigate the impact of the length of maternity leave on maternal health in a sample of working mothers. Two measures of depression and a measure of overall health are used to represent maternal health. Ordinary Least Squares models provide baseline estimates, and instrumental variables models account for the potential endogeneity of the return-to-work decision. The findings suggest that returning to work later may reduce the number or frequency of depressive symptoms, but the length of time before returning to work is not associated with a lower probability of being a likely case of clinical depression. Similarly, there is little evidence that longer maternity leave impacts physical and mental health as measured by frequent outpatient visits during the first six months after childbirth.

10.3386/w10206.abstractZh: 本文旨在研究产假时长对在职母亲健康的影响。研究采用抑郁程度指标和整体健康指标来衡量母亲的健康状况。普通最小二乘法模型提供了基线估计值，而工具变量模型则考虑了重返工作岗位决策可能存在的内生性。研究结果表明，推迟重返工作岗位可能会减少抑郁症状的发生次数，但重返工作岗位前的时长与临床抑郁症发生的概率并无关联。同样，也没有证据表明较长的产假会对母亲在产后六个月内频繁就诊的身心健康产生显著影响。

abstract.text: As part of welfare reform efforts in the 1990s, twenty-three states implemented family caps, provisions that deny or reduce cash assistance to welfare recipients who have additional births. We use birth and abortion records from 24 states to estimate effects of family caps on birth and abortion rates. We use age, marital status and completed schooling to identify women at high risk for use of public assistance, and parity (number of previous live births) to identify those most directly affected by the family cap. In family cap states, birth rates fell more and abortion rates rose more among high-risk women with at least one previous live birth compared to similar childless women, consistent with an effect of the family cap. However, this parity-specific pattern of births and abortions also occurred in states that implemented welfare reform with no family cap. Thus, the effects of welfare reform may have differed between mothers and childless women, but there is little evidence of an independent effect of the family cap.

10.3386/w10214.abstractZh: 作为20世纪90年代福利改革的一部分，有23个州实施了家庭限额制度，该制度拒绝或减少向有额外新生儿的福利领取者提供的现金援助。我们利用24个州的出生和堕胎记录来估算家庭限额对出生率和堕胎率的影响。我们通过年龄、婚姻状况和教育程度来识别使用公共援助的高风险女性，并通过生育次数来识别受家庭限额直接影响的人群。在实行家庭限额的州中，至少有一次活产的高风险女性，其出生率下降幅度更大，堕胎率上升幅度也更大，这与家庭限额的影响一致。然而，这种基于生育次数的出生和堕胎模式也出现在没有实施家庭限额的福利改革实施州中。因此，福利改革的影响可能在母亲和无子女女性之间有所不同，但几乎没有证据表明家庭限额本身具有独立的效应。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of air pollution on infant death in California over the 1990s. Our work offers several innovations: First, many previous studies examine populations subject to far greater levels of pollution. In contrast, the experience of California in the 1990s is clearly relevant to current debates over the regulation of pollution. Second, many studies examine a few routinely monitored pollutants in isolation, generally because of data limitations. We examine four criteria' pollutants in a common framework. Third, we develop an identification strategy based on within zip code variation in pollution levels that controls for potentially important unobserved characteristics of high pollution areas. Fourth, we use rich individual-level data to investigate effects of pollution on infant mortality, fetal deaths, low birth weight and prematurity in a common framework. We find that the reductions in carbon monoxide (CO) and particulates (PM10) over the 1990s in California saved over 1,000 infant lives. However, we find little consistent evidence of pollution effects on fetal deaths, low birth weight or short gestation.

10.3386/w10251.abstractZh: 我们研究了1990年代空气污染对加利福尼亚州婴儿死亡的影响。我们的研究具有几项创新之处：首先，许多先前的研究关注的是受到更高污染水平影响的人群。相比之下，1990年代加利福尼亚州的经历显然与当前关于污染监管的争论密切相关。其次，许多研究仅单独考察少数常规监测的污染物，这通常是由于数据限制所致。我们采用一个共同的框架来考察四种标准污染物。第三，我们基于各邮政编码区污染水平的差异，开发了一种识别策略，以控制高污染地区可能重要的未观测特征。第四，我们利用丰富的个体级数据，在一个共同的框架内研究污染对婴儿死亡率、胎儿死亡、低出生体重和早产的影响。我们发现，1990年代加利福尼亚州一氧化碳和颗粒物浓度的降低挽救了超过1000名婴儿的生命。然而，我们发现几乎没有一致的证据表明污染对胎儿死亡、低出生体重或短妊娠期有显著影响。

abstract.text: Our research examines empirically the age pattern of the implicit value of life revealed from workers' differential wages and job safety pairings. Although aging reduces the number of years of life expectancy, aging can affect the value of life through an effect on planned life-cycle consumption. The elderly could, a priori, have the highest implicit value of life if there is a life-cycle plan to defer consumption until old age. We find that largely due to the age pattern of consumption, which is non-constant, the implicit value of life rises and falls over the lifetime in a way that the value for the elderly is higher than the average over all ages or for the young. There are important policy implications of our empirical results. Because there may be age-specific benefits of programs to save statistical lives, instead of valuing the lives of the elderly at less than the young, policymakers should more correctly value the lives of the elderly at as much as twice the young because of relatively greater consumption lost when accidental death occurs.

10.3386/w10266.abstractZh: 我们的研究通过实证分析，探讨了工人差异化的工资与工作安全状况所反映的隐含生命价值的年龄模式。虽然老龄化会减少预期寿命，但它可以通过影响生命周期消费计划来影响生命的价值。如果人们有将消费推迟到老年阶段的生命周期规划，那么老年人可能具有最高的隐含生命价值。我们发现，由于消费模式的非恒定性，隐含生命价值在生命过程中会有所上升或下降，老年人的价值高于所有年龄段的均值或年轻人的价值。我们的实证结果具有重要的政策意义。因为针对特定年龄段的储蓄计划可能具有积极效果，因此政策制定者不应低估老年人的价值，而应将其价值视为年轻人的两倍，因为意外死亡会导致相对更大的消费损失。

abstract.text: Longitudinal studies support the proposition that the extent and severity of chronic conditions in middle and late ages are to a large extent the outcome of environmental insults at early ages, including in utero. Data from the Early Indicators program project undertaken at the Center for Population Economics suggest that the range of differences in exposure to disease has narrowed greatly over the course of the twentieth century, that age-specific prevalence rates of chronic diseases were much lower at the end of the twentieth century than they were at the beginning of the last century or during the last half of the nineteenth century, and that there has been a significant delay in the onset of chronic diseases over the course of the twentieth century. These trends appear to be related to changes in levels of environmental hazards and in body size. These findings have led investigators to posit a synergism between technological and physiological improvements. This synergism has contributed to reductions in inequality in real income, body size, and life expectancy during the twentieth century.

10.3386/w10311.abstractZh: 纵向研究支持这样一种观点，即中年和老年时期慢性疾病的程度和严重程度在很大程度上是由早年环境因素的影响造成的，包括在子宫内受到的伤害。来自人口经济中心开展的早期指标项目的数据表明，在二十世纪期间，疾病暴露的差异显著缩小；二十世纪末，慢性疾病的年龄特异性发病率比上个世纪初或十九世纪后半期要低得多；此外，二十世纪期间慢性疾病的发病时间也出现了显著延迟。这些趋势似乎与环境危害水平及身体大小的变化有关。这些发现促使研究者提出技术和生理方面的改进之间存在协同作用。这种协同作用有助于在二十世纪期间减少实际收入、身体大小以及预期寿命方面的不平等现象。

abstract.text: The history of foreign development assistance is one of movement away from addressing immediate needs and toward focusing on the underlying causes of poverty. A recent manifestation is the move towards sustainability,' which stresses community mobilization, education, and cost-recovery. This stands in contrast to the traditional economic analysis of development projects, with its focus on providing public goods and correcting externalities. We examine evidence from randomized evaluations on strategies for combating intestinal worms, which affect one in four people worldwide. Providing medicine to treat worms was extremely cost effective, although medicine must be provided twice per year indefinitely to keep children worm-free. An effort to promote sustainability by educating Kenyan schoolchildren on worm prevention was ineffective, and a mobilization' intervention from psychology failed to boost deworming drug take-up. Take-up was highly sensitive to drug cost: a small increase in cost led to an 80 percent reduction in take-up (relative to free treatment). The results suggest that, in the context we examine, the pursuit of sustainability may be an illusion, and that in the short-run, at least, external subsidies will remain necessary.

10.3386/w10324.abstractZh: 外国发展援助的历史是从解决即时需求转向关注贫困的根本原因。最近的一个表现是向可持续性的转变，这强调社区动员、教育和成本回收。这与传统的发展项目经济分析形成对比，后者侧重于提供公共物品和纠正外部性。我们研究了针对影响全球四分之一人口的肠道蠕虫病的随机评估结果。提供治疗蠕虫的药物在成本效益方面非常显著，尽管必须每年两次无限期地提供药物以保持儿童免受蠕虫侵害。通过教育肯尼亚学童预防蠕虫来推动可持续性并未取得成效，而心理学方面的动员干预也未能提高蠕虫药物的采用率。药物采用率对成本非常敏感：成本略有增加就会导致采用率下降80%（相对于免费治疗）。结果表明，在我们研究的背景下，追求可持续性可能是一种幻觉，至少在短期内，外部补贴仍然是必要的。

abstract.text: Only about one third of the approximately 80 drugs currently used to treat cancer had been approved when the war on cancer was declared in 1971. We assess the contribution of pharmaceutical innovation to the increase in cancer survival rates in a differences in differences' framework, by estimating models of cancer mortality rates using longitudinal, annual, cancer-site-level data based on records of 2.1 million people diagnosed with cancer during the period 1975-1995. We control for fixed cancer site effects, fixed year effects, incidence, stage distribution of diagnosed patients, mean age at diagnosis, and surgery and radiation treatment rates. Cancers for which the stock of drugs increased more rapidly tended to have greater increases in survival rates. The increase in the stock of drugs accounted for about 50-60% of the increase in age-adjusted survival rates in the first 6 years after diagnosis. New cancer drugs increased the life expectancy of people diagnosed with cancer by about one year from 1975 to 1995. The estimated cost to achieve the additional year of life per person diagnosed with cancer below $3000 is well below recent estimates of the value of a statistical life-year. Since the lifetime risk of being diagnosed with cancer is about 40%, the estimates imply that new cancer drugs accounted for 10.7% of the overall increase in U.S. life expectancy at birth.

10.3386/w10328.abstractZh: 在1971年宣布抗癌战争时，目前用于治疗癌症的约80种药物中，只有大约三分之一获得了批准。我们通过使用基于1975年至1995年间被诊断出癌症的210万人的纵向、年度、癌症部位级数据，建立癌症死亡率模型，以“差异中的差异”框架评估药品创新对提高癌症生存率的影响。我们控制了固定的癌症部位效应、固定的年份效应、发病率、被诊断患者的分期分布、诊断时的平均年龄以及手术和放射治疗率。药物存量增长较快的癌症类型，其生存率的增长幅度也更大。在诊断后的前6年里，药物存量的增加约占年龄调整后生存率增长的50-60%。新的癌症药物使被诊断出癌症的人的预期寿命从1975年到1995年增加了约一年。每被诊断出癌症的人额外一年的预期寿命，其估计成本低于最近对统计生命年价值的估计。由于被诊断出癌症的终生风险约为40%，这些估计表明，新的癌症药物占美国出生人口预期寿命整体增长的10.7%。

abstract.text: Self-control devices, such as rehabilitation programs, group commitment, and informal fines, can make time-inconsistent smokers better off. Health economists have used this result to argue in favor of cigarette taxes that restrain smoking. However, taxes alone are not Pareto-improving overall, because they benefit today's smoker at the expense of her future selves, who have less demand for self-control. We suggest an alternative class of taxation policies that provide selfcontrol and benefit a smoker at every point in life. Smokers could be allowed to purchase smoking licenses' when they start to smoke, and in exchange commit their future selves to face compensated cigarette taxes. We show that this scheme which could be made voluntary improves the welfare of current and future smokers, generates positive revenue for the government, and can be made incentive-compatible. Similar schemes can also be envisioned to address problems of timeinconsistency in other contexts.

10.3386/w10345.abstractZh: 自我控制措施，如康复计划、团体承诺和非正式罚款，可以提升时间不一致性吸烟者的情况。健康经济学家利用这一结果来支持对香烟征税以限制吸烟的论点。然而，仅靠税收并不能实现帕累托改进，因为税收会惠及当前的吸烟者，而牺牲他们未来自我对自我控制的追求。我们提出了另一类税收政策，这种政策既能提供自我控制，又能使吸烟者在人生的每个阶段都受益。吸烟者可以在开始吸烟时购买吸烟许可证，并承诺未来自我承担补偿性的香烟税。我们证明，这种可以自愿实施的方案能够提升当前和未来吸烟者的福利，为政府带来正收益，并且能够实现激励相容性。类似的方案也可以用于解决其他情境下的时间不一致性问题。

abstract.text: We use the increases in health insurance coverage at age 65 generated by the rules of the Medicare program to evaluate the effects of health insurance coverage on health related behaviors and outcomes. The rise in overall coverage at age 65 is accompanied by a narrowing of disparities across race and education groups. Groups with bigger increases in coverage at 65 experience bigger reductions in the probability of delaying or not receiving medical care, and bigger increases in the probability of routine doctor visits. Hospital discharge records also show large increases in admission rates at age 65, especially for elective procedures like bypass surgery and joint replacement. The rises in hospitalization are bigger for whites than blacks, and for residents of areas with higher rates of insurance coverage prior to age 65, suggesting that the gains arise because of the relative generosity of Medicare, rather than the availability of insurance coverage. Finally, there are small impacts of reaching age 65 on self-reported health, with the largest gains among the groups that experience the largest gains in insurance coverage. In contrast we find no evidence of a shift in the rate of growth of mortality rates at age 65.

10.3386/w10365.abstractZh: 我们利用医疗保险制度在65岁时增加的医疗保险覆盖情况，来评估医疗保险覆盖对健康相关行为和结果的影响。65岁时整体覆盖率的上升伴随着种族和教育群体之间差异的缩小。在65岁时医疗保险覆盖增加幅度较大的群体，推迟就医或不接受医疗护理的概率下降幅度更大，而定期看医生的频率则有所上升。医院出院记录也显示，65岁时的住院率大幅增加，尤其是像搭桥手术和关节置换这样的选择性手术。白人的住院率上升幅度大于黑人，而在65岁之前医疗保险覆盖率较高的地区的居民，其住院率上升幅度也更大，这表明这些改善是由于医疗保险的相对慷慨性，而非保险覆盖的可用性。最后，达到65岁对自我报告的健康状况几乎没有影响，其中医疗保险覆盖增加幅度最大的群体受益最大。相比之下，我们没有发现65岁时死亡率增长率出现变化的证据。

abstract.text: It is generally assumed that managed care has been successful at capturing discounts from medical providers, but the implications have been a matter of debate. Critics argue that managed care organizations attain savings by reducing intensity of services, while others have argued that savings are 'real' and are a consequence of discounts per unit of care. To address this, we obtain separate transaction prices for hospital episodes (treatment) and for the narrowly defined surgical procedure, using the example of heart bypass surgery. Both sets of prices were drawn from a database of insurance claims of self-insured firms that offer a menu of insurance options. We use a Nash-Bargaining framework to obtain price discounts by type of insurance. Adjusting for product and patient heterogeneity, the per-procedure prices yield the anticipated pattern of discounts: Relative to traditional fee for service, point-of-service HMOs exhibited the largest discounts followed by Preferred-Provider-Organizations (18 and 12 percent, respectively). While reductions in intensity of services are not directly observable from the data, combining the results from the per-procedure and per-episode analysis yields a range of intensity reduction of 20-6 percent, with a corresponding per-unit price discount of 4-18 percent for the entire episode. We conclude that a large share cost savings by managed care organizations are due to per-unit price reductions.

10.3386/w10377.abstractZh: 一般认为，管理式护理在获取医疗服务提供商的折扣方面取得了成功，但其影响一直存在争议。批评者认为，管理式护理组织通过降低服务强度来实现节省成本，而另一些人则认为，节省的成本是“真实的”，是每单位护理服务的折扣所带来的结果。为了研究这一问题，我们分别获取了医院治疗病例和狭义定义的外科手术的费用价格，以心脏搭桥手术为例。这两组价格都来自提供多种保险选项的自我保险公司的保险索赔数据库。我们使用纳什博弈框架来根据保险类型获得价格折扣。考虑到产品和患者的异质性，每次手术的价格显示出预期的折扣模式：与传统的按服务收费方式相比，服务点HMO的折扣最大，其次是优先医疗服务组织（分别达到18%和12%）。虽然服务强度的降低并非直接可以从数据中观察到，但将每次手术和每次治疗分析的结果结合起来，发现服务强度减少了20-6%，相应的每单位价格折扣为4-18%。我们得出结论，管理式护理组织的大部分成本节省是由于每单位价格的降低所致。

abstract.text: I use data from the Current Population Surveys and Employee Benefits Surveys to analyze employer-sponsored disability insurance coverage. There does not appear to be a systematic trend from 1980 to 2000 in the fraction of workers with coverage. Disability insurance coverage rates are lower than health insurance coverage rates; low-skill, low-wage, low-tenure, part-time and small establishment workers are all less likely to have either of these fringe benefits. Public policy debates about workers without health insurance fail to consider an important economic risk these workers face in the event of an illness or injury: the risk of lost wages.

10.3386/w10382.abstractZh: 我利用当前人口调查和员工福利调查的数据来分析雇主提供的残疾保险覆盖范围。从1980年到2000年，有保险覆盖的工人比例并没有出现系统性趋势。残疾保险覆盖率低于健康保险覆盖率；低技能、低工资、工作年限短、兼职以及小型企业的工人都不太可能享有这些附加福利。关于没有健康保险的工人的公共政策讨论没有考虑到这些工人在患病或受伤时面临的一个重要经济风险：工资损失的风险。

abstract.text: The challenges consumers face in acquiring and using information are a defining feature of health care markets. In this paper, we examine demand for health information on the Internet. We find that individuals in poor health are more likely than those in better health to use the Internet to search for health information and to communicate with others about health and health care. We also find that individuals facing a higher price to obtain information from health care professionals are more likely to turn to the Internet for health information. Our findings indicate that demand for consumer health information depends on the expected benefits of information and the price of information substitutes.

10.3386/w10386.abstractZh: 消费者在获取和使用信息方面所面临的挑战是医疗保健市场的一个显著特征。在本文中，我们研究了互联网上健康信息的需求。我们发现，健康状况较差的人比健康状况较好的人更有可能使用互联网来搜索健康信息，并与其他人交流关于健康和医疗保健的信息。我们还发现，那些从医疗保健专业人士那里获取信息成本较高的人，更有可能转向互联网获取健康信息。我们的研究结果表明，对消费者健康信息的需求取决于信息带来的预期好处以及信息替代品的成本。

abstract.text: In this paper we show that omitted variables and publication bias lead to severely biased estimates of the value of a statistical life. Although our empirical results are obtained in the context of a study of choices about road safety, we suspect that the same issues plague the estimation of monetary trade-offs regarding safety in other contexts.

10.3386/w10401.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们指出遗漏变量和发表偏倚会导致对统计生命价值的估计出现严重偏差。尽管我们的实证结果是在关于道路安全选择的研究背景下获得的，但我们怀疑同样的问题也存在于其他关于安全性的货币权衡估计中。

abstract.text: We analyzed cigarette smoking among people aged 15 - 24 in approximately 90,000 households in the 1992 - 1999 U.S. Current Population Surveys. We modeled social influence as an informational externality, in which each young person's smoking informs her peers about its coolness.' The resulting family smoking game,' with each sibling's smoking endogenous, may have multiple equilibria. We found that the pro-smoking influence of a fellow smoker markedly exceeded the deterrent effect of a non-smoking peer. The phenomenon of asymmetric social influence has implications for financial markets, educational performance, criminal behavior, and other areas of inquiry where peer influence is important.

10.3386/w10409.abstractZh: 我们分析了1992年至1999年美国当前人口调查中约9万个家庭中的15至24岁人群吸烟情况。我们将社会影响建模为一种信息外部性，即每个年轻人的吸烟行为会向其同龄人传递吸烟的“酷”感。由此产生的“家庭吸烟博弈”中，每个成员的吸烟行为都是内生的，可能存在多种均衡状态。我们发现，吸烟者的吸烟行为对同龄人的劝阻作用明显低于非吸烟者的劝阻作用。这种不对称社会影响现象对金融市场、教育表现、犯罪行为以及其他需要考虑同伴影响的领域都有重要意义。

abstract.text: Long-term care currently comprises almost 10% of national health expenditures and is projected to rise rapidly over coming decades. A key, and relatively poorly understood, element of long-term care is home health care. I use a substantial change in Medicare reimbursement policy, which took the form of tightly binding average per-patient reimbursement caps, to address several questions about the market for home care. I find that the reimbursement change was associated with a large drop in the provision of home care. This drop was concentrated among unhealthy beneficiaries, which is consistent with the incentives for patient selection inherent in the per-patient caps. I find that the decline in home health utilization was not offset by increases in institutional long-term care or other medical care and that there were no associated adverse health consequences. However, approximately one-quarter of the decline in Medicare spending was offset by increases in out-of-pocket expenditures for home health care, with the offset concentrated in higher income populations. Despite the value of home health care implied by the out-of-pocket expenditures, I find that the welfare implications of the reimbursement change were ambiguous.

10.3386/w10414.abstractZh: 长期护理目前占国家卫生支出的近10%，并且预计在未来几十年内将迅速增长。长期护理中的一个关键且相对不为人所理解的方面是家庭护理。我通过 Medicare报销政策的重大调整来解决这个问题，该调整采取了严格限制每位患者报销金额上限的形式，以此来探讨关于家庭护理市场的几个问题。我发现，报销政策的调整导致了家庭护理服务的大幅减少。这种减少主要集中在健康状况不佳的受益人身上，这与每位患者报销上限所固有的患者选择激励机制是一致的。我发现，家庭护理服务的减少并没有被机构长期护理或其他医疗服务的增加所抵消，也没有带来任何相关的健康后果。然而，Medicare支出减少的约四分之一被家庭护理的自付费用增加所抵消，这种抵消效应主要集中在高收入人群身上。尽管自付费用表明了家庭护理的价值，但我发现报销政策调整对福利的影响并不明确。

abstract.text: To assess the relative impact of clinical factors versus non-clinical factors such as post acute care (PAC) supply - in determining whether patients receive care from skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) or inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) after discharge from acute care. Medicare acute hospital, IRF and SNF claims provided data on PAC choices; predictors of site of PAC chosen were generated from Medicare claims, provider of services, enrollment file, and Area Resource File data. We used multinomial logit models to predict post-acute care use by elderly patients after hospitalizations for stroke, hip fractures, or lower extremity joint replacements. A file was constructed linking Medicare acute and post-acute utilization data for all sample patients hospitalized in 1999. PAC availability is a more powerful predictor of PAC use than the clinical characteristics in many of our models. The effects of distance to providers and supply of providers are particularly clear in the choice between IRF and SNF care. The farther away the nearest IRF is, and the closer the nearest SNF is, the less likely a patient is to go to an IRF. Similarly, the fewer IRFs, and the more SNFs, there are in the patient's area the less likely the patient is to go to an IRF. In addition, if the hospital from which the patient is discharged has a related IRF or a related SNF the patient is more likely to go there. We find that the availability of PAC is a major determinant of whether patients use such care and which type of PAC facility they use. Further research is needed in order to evaluate whether these findings indicate that a greater supply of PAC leads to both higher use of institutional care and better outcomes or whether it leads to unwarranted expenditures of resources and delays in returning patients to their homes.

10.3386/w10424.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估临床因素与非临床因素（如急性护理后的护理设施供应）在决定患者出院后是否接受专业护理机构或住院康复机构护理方面的相对影响。通过医疗保险的急性医院、住院康复机构和专业护理机构索赔数据，收集了护理设施选择的相关信息；预测选择护理设施地点的因素来自医疗保险索赔数据、服务提供者信息、患者登记文件以及地区资源文件。我们使用多项逻辑回归模型来预测因中风、髋部骨折或下肢关节置换而住院的老年患者在急性护理后的护理设施使用情况。我们构建了一个文件，将1999年住院的所有患者的医疗保险急性护理和急性护理后的使用数据关联起来。在许多模型中，护理设施的可用性比临床特征更能有效预测患者的护理设施选择。在选择住院康复机构和专业护理机构时，距离服务提供者以及服务提供者数量的影响尤为明显。最近的住院康复机构距离越远，最近的专业护理机构越近，患者选择住院康复机构的可能性就越小。同样，患者所在地区住院康复机构越少，专业护理机构越多，患者选择专业护理机构的可能性就越小。此外，如果患者出院时所在的医院有相关的住院康复机构或专业护理机构，患者选择这些机构的可能性就更大。我们发现，护理设施的可用性是决定患者是否使用此类护理以及选择哪种护理设施的主要因素。需要进一步的研究来评估这些发现是否表明，更多的护理设施供应会导致更高的机构护理使用率和更好的治疗效果，还是会导致不必要的资源浪费以及患者出院后返回家中的延迟。

abstract.text: Poor and uneducated patients may not know what health care is desirable and, if fully insured, have little incentive to minimize the costs of their care. Partly in response to these concerns, most states have moved a substantial portion of their Medicaid caseloads out of traditional competitive fee-for-service (FFS) care, and into mandatory managed care (MMC) plans that severely restrict the choice of provider. We use a unique longitudinal data base of California births in order to examine the impact of this policy on pregnant women and infants. California phased in MMC creating variation in the timing of MMC. We identify the effects of MMC using changes in the regime faced by individual mothers between births. Some counties adopted single-carrier plans, while others adopted regimes with at least two carriers. Hence, we also ask whether competition between at least two carriers improved MMC outcomes. We find that MMC reduced the quality of prenatal care and increased low birth weight, prematurity, and neonatal death. Our results suggest that the competitive FFS system provided better care than the new MMC system, and that requiring the participation of at least two plans did not improve matters.

10.3386/w10429.abstractZh: 贫困且受教育程度较低的患者可能并不了解什么是理想的医疗保健服务，如果完全享有保险，他们也没有多少动力去降低医疗成本。部分出于对这些问题的回应，大多数州将大量医疗补助项目从传统的竞争性按服务收费模式转移到了强制性的管理式护理计划中，后者严格限制了医疗服务提供者的选择。我们利用加州出生数据的独特纵向数据库来研究这一政策对孕妇和婴儿的影响。加州逐步引入管理式护理计划，导致实施时间存在差异。我们通过分析个体母亲在分娩前后所面临的制度变化来识别管理式护理计划的影响。一些县采用了单一携带者计划，而另一些县则采用了至少两名携带者的制度。因此，我们还探讨了至少两名携带者之间的竞争是否改善了管理式护理计划的效果。研究发现，管理式护理计划降低了产前护理的质量，并增加了低出生体重、早产和新生儿死亡的情况。我们的结果表明，竞争性按服务收费制度所提供的护理质量优于新的管理式护理计划，而要求至少使用两种计划并不能改善护理效果。

abstract.text: One in five U.S. youngsters has a mental disorder, but we know little about the effects of these disorders on outcomes. We examine U.S. and Canadian children with symptoms of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), the most common child mental health problem. Our innovations include the use of large nationally representative samples of children, the use of questions administered to all children rather than focusing only on diagnosed cases, and the use of sibling fixed effects to control for omitted variables. We find large negative effects on test scores and schooling attainment suggesting that mental health conditions are a more important determinant of average outcomes than physical health conditions.

10.3386/w10435.abstractZh: 在美国，每五个年轻人中就有一个患有精神障碍，但我们对这些疾病对结果的影响知之甚少。我们研究了美国和加拿大患有注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的儿童的情况，这是最常见的儿童心理健康问题。我们的研究创新之处在于使用了大规模且具有全国代表性的儿童样本，对所有的儿童进行了调查，而不仅仅是针对被诊断出患有该疾病的儿童，并且使用了兄弟姐妹固定效应来控制遗漏变量。我们发现，这些疾病对考试成绩和学业成就有显著的负面影响，这表明心理健康状况是平均结果的重要决定因素，而非身体健康状况。

abstract.text: The paper examines price discounting by health maintenance organizations and preferred provider organizations in markets for hospital services. Our empirical analysis focuses on transaction prices for angioplasty, which is a relatively common procedure, with well defined 'product' characteristics. After controlling for patient and procedure heterogeneity and market power we find that on average prices for PPOs are 8% lower than fee-for-service plans, followed by point-of-service HMOs who capture a 24% discount. Our results are in general agreement with earlier work that shows that managed care discounts are 'real', after accounting for process of care.

10.3386/w10437.abstractZh: 本文研究了健康维护组织和优先医疗服务组织在医院服务市场中的价格折扣现象。我们的实证分析重点关注血管成形术的交易价格，这是一种较为常见的手术，其“产品”特征较为明确。在控制了患者和手术异质性的基础上，以及市场力量的影响后，我们发现，优先医疗服务组织的平均价格比按服务收费的计划低8%，而服务点健康维护组织的价格则低24%。我们的研究结果与早期的研究结果一致，这些研究指出，在考虑了护理过程后，管理式医疗的折扣是“真实”的。

abstract.text: The federal government spends billions of dollars each year on programs designed to increase the resources available to hospitals that serve the poor. This paper explores the intended and unintended effects of such targeted funds. First, how do these funds distort the behavior of state and local governments who wish to appropriate the funds for other uses? Second, to the extent that these funds do increase resources in the targeted hospitals, do patients benefit? We use the rapid and uneven growth in Medicaid Disproportionate Share Hospital (DSH) payments across states and hospitals to answer these questions. We identify states that were most able to appropriate DSH funds and show that, while DSH payments to public hospitals in these states were systematically diverted, DSH payments to other hospitals and in other states were not diverted. Additional resources that were made available to hospitals (rather than appropriated by the state) were associated with significant declines in infant and post-heart attack mortality. A range of evidence suggests that these improvements were due to better hospital care. Overall, our analysis implies that public subsidies can be an effective mechanism for improving medical care and outcomes for the poor, but that the impact is limited by the ability of state and local government to divert the targeted funds.

10.3386/w10440.abstractZh: 联邦政府每年花费数十亿美元用于资助旨在增加为贫困患者服务的医院资源的项目。本文探讨了此类定向资金所带来的预期与非预期影响。首先，这些资金如何扭曲那些希望将这些资金用于其他用途的州和地方政府的行为？其次，如果这些资金确实增加了目标医院的资源，患者是否从中受益？我们通过分析各州和医院之间医疗补助不成比例份额医院支付金额的快速增长和不均衡变化来回答这些问题。我们发现，那些能够更有效地利用DSH资金的州，虽然公共医院的DSH资金被系统性地挪用于其他用途，但其他医院和其他州的DSH资金则未被挪用。那些由医院自行获取的资源与婴儿死亡率和心脏病发作后死亡率的显著下降有关。一系列证据表明，这些改善是由于医院护理质量的提高所致。总体而言，我们的分析表明，公共补贴可以成为改善贫困人群医疗护理和疗效的有效机制，但其效果受到州和地方政府挪用定向资金能力的限制。

abstract.text: This paper explores whether choice of provider explains any of the observed infant health gradients, and if so, why poor women choose different providers than their richer neighbors. We exploit an exogenous change in policy that occurred in California in the early 1990s that suddenly increased Medicaid payments to hospitals and which lead to a sharp change in where women with Medicaid delivered. To characterize the extent to which poor women responded to the increase in provider access, we calculate hospital segregation indices (which measure the extent to which Medicaid mothers delivered in separate hospitals than privately insured mothers residing in the same geographic area) both before and after the policy change for each market in California and show that it fell sharply after the policy change. Even though black mothers responded least to the increase in provider choice afforded by the policy change, they benefited the most from hospital desegregation in terms of reduced neonatal mortality and decreased incidence of very low birth weight. In contrast, other groups with lower initial neonatal mortality moved more and gained less in terms of improvements in birth outcomes.

10.3386/w10445.abstractZh: 本文探讨了选择医疗服务提供者是否解释了观察到的婴儿健康差异，如果确实如此，为什么贫困女性会选择与富裕邻居不同的医疗服务提供者。我们利用了20世纪90年代初加州发生的政策变化作为研究背景，这一变化突然增加了对医院的医疗补助支付，导致拥有医疗补助的女性就诊医院发生了显著变化。为了了解贫困女性对医疗服务提供者增加的反应程度，我们计算了医院隔离指数（用于衡量拥有医疗补助的母亲与同一地理区域内私人保险母亲在哪些医院就诊的情况），并对比了政策变化前后加州各市场的数据，发现政策变化后医院隔离指数显著下降。尽管黑人母亲对政策变化带来的医疗服务选择增加反应最小，但她们在减少新生儿死亡率和降低极低出生体重发生率方面获得了最大收益。相比之下，其他初始新生儿死亡率较低的群体在改善出生结果方面获得的收益较少。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of actual subsidy receipt of single mothers on their joint employment and child care mode decisions in the post-welfare reform environment, which places a high priority on parental choice with the quality and type of care chosen. Results indicate that single mothers are highly responsive to child care subsidies by increasing their employment while moving from parental and relative care to center care in the process.

10.3386/w10459.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在福利改革后环境下，单身母亲实际获得补贴对其联合就业和育儿模式决策的影响。在改革背景下，父母的选择以及所选择的育儿质量与类型被赋予了高度优先级。研究结果表明，单身母亲对育儿补贴的反应非常积极，她们通过增加就业来应对育儿需求，同时从以父母和亲属照顾为主的模式转向以中心照顾为主的模式。

abstract.text: Employers must determine which sorts of healthcare insurance plans to offer employees and also set employee premiums for each plan provided. Depending on how they structure the premiums that employees pay across different healthcare insurance plans, plan sponsors alter the incentives to choose one plan over another. If employees know they differ by risk level but premiums do not fully reflect these risk differences, this can give rise to a so-called "death spiral" due to adverse selection. In this paper use longitudinal information from a natural experiment in the management of health benefits for a large employer to explore the impact of moving from a fixed dollar contribution policy to a risk-adjusted employer contribution policy. Our results suggest that implementing a significant risk adjustment had no discernable effect on adverse selection against the most generous indemnity insurance policy. This stands in stark contrast to previous studies, which have tended to find large impacts. Further analysis suggests that previous studies which appeared to detect plans in the throes of a death spiral, may instead have been experiencing an inexorable movement away from a non-preferred product, one that would have been inefficient for almost all workers even in the absence of adverse selection.

10.3386/w10464.abstractZh: 雇主必须确定向员工提供哪种类型的医疗保险计划，并为每种计划设定员工保费。根据员工在不同医疗保险计划中所支付的保费结构，计划发起人可以调整激励措施，以促使员工选择某一计划而非另一计划。如果员工知道自己的风险水平不同，但保费并未完全反映这些风险差异，那么由于逆向选择效应，可能会引发所谓的“死亡螺旋”。本文利用一项关于大型雇主健康福利管理的自然实验的纵向数据，探讨从固定金额缴费政策转向风险调整雇主缴费政策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，实施显著的风险调整对最慷慨的赔偿保险政策并没有明显的影响。这与以往的研究结果形成鲜明对比，以往的研究往往发现这种转变会产生巨大影响。进一步分析表明，那些似乎发现计划正处于“死亡螺旋”中的研究，实际上可能只是经历了一种不可避免地从非首选产品转向的情况，而这种情况即使在没有逆向选择的情况下，对几乎所有工人来说也是低效的。

abstract.text: This paper studies factor substitution in one important sector: the nursing home industry. Specifically, we measure the extent to which nursing homes substitute materials for labor when labor becomes relatively more expensive. From a policy perspective, factor substitution in this market is important because materials-intensive methods of care are associated with greater risks of morbidity and mortality among nursing home residents. Studying longitudinal data from 1991-1998 on nearly every nursing home in the United States, we use the method of instrumental variables (IV) to address the potential endogeneity of nursing home wages. The results from the IV models are consistent with the theory of factor substitution: higher nursing home wages are associated with lower staffing, greater use of materials (specifically, physical restraints), and a higher proportion of residents with pressure ulcers. A comparison of OLS and IV results suggests that empirical studies of factor substitution should take into account unobserved heterogeneity in factor quality.

10.3386/w10465.abstractZh: 本文研究了重要行业之一——养老院行业的要素替代现象。具体而言，我们衡量了在劳动力成本相对上升时，养老院在多大程度上用材料替代劳动力。从政策角度来看，该市场的要素替代现象非常重要，因为以材料为主的护理方式与养老院居民更高的发病率和死亡率相关。通过对1991年至1998年间美国几乎所有养老院的长期数据进行分析，我们采用工具变量方法来解决养老院工资潜在的内生性问题。工具变量模型的结果与要素替代理论一致：较高的养老院工资与较低的员工数量、更多使用材料（特别是物理约束装置）以及更高比例的患有压疮的居民相关。OLS结果与工具变量结果的比较表明，对要素替代现象的研究应考虑到要素质量上的未观测异质性。

abstract.text: This paper explores the origins and effects of occupational licensing regulation in late nineteenth and early twentieth century America. Was licensing regulation introduced to limit competition in the market for professional services at the expense of efficiency? Or was licensing adopted to reduce informational asymmetries about professional quality? To investigate these hypotheses, we analyze the determinants of licensing legislation and the effect of licensing on entry into eleven occupations. We also examine the impact of medical licensing laws on entry into the medical profession, physician earnings, mortality rates, and the incidence of medical malpractice. We believe that, at least for the Progressive Era, the evidence is more consistent with the asymmetric information hypothesis than the industry capture hypothesis.

10.3386/w10467.abstractZh: 本文探讨了19世纪末至20世纪初美国职业许可监管的起源与影响。许可监管是否是为了限制专业服务市场的竞争而引入的，从而牺牲了效率？还是为了减少关于专业质量的信息不对称而采用的？为了验证这些假设，我们分析了许可立法的决定因素，以及许可对11个职业进入市场的影響。我们还研究了医疗许可法对进入医疗行业、医生收入、死亡率以及医疗过失发生率的影响。我们认为，至少在进步时代，现有证据更支持信息不对称假说，而非行业控制假说。

abstract.text: During the past two decades, several public and private organizations have initiated programs to report publicly on the quality of medical care provided by specific hospitals and physicians. These programs have sparked broad debate among economists and policy makers concerning whether, and to what extent, they have improved or harmed medical productivity. We take advantage of a cross-sectional time series of different hospitals to address two fundamental questions about quality reporting. First, we examine whether report cards affect the distribution of patients across hospitals. Second, we determine whether report cards lead to improved medical quality among hospitals identified as particularly bad or good performers. Our data are from the longest-standing effort to measure and report health care quality the Cardiac Surgery Reporting System (CSRS) in New York State. Using data for 1991 through 1999, we find that CSRS affected both the volume of cases and future quality at hospitals identified as poor performers. Poor performing hospitals lost relatively healthy patients to competing facilities and experienced subsequent improvements in their performance as measured by risk-adjusted mortality.

10.3386/w10489.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，许多公共和私人组织开始实施计划，公开报告特定医院和医生所提供的医疗服务质量。这些计划引发了经济学家和政策制定者之间的广泛讨论，关于这些报告是否以及在多大程度上提升了或降低了医疗效率。我们利用不同医院的横截面时间序列数据，来探讨关于质量报告的两个基本问题。首先，我们研究报告卡是否影响了患者在不同医院之间的分布。其次，我们确定报告卡是否改善了被认定为表现较差或表现良好的医院的医疗质量。我们的数据来自纽约州 longest-standing的医疗服务质量测量和报告系统——心脏外科报告系统（CSRS）。通过1991年至1999年的数据，我们发现CSRS不仅影响了被认定为表现较差的医院病例数量，还影响了这些医院未来的服务质量。表现较差的医院失去了相对健康的患者，转而转向竞争性的医疗机构，随后其表现通过风险调整后的死亡率得到了改善。

abstract.text: This paper studies the links between income, sexual behavior and reported happiness. It uses recent data on a random sample of 16,000 adult Americans. The paper finds that sexual activity enters strongly positively in happiness equations. Greater income does not buy more sex, nor more sexual partners. The typical American has sexual intercourse 2-3 times a month. Married people have more sex than those who are single, divorced, widowed or separated. Sexual activity appears to have greater effects on the happiness of highly educated people than those with low levels of education. The happiness-maximizing number of sexual partners in the previous year is calculated to be 1. Highly educated females tend to have fewer sexual partners. Homosexuality has no statistically significant effect on happiness. Our conclusions are based on pooled cross-section equations in which it is not possible to correct for the endogeneity of sexual activity. The statistical results should be treated cautiously.

10.3386/w10499.abstractZh: 本文研究了收入、性行为与幸福感之间的关系。研究使用了近期的数据，样本为16,000名美国成年人。研究发现，性行为对幸福感有显著的正面影响。较高的收入并不能带来更多的性行为，也不能增加性伴侣数量。典型的美国人的性行为频率为每月2-3次。已婚人士的性行为频率高于单身、离异、丧偶或分居的人士。性行为对高教育水平人群的幸福感影响更大，而对低教育水平人群的影响则较小。计算结果显示，过去一年中使幸福感最大化的性伴侣数量为1个。高教育水平的女性往往拥有较少的性伴侣。同性性行为对幸福感没有统计学上的显著影响。我们的结论基于汇总后的横截面数据，在这些数据中无法纠正性行为的内生性问题。因此，统计结果应谨慎对待。

abstract.text: Many studies have documented large and persistent productivity differences across producers, even within narrowly defined industries.This paper both extends and departs from the past literature, which focused on technological explanations for these differences, by proposing that demand-side features also play a role in creating the observed productivity variation.The specific mechanism investigated here is the effect of spatial substitutability in the product market.When producers are densely clustered in a market, it is easier for consumers to switch between suppliers (making the market in a certain sense more competitive).Relatively inefficient producers find it more difficult to operate profitably as a result.Substitutability increases truncate the productivity distribution from below, resulting in higher minimum and average productivity levels as well as less productivity dispersion.The paper presents a model that makes this process explicit and empirically tests it using data from U.S. ready-mixed concrete plants, taking advantage of geographic variation in substitutability created by the industry's high transport costs.The results support the model's predictions and appear robust.Markets with high demand density for ready-mixed concrete -and thus high concrete plant densities -have higher lower-bound and average productivity levels and exhibit less productivity dispersion among their producers.

10.3386/w10501.abstractZh: 许多研究记录了即使在定义明确的行业内，不同生产者的生产力也存在巨大且持续的差异。本文不仅扩展了以往文献对技术因素解释这些差异的研究，还提出了需求侧因素在创造观察到的生产力差异中也起着作用的观点。本文研究的具体机制是产品市场中空间替代性的影响。当生产者在一个市场中密集聚集时，消费者更容易在供应商之间切换（这使得市场在某种程度上更具竞争力）。因此，效率较低的生产者更难实现盈利经营。替代性的增加会从下方压缩生产力分布，从而导致最低和平均生产力水平更高，同时生产者的生产力差异也更小。本文提出了一个模型来明确这一过程，并使用美国预拌混凝土厂的数据进行了实证测试，这些测试利用了该行业因运输成本较高而产生的地理性替代性差异。研究结果支持模型的预测，并且结果相当稳健。对于预拌混凝土需求密度较高的市场——因此混凝土厂密度较高的市场——其最低和平均生产力水平更高，生产者的生产力差异也更小。

abstract.text: This paper utilizes a rich longitudinal data set -- the Women's Employment Study (WES) to investigate whether obesity, which is common among women of low socioeconomic status, is a barrier to employment and earnings for current and former welfare recipients. We find evidence that, among current and former welfare recipients, high body weight is a greater barrier to labor market success for white women than for African-American women. Among white women, we consistently find a negative correlation between weight and labor market outcomes such as employment, hours worked, and earnings. Among African American women, weight is not correlated with employment, hours worked, or earnings, but it is correlated with the percentage of months spent on welfare between interviews. We provide suggestive evidence that these differences between white and African-American women in the relationship between body weight and labor market outcomes are partly due to differential weight-based discrimination in employment.

10.3386/w10508.abstractZh: 本文利用丰富的纵向数据集——女性就业研究（WES），探讨在低社会经济地位的女性中常见的肥胖问题是否成为当前和曾经领取福利的女性的就业和收入障碍。我们发现，在当前和曾经领取福利的女性中，对于白人女性而言，超重是阻碍其劳动力市场成功的主要因素，而这一点在非洲裔美国女性中并不明显。在白人女性中，体重与就业、工作时数和收入等劳动力市场结果之间存在负相关关系。而在非洲裔美国女性中，体重与就业、工作时数或收入无关，但与两次访谈之间领取福利的月份比例有关。我们有证据表明，白人女性与非洲裔美国女性在体重与劳动力市场结果之间的关系上的差异，部分是由于就业过程中基于体重的歧视造成的。

abstract.text: Mortality rates in the US fell more rapidly during the late 19th and early 20th Centuries than any other period in American history. This decline coincided with an epidemiological transition and the disappearance of a mortality "penalty" associated with living in urban areas. There is little empirical evidence and much unresolved debate about what caused these improvements, however. This paper investigates the causal influence of clean water technologies - filtration and chlorination - on mortality in major cities during the early 20th Century. Plausibly exogenous variation in the timing and location of technology adoption is used to idetify these effects, and the validity of this identifying assumption is examined in detail. We find that clean water was responsible for nearly half of the total mortality reduction in major cities, three-quarters of the infant mortality reduction, and nearly two-thirds of the child mortality reduction. Rough calculations suggest that the social rate of return to these technologies was greater than 23 to 1 with a cost per life-year saved by clean water of about $500 in 2003 dollars. Implications for developing countries are briefly considered.

10.3386/w10511.abstractZh: 在19世纪末和20世纪初，美国的死亡率下降速度比美国历史上任何其他时期都要快。这一下降与流行病学转变以及与居住在城市地区相关的死亡率“惩罚”的消失同时发生。然而，关于这些改善的原因，几乎没有实证证据，且仍有许多争议。本文研究了20世纪初清洁水技术——过滤和氯化——对主要城市死亡率的因果影响。通过假设技术采用的时间和地点的外生变化来识别这些效应，并详细探讨了这一识别假设的有效性。我们发现，清洁水技术几乎导致了主要城市总死亡率下降的一半，婴儿死亡率下降的三分之二，以及儿童死亡率下降的近三分之二。粗略计算表明，这些技术的社会回报率超过23倍，而每节省一个生命年的成本约为2003年美元价值的500美元。本文简要讨论了这些技术对发展中国家的影响。

abstract.text: Recent breakthroughs in the treatment of HIV have coincided with an increase in infection rates and an eventual slowing of reductions in HIV mortality. These trends may be causally related, if treatment improves the health and functional status of HIV+ individuals and allows them to engage in more sexual risk-taking. We examine this hypothesis empirically using access to health insurance as an instrument for treatment status. We find that treatment results in more sexual risk-taking by HIV+ adults, and possibly more of other risky behaviors like drug abuse. This relationship implies that breakthroughs in treating an incurable disease like HIV can increase precautionary behavior by the uninfected and thus reduce welfare. We also show that, in the presence of this effect, treatment and prevention are social complements for incurable diseases, even though they are substitutes for curable ones. Finally, there is less under-provision of treatment for an incurable disease than a curable one, because of the negative externalities associated with treating an incurable disease.

10.3386/w10516.abstractZh: 近期在HIV治疗方面取得的突破，与感染率的增加以及HIV死亡率的下降速度放缓同时发生。这些趋势可能存在因果关系，因为治疗能够改善HIV阳性个体的健康状况和功能状态，使他们更倾向于承担更高的性风险。我们通过使用医疗保险获取情况作为治疗状态的指标，对这一假设进行了实证分析。研究发现，治疗会导致HIV阳性成年人更倾向于承担性风险，也可能引发其他风险行为，如药物滥用。这种关系意味着，治疗像HIV这样无法治愈的疾病，可能会增加未感染者采取的预防行为，从而降低福利水平。我们还发现，在这种效应存在的情况下，治疗和预防对于无法治愈的疾病来说是一种社会互补手段，尽管它们对于可治愈的疾病来说却是替代手段。最后，由于治疗无法治愈的疾病所带来的负面外部性，无法治愈疾病的治疗供应往往少于可治愈疾病的供应。

abstract.text: This paper examines the determinants of M&A activity in the pharmaceutical-biotechnology industry and the effects of mergers using propensity scores to control for merger endogeneity. Among large firms, we find that mergers are a response to excess capacity due to anticipated patent expirations and gaps in a company's product pipeline. For small firms, mergers are primarily an exit strategy for firms in financial trouble, as indicated by low Tobin's q, few marketed products, and low cash-sales ratios. We find that it is important to control for a firm's prior propensity to merge. Firms with relatively high propensity scores experienced slower growth of sales, employees and R&D regardless of whether they actually merged, which is consistent with mergers being a response to distress. Controlling for a firm's merger propensity, large firms that merged experienced similar changes in enterprise value, sales, employees, and R&D relative to similar firms that did not merge. Merged firms had slower growth in operating profit in the third year following a merger. Thus mergers may be a response to trouble, but they are not an effective solution for large firms. Neither mergers nor propensity scores have any effect on subsequent growth in enterprise value. This confirms that market valuations on average yield unbiased predictions of the effects of mergers. Small firms that merged experienced slower R&D growth relative to similar firms that did not merge, suggesting that post-merger integration may divert cash from R&D.

10.3386/w10536.abstractZh: 本文探讨了制药生物技术行业并购活动的决定因素，以及通过倾向评分来控制并购内生性对并购影响的效应。对于大型企业而言，我们发现并购是对预期专利到期和产品管线空缺导致的过剩产能的响应。而对于小型企业来说，并购主要是陷入财务困境的企业的退出策略，这从低托宾指数、少量上市产品和低现金销售比率中可以看出来。我们发现，控制企业过去的并购倾向非常重要。无论是否真正进行了并购，倾向评分较高的企业，其销售额、员工数量和研发支出增长都较慢，这与并购是对困境的响应相一致。在控制了企业的并购倾向后，并购的大型企业与未并购的类似企业相比，其企业价值、销售额、员工数量和研发支出都经历了类似的变化。并购后的第三年，这些企业的经营利润增长较慢。因此，并购可能是对困境的响应，但对于大型企业来说，它并不是有效的解决方案。并购倾向评分与企业价值后续增长无关。这证实了市场估值平均能够无偏地预测并购的影响。与未并购的类似企业相比，并购的小型企业在研发方面的增长较慢，这表明并购后的整合可能会将资金从研发中转移出去。

abstract.text: Twenty-five cohorts of medical students were asked in their first and fourth year of school to estimate contemporaneous physician income in six different specialties. The students' income estimation errors varied systematically over time and cross-sectionally by specialty and type of student. The median student underestimated physician income by 15 percent, and the median absolute value of the estimation errors was 26 percent of actual income. Students were 35 percent more accurate when estimating market income in their fourth relative to their first year, which indicates medical students learn a considerable amount before choosing a specialty.

10.3386/w10542.abstractZh: 在医学学生的第一年和第四年，有25组学生被要求估算六种不同专科的医生收入。学生的估算误差随时间变化，并且在不同专科和类型的学生中也有所差异。中位数的学生低估了医生收入15%，估算误差的绝对值中位数为实际收入的26%。与第一年相比，学生在第四年估算市场收入时准确程度提高了35%，这表明医学学生在选择专科之前已经学到了很多知识。

abstract.text: We investigate the relationship between welfare reform and health insurance, health care utilization, and self-reported measures of health status for women aged 20-45, using nationally representative data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System. We present estimates from both difference-in-difference models (applied to single women and single women with children) and difference-in-difference-in-difference models (using married women and single women without children as comparison groups). We find that welfare reform is associated with reductions in health insurance coverage and specific measures of health care utilization, as well as an increase in the likelihood of needing care but finding it unaffordable. We find no statistically significant effects of reform on health status. Overall, effects are somewhat larger for Hispanics compared to blacks and low educated women.

10.3386/w10549.abstractZh: 我们研究了福利改革与医疗保险、医疗保健利用以及20-45岁女性的自我报告健康状况之间的关系，使用了来自行为风险因素监测系统的全国代表性数据。我们采用了差异-差异模型（适用于单身女性及有孩子的单身女性）和差异-差异-差异模型（以已婚女性和无孩子的单身女性作为对照组）来估算结果。研究发现，福利改革与医疗保险覆盖率的减少、特定医疗保健利用指标的下降以及需要医疗护理但难以负担的情况增加有关。然而，我们并未发现改革对健康状况有显著的统计影响。总体而言，对于西班牙裔女性而言，改革的影响比黑人和低教育水平女性更为显著。

abstract.text: Birth weight has emerged as the leading indicator of infant health and welfare and the central focus of infant health policy. This is because low birth weight (LBW) infants experience severe health and developmental difficulties that can impose enormous costs on society. But would the prevention of LBW generate equally sizable cost savings and health improvements? Estimates of the return to LBW-prevention from cross-sectional associations may be biased by omitted variables that cannot be influenced by policy, such as genetic factors. To address this, we compare the hospital costs, health at birth, and infant mortality rates between heavier and lighter infants from all twin pairs born in the United States. We also examine the effect of maternal smoking during pregnancy the leading risk factor for LBW in the United States on health among singleton births after controlling for detailed background characteristics. Both analyses imply substantially smaller effects of LBW than previously thought, suggesting two possibilities: 1) existing estimates overstate the true costs and consequences of LBW by at least a factor of four and by as much as a factor of 20; or 2) different LBW-preventing interventions have different health and cost consequences, implying that policy efforts that presume a single return to reducing LBW will necessarily be suboptimal.

10.3386/w10552.abstractZh: 出生体重已成为衡量婴儿健康和福利的主要指标，也是婴儿健康政策的核心关注点。这是因为低出生体重的婴儿会面临严重的健康和发育问题，这会给社会带来巨大的成本。但是，预防低出生体重是否能带来同样可观的成本节约和健康改善呢？从横断面关联数据估计的预防低出生体重的回报可能会受到无法通过政策影响的遗漏变量的影响，例如遗传因素。为了研究这个问题，我们比较了在美国出生的所有双胞胎中，体重较重的婴儿与体重较轻的婴儿在医院费用、出生时的健康状况和婴儿死亡率方面的差异。我们还研究了美国孕妇在怀孕期间吸烟这一导致低出生体重的主要风险因素对单胎婴儿健康的影响，同时控制了详细的背景特征。这两种分析都表明，低出生体重的影响比之前认为的要小得多，这提示了两种可能性：1）现有的估计值高估了低出生体重的真实成本和后果，至少是其四倍，甚至高达二十倍；或者2）不同的预防低出生体重的干预措施会带来不同的健康和成本后果，这意味着假设单一干预措施就能减少低出生体重的政策努力必然是不理想的。

abstract.text: The inverse relationship between abortion and crime has spurred new research and much controversy. If the relationship is causal, then polices that increased abortion have generated enormous external benefits from reduced crime. In previous papers, I argued that evidence for a casual relationship is weak and incomplete. In this paper, I conduct a number of new analyses intended to address criticisms of my earlier work. First, I examine closely the effects of changes in abortion rates between 1971 and 1974. Changes in abortion rates during this period were dramatic, varied widely by state, had a demonstrable effect on fertility, and were more plausibly exogenous than changes in the late 1970s and early 1980s. If abortion reduced crime, crime should have fallen sharply as these post-legalization cohorts reached their late teens and early 20s, the peak ages of criminal involvement. It did not. Second, I conduct separate estimates for whites and blacks because the effect of legalized abortion on crime should have been much larger for blacks than whites, since the effect of legalization of abortion on the fertility rates of blacks was much larger. There was little race difference in the reduction in crime. Finally, I compare changes in homicide rates before and after legalization of abortion, within states, by single year of age. The analysis of older adults is compelling because they were largely unaffected by the crack-cocaine epidemic, which was a potentially important confounding factor in earlier estimates. These analyses provide little evidence that legalized abortion reduced crime.

10.3386/w10564.abstractZh: 堕胎与犯罪之间的反向关系引发了新的研究并引发了大量争议。如果这种关系是因果关系，那么增加堕胎行为的政策确实带来了减少犯罪的巨大外部收益。在之前的论文中，我指出支持这种关系的证据较弱且不完整。在本文中，我进行了一些新的分析，旨在回应对我早期工作的批评。首先，我仔细研究了1971年至1974年间堕胎率的变化情况。这一时期的堕胎率变化非常显著，各州的差异很大，对生育率产生了明显的影响，并且这些变化比1970年代末和1980年代初的变化更为合理。如果堕胎确实减少了犯罪，那么在这些合法化后的群体达到青少年晚期和二十岁出头的年龄时，犯罪率应该会大幅下降。但实际上并没有如此。其次，我分别对白人和黑人进行了单独估计，因为合法化堕胎对黑人的犯罪影响应该比白人更大，因为堕胎合法化对黑人生育率的影响更大。犯罪率的降低在种族之间几乎没有差异。最后，我比较了各州在堕胎合法化前后按年龄单一年份划分的杀人率变化。对老年人的分析很有说服力，因为他们基本上没有受到可卡因流行的影响，而这在早期的研究中是一个重要的混淆因素。这些分析几乎没有证据表明合法化堕胎减少了犯罪。

abstract.text: We conduct a panel data analysis of 74 countries over 1980 2000 to investigate whether population health affects foreign direct investment inflows. Our main finding is that health has a positive and significant effect on such inflows for low- and middle-income countries. This finding is consistent with the view that health is an integral component of human capital in developing countries.

10.3386/w10596.abstractZh: 我们对1980年至2000年间74个国家的面板数据进行了分析，以研究人口健康是否会影响外国直接投资流入。我们的主要发现是，对于低收入和中等收入国家而言，健康对这类投资流入具有积极且显著的影响。这一发现与“健康是发展中国家人力资本的重要组成部分”的观点一致。

abstract.text: In the U.S., Great Britain, and in many other countries, the gap between the demand and the supply of human organs for transplantation is on the rise, despite the efforts of governments and health agencies to promote donor registration. In some countries of continental Europe, however, cadaveric organ procurement is based on the principle of presumed consent. Under presumed consent legislation, a deceased individual is classified as a potential donor in absence of explicit opposition to donation before death. This article analyzes the impact of presumed consent laws on donation rates. For this purpose, we construct a dataset on organ donation rates and potential factors affecting organ donation for 22 countries over a 10-year period. We find that while differences in other determinants of organ donation explain much of the variation in donation rates, after controlling for those determinants presumed consent legislation has a positive and sizeable effect on organ donation rates.

10.3386/w10604.abstractZh: 在美国、英国以及许多其他国家，尽管政府和卫生机构努力推动器官捐赠登记，但用于移植的人类器官的需求与供应之间的差距仍在扩大。然而，在欧洲大陆的一些国家，尸体器官获取是基于“推定同意”原则进行的。根据“推定同意”法律，如果死亡者在生前没有明确表示反对捐赠，则会被归类为潜在捐赠者。本文分析了“推定同意”法律对捐赠率的影响。为此，我们构建了一个包含22个国家在10年期间的器官捐赠率及相关影响因素的数据集。研究发现，虽然其他影响器官捐赠的因素解释了捐赠率的很大一部分差异，但在控制这些因素后，“推定同意”法律对器官捐赠率有积极且显著的影响。

abstract.text: We use the National Health and Nutritional Examination Survey (NHANES) III to examine the effect of the availability of the school breakfast program (SBP). Our work builds on previous research in four ways: First, we develop a transparent difference-in-differences strategy to account for unobserved differences between students with access to SBP and those without. Second, we examine serum measures of nutrient in addition to intakes based on dietary recall data. Third, we ask whether the SBP improves the diet by increasing/or decreasing the intake of nutrients relative to meaningful threshold levels. Fourth, we examine the effect of the SBP on other members of the family besides the school-aged child. We have three main findings. First, the SBP helps students build good eating habits: SBP increases scores on the healthy eating index, reduces the percentage of calories from fat, and reduces the probability of low fiber intake. Second, the SBP reduces the probability of serum micronutrient deficiencies in vitamin C, vitamin E, and folate, and it increases the probability that children meet USDA recommendations for potassium and iron intakes. Since we find no effect on total calories these results indicate that the program improves the quality of food consumed. Finally, in households with school-aged children, both preschool children and adults have healthier diets and consume less fat when the SBP is available. These results suggest that school nutrition programs may be an effective way to combat both nutritional deficiencies and excess consumption among children and their families.

10.3386/w10608.abstractZh: 我们利用国家健康与营养调查III（NHANES）的数据来研究学校早餐计划的可及性对饮食影响。我们的研究在四个方面继承了以往的研究：首先，我们采用了一种透明的差异比较策略，以处理有和没有学校早餐计划的学生之间的未观测到的差异；其次，我们除了基于饮食回忆数据的摄入量外，还研究了血清中的营养指标；第三，我们探讨了学校早餐计划是否通过增加或减少相对于一定阈值的营养摄入量来改善饮食；第四，我们研究了学校早餐计划对家庭其他成员的影响，而不仅仅是学龄儿童。我们的主要发现如下：首先，学校早餐计划有助于学生养成良好的饮食习惯：它提高了健康饮食指数的得分，减少了来自脂肪的热量比例，并降低了低纤维摄入的概率；其次，学校早餐计划降低了血清中维生素C、维生素E和叶酸等微量营养素缺乏的概率，并增加了儿童达到美国农业部关于钾和铁摄入量建议的可能性；由于我们没有发现总热量方面的影响，这些结果表明该计划提高了所摄入食物的质量。最后，在有学龄儿童的家庭中，无论是学龄前儿童还是成人，在拥有学校早餐计划的情况下，他们的饮食更健康，脂肪摄入量也更低。这些结果表明，学校营养计划可能是对抗儿童及其家庭中的营养不足和过度消费的有效手段。

abstract.text: In this paper we explore to what extent secondary policy issues are influenced by electoral incentives.We develop a political agency model in which a politician decides on both a frontline policy issue, such as the level of public spending, and a secondary policy issue, such as environmental policy.The model shows under which conditions the incumbent finds it worthwhile to manipulate the secondary policy to attract additional votes to his platform.We test the predictions of the model using state-level panel data on Gubernatorial environmental policy choices over the years 1960-2000.In contrast to the popular view that choices on secondary policy instruments are largely determined by lobbying, we find strong effects of electoral incentives on environmental policy.

10.3386/w10609.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了次要政策问题在多大程度上受到选举激励的影响。我们构建了一个政治代理模型，其中政治家需要同时处理一线政策问题，例如公共支出水平，以及次要政策问题，例如环境政策。该模型展示了在何种情况下，现任政治家会考虑操纵次要政策以吸引更多选票支持其政纲。我们通过使用1960年至2000年间各州州长环境政策选择的相关面板数据来验证该模型的预测结果。与普遍的观点不同，我们认为次要政策工具的决策在很大程度上是由游说活动决定的，而实际上选举激励对环境政策的决策有着显著的影响。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the empirical relationship between the prices of cocaine and heroin and objective indicators of use. The set of outcomes is drug related hospital emergency department admissions where cocaine and heroin are cited, for 21 large U.S. metropolitan areas. These outcomes are superior to subjective self-reports, and are policy-relevant since they directly measure a large component of the health-care costs associated with heavy or chronic drug usage. Panel data methodology is used to identify the empirical link between drug prices and these indicators. Results indicate that health consequences associated with heavy or chronic drug use are negatively related to drug prices, an instrument of drug control policy. The elasticity of the probability of a cocaine mention with respect to own-price is estimated at -0.27, and the corresponding elasticity for the probability of a heroin mention is -0.15. The probability of any drug related episode, which captures polydrug usage, is also significantly negatively related to both cocaine and heroin prices. Cross-price effects are consistent with a complementary relationship between cocaine and heroin. Models indicate the presence of negative lagged price effects, confirming the strong addictive aspects of both drugs and the cumulative adverse effects of drug use on health.

10.3386/w10619.abstractZh: 本文估计了可卡因和海洛因价格与用药客观指标之间的实证关系。研究样本为21个美国大都市区的药物相关急诊入院病例，其中涉及可卡因和海洛因。这些结果优于主观自我报告，并且具有政策相关性，因为它们直接衡量了与重度或慢性药物使用相关的医疗成本的重要组成部分。采用面板数据方法来确定药物价格与这些指标之间的实证联系。结果表明，与重度或慢性药物使用相关的健康后果与药物价格呈负相关，这是药物控制政策的工具之一。可卡因价格自身变化对药物提及概率的弹性估计为-0.27，海洛因价格对应的弹性为-0.15。任何与药物相关的事件概率也与可卡因和海洛因价格显著负相关。交叉价格效应表明可卡因和海洛因之间存在互补关系。模型显示存在负面的滞后价格效应，这证实了这两种药物的强烈成瘾性以及药物使用对健康的累积负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a functional approach to designing and managing the financial systems of countries, regions, firms, households, and other entities. It is a synthesis of the neoclassical, neo-institutional, and behavioral perspectives. Neoclassical theory is an ideal driver to link science and global practice in finance because its prescriptions are robust across time and geopolitical borders. By itself, however, neoclassical theory provides little prescription or prediction of the institutional structure of financial systems that is, the specific kinds of financial intermediaries, markets, and regulatory bodies that will or should evolve in response to underlying changes in technology, politics, demographics, and cultural norms. The neoclassical model therefore offers important, but incomplete, guidance to decision makers seeking to understand and manage the process of institutional change. In accomplishing this task, the neo-institutional and behavioral perspectives can be very useful. In this proposed synthesis of the three approaches, functional and structural finance (FSF), institutional structure is endogenous. When particular transaction costs or behavioral patterns produce large departures from the predictions of the ideal frictionless' neoclassical equilibrium for a given institutional structure, new institutions tend to develop that partially offset the resulting inefficiencies. In the longer run, after institutional structures have had time to fully develop, the predictions of the neoclassical model will be approximately valid for asset prices and resource allocations. Through a series of examples, the paper sets out the reasoning behind the FSF synthesis and illustrates its application.

10.3386/w10620.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于设计和管理国家、地区、企业、家庭及其他实体金融系统的功能性方法。它融合了新古典主义、新制度主义和行为主义的观点。新古典主义理论是连接科学与金融实践的理想工具，因为其理论框架具有跨时间和地缘政治边界的稳健性。然而，新古典主义理论本身并不能提供关于金融系统制度结构的具体建议或预测，即哪些类型的金融中介、市场以及监管机构会或应该随着技术、政治、人口统计和文化规范的变化而演变。因此，新古典主义模型为决策者理解和管理制度变革过程提供了重要但不够全面的指导。在实现这一目标的过程中，新制度主义和行为主义观点可以发挥非常重要的作用。在这项对三种方法的综合研究中，功能性金融与结构性金融与制度结构是相互依存的。当特定的交易成本或行为模式导致与理想的无摩擦新古典均衡预测出现较大偏差时，新的制度就会形成，从而部分弥补由此产生的效率低下问题。从长远来看，在制度结构完全形成之后，新古典模型的预测对于资产价格和资源配置将具有大致的有效性。通过一系列案例，本文阐述了这种综合方法背后的逻辑，并展示了其应用实例。

abstract.text: Previous studies, by relying on nationally representative surveys, have overlooked the important fact that use of addictive substances is not uniformly distributed; subgroups of hardcore users account for most of the drug consumption. This study employs the Drug Use Forecasting system to analyze the demand for cocaine and heroin by arrestees, employing objective indicators of use based on urinalysis. The data are repeated city cross-sections, and panel data methodologies are employed to control for policy endogeneity. Cocaine and heroin prices have a negative effect on the probability of use even among this group of heavy users. Results indicate that subjective, self-reported measures of participation are likely to be under-reported impart bias to estimates of the price elasticity. The own-price cocaine participation elasticity is about 0.17, and the own-price heroin participation elasticity is about 0.09 for arrestees. This contemporaneous elasticity understates the full effect, and the long-run price elasticity is about twice the magnitude. Estimated cross-price elasticities indicate that cocaine and heroin are economic complements. While these findings show that higher penalties, enforcement, and supply reduction activities can discourage participation by heavy users, the elasticities are smaller in magnitude relative to the estimates in the prior literature.

10.3386/w10648.abstractZh: 以往的研究依赖于全国性的代表性调查，却忽视了这样一个重要事实：成瘾物质的使用并非均匀分布；大多数药物消费由极端使用者构成。本研究采用药物使用预测系统，通过尿液分析等客观指标来分析被捕者对于可卡因和海洛因的需求。数据采用重复的城市横截面样本，并采用面板数据方法来控制政策内生性。即使在这一组重度使用者中，可卡因和海洛因的价格对使用概率也有负面影响。研究结果表明，主观自我报告的参与程度可能被低估，这会对价格弹性的估计产生偏差。被捕者对于可卡因的自价格参与弹性约为0.17，对于海洛因的自价格参与弹性约为0.09。这种同时期的弹性低估了实际影响，而长期价格弹性的幅度大约是其两倍。估计的跨价格弹性表明，可卡因和海洛因是经济互补品。虽然这些发现表明，更高的处罚、执法力度以及供应减少措施可以抑制重度使用者的参与行为，但这些弹性的数值相对于以往文献的估计值来说要小一些。

abstract.text: Women have worse self-rated health and more hospitalization episodes than men from early adolescence to late middle age, but are less likely to die at each age. We use 14 years of data from the U.S. National Health Interview Survey to examine this paradox. Our results indicate that the difference in self-assessed health between women and men can be entirely explained by differences in the distribution of the chronic conditions they face. Although on average women have worse self-rated health than men, women and men with the same chronic conditions have the same self-rated health. The results for hospital episodes are somewhat different. While the effect of poor health on hospital episodes is the same for men and women, men with respiratory cancer, cardiovascular disease, and bronchitis are more likely to experience hospital episodes than women who suffer from the same chronic conditions, implying that men may experience more severe forms of these conditions. The same is true for mortality. Although the effects of many chronic conditions on the probability of death are the same for women and men, men who report having cardiovascular disease and certain lung disorders are significantly more likely to die than women with these conditions. While some of the gender difference in mortality can be explained by differences in the distribution of chronic conditions, an equally large share can be attributed to the larger adverse effects of these conditions on male mortality. Is smoking the smoking gun? Conditions for which we find excess male hospitalizations and mortality are generally smoking-related.

10.3386/w10653.abstractZh: 从青少年早期到中年后期，女性的自我健康评估通常较差，住院次数也多于男性，但在各个年龄阶段，女性死亡的可能性较低。我们利用美国国家健康访谈调查中的14年数据来研究这一矛盾现象。研究结果表明，女性与男性在自我健康评估上的差异完全可以由他们所面临的慢性疾病的分布差异来解释。尽管平均而言女性的自我健康评估较差，但患有相同慢性疾病的女性和男性在自我健康评估方面是相同的。关于住院次数的研究结果则有所不同。虽然健康状况不佳对住院次数的影响对男性和女性来说是相同的，但患有肺癌、心血管疾病和支气管炎的男性比患有相同慢性疾病的女性更有可能住院，这表明男性可能面临更严重的疾病状况。同样的情况也适用于死亡率。尽管许多慢性疾病对死亡概率的影响对男性和女性来说是相同的，但报告患有心血管疾病和某些肺部疾病的男性比患有这些疾病的女性更有可能死亡。虽然性别差异在死亡率上的部分原因可以由慢性疾病的分布差异来解释，但同样大的部分原因可以归因于这些疾病对男性死亡率的更大负面影响。吸烟是否是导致男性住院和死亡增加的原因呢？我们发现男性住院和死亡人数增加的情况通常与吸烟有关。

abstract.text: Disease has traveled with goods and people since the earliest times. Armed globalization spread disease, to the extent of eliminating entire populations. The geography of disease shaped patterns of colonization and industrialization throughout the now poor world. Many see related threats to public health from current globalization. Multilateral and bilateral trade agreements do not always adequately represent the interests of poor countries, the General Agreement on Trade in Services may restrict the freedom of signatories to shape their own health delivery systems, and it remains unclear whether current arrangements for intellectual property rights are in the interests of citizens of poor countries with HIV/AIDS. However, to the extent that globalization promotes economic growth, population health may benefit, and there has been substantial reductions in poverty and in international inequalities in life-expectancy over the last 50 years. Although there is a strong inverse relationship between the poverty and life-expectancy in levels, gains in life expectancy have been only weakly correlated with growth rates and, in the last decade, the HIV/AIDS epidemic has widened international inequalities in life expectancy. The rapid transmission of health knowledge and therapies from one rich country to another has led to a swift convergence of adult mortality rates among the rich of the world, particularly men. Globalization would do much for global health if transmission from rich to poor countries could be accelerated.

10.3386/w10669.abstractZh: 自古以来，疾病就随着商品和人们流动。全球化的推进使得疾病得以传播，甚至导致部分人口灭绝。疾病的地理分布影响了殖民化和工业化的进程，这些进程至今仍在影响着那些贫穷的国家。许多人认为当前的全球化对公共健康构成了威胁。多边和双边贸易协定并不总是能够充分代表贫穷国家的利益，《服务贸易总协定》可能会限制签约国自主构建卫生体系的自由，而且目前关于知识产权的安排是否有利于感染艾滋病的贫穷国家的公民，仍不清楚。不过，只要全球化能够促进经济增长，人口健康就有可能得到改善。在过去50年里，贫困程度和国际预期寿命的不平等现象都得到了显著减少。尽管贫困程度与预期寿命之间存在强烈的负相关关系，但预期寿命的增长与经济增长率之间的关联却很弱。在过去的十年里，艾滋病的流行进一步加剧了国际预期寿命的不平等现象。健康知识和疗法的快速传播，使得世界上的富裕国家，尤其是男性，在成人死亡率方面实现了迅速的趋同。如果能够从富裕国家向贫穷国家传播这些知识和疗法，全球化将对全球健康产生巨大的积极影响。

abstract.text: This paper identifies which types of patients and hospitals have abusive Medicare billings that are responsive to law enforcement. For a 20 percent random sample of elderly Medicare beneficiaries hospitalized from 1994-98 with one or more of six illnesses that are prone to abuse, we obtain longitudinal claims data linked with Social Security death records, hospital characteristics, and state/year-level anti-fraud enforcement efforts. We show that increased enforcement leads certain types of types of patients and hospitals to have lower billings, without adverse consequences for patients' health outcomes.

10.3386/w10677.abstractZh: 本文确定了哪些类型的患者和医院存在对执法机构具有敏感性的滥用医疗保险费用的情况。通过对1994年至1998年间因六种易滥用疾病之一而住院的老年医疗保险受益人进行20%的随机抽样，我们获得了与社会保障死亡记录、医院特征以及州/年度级别的反欺诈执法努力相关的纵向索赔数据。研究表明，加强执法力度能够降低某些类型的患者和医院的费用，而不会对患者的健康结果产生负面影响。

abstract.text: We use survey data that have been linked to medical records data and city-level drug prices to estimate the demand for illicit drugs among pregnant women. The prevalence of prenatal drug use based on post partum interviews was much lower than that based on evidence in the mothers' and babies' medical records. We found that a $10 increase in the retail price of a gram of pure cocaine decreases illicit drug use by 12 to 15%. The estimated price effects for heroin are lower than for cocaine and are less robust across alternative model specifications. This study provides the first estimates of the effects of drug prices on prenatal drug use and yields important information about the potential of drug enforcement as a tool for improving birth outcomes.

10.3386/w10688.abstractZh: 我们使用与医疗记录数据和城市级药品价格相关的调查数据，来估算孕妇对非法药物的需求。基于产后访谈得出的产前药物使用率，远低于基于母亲和婴儿医疗记录得出的数据。我们发现，纯可卡因零售价格每上涨10美元，非法药物使用率就会下降12%到15%。海洛因的价格效应低于可卡因，并且在不同的模型设定下表现并不稳定。这项研究首次估算了药品价格对产前药物使用的影响，并提供了关于药物执法作为改善出生结果工具潜力的重要信息。

abstract.text: This study investigates how maternal employment is related to the outcomes of 10 and 11 year olds after controlling for a wide variety of child, mother and family background characteristics. The results suggest that the mother's labor supply has deleterious effects on cognitive development, obesity and possibly risky behaviors such as smoking or drinking, while reducing behavior problems. These negative consequences are quite small for the average child, however, and usually restricted to relatively long maternal work hours. Less intensive employment is often associated with favorable outcomes and labor supply after the first three years typically has little effect. By contrast, large adverse consequences are frequently obtained for advantaged' adolescents, with negative impacts predicted even for limited amounts of maternal labor supply and for work during the child's fourth through ninth year.

10.3386/w10691.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在控制多种儿童、母亲和家庭背景特征后，母亲就业状况与10岁和11岁儿童的发展结果之间的关系。研究结果表明，母亲的工作时间对儿童的认知发展、肥胖问题以及吸烟和饮酒等风险行为的负面影响较大，同时也有助于减少行为问题。然而，这些负面影响的程度对于普通儿童来说相当有限，通常只发生在母亲工作时间较长的情况下。相比之下，较为宽松的就业状况通常能带来积极的结果，而母亲在出生后的前三年工作时间的增加通常影响较小。然而，对于处于优势地位的青少年来说，母亲的工作时间即使有限，也会带来严重的负面影响，甚至在儿童第四至第九年期间的工作也会产生不良影响。

abstract.text: In connection with an earlier paper on the exchange of live donor kidneys (Roth, Sonmez, and Unver 2004) the authors entered into discussions with New England transplant surgeons and their colleagues in the transplant community, aimed at implementing a Kidney Exchange program. In the course of those discussions it became clear that a likely first step will be to implement pairwise exchanges, between just two patient-donor pairs, as these are logistically simpler than exchanges involving more than two pairs. Furthermore, the experience of these surgeons suggests to them that patient and surgeon preferences over kidneys should be 0-1, i.e. that patients and surgeons should be indifferent among kidneys from healthy donors whose kidneys are compatible with the patient. This is because, in the United States, transplants of compatible live kidneys have about equal graft survival probabilities, regardless of the closeness of tissue types between patient and donor (unless there is a rare perfect match). In the present paper we show that, although the pairwise constraint eliminates some potential exchanges, there is a wide class of constrained-efficient mechanisms that are strategy-proof when patient-donor pairs and surgeons have 0-1 preferences. This class of mechanisms includes deterministic mechanisms that would accommodate the kinds of priority setting that organ banks currently use for the allocation of cadaver organs, as well as stochastic mechanisms that allow considerations of distributive justice to be addressed.

10.3386/w10698.abstractZh: 在之前关于活体捐赠者肾脏交换的论文（Roth、Sonmez和Unver，2004年）中，作者与新英格兰地区的移植外科医生及移植领域的同行进行了讨论，旨在实施一个肾脏交换计划。在讨论过程中，人们意识到，可能的第一步是实施两两交换，即仅涉及两对病人与捐赠者，因为这种方式在物流上更为简单。此外，这些外科医生的经验表明，病人和外科医生对肾脏的偏好应该是0-1的，也就是说，病人和外科医生对来自健康捐赠者的肾脏应该是无差别的，只要这些肾脏与患者的情况相容。因为在美国，兼容的活体肾脏的移植成功率大致相同，无论病人与捐赠者之间的组织类型有多接近（除非存在罕见的完全匹配）。在本文中，我们展示了尽管两两交换的限制排除了一些潜在的交换方案，但存在一类受限但高效的机制，当病人与捐赠者以及外科医生都有0-1偏好时，这些机制是策略安全的。这类机制包括确定性机制，可以适应器官库目前用于分配尸体器官的优先设置方式，以及允许考虑分配正义的随机机制。

abstract.text: The 'Illegitimacy Bonus,' part of 1996 welfare reform legislation, awarded $100 million in each of five years to the five states with the greatest reduction in the nonmarital birth ratio. Three states -- Alabama, Michigan, and Washington DC -- won bonuses four or more times each, claiming nearly 60% of award monies. However, in none of these three states was the decline in the nonmarital birth ratio linked to increases in proportions married, and only in Michigan was it linked to declines in nonmarital (relative to marital) fertility within demographic groups, behavioral changes that the Illegitimacy Bonus was presumably intended to reward. Shifts in the racial composition of births accounted for 1/3 (Michigan), 2/3 (DC) or all (Alabama) of the decline in the nonmarital birth ratio. The non-marital birth ratio fell most in DC, averaging 1.5 percentage points per year over the award period. However, the number of black children born in DC fell by nearly one half from 1991 to 2001. Changes in population composition alone primarily a decline in the number of black women aged 15 to 34 can account for the entire decline in the nonmarital birth ratio in DC between 1990 and 2000.

10.3386/w10699.abstractZh: 1996年福利改革立法中的“非婚生育减少奖励”制度，每年向非婚生育比例下降最严重的五个州各授予1亿美元。阿拉巴马州、密歇根州和华盛顿特区这三个州分别获得了四次或更多的奖励，占全部奖励资金的近60%。然而，在这三个州中，非婚生育比例的下降并未与已婚人口比例的增加相关联，只有密歇根州发现非婚生育比例下降与人口群体中的非婚生育率下降有关，而这种行为变化正是非婚生育奖励制度旨在奖励的。出生人口的种族构成变化分别解释了阿拉巴马州非婚生育比例下降的1/3、华盛顿特区的2/3，以及全部下降的原因。在华盛顿特区的非婚生育比例下降最为明显，奖励期间年均下降1.5个百分点。不过，从1991年到2001年，华盛顿特区的黑人儿童数量减少了近一半。仅人口构成的变化，尤其是15至34岁黑人女性数量的减少，就能解释1990年至2000年间华盛顿特区非婚生育比例下降的全部原因。

abstract.text: Do urban hospital closures affect health care access or health outcomes? We study closures in Los Angeles County between 1997 and 2003, through their effect on distance to the nearest hospital. We find that increased distance to the nearest hospital shifts regular care away from emergency rooms and outpatient clinics to doctor's offices. While most residents are otherwise unaffected by closures, lower-income residents report more difficulty accessing care, working age residents are less likely to receive HIV tests, and seniors less likely to receive flu shots. We also find some evidence that increased distance raises infant mortality rates and stronger evidence that it increases deaths from unintentional injuries and heart attacks.

10.3386/w10700.abstractZh: 城市医院的关闭是否会影响医疗保健的获取或健康结果？我们研究了1997年至2003年间洛杉矶县的医院关闭情况，以及这些关闭对居民到最近医院距离的影响。研究发现，距离最近医院的距离增加会导致常规医疗服务从急诊室和门诊诊所转移到医生办公室。虽然大多数居民并未受到关闭的影响，但低收入居民报告说难以获得医疗服务；工作年龄的居民接受HIV检测的可能性较低；老年人接种流感疫苗的可能性也较低。我们还发现，距离增加可能会提高婴儿死亡率，并且更有证据表明，距离增加会导致非故意伤害和心脏病发作的死亡率上升。

abstract.text: Previous research has convincingly shown that abortion legalization in the early 1970s led to a significant drop in fertility at that time. But this decline may have either represented a delay in births from a point where they were have represented a permanent reduction in fertility. We combine data from the 1970 U.S. Census and microdata from 1968 to 1999 Vital Statistics records to calculate lifetime fertility of women in the 1930s through 1960s birth cohorts. We examine whether those women who were born in early legalizing states and who passed through the early 1970s in their peak childbearing years had differential lifetime fertility patterns compared to women born in other states and in different birth cohorts. We consider the impact of abortion legalization on both the number of children ever born as well as the distribution of number of children ever born. Our results indicate that much of the reduction in fertility at the time abortion was legalized was permanent in that women did not have more subsequent births as a result. We also find that this result is largely attributable to an increase in the number of women who remained childless throughout their fertile years.
